```sample
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to check the commit log message.
# Called by "git commit" with one argument, the name of the file
# that has the commit message.  The hook should exit with non-zero
# status after issuing an appropriate message if it wants to stop the
# commit.  The hook is allowed to edit the commit message file.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "commit-msg".

# Uncomment the below to add a Signed-off-by line to the message.
# Doing this in a hook is a bad idea in general, but the prepare-commit-msg
# hook is more suited to it.
#
# SOB=$(git var GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT | sed -n 's/^\(.*>\).*$/Signed-off-by: \1/p')
# grep -qs "^$SOB" "$1" || echo "$SOB" >> "$1"

# This example catches duplicate Signed-off-by lines.

test "" = "$(grep '^Signed-off-by: ' "$1" |
	 sort | uniq -c | sed -e '/^[ 	]*1[ 	]/d')" || {
	echo >&2 Duplicate Signed-off-by lines.
	exit 1
}
```

### projeto_narrative-write/.git/hooks/fsmonitor-watchman.sample

*Extensão:* `sample` · *Tamanho:* 4.6 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```sample
#!/usr/bin/perl

use strict;
use warnings;
use IPC::Open2;

# An example hook script to integrate Watchman
# (https://facebook.github.io/watchman/) with git to speed up detecting
# new and modified files.
#
# The hook is passed a version (currently 2) and last update token
# formatted as a string and outputs to stdout a new update token and
# all files that have been modified since the update token. Paths must
# be relative to the root of the working tree and separated by a single NUL.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "query-watchman" and set
# 'git config core.fsmonitor .git/hooks/query-watchman'
#
my ($version, $last_update_token) = @ARGV;

# Uncomment for debugging
# print STDERR "$0 $version $last_update_token\n";

# Check the hook interface version
if ($version ne 2) {
	die "Unsupported query-fsmonitor hook version '$version'.\n" .
	    "Falling back to scanning...\n";
}

my $git_work_tree = get_working_dir();

my $retry = 1;

my $json_pkg;
eval {
	require JSON::XS;
	$json_pkg = "JSON::XS";
	1;
} or do {
	require JSON::PP;
	$json_pkg = "JSON::PP";
};

launch_watchman();

sub launch_watchman {
	my $o = watchman_query();
	if (is_work_tree_watched($o)) {
		output_result($o->{clock}, @{$o->{files}});
	}
}

sub output_result {
	my ($clockid, @files) = @_;

	# Uncomment for debugging watchman output
	# open (my $fh, ">", ".git/watchman-output.out");
	# binmode $fh, ":utf8";
	# print $fh "$clockid\n@files\n";
	# close $fh;

	binmode STDOUT, ":utf8";
	print $clockid;
	print "\0";
	local $, = "\0";
	print @files;
}

sub watchman_clock {
	my $response = qx/watchman clock "$git_work_tree"/;
	die "Failed to get clock id on '$git_work_tree'.\n" .
		"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $? != 0;

	return $json_pkg->new->utf8->decode($response);
}

sub watchman_query {
	my $pid = open2(\*CHLD_OUT, \*CHLD_IN, 'watchman -j --no-pretty')
	or die "open2() failed: $!\n" .
	"Falling back to scanning...\n";

	# In the query expression below we're asking for names of files that
	# changed since $last_update_token but not from the .git folder.
	#
	# To accomplish this, we're using the "since" generator to use the
	# recency index to select candidate nodes and "fields" to limit the
	# output to file names only. Then we're using the "expression" term to
	# further constrain the results.
	my $last_update_line = "";
	if (substr($last_update_token, 0, 1) eq "c") {
		$last_update_token = "\"$last_update_token\"";
		$last_update_line = qq[\n"since": $last_update_token,];
	}
	my $query = <<"	END";
		["query", "$git_work_tree", {$last_update_line
			"fields": ["name"],
			"expression": ["not", ["dirname", ".git"]]
		}]
	END

	# Uncomment for debugging the watchman query
	# open (my $fh, ">", ".git/watchman-query.json");
	# print $fh $query;
	# close $fh;

	print CHLD_IN $query;
	close CHLD_IN;
	my $response = do {local $/; <CHLD_OUT>};

	# Uncomment for debugging the watch response
	# open ($fh, ">", ".git/watchman-response.json");
	# print $fh $response;
	# close $fh;

	die "Watchman: command returned no output.\n" .
	"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $response eq "";
	die "Watchman: command returned invalid output: $response\n" .
	"Falling back to scanning...\n" unless $response =~ /^\{/;

	return $json_pkg->new->utf8->decode($response);
}

sub is_work_tree_watched {
	my ($output) = @_;
	my $error = $output->{error};
	if ($retry > 0 and $error and $error =~ m/unable to resolve root .* directory (.*) is not watched/) {
		$retry--;
		my $response = qx/watchman watch "$git_work_tree"/;
		die "Failed to make watchman watch '$git_work_tree'.\n" .
		    "Falling back to scanning...\n" if $? != 0;
		$output = $json_pkg->new->utf8->decode($response);
		$error = $output->{error};
		die "Watchman: $error.\n" .
		"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $error;

		# Uncomment for debugging watchman output
		# open (my $fh, ">", ".git/watchman-output.out");
		# close $fh;

		# Watchman will always return all files on the first query so
		# return the fast "everything is dirty" flag to git and do the
		# Watchman query just to get it over with now so we won't pay
		# the cost in git to look up each individual file.
		my $o = watchman_clock();
		$error = $output->{error};

		die "Watchman: $error.\n" .
		"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $error;

		output_result($o->{clock}, ("/"));
		$last_update_token = $o->{clock};

		eval { launch_watchman() };
		return 0;
	}

	die "Watchman: $error.\n" .
	"Falling back to scanning...\n" if $error;

	return 1;
}

sub get_working_dir {
	my $working_dir;
	if ($^O =~ 'msys' || $^O =~ 'cygwin') {
		$working_dir = Win32::GetCwd();
		$working_dir =~ tr/\\/\//;
	} else {
		require Cwd;
		$working_dir = Cwd::cwd();
	}

	return $working_dir;
}
```

### projeto_narrative-write/.git/hooks/pre-commit.sample

*Extensão:* `sample` · *Tamanho:* 1.6 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```sample
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to verify what is about to be committed.
# Called by "git commit" with no arguments.  The hook should
# exit with non-zero status after issuing an appropriate message if
# it wants to stop the commit.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "pre-commit".

if git rev-parse --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1
then
	against=HEAD
else
	# Initial commit: diff against an empty tree object
	against=$(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null)
fi

# If you want to allow non-ASCII filenames set this variable to true.
allownonascii=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allownonascii)

# Redirect output to stderr.
exec 1>&2

# Cross platform projects tend to avoid non-ASCII filenames; prevent
# them from being added to the repository. We exploit the fact that the
# printable range starts at the space character and ends with tilde.
if [ "$allownonascii" != "true" ] &&
	# Note that the use of brackets around a tr range is ok here, (it's
	# even required, for portability to Solaris 10's /usr/bin/tr), since
	# the square bracket bytes happen to fall in the designated range.
	test $(git diff-index --cached --name-only --diff-filter=A -z $against |
	  LC_ALL=C tr -d '[ -~]\0' | wc -c) != 0
then
	cat <<\EOF
Error: Attempt to add a non-ASCII file name.

This can cause problems if you want to work with people on other platforms.

To be portable it is advisable to rename the file.

If you know what you are doing you can disable this check using:

  git config hooks.allownonascii true
EOF
	exit 1
fi

# If there are whitespace errors, print the offending file names and fail.
exec git diff-index --check --cached $against --
```

### projeto_narrative-write/.git/hooks/pre-push.sample

*Extensão:* `sample` · *Tamanho:* 1.3 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```sample
#!/bin/sh

# An example hook script to verify what is about to be pushed.  Called by "git
# push" after it has checked the remote status, but before anything has been
# pushed.  If this script exits with a non-zero status nothing will be pushed.
#
# This hook is called with the following parameters:
#
# $1 -- Name of the remote to which the push is being done
# $2 -- URL to which the push is being done
#
# If pushing without using a named remote those arguments will be equal.
#
# Information about the commits which are being pushed is supplied as lines to
# the standard input in the form:
#
#   <local ref> <local oid> <remote ref> <remote oid>
#
# This sample shows how to prevent push of commits where the log message starts
# with "WIP" (work in progress).

remote="$1"
url="$2"

zero=$(git hash-object --stdin </dev/null | tr '[0-9a-f]' '0')

while read local_ref local_oid remote_ref remote_oid
do
	if test "$local_oid" = "$zero"
	then
		# Handle delete
		:
	else
		if test "$remote_oid" = "$zero"
		then
			# New branch, examine all commits
			range="$local_oid"
		else
			# Update to existing branch, examine new commits
			range="$remote_oid..$local_oid"
		fi

		# Check for WIP commit
		commit=$(git rev-list -n 1 --grep '^WIP' "$range")
		if test -n "$commit"
		then
			echo >&2 "Found WIP commit in $local_ref, not pushing"
			exit 1
		fi
	fi
done

exit 0
```

### projeto_narrative-write/.git/hooks/pre-rebase.sample

*Extensão:* `sample` · *Tamanho:* 4.8 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```sample
#!/bin/sh
#
# Copyright (c) 2006, 2008 Junio C Hamano
#
# The "pre-rebase" hook is run just before "git rebase" starts doing
# its job, and can prevent the command from running by exiting with
# non-zero status.
#
# The hook is called with the following parameters:
#
# $1 -- the upstream the series was forked from.
# $2 -- the branch being rebased (or empty when rebasing the current branch).
#
# This sample shows how to prevent topic branches that are already
# merged to 'next' branch from getting rebased, because allowing it
# would result in rebasing already published history.

publish=next
basebranch="$1"
if test "$#" = 2
then
	topic="refs/heads/$2"
else
	topic=`git symbolic-ref HEAD` ||
	exit 0 ;# we do not interrupt rebasing detached HEAD
fi

case "$topic" in
refs/heads/??/*)
	;;
*)
	exit 0 ;# we do not interrupt others.
	;;
esac

# Now we are dealing with a topic branch being rebased
# on top of master.  Is it OK to rebase it?

# Does the topic really exist?
git show-ref -q "$topic" || {
	echo >&2 "No such branch $topic"
	exit 1
}

# Is topic fully merged to master?
not_in_master=`git rev-list --pretty=oneline ^master "$topic"`
if test -z "$not_in_master"
then
	echo >&2 "$topic is fully merged to master; better remove it."
	exit 1 ;# we could allow it, but there is no point.
fi

# Is topic ever merged to next?  If so you should not be rebasing it.
only_next_1=`git rev-list ^master "^$topic" ${publish} | sort`
only_next_2=`git rev-list ^master           ${publish} | sort`
if test "$only_next_1" = "$only_next_2"
then
	not_in_topic=`git rev-list "^$topic" master`
	if test -z "$not_in_topic"
	then
		echo >&2 "$topic is already up to date with master"
		exit 1 ;# we could allow it, but there is no point.
	else
		exit 0
	fi
else
	not_in_next=`git rev-list --pretty=oneline ^${publish} "$topic"`
	/usr/bin/perl -e '
		my $topic = $ARGV[0];
		my $msg = "* $topic has commits already merged to public branch:\n";
		my (%not_in_next) = map {
			/^([0-9a-f]+) /;
			($1 => 1);
		} split(/\n/, $ARGV[1]);
		for my $elem (map {
				/^([0-9a-f]+) (.*)$/;
				[$1 => $2];
			} split(/\n/, $ARGV[2])) {
			if (!exists $not_in_next{$elem->[0]}) {
				if ($msg) {
					print STDERR $msg;
					undef $msg;
				}
				print STDERR " $elem->[1]\n";
			}
		}
	' "$topic" "$not_in_next" "$not_in_master"
	exit 1
fi

<<\DOC_END

This sample hook safeguards topic branches that have been
published from being rewound.

The workflow assumed here is:

 * Once a topic branch forks from "master", "master" is never
   merged into it again (either directly or indirectly).

 * Once a topic branch is fully cooked and merged into "master",
   it is deleted.  If you need to build on top of it to correct
   earlier mistakes, a new topic branch is created by forking at
   the tip of the "master".  This is not strictly necessary, but
   it makes it easier to keep your history simple.

 * Whenever you need to test or publish your changes to topic
   branches, merge them into "next" branch.

The script, being an example, hardcodes the publish branch name
to be "next", but it is trivial to make it configurable via
$GIT_DIR/config mechanism.

With this workflow, you would want to know:

(1) ... if a topic branch has ever been merged to "next".  Young
    topic branches can have stupid mistakes you would rather
    clean up before publishing, and things that have not been
    merged into other branches can be easily rebased without
    affecting other people.  But once it is published, you would
    not want to rewind it.

(2) ... if a topic branch has been fully merged to "master".
    Then you can delete it.  More importantly, you should not
    build on top of it -- other people may already want to
    change things related to the topic as patches against your
    "master", so if you need further changes, it is better to
    fork the topic (perhaps with the same name) afresh from the
    tip of "master".

Let's look at this example:

		   o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o "next"
		  /       /           /           /
		 /   a---a---b A     /           /
		/   /               /           /
	       /   /   c---c---c---c B         /
	      /   /   /             \         /
	     /   /   /   b---b C     \       /
	    /   /   /   /             \     /
    ---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o---o "master"


A, B and C are topic branches.

 * A has one fix since it was merged up to "next".

 * B has finished.  It has been fully merged up to "master" and "next",
   and is ready to be deleted.

 * C has not merged to "next" at all.

We would want to allow C to be rebased, refuse A, and encourage
B to be deleted.

To compute (1):

	git rev-list ^master ^topic next
	git rev-list ^master        next

	if these match, topic has not merged in next at all.

To compute (2):

	git rev-list master..topic

	if this is empty, it is fully merged to "master".

DOC_END
```

### projeto_narrative-write/.git/hooks/pre-receive.sample

```sample
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to make use of push options.
# The example simply echoes all push options that start with 'echoback='
# and rejects all pushes when the "reject" push option is used.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "pre-receive".

if test -n "$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_COUNT"
then
	i=0
	while test "$i" -lt "$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_COUNT"
	do
		eval "value=\$GIT_PUSH_OPTION_$i"
		case "$value" in
		echoback=*)
			echo "echo from the pre-receive-hook: ${value#*=}" >&2
			;;
		reject)
			exit 1
		esac
		i=$((i + 1))
	done
fi
```

#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to prepare the commit log message.
# Called by "git commit" with the name of the file that has the
# commit message, followed by the description of the commit
# message's source.  The hook's purpose is to edit the commit
# message file.  If the hook fails with a non-zero status,
# the commit is aborted.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "prepare-commit-msg".

# This hook includes three examples. The first one removes the
# "# Please enter the commit message..." help message.
#
# The second includes the output of "git diff --name-status -r"
# into the message, just before the "git status" output.  It is
# commented because it doesn't cope with --amend or with squashed
# commits.
#
# The third example adds a Signed-off-by line to the message, that can
# still be edited.  This is rarely a good idea.

COMMIT_MSG_FILE=$1
COMMIT_SOURCE=$2
SHA1=$3

/usr/bin/perl -i.bak -ne 'print unless(m/^. Please enter the commit message/..m/^#$/)' "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE"

### projeto_narrative-write/.git/hooks/push-to-checkout.sample

*Extensão:* `sample` · *Tamanho:* 2.7 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```sample
#!/bin/sh

# An example hook script to update a checked-out tree on a git push.
#
# This hook is invoked by git-receive-pack(1) when it reacts to git
# push and updates reference(s) in its repository, and when the push
# tries to update the branch that is currently checked out and the
# receive.denyCurrentBranch configuration variable is set to
# updateInstead.
#
# By default, such a push is refused if the working tree and the index
# of the remote repository has any difference from the currently
# checked out commit; when both the working tree and the index match
# the current commit, they are updated to match the newly pushed tip
# of the branch. This hook is to be used to override the default
# behaviour; however the code below reimplements the default behaviour
# as a starting point for convenient modification.
#
# The hook receives the commit with which the tip of the current
# branch is going to be updated:
commit=$1

# It can exit with a non-zero status to refuse the push (when it does
# so, it must not modify the index or the working tree).
die () {
	echo >&2 "$*"
	exit 1
}

# Or it can make any necessary changes to the working tree and to the
# index to bring them to the desired state when the tip of the current
# branch is updated to the new commit, and exit with a zero status.
#
# For example, the hook can simply run git read-tree -u -m HEAD "$1"
# in order to emulate git fetch that is run in the reverse direction
# with git push, as the two-tree form of git read-tree -u -m is
# essentially the same as git switch or git checkout that switches
# branches while keeping the local changes in the working tree that do
# not interfere with the difference between the branches.

# The below is a more-or-less exact translation to shell of the C code
# for the default behaviour for git's push-to-checkout hook defined in
# the push_to_deploy() function in builtin/receive-pack.c.
#
# Note that the hook will be executed from the repository directory,
# not from the working tree, so if you want to perform operations on
# the working tree, you will have to adapt your code accordingly, e.g.
# by adding "cd .." or using relative paths.

if ! git update-index -q --ignore-submodules --refresh
then
	die "Up-to-date check failed"
fi

if ! git diff-files --quiet --ignore-submodules --
then
	die "Working directory has unstaged changes"
fi

# This is a rough translation of:
#
#   head_has_history() ? "HEAD" : EMPTY_TREE_SHA1_HEX
if git cat-file -e HEAD 2>/dev/null
then
	head=HEAD
else
	head=$(git hash-object -t tree --stdin </dev/null)
fi

if ! git diff-index --quiet --cached --ignore-submodules $head --
then
	die "Working directory has staged changes"
fi

if ! git read-tree -u -m "$commit"
then
	die "Could not update working tree to new HEAD"
fi
```

*Extensão:* `sample` · *Tamanho:* 2.3 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```sample
#!/bin/sh

# An example hook script to validate a patch (and/or patch series) before
# sending it via email.
#
# The hook should exit with non-zero status after issuing an appropriate
# message if it wants to prevent the email(s) from being sent.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "sendemail-validate".
#
# By default, it will only check that the patch(es) can be applied on top of
# the default upstream branch without conflicts in a secondary worktree. After
# validation (successful or not) of the last patch of a series, the worktree
# will be deleted.
#
# The following config variables can be set to change the default remote and
# remote ref that are used to apply the patches against:
#
#   sendemail.validateRemote (default: origin)
#   sendemail.validateRemoteRef (default: HEAD)
#
# Replace the TODO placeholders with appropriate checks according to your
# needs.

validate_cover_letter () {
	file="$1"
	# TODO: Replace with appropriate checks (e.g. spell checking).
	true
}

validate_patch () {
	file="$1"
	# Ensure that the patch applies without conflicts.
	git am -3 "$file" || return
	# TODO: Replace with appropriate checks for this patch
	# (e.g. checkpatch.pl).
	true
}

validate_series () {
	# TODO: Replace with appropriate checks for the whole series
	# (e.g. quick build, coding style checks, etc.).
	true
}

# main -------------------------------------------------------------------------

if test "$GIT_SENDEMAIL_FILE_COUNTER" = 1
then
	remote=$(git config --default origin --get sendemail.validateRemote) &&
	ref=$(git config --default HEAD --get sendemail.validateRemoteRef) &&
	worktree=$(mktemp --tmpdir -d sendemail-validate.XXXXXXX) &&
	git worktree add -fd --checkout "$worktree" "refs/remotes/$remote/$ref" &&
	git config --replace-all sendemail.validateWorktree "$worktree"
else
	worktree=$(git config --get sendemail.validateWorktree)
fi || {
	echo "sendemail-validate: error: failed to prepare worktree" >&2
	exit 1
}

unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE
cd "$worktree" &&

if grep -q "^diff --git " "$1"
then
	validate_patch "$1"
else
	validate_cover_letter "$1"
fi &&

if test "$GIT_SENDEMAIL_FILE_COUNTER" = "$GIT_SENDEMAIL_FILE_TOTAL"
then
	git config --unset-all sendemail.validateWorktree &&
	trap 'git worktree remove -ff "$worktree"' EXIT &&
	validate_series
fi
```

### projeto_narrative-write/.git/hooks/update.sample

*Extensão:* `sample` · *Tamanho:* 3.6 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```sample
#!/bin/sh
#
# An example hook script to block unannotated tags from entering.
# Called by "git receive-pack" with arguments: refname sha1-old sha1-new
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "update".
#
# Config
# ------
# hooks.allowunannotated
#   This boolean sets whether unannotated tags will be allowed into the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.allowdeletetag
#   This boolean sets whether deleting tags will be allowed in the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.allowmodifytag
#   This boolean sets whether a tag may be modified after creation. By default
#   it won't be.
# hooks.allowdeletebranch
#   This boolean sets whether deleting branches will be allowed in the
#   repository.  By default they won't be.
# hooks.denycreatebranch
#   This boolean sets whether remotely creating branches will be denied
#   in the repository.  By default this is allowed.
#

# --- Command line
refname="$1"
oldrev="$2"
newrev="$3"

# --- Safety check
if [ -z "$GIT_DIR" ]; then
	echo "Don't run this script from the command line." >&2
	echo " (if you want, you could supply GIT_DIR then run" >&2
	echo "  $0 <ref> <oldrev> <newrev>)" >&2
	exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$refname" -o -z "$oldrev" -o -z "$newrev" ]; then
	echo "usage: $0 <ref> <oldrev> <newrev>" >&2
	exit 1
fi

# --- Config
allowunannotated=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allowunannotated)
allowdeletebranch=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allowdeletebranch)
denycreatebranch=$(git config --type=bool hooks.denycreatebranch)
allowdeletetag=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allowdeletetag)
allowmodifytag=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allowmodifytag)

# check for no description
projectdesc=$(sed -e '1q' "$GIT_DIR/description")
case "$projectdesc" in
"Unnamed repository"* | "")
	echo "*** Project description file hasn't been set" >&2
	exit 1
	;;
esac

# --- Check types
# if $newrev is 0000...0000, it's a commit to delete a ref.
zero=$(git hash-object --stdin </dev/null | tr '[0-9a-f]' '0')
if [ "$newrev" = "$zero" ]; then
	newrev_type=delete
else
	newrev_type=$(git cat-file -t $newrev)
fi

case "$refname","$newrev_type" in
	refs/tags/*,commit)
		# un-annotated tag
		short_refname=${refname##refs/tags/}
		if [ "$allowunannotated" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** The un-annotated tag, $short_refname, is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			echo "*** Use 'git tag [ -a | -s ]' for tags you want to propagate." >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/tags/*,delete)
		# delete tag
		if [ "$allowdeletetag" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a tag is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/tags/*,tag)
		# annotated tag
		if [ "$allowmodifytag" != "true" ] && git rev-parse $refname > /dev/null 2>&1
		then
			echo "*** Tag '$refname' already exists." >&2
			echo "*** Modifying a tag is not allowed in this repository." >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/heads/*,commit)
		# branch
		if [ "$oldrev" = "$zero" -a "$denycreatebranch" = "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Creating a branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/heads/*,delete)
		# delete branch
		if [ "$allowdeletebranch" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	refs/remotes/*,commit)
		# tracking branch
		;;
	refs/remotes/*,delete)
		# delete tracking branch
		if [ "$allowdeletebranch" != "true" ]; then
			echo "*** Deleting a tracking branch is not allowed in this repository" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
		;;
	*)
		# Anything else (is there anything else?)
		echo "*** Update hook: unknown type of update to ref $refname of type $newrev_type" >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

# --- Finished
exit 0
```

/**
 * @file boot.js
 * @module boot
 * @description Ponto de entrada. Orquestra infraestrutura, sistemas, registries, UI.
 * @level 13
 *
 * Fase 6 boot: adiciona botão 📖 no header; função
 *              `wireNarrativeModeButton` que cicla modos;
 *              instancia `NarrativeOverlay` (Fase 6).
 *
 * Fase 13 boot: importa e registra `PhraseSystem` (phr.*).
 *
 * Fase 13.7 (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   Instala `SystemCanary` para detectar divergência entre boot e sandbox.
 *
 * Camada 1 (backend NLP):
 *   Inicializa o `Adapter` com backend `spacy` via HTTP antes de
 *   registrar os sistemas. Se o servidor estiver indisponível, cai
 *   silenciosamente para heurística e o boot continua.
 */

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 1. IMPORTS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { EventBus } from './ecs/event-bus.js';
import { World } from './ecs/world.js';
import { Machine } from './context-machine/machine.js';

import { Adapter } from './narrative-language/pt-br/adapter.js';

import { ParseSystem } from './systems/parse-system.js';
import { CommandSystem } from './systems/command-system.js';
import { EntitySystem } from './systems/entity-system.js';
import { IdentitySystem } from './systems/identity-system.js';
import { InstantiationSystem } from './systems/instantiation-system.js';
import { InheritanceSystem } from './systems/inheritance-system.js';
import { MutationSystem } from './systems/mutation-system.js';
import { LinkSystem } from './systems/link-system.js';
import { LinkQuerySystem } from './systems/link-query-system.js';
import { QuerySystem } from './systems/query-system.js';
import { SearchQuerySystem } from './systems/search-query-system.js';
import { KnowledgeSystem } from './systems/knowledge-system.js';
import { SearchSystem } from './systems/search-system.js';
import { SnippetSystem } from './systems/snippet-system.js';
import { TemplateSystem } from './systems/template-system.js';
import { RuleSystem } from './systems/rule-system.js';
import { ManualRuleSystem } from './systems/manual-rule-system.js';
import { PhraseSystem } from './systems/phrase-system.js';
import { DiagnosticsSystem } from './systems/diagnostics-system.js';
import { TimelineSystem } from './systems/timeline-system.js';
import { StaleSystem } from './systems/stale-system.js';
import { AuditSystem } from './systems/audit-system.js';
import { ForkSystem } from './systems/fork-system.js';
import { DiffSystem } from './systems/diff-system.js';
import { ValidationSystem } from './systems/validation-system.js';
import { ExportSystem } from './systems/export-system.js';
import { HelpSystem } from './systems/help-system.js';
import { SlashCommandSystem } from './systems/slash-command-system.js';
import { RenderSystem } from './systems/render-system.js';
import { NarrativeSystem } from './systems/narrative-system.js';

import { GMStorageAdapter } from './data/storage-gm.js';
import { LocalStorageAdapter } from './data/storage-ls.js';

import { bootstrapRegistries } from './schemas/bootstrap.js';

import { ToastManager } from './ui/toast.js';
import { ModalManager } from './ui/modal.js';
import { FocusManager } from './ui/focus-manager.js';
import { PanelLeft } from './ui/panel-left.js';

import { wireUI, updateNarrativeButton, cycleNarrativeMode } from './ui/ui-wires.js';

import { Editor } from './editor/editor.js';

import { DiagnosticsSuite } from './diagnostics/index.js';

// Import por efeito colateral: registra window.__UIBattery para inspeção manual
import './diagnostics/ui-battery.js';

import { STORAGE_KEYS, APP_VERSION, APP_NAME } from './core/constants.js';
import { el } from './core/utils/dom.js';
import { nowISO } from './core/utils/time.js';
import { deepClone } from './core/utils/object.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 2. GUARDS INICIAIS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  if (window.top !== window.self) {
    // Não roda em iframe — aborta silenciosamente
  } else if (!window.__NarrativeAppLoaded) {
    window.__NarrativeAppLoaded = true;

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => bootstrap().catch(console.error));
    } else {
      bootstrap().catch(console.error);
    }
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 3. BOOTSTRAP PRINCIPAL
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

async function bootstrap() {
  const bus = new EventBus();
  const world = new World({ bus });
  const machine = new Machine({ world, bus });

  // ── 1b. Inicializa o Adapter NLP (Camada 1) ─────────────
  // Roda antes do registro de sistemas. O NarrativeSystem usará
  // o backend para analisar prosa assincronamente. Se o servidor
  // spaCy estiver indisponível, cai silenciosamente para heurística.
  try {
    await Adapter.init({ backend: 'spacy' });
    console.log('[boot] NLP backend:', Adapter.backend(), Adapter.version());
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[boot] Adapter NLP falhou, continuando em heurística:', err);
  }

  // ── 2. Registro dos sistemas ─────────────────────────────
  machine.registerSystem(new ParseSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new CommandSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new EntitySystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new IdentitySystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new InstantiationSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new InheritanceSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new MutationSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new LinkSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new LinkQuerySystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new QuerySystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new SearchQuerySystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new KnowledgeSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new SearchSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new SnippetSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new TemplateSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new RuleSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new ManualRuleSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new PhraseSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new DiagnosticsSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new TimelineSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new StaleSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new AuditSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new ForkSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new DiffSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new ValidationSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new ExportSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new HelpSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new SlashCommandSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new RenderSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new NarrativeSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new PersistenceSystem());
  machine.registerSystem(new SeedSystem());

  // ── 2b. Canário de integridade ────────────────────────────
  // Compara a lista de sistemas registrados no boot com a do sandbox
  // de testes. Previne divergência silenciosa (ver auditoria 25/09/2026).
  const { SystemCanary } = await import('./diagnostics/system-canary.js');
  const bootNames = Array.from(machine.systems.keys());
  const canary = new SystemCanary();

  bus.on('sandbox:created', ({ names } = {}) => {
    const report = canary.compare(bootNames, names);
    if (!report.ok) {
      console.warn('[boot] sandbox divergiu do boot:', report);
      bus.emit('canary:divergence', report);
    }
  });

  // ── 3. Registries ────────────────────────────────────────
  bootstrapRegistries(world.registry, machine.registry);

  // ── 4. Adapter de persistência ───────────────────────────
  const adapter = await pickStorageAdapter();
  const persist = machine.systems.get('PersistenceSystem');
  persist.setAdapter(adapter);

  // ── 5. Cold ou warm boot ─────────────────────────────────
  let bootMode = 'cold';
  let bootStats = null;

  try {
    const state = await persist.loadWorld();
    if (state) {
      bootStats = restoreFromState(machine, state);
      bootMode = 'warm';
    } else {
      bootStats = seedFreshWorld(machine, world);
      await persist.flush('seed');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[boot] restore falhou, caindo para cold:', err);
    bootStats = seedFreshWorld(machine, world);
  }

  // ── 6. UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const app = mountUI(machine);

  // ── 6b. Diagnostics Suite ────────────────────────────────
  const diag = new DiagnosticsSuite();
  diag.install(machine, world, bus, { persist });

  // ── 7. Wire de eventos ───────────────────────────────────
  wireUI(machine, app);

  // ── 8. First run ─────────────────────────────────────────
  try {
    const firstRun = await adapter.get(STORAGE_KEYS.META_FIRST_RUN);
    if (!firstRun) {
      await adapter.set(STORAGE_KEYS.META_FIRST_RUN, nowISO());
      app.toast.info(
        '👋 Bem-vindo ao Editor Narrativo. Digite help.tutorial para um tour.',
        6000
      );
    }
  } catch { /* não bloqueia */ }

  // ── 9. API global ────────────────────────────────────────
  window.__NarrativeApp = {
    machine,
    world,
    bus,
    adapter,
    persist,
    diag,
    canary,
    bootMode,
    bootStats,
    version: APP_VERSION,
    name: APP_NAME,
  };

  // ── 10. Notifica ─────────────────────────────────────────
  bus.emit('boot:complete', {
    mode: bootMode,
    tick: machine.getTick(),
    entityCount: world.allEntities().length,
    systemCount: machine.systems.size,
    version: APP_VERSION,
  });

  // ── 10b. Auto-run de testes via URL ──────────────────────
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof URLSearchParams === 'function') {
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const testParam = params.get('test');
      if (testParam) {
        const seedParam = params.get('seed');
        const iterParam = params.get('iterations');

        const parts = [`diag.test ${testParam}`];
        if (seedParam) parts.push(`seed=${seedParam}`);
        if (iterParam) parts.push(`iterations=${iterParam}`);
        const command = parts.join(' ');

        setTimeout(() => {
          try {
            machine.handleLine(command);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('[boot] falha ao rodar bateria via URL:', err);
          }
        }, 600);
      }
    } catch { /* isola */ }
  }

  return window.__NarrativeApp;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 4. COLD BOOT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function seedFreshWorld(machine, world) {
  const seedSystem = machine.systems.get('SeedSystem');
  const result = seedSystem ? seedSystem.seed() : { seeded: 0 };

  const timeline = machine.systems.get('TimelineSystem');
  if (timeline) {
    timeline.clear();
    timeline.init();
  }

  return {
    applied: result.applied ?? result.seeded ?? 0,
    byType: result.byType ?? {},
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 5. WARM BOOT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function restoreFromState(machine, state) {
  if (!state || state.version !== 1) {
    throw new Error('schema version incompatível');
  }

  const world = machine.world;
  world.clear();

  for (const [id, comps] of Object.entries(state.world || {})) {
    const cloned = deepClone(comps);

    if (cloned && cloned.Meta) {
      cloned.Meta.createdAt = 'T0';
      cloned.Meta.updatedAt = 'T0';
    }

    world.createEntity(cloned, { id });
  }

  const timeline = machine.systems.get('TimelineSystem');
  if (timeline && state.timelines) {
    timeline.clear();
    for (const [name, tl] of Object.entries(state.timelines)) {
      const snapshots = new Map(Object.entries(tl.snapshots || {}));
      timeline.timelines.set(name, {
        entries: tl.entries || [],
        snapshots,
      });
    }
    timeline.switchTo(state.timeline || 'main');
  }

  machine.state.tick = state.tick ?? 'T0';
  machine.state.tickNumber = parseInt(String(state.tick).slice(1), 10) || 0;
  machine.state.timeline = state.timeline ?? 'main';

  machine.links.rebuild(world);
  machine.ids.rebuildFromWorld(world);

  return {
    entities: world.allEntities().length,
    timelines: Object.keys(state.timelines || {}).length,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6. STORAGE ADAPTER
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

async function pickStorageAdapter() {
  const candidates = [
    new GMStorageAdapter(),
    new IndexedDBAdapter(),
    new LocalStorageAdapter(),
  ];

  for (const adapter of candidates) {
    try {
      if (await adapter.isAvailable()) return adapter;
    } catch { /* tenta próximo */ }
  }

  throw new Error('[boot] nenhum storage adapter disponível');
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 7. UI
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function mountUI(machine) {
  injectStyles();

  const root = ensureRoot();

  const icon = createFloatingIcon();
  root.appendChild(icon);

  const platform = createPlatform();
  root.appendChild(platform);

  const editorContainer = platform.querySelector('.editor-container');
  const editor = new Editor(machine, editorContainer);

  const leftContainer = platform.querySelector('.panel-left');
  const panelLeft = new PanelLeft(machine, leftContainer);

  const rightContainer = platform.querySelector('.panel-right');
  const panelRight = new PanelRight(machine, rightContainer);

  const floatingMenu = new FloatingMenu(machine);
  const historyPanel = new HistoryPanel(machine);
  const rollOverlay = new RollOverlay(machine);
  const playOverlay = new PlayOverlay(machine);
  const commandGuide = new CommandGuide(machine);

  const narrativeOverlay = new NarrativeOverlay(machine);

  const toast = new ToastManager();
  const modal = new ModalManager();

  const focusManager = new FocusManager({
    panelLeft: leftContainer,
    panelRight: rightContainer,
    editor: editorContainer,
  });

  const keyboardRouter = new KeyboardRouter(machine, {
    floatingMenu,
    historyPanel,
    rollOverlay,
    playOverlay,
    commandGuide,
  });

  const togglePlatform = () => {
    platform.classList.toggle('visible');
    if (platform.classList.contains('visible')) {
      positionPlatform(platform, icon);
      editor.focus();
    }
  };

  wireFloatingIcon(icon, platform, togglePlatform);

  const guideBtn = platform.querySelector('[data-action="guide"]');
  const configBtn = platform.querySelector('[data-action="config"]');
  const modeBtn = platform.querySelector('[data-action="mode"]');

  if (guideBtn) guideBtn.addEventListener('click', () => commandGuide.toggle());
  if (configBtn) configBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    toast.info('Configurações em breve.');
  });
  if (modeBtn) modeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    machine.state.play = !machine.state.play;
    playOverlay.toggle();
  });

  wireNarrativeModeButton(machine, platform, toast);
  wireTestButton(machine, platform, toast);
  wireNarrativeOverlay(machine, editor, narrativeOverlay);

  return {
    root, icon, platform, editor, panelLeft, panelRight,
    floatingMenu, historyPanel, rollOverlay, playOverlay,
    commandGuide, toast, modal, focusManager, keyboardRouter,
    narrativeOverlay,
    togglePlatform,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 7a. BOTÃO 📖 — Modo narrativo (Fase 6)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function wireNarrativeModeButton(machine, platform, toast) {
  const btn = platform.querySelector('[data-action="narrative-mode"]');
  if (!btn) return;

  try {
    const sys = machine.systems.get('NarrativeSystem');
    const mode = sys?.getMode?.() ?? 'off';
    updateNarrativeButton(platform, mode);
  } catch { /* isola */ }

  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const next = cycleNarrativeMode(machine);
    const label = {
      off: 'Narrativa desativada',
      preview: 'Modo preview — análise visível, sem mutação',
      suggest: 'Modo suggest — aprovação manual',
      auto: 'Modo auto — aplicação automática',
    }[next] ?? next;
    toast.info(label, 2500);
  });
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 7a-bis. WIRING DO OVERLAY NARRATIVO (Fase 6)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function wireNarrativeOverlay(machine, editor, overlay) {
  if (!overlay || !editor) return;

  try {
    const ta = editor.textarea;
    if (!ta) return;

    ta.addEventListener('click', () => {
      try {
        const pos = ta.selectionStart;
        const spans = editor.highlighter?.getNarrativeSpans?.() ?? [];
        const hit = spans.find((s) => s.ambiguous && pos >= s.start && pos <= s.end);

        if (!hit) return;

        const ir = machine.systems.get('NarrativeSystem')?._lastIR;
        if (!ir) return;

        const diag = (ir.diagnostics ?? []).find(
          (d) => d.code === 'REF_AMBIGUOUS' &&
            d.sourceSpan?.start === hit.start
        );
        if (!diag || !diag.context?.candidates) return;

        overlay.open({
          spanKey: `${ir.documentId ?? 's1'}.t${hit.start}`,
          candidates: diag.context.candidates,
          current: null,
          sourceSpan: { start: hit.start, end: hit.end, raw: hit.raw },
        });
      } catch { /* isola */ }
    });
  } catch { /* isola */ }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 7b. BOTÃO 🧪 — Bateria de testes
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function wireTestButton(machine, platform, toast) {
  const testBtn = platform.querySelector('[data-action="test"]');
  if (!testBtn) return;

  const SAFETY_MS = 90_000;
  let running = false;
  let safetyTimer = null;

  const reset = () => {
    running = false;
    testBtn.disabled = false;
    testBtn.textContent = '🧪';
    if (safetyTimer) {
      clearTimeout(safetyTimer);
      safetyTimer = null;
    }
  };

  machine.bus.on('test:battery:complete', reset);
  machine.bus.on('test:battery:error', reset);

  testBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;
    testBtn.disabled = true;
    testBtn.textContent = '⏳';

    safetyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (running) {
        toast.warning(
          'Bateria não respondeu em 90s — destravando o botão. Veja o console.',
          5000
        );
        reset();
      }
    }, SAFETY_MS);

    try {
      machine.handleLine('diag.test full');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(`Bateria falhou ao iniciar: ${err.message}`);
      reset();
    }
  });
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 8. HELPERS DE DOM
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function ensureRoot() {
  let root = document.getElementById('narrative-root');
  if (!root) {
    root = el('div', { id: 'narrative-root' });
    document.body.appendChild(root);
  }
  root.hidden = false;
  return root;
}

function injectStyles() {
  if (document.getElementById('narrative-styles')) return;
  const link = el('link', {
    id: 'narrative-styles',
    rel: 'stylesheet',
    href: new URL('./ui/styles.css', import.meta.url).href,
  });
  document.head.appendChild(link);
}

function createFloatingIcon() {
  const icon = el('div', {
    id: 'narrative-floating-icon',
    title: 'Editor Narrativo (clique para abrir)',
  }, 'N');
  icon.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'global-indicator' }));
  return icon;
}

function createPlatform() {
  const platform = el('div', { id: 'narrative-platform' });

  const header = el('div', { class: 'narrative-header' });
  header.appendChild(el('div', {}, 'Editor Narrativo ECS'));

  const actions = el('div', { class: 'narrative-header-actions' });
  actions.appendChild(el('span', { 'data-tick': '' }, 'T0'));
  actions.appendChild(el('span', { 'data-boot-mode': '' }, '—'));
  actions.appendChild(el('span', { 'data-save-indicator': '' }, '●'));

  actions.appendChild(el('button', {
    class: 'header-btn',
    'data-action': 'narrative-mode',
    title: 'Modo narrativo — clique para ciclar (OFF → PRV → SUG → AUTO)',
  }, '📖 OFF'));

  actions.appendChild(el('button', {
    class: 'header-btn',
    'data-action': 'test',
    title: 'Rodar bateria de testes automáticos (diag.test)',
  }, '🧪'));
  actions.appendChild(el('button', { class: 'header-btn', 'data-action': 'guide' }, 'Comandos'));
  actions.appendChild(el('button', { class: 'header-btn', 'data-action': 'config' }, 'Config'));
  actions.appendChild(el('button', { class: 'header-btn', 'data-action': 'mode' }, '🌐'));
  header.appendChild(actions);
  platform.appendChild(header);

  const body = el('div', { class: 'narrative-body' });
  body.appendChild(el('aside', { class: 'panel-left' }));
  body.appendChild(el('main', { class: 'editor-container' }));
  body.appendChild(el('aside', { class: 'panel-right' }));
  platform.appendChild(body);

  return platform;
}

function wireFloatingIcon(icon, platform, onToggle) {
  let dragging = false;
  let moved = false;
  let offsetX = 0;
  let offsetY = 0;
  let startX = 0;
  let startY = 0;

  const onMouseDown = (e) => {
    dragging = true;
    moved = false;
    startX = e.clientX;
    startY = e.clientY;
    const rect = icon.getBoundingClientRect();
    offsetX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    offsetY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    icon.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  };

  const onMouseMove = (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const dx = Math.abs(e.clientX - startX);
    const dy = Math.abs(e.clientY - startY);
    if (dx > 4 || dy > 4) moved = true;
    if (!moved) return;
    const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(e.clientX - offsetX, window.innerWidth - 52));
    const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(e.clientY - offsetY, window.innerHeight - 52));
    icon.style.left = `${x}px`;
    icon.style.top = `${y}px`;
    if (platform.classList.contains('visible')) positionPlatform(platform, icon);
  };

  const onMouseUp = () => {
    dragging = false;
    icon.style.cursor = 'grab';
    document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    if (!moved) onToggle();
  };

  icon.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
  icon.style.cursor = 'grab';
}

function positionPlatform(platform, icon) {
  const rect = icon.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = 1120;
  const h = 640;
  let left = rect.left + 60;
  let top = rect.top;
  if (left + w > window.innerWidth - 10) left = rect.left - w - 10;
  if (top + h > window.innerHeight - 10) top = window.innerHeight - h - 10;
  if (left < 10) left = 10;
  if (top < 10) top = 10;
  platform.style.left = `${left}px`;
  platform.style.top = `${top}px`;
}

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 1.5 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file enums.js
 * @module components
 * @description Mapa de escolha única (string por campo).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/mutation-system, systems/inheritance-system
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const ENUMS = COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS;

/**
 * Cria Enums a partir de um objeto.
 * @param {Object} [data={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeEnums(data = {}) {
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') {
      out[k] = String(v);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Enums válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isEnums(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
}

/**
 * Lê um valor de enum.
 * @param {Object} enums
 * @param {string} field
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function getEnum(enums, field) {
  return enums?.[field] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Define um valor de enum.
 * @param {Object} enums
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {string} value
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function setEnum(enums, field, value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    const out = { ...(enums || {}) };
    delete out[field];
    return out;
  }
  return { ...(enums || {}), [field]: String(value) };
}

/**
 * Lista os campos.
 * @param {Object} enums
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function fields(enums) {
  return enums ? Object.keys(enums) : [];
}

/**

 * @module components
 * @description Conjunto de flags booleanas (presença = true).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/mutation-system, systems/inheritance-system, systems/rule-system
 * @level 4

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const FLAGS = COMPONENT_NAMES.FLAGS;

/**
 * Cria Flags a partir de array ou Set.
 * @param {string[]|Set<string>} [values=[]]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeFlags(values = []) {
  const arr = Array.isArray(values) ? values : Array.from(values);
  return { values: [...new Set(arr.filter(Boolean).map(String))] };
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Flags válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isFlags(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && Array.isArray(v.values);
}

/**
 * Verifica se um flag está ativo.
 * @param {Object} flags
 * @param {string} flag
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function hasFlag(flags, flag) {
  return Array.isArray(flags?.values) && flags.values.includes(flag);
}

/**
 * Liga um flag (idempotente).
 * @param {Object} flags
 * @param {string} flag
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function flagOn(flags, flag) {
  const before = Array.isArray(flags?.values) ? flags.values : [];
  if (before.includes(flag)) return { values: [...before] };
  return { values: [...before, flag] };
}

/**
 * Desliga um flag (idempotente).
 * @param {Object} flags
 * @param {string} flag
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function flagOff(flags, flag) {
  const before = Array.isArray(flags?.values) ? flags.values : [];
  return { values: before.filter(f => f !== flag) };
}

/**
 * Lista os flags ativos.
 * @param {Object} flags
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function flagValues(flags) {
  return Array.isArray(flags?.values) ? [...flags.values] : [];
}

/**
 * @file identity.js
 * @module components
 * @description Identidade canônica de qualquer entidade.
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/entity-system, systems/identity-system, systems/instantiation-system, ui/*
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const IDENTITY = COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY;

/**
 * Cria um Identity canônico.
 * @param {Object} opts
 * @param {string} opts.id — shortcode imutável (ex: 'CHR-KAE')
 * @param {string} opts.name — nome humano
 * @param {string} [opts.description='']
 * @param {string} [opts.type='custom']
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeIdentity({ id, name, description = '', type = 'custom' }) {
  if (!id || typeof id !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('[Identity] id obrigatório (shortcode)');
  }
  if (!name || typeof name !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('[Identity] name obrigatório');
  }
  return {
    id: String(id),
    name: String(name),
    description: String(description || ''),
    type: String(type || 'custom'),
  };
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Identity válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isIdentity(v) {
  return !!v
    && typeof v === 'object'
    && typeof v.id === 'string' && v.id.length > 0
    && typeof v.name === 'string' && v.name.length > 0
    && typeof v.type === 'string';
}

/**
 * Cópia rasa com campos atualizados.
 * @param {Object} identity
 * @param {Object} [patch={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function updateIdentity(identity, patch = {}) {
  if (!isIdentity(identity)) {
    throw new Error('[Identity] identity inválido');
  }
  return {
    id: identity.id,           // imutável
    name: patch.name ?? identity.name,
    description: patch.description ?? identity.description,
    type: patch.type ?? identity.type,
  };
}

}

}

/**

 * @returns {Object}

}

export function makeBlueprintFields({ copy = null, override = {} } = {}) {

    copy: Array.isArray(copy) ? [...copy] : null,
    override: { ...override },
  };
}

/**
 * Cria Stale.
 * @param {string} tick
 * @param {string} [cause='']
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeStale(tick, cause = '') {
  return { value: true, at: String(tick), cause: String(cause) };
}

/**

 * @param {string} [cause='']
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeOrphaned(tick, cause = '') {

}

/**

 * @param {string} pattern — ex: '{bp} {n}'
 * @param {string} base — nome do blueprint
 * @param {number} n — número
 * @param {number} [pad=0] — zeros à esquerda
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatInstanceName(pattern, base, n, pad = 0) {
  const num = pad > 0 ? String(n).padStart(pad, '0') : String(n);
  return String(pattern).replace('{bp}', base).replace('{n}', num);

/**
 * @file knowledge.js
 * @module components
 * @description O que uma entidade sabe — mapa fato→tick.
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/knowledge-system
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const KNOWS = COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS;

/**
 * Cria Knows vazio.
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeKnows() {
  return { facts: {} };
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Knows válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isKnows(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && v.facts && typeof v.facts === 'object';
}

/**
 * Verifica se uma entidade sabe um fato.
 * @param {Object} knows
 * @param {string} fact
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function knowsFact(knows, fact) {
  return !!knows?.facts && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(knows.facts, fact);
}

/**
 * Tick em que um fato foi aprendido (ou null).
 * @param {Object} knows
 * @param {string} fact
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function learnedAt(knows, fact) {
  return knows?.facts?.[fact] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Registra o aprendizado de um fato (idempotente).
 * @param {Object} knows
 * @param {string} fact
 * @param {string} tick
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function learn(knows, fact, tick) {
  const facts = { ...(knows?.facts || {}) };
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(facts, fact)) {
    return { facts };
  }
  facts[fact] = String(tick);
  return { facts };
}

/**
 * Remove um fato (idempotente).
 * @param {Object} knows
 * @param {string} fact
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function forget(knows, fact) {
  const facts = { ...(knows?.facts || {}) };
  delete facts[fact];
  return { facts };
}

/**
 * Lista todos os fatos.
 * @param {Object} knows
 * @returns {Array<{fact:string, learnedAt:string}>}
 */
export function facts(knows) {
  if (!knows?.facts) return [];
  return Object.entries(knows.facts).map(([fact, at]) => ({ fact, learnedAt: at }));
}

/**
 * @file links.js
 * @module components
 * @description Arestas nomeadas — relações entre entidades.
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/link-system, systems/link-query-system, ecs/link-index
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const LINKS = COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS;

/**
 * Cria um Links vazio.
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function emptyLinks() {
  return {};
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Links válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isLinks(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
}

/**
 * Verifica se uma relação é multi (array) num Links.
 * @param {Object} links
 * @param {string} rel
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isMultiRel(links, rel) {
  if (!links) return false;
  return Array.isArray(links[rel]);
}

/**
 * Retorna os alvos de uma relação como array (sempre).
 * @param {Object} links
 * @param {string} rel
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function getTargets(links, rel) {
  if (!links || !(rel in links)) return [];
  const v = links[rel];
  return Array.isArray(v) ? [...v] : [v];
}

/**
 * Retorna a relação como single (primeiro alvo) ou null.
 * @param {Object} links
 * @param {string} rel
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function getSingleTarget(links, rel) {
  if (!links || !(rel in links)) return null;
  const v = links[rel];
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v[0] || null;
  return v;
}

/**
 * Aplica `set` (substitui) numa relação.
 * Retorna novo objeto (não muta).
 * @param {Object} links
 * @param {string} rel
 * @param {string} to
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function setLink(links, rel, to) {
  if (!rel || !to) throw new Error('[Links] rel e to obrigatórios');
  return { ...(links || {}), [rel]: to };
}

/**
 * Aplica `add` (adiciona a multi, ou promove single para multi).
 * Idempotente.
 * @param {Object} links
 * @param {string} rel
 * @param {string} to
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function addLink(links, rel, to) {
  if (!rel || !to) throw new Error('[Links] rel e to obrigatórios');
  const current = links?.[rel];

  if (current === undefined) {
    return { ...(links || {}), [rel]: [to] };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(current)) {
    if (current.includes(to)) return { ...links };
    return { ...links, [rel]: [...current, to] };
  }
  if (current === to) return { ...links };
  return { ...links, [rel]: [current, to] };
}

/**
 * Aplica `pull` (remove item ou chave).
 * Idempotente.
 * @param {Object} links
 * @param {string} rel
 * @param {string} to
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function pullLink(links, rel, to) {
  if (!rel || !to) throw new Error('[Links] rel e to obrigatórios');
  if (!links || !(rel in links)) return { ...(links || {}) };

  const current = links[rel];

  if (Array.isArray(current)) {
    const next = current.filter(x => x !== to);
    if (next.length === current.length) return { ...links };
    return { ...links, [rel]: next };
  }
  if (current === to) {
    const out = { ...links };
    delete out[rel];
    return out;
  }
  return { ...links };
}

/**
 * Aplica `clear` (remove chave inteira).
 * Idempotente.
 * @param {Object} links
 * @param {string} rel
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function clearLink(links, rel) {
  if (!rel) throw new Error('[Links] rel obrigatório');
  if (!links || !(rel in links)) return { ...(links || {}) };
  const out = { ...links };
  delete out[rel];
  return out;
}

/**
 * Lista todas as relações de um Links.
 * @param {Object} links
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function rels(links) {
  if (!links) return [];
  return Object.keys(links);
}

/**
 * Conta o número total de arestas em Links.
 * @param {Object} links
 * @returns {number}
 */
export function edgeCount(links) {
  if (!links) return 0;
  let n = 0;
  for (const v of Object.values(links)) {
    n += Array.isArray(v) ? v.length : (v ? 1 : 0);
  }
  return n;
}
```

/**
 * @file lists.js
 * @module components
 * @description Mapa de arrays de strings.
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/mutation-system, systems/inheritance-system
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const LISTS = COMPONENT_NAMES.LISTS;

/**
 * Cria Lists a partir de um objeto de arrays.
 * @param {Object} [data={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeLists(data = {}) {
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      out[k] = [...v];
    } else if (v !== undefined && v !== null) {
      out[k] = [String(v)];
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Lists válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isLists(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
}

/**
 * Lê uma lista.
 * @param {Object} lists
 * @param {string} field
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function getList(lists, field) {
  const v = lists?.[field];
  return Array.isArray(v) ? [...v] : [];
}

/**
 * Aplica push (idempotente).
 * @param {Object} lists
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {string} item
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function pushList(lists, field, item) {
  const before = getList(lists, field);
  if (before.includes(item)) return { ...(lists || {}), [field]: before };
  return { ...(lists || {}), [field]: [...before, item] };
}

/**
 * Aplica pull (idempotente).
 * @param {Object} lists
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {string} item
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function pullList(lists, field, item) {
  const before = getList(lists, field);
  const next = before.filter(x => x !== item);
  return { ...(lists || {}), [field]: next };
}

/**
 * Substitui uma lista inteira.
 * @param {Object} lists
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {string[]} values
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function setList(lists, field, values) {
  const arr = Array.isArray(values) ? [...values] : [];
  return { ...(lists || {}), [field]: arr };
}

/**
 * Lista os campos.
 * @param {Object} lists
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function fields(lists) {
  return lists ? Object.keys(lists) : [];
}

/**
 * @file meta.js
 * @module components
 * @description Metadata de qualquer entidade (tick de criação/atualização, builtin, dirty).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/entity-system, systems/instantiation-system,
 *             systems/rule-system, systems/snippet-system, schemas/seed-builder
 * @level 4
 *
 * Fase 3 — Refatoração arquitetural:
 *   `createdAt` e `updatedAt` armazenam **ticks** (ex.: 'T0', 'T5'),
 *   não wall-clock ISO. Motivo: o sistema é determinístico por tick;
 *   `dif`, `frk.merge`, `replay` e `regression` comparam estados entre
 *   execuções. Timestamps de relógio de parede introduzem divergências
 *   espúrias a cada milissegundo — duas execuções da mesma sequência
 *   produzem mundos estruturalmente idênticos mas com `Meta` diferente.
 *   O tick é a coordenada narrativa; é ele que o escritor usa para
 *   referenciar o passado da história.
 *
 *   A informação autoral "quando escrevi isto" continua disponível no
 *   nível do documento, via `PersistenceSystem` (`state.savedAt`).
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const META = COMPONENT_NAMES.META;

/**
 * Cria Meta com tick de criação = tick de atualização.
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @param {boolean} [opts.builtin=false]
 * @param {string} [opts.tick='T0'] — tick em que a entidade é criada
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeMeta({ builtin = false, tick = 'T0' } = {}) {
  const t = String(tick || 'T0');
  return {
    createdAt: t,
    updatedAt: t,
    builtin: !!builtin,
    dirty: false,
  };
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Meta válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isMeta(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && typeof v.createdAt === 'string';
}

/**
 * Marca Meta como atualizado no tick dado.
 * @param {Object} meta
 * @param {string} [tick='T0']
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function touch(meta, tick = 'T0') {
  return { ...(meta || {}), updatedAt: String(tick || 'T0') };
}

/**
 * Marca Meta como dirty (precisa persistir).
 * @param {Object} meta
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function markDirty(meta) {
  return { ...(meta || {}), dirty: true };
}

/**
 * Limpa flag dirty.
 * @param {Object} meta
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function markClean(meta) {
  return { ...(meta || {}), dirty: false };
}

/**
 * Verifica se Meta está dirty.
 * @param {Object} meta
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isDirty(meta) {
  return !!meta?.dirty;
}

 * @file placeholders.js
 * @module components
 * @description Definições de placeholders tipados (template).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/template-system, editor/inline-template
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const PLACEHOLDER_DEFS = COMPONENT_NAMES.PLACEHOLDER_DEFS;

/**
 * Tipos válidos de placeholder.
 */
export const PLACEHOLDER_TYPES = [
  'entity.character',
  'entity.location',
  'entity.item',
  'entity.faction',
  'entity.custom',
  'enum',
  'number',
  'text',
  'date',
];

/**
 * Cria PlaceholderDefs.
 * @param {Array<{name:string,type:string,opts?:any}>} defs
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makePlaceholderDefs(defs = []) {
  const normalized = (Array.isArray(defs) ? defs : [])
    .filter(d => d && d.name)
    .map(d => ({
      name: String(d.name),
      type: PLACEHOLDER_TYPES.includes(d.type) ? d.type : 'text',
      opts: d.opts ?? null,
    }));
  return { defs: normalized };
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é PlaceholderDefs válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isPlaceholderDefs(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && Array.isArray(v.defs);
}

/**
 * Lista os nomes dos placeholders.
 * @param {Object} defs
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function names(defs) {
  return (defs?.defs || []).map(d => d.name);
}

/**
 * Busca um placeholder por nome.
 * @param {Object} defs
 * @param {string} name
 * @returns {Object|null}
 */
export function findDef(defs, name) {
  return (defs?.defs || []).find(d => d.name === name) || null;
}

/**
 * Verifica se um placeholder é do tipo entidade.
 * @param {Object} def
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isEntityDef(def) {
  return !!def && typeof def.type === 'string' && def.type.startsWith('entity.');
}

/**
 * Verifica se um placeholder é enum.
 * @param {Object} def
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isEnumDef(def) {
  return def?.type === 'enum';
}

/**
 * Verifica se um placeholder é number.
 * @param {Object} def
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isNumberDef(def) {
  return def?.type === 'number';
}

/**
 * @file rule.js
 * @module components
 * @description Componentes de regra — On/If/Do + meta.
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/rule-system, systems/manual-rule-system, systems/audit-system
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES, RULE_MODES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const RULE       = COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE;
export const RULE_META  = COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE_META;

/**
 * Cria Rule.
 * @param {Object} opts
 * @param {string} opts.on
 * @param {string} [opts.if='true']
 * @param {string} opts.do
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeRule({ on, if: ifExpr = 'true', do: doExpr }) {
  if (!on) throw new Error('[Rule] on obrigatório');
  if (!doExpr) throw new Error('[Rule] do obrigatório');
  return {
    on: String(on).trim(),
    if: String(ifExpr || 'true').trim(),
    do: String(doExpr).trim(),
  };
}

/**
 * Cria RuleMeta.
 * @param {Object} opts
 * @param {string} opts.declaredAt — tick
 * @param {string} [opts.mode='auto']
 * @param {string} [opts.tag=null]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeRuleMeta({ declaredAt, mode = 'auto', tag = null }) {
  if (!RULE_MODES.includes(mode)) {
    throw new Error(`[RuleMeta] modo inválido: ${mode}`);
  }
  return {
    declaredAt: String(declaredAt),
    mode,
    tag: tag ? String(tag) : null,
    firedCount: 0,
    lastFiredAt: null,
    lastTrigger: null,
  };
}

/**
 * Atualiza RuleMeta após um fire.
 * @param {Object} meta
 * @param {string} tick
 * @param {string} [trigger='auto']
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function markFired(meta, tick, trigger = 'auto') {
  return {
    ...meta,
    firedCount: (meta?.firedCount ?? 0) + 1,
    lastFiredAt: String(tick),
    lastTrigger: trigger,
  };
}

/**
 * Verifica se a regra está em modo automático.
 * @param {Object} meta
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isAuto(meta) {
  return meta?.mode === 'auto';
}

/**
 * Verifica se a regra está em modo manual.
 * @param {Object} meta
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isManual(meta) {
  return meta?.mode === 'manual';
}

/**
 * Verifica se a regra nunca disparou.
 * @param {Object} meta
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function neverFired(meta) {
  return (meta?.firedCount ?? 0) === 0;
}

/**
 * @file snippet.js
 * @module components
 * @description Componentes de snippet (trigger, body, tipo, menu, runs).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/snippet-system, systems/template-system, ui/floating-menu
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES, SNIPPET_TYPES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const TRIGGER       = COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER;
export const BODY          = COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY;
export const SNIPPET_TYPE  = COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE;
export const MENU_OPTS     = COMPONENT_NAMES.MENU_OPTS;
export const RUNS          = COMPONENT_NAMES.RUNS;

/**
 * Cria Trigger.
 * @param {string} value
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeTrigger(value) {
  if (!value) throw new Error('[Trigger] value obrigatório');
  return { value: String(value) };
}

/**
 * Cria Body.
 * @param {string} text
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeBody(text) {
  return { text: String(text ?? '') };
}

/**
 * Cria SnippetType.
 * @param {string} value — 'text' | 'template' | 'menu' | 'command'
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeSnippetType(value) {
  if (!SNIPPET_TYPES.includes(value)) {
    throw new Error(`[SnippetType] tipo inválido: ${value}`);
  }
  return { value };
}

/**
 * Cria MenuOpts.
 *
 * Cada opção pode ter:
 *   { key: string, label: string, type?: 'text'|'submenu', body?: string, run?: string }
 *
 *   - key:   identificador curto (obrigatório)
 *   - label: texto exibido no menu (default: key)
 *   - type:  'text' | 'submenu' (default: 'text')
 *   - body:  texto a inserir no editor ao confirmar (default: null)
 *   - run:   comando a executar via machine.handleLine (default: null)
 *
 * @param {Array} options
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeMenuOpts(options = []) {
  const normalized = (Array.isArray(options) ? options : [])
    .filter(o => o && o.key)
    .map(o => ({
      key: String(o.key),
      label: String(o.label ?? o.key),
      type: o.type === 'submenu' ? 'submenu' : 'text',
      body: typeof o.body === 'string' ? o.body : null,
      run: typeof o.run === 'string' ? o.run : null,
    }));
  return { options: normalized };
}

/**
 * Cria Runs.
 * @param {string[]} cmds
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeRuns(cmds = []) {
  return { cmds: (Array.isArray(cmds) ? cmds : []).map(String) };
}

/**
 * Verifica se um snippet é de um certo tipo.
 * @param {Object} snippetType
 * @param {string} type
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isType(snippetType, type) {
  return snippetType?.value === type;
}

/**
 * Extrai os nomes de placeholders `{x}` de um body.
 * @param {string} body
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function extractPlaceholderNames(body) {
  const out = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const re = /\{([^}]+)\}/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(String(body || ''))) !== null) {
    const name = m[1].trim();
    if (name && !seen.has(name)) {
      seen.add(name);
      out.push(name);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Interpola placeholders num body.
 * @param {string} body
 * @param {Object<string,string>} values
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function interpolateBody(body, values = {}) {
  return String(body || '').replace(/\{([^}]+)\}/g, (m, name) => {
    const key = name.trim();
    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values, key)
      ? String(values[key])
      : m;
  });
}

/**
 * @file stats.js
 * @module components
 * @description Mapa numérico de atributos.
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/mutation-system, systems/inheritance-system, systems/query-system
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const STATS = COMPONENT_NAMES.STATS;

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Stats válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isStats(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
}

/**
 * Cria Stats a partir de um objeto, forçando valores numéricos.
 * @param {Object} [data={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeStats(data = {}) {
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) {
    const n = Number(v);
    if (Number.isFinite(n)) out[k] = n;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Lê um campo de Stats.
 * @param {Object} stats
 * @param {string} field
 * @returns {number}
 */
export function getStat(stats, field) {
  const n = stats?.[field];
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

/**
 * Verifica se um campo está definido em Stats.
 * @param {Object} stats
 * @param {string} field
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function hasStat(stats, field) {
  return stats && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(stats, field);
}

/**
 * Aplica soma.
 * @param {Object} stats
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {number} amount
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function addStat(stats, field, amount) {
  const before = getStat(stats, field);
  const after = before + Number(amount);
  return { ...(stats || {}), [field]: after };
}

/**
 * Aplica subtração.
 * @param {Object} stats
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {number} amount
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function subStat(stats, field, amount) {
  return addStat(stats, field, -Number(amount));
}

/**
 * Aplica set (substitui).
 * @param {Object} stats
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {number} value
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function setStat(stats, field, value) {
  const n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) {
    throw new Error(`[Stats] valor não numérico: ${value}`);
  }
  return { ...(stats || {}), [field]: n };
}

/**
 * Lista os campos de Stats.
 * @param {Object} stats
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function fields(stats) {
  return stats ? Object.keys(stats) : [];
}

/**
 * @file tags.js
 * @module components
 * @description Conjunto de strings livres (tags).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/mutation-system, systems/search-system
 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const TAGS = COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS;

/**
 * Cria Tags a partir de array.
 * @param {string[]|Set<string>} [values=[]]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeTags(values = []) {
  const arr = Array.isArray(values) ? values : Array.from(values);
  return { values: [...new Set(arr.filter(Boolean).map(String))] };
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Tags válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isTags(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && Array.isArray(v.values);
}

/**
 * Verifica se uma tag está presente.
 * @param {Object} tags
 * @param {string} tag
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function hasTag(tags, tag) {
  return Array.isArray(tags?.values) && tags.values.includes(tag);
}

/**
 * Adiciona uma tag (idempotente).
 * @param {Object} tags
 * @param {string} tag
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function addTag(tags, tag) {
  const before = Array.isArray(tags?.values) ? tags.values : [];
  if (before.includes(tag)) return { values: [...before] };
  return { values: [...before, tag] };
}

/**
 * Remove uma tag (idempotente).
 * @param {Object} tags
 * @param {string} tag
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function removeTag(tags, tag) {
  const before = Array.isArray(tags?.values) ? tags.values : [];
  return { values: before.filter(t => t !== tag) };
}

/**
 * Lista as tags.
 * @param {Object} tags
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function tagValues(tags) {
  return Array.isArray(tags?.values) ? [...tags.values] : [];
}

 * @level 4
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export const TEXTS = COMPONENT_NAMES.TEXTS;

/**
 * Cria Texts a partir de um objeto.
 * @param {Object} [data={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeTexts(data = {}) {
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) {
    if (v !== undefined && v !== null) out[k] = String(v);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é Texts válido.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isTexts(v) {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
}

/**
 * Lê um texto.
 * @param {Object} texts
 * @param {string} field
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function getText(texts, field) {
  return texts?.[field] ?? '';
}

/**
 * Define um texto (substitui).
 * @param {Object} texts
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {string} value
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function setText(texts, field, value) {
  return { ...(texts || {}), [field]: String(value ?? '') };
}

/**
 * Concatena a um texto existente.
 * @param {Object} texts
 * @param {string} field
 * @param {string} suffix
 * @param {string} [sep=' ']
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function concatText(texts, field, suffix, sep = ' ') {
  const before = getText(texts, field);
  const next = before ? `${before}${sep}${suffix}` : String(suffix);
  return { ...(texts || {}), [field]: next };
}

/**
 * Lista os campos.
 * @param {Object} texts
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function fields(texts) {
  return texts ? Object.keys(texts) : [];
}
