```javascript
/**
 * @file storage-sheets-backend.gs
 * @module data
 * @description Backend Google Apps Script (Web App) para o SheetsStorageAdapter.
 * @companion data/storage-sheets.js
 * @language Google Apps Script (JavaScript + APIs Google)
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * INSTALAÇÃO (5 minutos)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * 1. Crie uma planilha Google Sheets em branco.
 *    (É onde os dados serão guardados.)
 *
 * 2. Abra a planilha → Extensões → Apps Script.
 *
 * 3. Apague o conteúdo padrão e cole TODO este arquivo.
 *
 * 4. Salve o projeto (Ctrl+S). Dê um nome, ex.: "Narrative Storage".
 *
 * 5. Rode a função `setup()` uma vez (menu ▶ Run).
 *    Isso cria a aba "KV" com os cabeçalhos corretos.
 *    Autorize as permissões quando o Google pedir.
 *
 * 6. (Opcional) Rode `setApiKey('sua-chave-secreta')` para ativar
 *    autenticação. Se não rodar, o backend fica em modo aberto.
 *
 * 7. Implantar → Nova implantação:
 *      - Tipo:  App da Web
 *      - Executar como:  Eu (seu@email.com)
 *      - Quem tem acesso:  Qualquer pessoa
 *    Copie a URL gerada (termina em /exec).
 *
 * 8. Cole essa URL no cliente:
 *      const adapter = new SheetsStorageAdapter({ webAppUrl: 'https://...' });
 *    Ou via localStorage:
 *      localStorage.setItem('narr:config:sheets:url', 'https://...');
 *    Ou via `setApiKey` no cliente, se você ativou auth no passo 6:
 *      localStorage.setItem('narr:config:sheets:key', 'sua-chave-secreta');
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * PROTOCOLO (o que o cliente envia e o que este backend devolve)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Todos os requests têm um parâmetro `action`:
 *
 *   ping     → verifica se o backend está vivo
 *              req:  { action: 'ping' }
 *              res:  { ok: true }
 *
 *   get      → lê uma chave
 *              req:  { action: 'get', key: 'world:main' }
 *              res:  { ok: true, value: '...' | null }
 *
 *   set      → grava uma chave (POST)
 *              req:  { action: 'set', key: 'world:main', value: '...' }
 *              res:  { ok: true }
 *
 *   delete   → remove uma chave (POST)
 *              req:  { action: 'delete', key: 'world:main' }
 *              res:  { ok: true }
 *
 *   list     → lista todas as chaves
 *              req:  { action: 'list' }
 *              res:  { ok: true, keys: ['world:main', 'meta:lastTick', ...] }
 *
 * Erros:
 *   res: { ok: false, error: 'mensagem' }
 *
 * Autenticação (opcional):
 *   - Se a Script Property `API_KEY` estiver definida, todo request
 *     precisa enviar `apiKey` (query no GET, campo no body do POST).
 *   - Se `API_KEY` não existir, modo aberto (sem auth).
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * ESTRUTURA DA PLANILHA
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   Aba "KV":
 *     ┌───────────┬───────────────┐
 *     │ A (key)   │ B (value)     │
 *     ├───────────┼───────────────┤
 *     │ world:main│ {"version":1..│
 *     │ meta:...  │ ...           │
 *     └───────────┴───────────────┘
 *
 * Valores são sempre strings. O cliente já cuida de compressão (gzip)
 * antes de enviar, então o backend não precisa saber o formato.
 */

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONFIGURAÇÃO
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** Nome da aba que guarda os pares chave-valor */
var SHEET_NAME = 'KV';

/** Coluna da chave (1-indexada) */
var KEY_COL = 1;

/** Coluna do valor (1-indexada) */
var VALUE_COL = 2;

/** Timeout do lock (ms) */
var LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000;

/** Tamanho máximo do value (10 MB — limite de célula do Sheets é ~50k chars) */
var MAX_VALUE_LENGTH = 45000;

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ENTRYPOINTS (chamados pelo Google Apps Script)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Handler de requisições GET.
 * @param {Object} e — evento do Apps Script (params em e.parameter)
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 */
function doGet(e) {
  return _dispatch(e, false);
}

/**
 * Handler de requisições POST.
 * @param {Object} e — evento do Apps Script (body em e.postData.contents)
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 */
function doPost(e) {
  return _dispatch(e, true);
}

/**
 * Handler de CORS preflight.
 * Apps Script não permite customizar headers CORS completamente, mas
 * responder OPTIONS evita alguns erros de preflight em navegadores.
 * @param {Object} e
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 */
function doOptions(e) {
  return _jsonOutput({ ok: true });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DISPATCH
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Roteia a requisição para o handler apropriado.
 * @param {Object} e
 * @param {boolean} isPost
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _dispatch(e, isPost) {
  var params;

  try {
    params = isPost ? _parsePostBody(e) : _parseGetParams(e);
  } catch (err) {
    return _error('payload inválido: ' + err.message);
  }

  var action = params.action;

  // Auth (só checa se API_KEY estiver configurada no servidor)
  var auth = _checkAuth(params.apiKey);
  if (!auth.ok) {
    return _error(auth.error || 'unauthorized');
  }

  try {
    switch (action) {
      case 'ping':   return _handlePing();
      case 'get':    return _handleGet(params);
      case 'set':    return _handleSet(params);
      case 'delete': return _handleDelete(params);
      case 'list':   return _handleList();
      default:       return _error('action desconhecida: ' + action);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    return _error('erro interno: ' + err.message);
  }
}

/**
 * Extrai params de uma requisição GET (e.parameter).
 * @param {Object} e
 * @returns {Object}
 * @private
 */
function _parseGetParams(e) {
  if (!e || !e.parameter) return {};
  return e.parameter;
}

/**
 * Extrai params do body de uma requisição POST.
 * Aceita Content-Type application/json OU text/plain (fallback).
 * @param {Object} e
 * @returns {Object}
 * @private
 */
function _parsePostBody(e) {
  if (!e || !e.postData || !e.postData.contents) {
    // Alguns clientes enviam como form-urlencoded → cai em e.parameter
    if (e && e.parameter) return e.parameter;
    return {};
  }

  var raw = e.postData.contents;
  try {
    var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {};
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error('body não é JSON: ' + raw.slice(0, 100));
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HANDLERS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * `ping` — health check.
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _handlePing() {
  return _ok({});
}

/**
 * `get` — lê uma chave.
 * @param {Object} params
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _handleGet(params) {
  var key = params.key;
  if (!key) return _error('get: key obrigatória');

  return _withLock(function() {
    var sheet = _getSheet();
    var row = _findRow(sheet, key);

    if (row < 0) {
      return _ok({ value: null });
    }

    var value = sheet.getRange(row, VALUE_COL).getValue();
    if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) {
      return _ok({ value: null });
    }

    return _ok({ value: String(value) });
  });
}

/**
 * `set` — grava uma chave.
 * @param {Object} params
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _handleSet(params) {
  var key = params.key;
  var value = params.value;

  if (!key) return _error('set: key obrigatória');
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return _error('set: value deve ser string');
  if (value.length > MAX_VALUE_LENGTH) {
    return _error('set: value excede ' + MAX_VALUE_LENGTH + ' chars (recebido ' + value.length + ')');
  }

  return _withLock(function() {
    var sheet = _getSheet();
    var row = _findRow(sheet, key);

    if (row < 0) {
      // Append nova linha
      sheet.appendRow([key, value]);
    } else {
      // Atualiza linha existente
      sheet.getRange(row, VALUE_COL).setValue(value);
    }

    return _ok({});
  });
}

/**
 * `delete` — remove uma chave.
 * @param {Object} params
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _handleDelete(params) {
  var key = params.key;
  if (!key) return _error('delete: key obrigatória');

  return _withLock(function() {
    var sheet = _getSheet();
    var row = _findRow(sheet, key);

    if (row > 0) {
      sheet.deleteRow(row);
    }

    return _ok({});
  });
}

/**
 * `list` — lista todas as chaves.
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _handleList() {
  return _withLock(function() {
    var sheet = _getSheet();
    var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();

    if (lastRow < 2) {
      return _ok({ keys: [] });
    }

    var values = sheet.getRange(2, KEY_COL, lastRow - 1, 1).getValues();
    var keys = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      var k = values[i][0];
      if (k !== '' && k !== null && k !== undefined) {
        keys.push(String(k));
      }
    }

    return _ok({ keys: keys });
  });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Retorna a aba "KV", criando-a se necessário.
 * @returns {Sheet}
 * @private
 */
function _getSheet() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss) {
    throw new Error('nenhuma planilha ativa (script não é container-bound?)');
  }

  var sheet = ss.getSheetByName(SHEET_NAME);

  if (!sheet) {
    sheet = ss.insertSheet(SHEET_NAME);
  }

  // Garante cabeçalho
  if (sheet.getLastRow() === 0) {
    sheet.appendRow(['key', 'value']);
    sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
  }

  return sheet;
}

/**
 * Encontra a linha de uma chave (1-indexada). Retorna -1 se ausente.
 * Assume que o cabeçalho está na linha 1.
 * @param {Sheet} sheet
 * @param {string} key
 * @returns {number}
 * @private
 */
function _findRow(sheet, key) {
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return -1;

  var values = sheet.getRange(2, KEY_COL, lastRow - 1, 1).getValues();
  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var k = values[i][0];
    if (k === key) return i + 2; // +2 por causa do header e 1-indexação
  }
  return -1;
}

/**
 * Verifica autenticação.
 * Se `API_KEY` não estiver definida em Script Properties, permite tudo.
 * @param {string} providedKey
 * @returns {{ ok:boolean, error?:string }}
 * @private
 */
function _checkAuth(providedKey) {
  var expected = null;
  try {
    expected = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('API_KEY');
  } catch (err) {
    // Sem acesso a Properties — modo aberto
    return { ok: true };
  }

  if (!expected) return { ok: true }; // modo aberto

  if (!providedKey) return { ok: false, error: 'apiKey ausente' };
  if (String(providedKey) !== String(expected)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'apiKey inválida' };
  }

  return { ok: true };
}

/**
 * Executa `fn()` dentro de um Lock exclusivo.
 * Protege contra escritas concorrentes que corromperiam os dados.
 * @param {Function} fn
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _withLock(fn) {
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  var acquired = false;

  try {
    lock.waitLock(LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS);
    acquired = true;
    return fn();
  } catch (err) {
    return _error('lock timeout ou erro: ' + err.message);
  } finally {
    if (acquired) {
      try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (e) { /* noop */ }
    }
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// OUTPUT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Serializa um objeto e devolve como JSON.
 * @param {Object} obj
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _jsonOutput(obj) {
  var json = JSON.stringify(obj);
  return ContentService
    .createTextOutput(json)
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

/**
 * Resposta de sucesso.
 * @param {Object} data
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _ok(data) {
  var out = { ok: true };
  if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
    for (var k in data) {
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, k)) {
        out[k] = data[k];
      }
    }
  }
  return _jsonOutput(out);
}

/**
 * Resposta de erro.
 * @param {string} message
 * @returns {ContentService.TextOutput}
 * @private
 */
function _error(message) {
  return _jsonOutput({ ok: false, error: String(message || 'erro desconhecido') });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SETUP (rodar uma vez manualmente)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Cria a aba "KV" com cabeçalhos, se não existir.
 * Rode isso UMA vez após colar este arquivo no Apps Script.
 */
function setup() {
  var sheet = _getSheet();
  Logger.log('OK — aba "%s" pronta com %s linhas', SHEET_NAME, sheet.getLastRow());
}

/**
 * Define a API key.
 * Depois de rodar isso, todo request precisa enviar `apiKey`.
 * @param {string} key
 */
function setApiKey(key) {
  if (!key) {
    Logger.log('Uso: setApiKey("sua-chave-secreta")');
    return;
  }
  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty('API_KEY', String(key));
  Logger.log('API_KEY definida.');
}

/**
 * Remove a API key (volta ao modo aberto).
 */
function clearApiKey() {
  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().deleteProperty('API_KEY');
  Logger.log('API_KEY removida — modo aberto.');
}

/**
 * Mostra a API key atual (para debug).
 */
function showApiKey() {
  var k = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('API_KEY');
  Logger.log('API_KEY: %s', k || '(não definida — modo aberto)');
}

/**
 * Roda um self-test do backend (sem rede).
 * Útil para verificar se a planilha está acessível.
 */
function selfTest() {
  Logger.log('=== selfTest ===');

  try {
    var sheet = _getSheet();
    Logger.log('Aba "%s" OK — %s linhas', SHEET_NAME, sheet.getLastRow());
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log('FALHOU: _getSheet → %s', err.message);
    return;
  }

  try {
    _handleSet({ key: '__selftest__', value: 'hello ' + Date.now() });
    Logger.log('set OK');

    var got = _handleGet({ key: '__selftest__' });
    Logger.log('get OK — %s', got.getContent());

    var list = _handleList();
    Logger.log('list OK — %s', list.getContent());

    _handleDelete({ key: '__selftest__' });
    Logger.log('delete OK');

    Logger.log('=== todos os testes passaram ===');
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log('FALHOU: %s', err.message);
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// NOTAS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// • Limite de célula: ~50.000 caracteres. O cliente já comprime o
//   payload (gzip + base64), então o valor que chega aqui geralmente
//   é menor que o JSON cru. Se você tem mundos muito grandes, aumente
//   a frequência de `flush()` ou considere chunking (não implementado).
//
// • Limite de células da planilha: 10 milhões. Um mundo com 500 KB de
//   JSON gzipado ocupa 1 célula. O ring de chaves é pequeno (~10-20).
//
// • Concorrência: `_withLock()` serializa writes. Leituras também
//   passam por lock para evitar ler estado inconsistente durante
//   um set (Apps Script não tem transações reais).
//
// • Cold start: primeira requisição após deploy pode demorar ~2s.
//   O cliente já tolera com timeout de 10s (configurável).
//
// • CORS: Apps Script Web Apps (implantados como "Qualquer pessoa")
//   respondem com os headers CORS corretos automaticamente. Se você
//   encontrar erro de preflight, verifique se a implantação está
//   como "Qualquer pessoa" e não "Somente eu".
//
// • Re-deploy: se você alterar este arquivo depois de implantar,
//   precisa criar uma NOVA implantação (Implantar → Gerenciar
//   implantações → editar → nova versão) para as mudanças valerem.
//   A URL `/exec` continua a mesma.
//
// • Debug: use `Logger.log()` + menu Execuções no Apps Script.
//   Rode `selfTest()` após qualquer alteração para sanity-check.
//
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file storage-sheets.js
 * @module data
 * @description Adapter Google Sheets via Apps Script Web App (fetch).
 * @imports data/storage, core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/persistence-system, boot.js
 * @level 2
 *
 * Configuração em runtime:
 *   - URL do Web App e API key podem ser definidas via `setWebAppUrl()` e
 *     `setApiKey()`, ou carregadas de localStorage via `loadConfigFromStorage()`.
 *   - Por padrão, `autoLoad = true` faz o constructor tentar carregar do
 *     localStorage automaticamente (chaves: `narr:config:sheets:url` e
 *     `narr:config:sheets:key`).
 *   - `setWebAppUrl` / `setApiKey` persistem automaticamente em localStorage
 *     (desativável com `{ persist: false }`).
 *   - `clearConfig()` remove tudo do localStorage e reseta o estado interno.
 */

import { StorageAdapter, StorageError } from './storage.js';
import { STORAGE_LIMITS, STORAGE_KEYS } from '../core/constants.js';

// ── Chaves de configuração persistida ─────────────────────────
const CONFIG_PREFIX = 'narr:';
const CONFIG_KEYS = Object.freeze({
  URL: `${CONFIG_PREFIX}${STORAGE_KEYS.CONFIG_PREFIX}sheets:url`,
  KEY: `${CONFIG_PREFIX}${STORAGE_KEYS.CONFIG_PREFIX}sheets:key`,
});

export class SheetsStorageAdapter extends StorageAdapter {
  /**
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {string} [opts.webAppUrl=''] — URL do Google Apps Script Web App
   * @param {string} [opts.apiKey=''] — chave opcional de autenticação
   * @param {number} [opts.timeout=10000] — timeout por requisição (ms)
   * @param {boolean} [opts.autoLoad=true] — carrega config do localStorage no construct
   */
  constructor({
    webAppUrl = '',
    apiKey = '',
    timeout = 10_000,
    autoLoad = true,
  } = {}) {
    super('sheets');
    this.webAppUrl = webAppUrl;
    this.apiKey = apiKey;
    this.timeout = timeout;

    /** @type {Map<string, string>} — cache write-through */
    this._cache = new Map();

    if (autoLoad && !this.webAppUrl) {
      this.loadConfigFromStorage();
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Configuração
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Define a URL do Web App.
   * @param {string} url
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.persist=true] — salva em localStorage
   */
  setWebAppUrl(url, { persist = true } = {}) {
    this.webAppUrl = String(url || '');
    this._available = null;
    this._cache.clear();
    if (persist) this._storageSet(CONFIG_KEYS.URL, this.webAppUrl);
  }

  /**
   * Define a API key.
   * @param {string} key
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.persist=true] — salva em localStorage
   */
  setApiKey(key, { persist = true } = {}) {
    this.apiKey = String(key || '');
    if (persist) this._storageSet(CONFIG_KEYS.KEY, this.apiKey);
  }

  /**
   * Carrega URL e API key do localStorage.
   * Não lança — silenciosamente ignora se localStorage indisponível.
   * @returns {{ url:boolean, key:boolean }} — quais foram carregados
   */
  loadConfigFromStorage() {
    const url = this._storageGet(CONFIG_KEYS.URL);
    const key = this._storageGet(CONFIG_KEYS.KEY);

    if (url) {
      this.webAppUrl = url;
      this._available = null;
      this._cache.clear();
    }
    if (key) {
      this.apiKey = key;
    }
    return { url: !!url, key: !!key };
  }

  /**
   * Persiste a config atual no localStorage.
   * @returns {{ url:boolean, key:boolean }} — quais foram salvos
   */
  saveConfigToStorage() {
    const okUrl = this._storageSet(CONFIG_KEYS.URL, this.webAppUrl);
    const okKey = this._storageSet(CONFIG_KEYS.KEY, this.apiKey);
    return { url: okUrl, key: okKey };
  }

  /**
   * Remove config do localStorage e reseta o estado interno.
   */
  clearConfig() {
    this._storageRemove(CONFIG_KEYS.URL);
    this._storageRemove(CONFIG_KEYS.KEY);
    this.webAppUrl = '';
    this.apiKey = '';
    this._available = null;
    this._cache.clear();
  }

  /**
   * Verifica se há config mínima para funcionar.
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  isConfigured() {
    return !!this.webAppUrl;
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Disponibilidade
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async _checkAvailable() {
    if (!this.webAppUrl) return false;
    if (typeof fetch !== 'function') return false;
    try {
      const res = await this._fetch('ping');
      return res?.ok === true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // API principal
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async get(key) {
    this._assertKey(key);

    // Write-through cache
    if (this._cache.has(key)) return this._cache.get(key);

    try {
      const res = await this._fetch('get', { key });
      if (!res || !res.ok) return null;

      const value = typeof res.value === 'string' ? res.value : null;
      if (value !== null) this._cache.set(key, value);
      return value;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new StorageError(
        `[sheets] falha ao ler "${key}": ${err.message}`,
        { code: 'READ_FAILED', cause: err }
      );
    }
  }

  async set(key, value) {
    this._assertKey(key);
    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
      throw new StorageError('[sheets] valor deve ser string', { code: 'INVALID_VALUE' });
    }

    try {
      const res = await this._fetch('set', { key, value }, 'POST');
      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        throw new Error(res?.error || 'resposta inválida');
      }
      this._cache.set(key, value);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new StorageError(
        `[sheets] falha ao escrever "${key}": ${err.message}`,
        { code: 'WRITE_FAILED', cause: err }
      );
    }
  }

  async delete(key) {
    this._assertKey(key);
    try {
      const res = await this._fetch('delete', { key }, 'POST');
      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        throw new Error(res?.error || 'resposta inválida');
      }
      this._cache.delete(key);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new StorageError(
        `[sheets] falha ao remover "${key}": ${err.message}`,
        { code: 'DELETE_FAILED', cause: err }
      );
    }
  }

  async list() {
    try {
      const res = await this._fetch('list');
      if (!res || !res.ok) return [];
      return Array.isArray(res.keys) ? res.keys.map(String) : [];
    } catch (err) {
      throw new StorageError(
        `[sheets] falha ao listar: ${err.message}`,
        { code: 'LIST_FAILED', cause: err }
      );
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Diagnóstico
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  getLimit() {
    return STORAGE_LIMITS.sheets;
  }

  async getBytesInUse() {
    try {
      const keys = await this.list();
      let bytes = 0;
      for (const k of keys) {
        const v = await this.get(k);
        if (v) bytes += k.length + v.length;
      }
      return bytes;
    } catch {
      return -1;
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Ciclo de vida
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Limpa o cache local (não o servidor).
   */
  clearCache() {
    this._cache.clear();
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Executa uma requisição ao Web App.
   * @param {string} action
   * @param {Object} [params]
   * @param {'GET'|'POST'} [method='GET']
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _fetch(action, params = {}, method = 'GET') {
    if (!this.webAppUrl) {
      throw new Error('webAppUrl não configurada');
    }

    const controller = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined'
      ? new AbortController()
      : null;

    const timeoutId = controller
      ? setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), this.timeout)
      : null;

    try {
      let url = this.webAppUrl;
      let body = null;

      const payload = {
        action,
        ...params,
        ...(this.apiKey ? { apiKey: this.apiKey } : {}),
      };

      if (method === 'GET') {
        const qs = new URLSearchParams(payload).toString();
        url = `${url}${url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}${qs}`;
      } else {
        body = JSON.stringify(payload);
      }

      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: method === 'POST'
          ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
          : undefined,
        body,
        signal: controller?.signal,
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      return data;
    } finally {
      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
  }

  _assertKey(key) {
    if (typeof key !== 'string' || !key) {
      throw new StorageError('[sheets] chave inválida', { code: 'INVALID_KEY' });
    }
  }

  // ── Helpers de localStorage (defensivos) ────────────────────

  /**
   * Lê do localStorage sem lançar.
   * @param {string} key
   * @returns {string|null}
   * @private
   */
  _storageGet(key) {
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return null;
      const v = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return v === null ? null : String(v);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Escreve no localStorage sem lançar.
   * @param {string} key
   * @param {string} value
   * @returns {boolean}
   * @private
   */
  _storageSet(key, value) {
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return false;
      localStorage.setItem(key, String(value ?? ''));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Remove do localStorage sem lançar.
   * @param {string} key
   * @returns {boolean}
   * @private
   */
  _storageRemove(key) {
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return false;
      localStorage.removeItem(key);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file storage.js
 * @module data
 * @description Contrato abstrato de storage. Implementações: storage-gm, storage-idb, storage-ls, storage-sheets.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy data/storage-gm, data/storage-idb, data/storage-ls, data/storage-sheets
 * @level 1
 */

/**
 * Erro específico de storage.
 */
export class StorageError extends Error {
  constructor(message, { code, cause } = {}) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'StorageError';
    this.code = code || 'UNKNOWN';
    this.cause = cause;
  }
}

/**
 * Classe base abstrata de storage.
 *
 * Contrato:
 *   - Todos os métodos são async.
 *   - Chaves são strings não-vazias.
 *   - Valores são strings (JSON ou binário codificado).
 *   - Implementações devem ser idempotentes.
 *   - Métodos de leitura retornam null se chave ausente.
 */
export class StorageAdapter {
  constructor(name = 'unknown') {
    if (new.target === StorageAdapter) {
      throw new TypeError('[StorageAdapter] classe abstrata — use uma subclasse');
    }
    this.name = name;
    this._available = null;
  }

  // ── Disponibilidade ─────────────────────────────────────────

  async isAvailable() {
    if (this._available !== null) return this._available;
    try {
      this._available = await this._checkAvailable();
    } catch {
      this._available = false;
    }
    return this._available;
  }

  async _checkAvailable() {
    return false;
  }

  // ── Leitura / Escrita ───────────────────────────────────────

  async get(_key) {
    throw new StorageError(`[${this.name}] get() não implementado`, { code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' });
  }

  async set(_key, _value) {
    throw new StorageError(`[${this.name}] set() não implementado`, { code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' });
  }

  async delete(_key) {
    throw new StorageError(`[${this.name}] delete() não implementado`, { code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' });
  }

  async list() {
    throw new StorageError(`[${this.name}] list() não implementado`, { code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' });
  }

  // ── Diagnóstico ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  async getBytesInUse() {
    return -1;
  }

  async hasSpaceFor(_n) {
    return true;
  }

  getLimit() {
    return -1;
  }

  // ── Ciclo de vida ───────────────────────────────────────────

  async clear() {
    const keys = await this.list();
    for (const k of keys) {
      await this.delete(k);
    }
  }

  async close() {
    // no-op por padrão
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file commands-diag.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Handlers dos comandos `diag.*`. Despachados pelo DiagnosticsSystem.
 * @imports diagnostics/smoke-tests
 * @importedBy systems/diagnostics-system
 * @level 9
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Refatoração estrutural (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   Removido o import estático de `NarrativeDiagHandlers`. Agora o
 *   `NarrativeSystem` registra um handler próprio via
 *   `bus.emit('diag:handler:register', { verb: 'narrative', handler })`
 *   no seu `init()`. Este arquivo consulta o Map antes do switch.
 *
 *   Isso elimina o acoplamento direto `systems/` → `narrative-language/`
 *   (que o README do LUME declara como fronteira).
 *
 * Contrato:
 *   - `dispatch(prev, ast)` recebe o result acumulado + AST.
 *   - Cada handler devolve `{ ...prev, ok, mutated, right?, ... }`.
 *   - Handlers assíncronos emitem `render:right` e devolvem "em progresso".
 *   - NUNCA lançam para fora.
 *   - `registerHandler(verb, handler)` permite extensão externa.
 */

import { SmokeTests } from './smoke-tests.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CLASSE
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export class DiagnosticsCommands {
  /**
   * @param {Object} system — instância de DiagnosticsSystem
   */
  constructor(system) {
    if (!system) throw new Error('[DiagnosticsCommands] system obrigatório');
    this.system = system;

    /**
     * Handlers externos registrados via `diag:handler:register`.
     * Mapa verb → (prev, ast) => result.
     * @type {Map<string, Function>}
     * @private
     */
    this._handlers = new Map();

    this._smokeRunning = false;
    this._fuzzRunning = false;
    this._bundleBuilding = false;
    this._testRunning = false;
  }

  get machine() { return this.system.machine; }
  get world()   { return this.system.world; }
  get bus()     { return this.system.bus; }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Registro de handlers externos (Fase 13.7)
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Registra um handler para um subcomando `diag.<verb>`.
   * Idempotente (sobrescreve).
   *
   * @param {string} verb — ex: 'narrative'
   * @param {Function} handler — (prev, ast) => SystemResult parcial
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  registerHandler(verb, handler) {
    if (typeof verb !== 'string' || !verb) return false;
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') return false;
    this._handlers.set(verb, handler);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Remove um handler registrado.
   * @param {string} verb
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  unregisterHandler(verb) {
    return this._handlers.delete(verb);
  }

  /**
   * Lista verbs com handler registrado.
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  listRegisteredHandlers() {
    return Array.from(this._handlers.keys()).sort();
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Dispatch
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  dispatch(prev, ast) {
    const action = ast?.action;
    if (!action) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'diag sem ação' };
    }

    // 1. Handlers externos registrados via bus
    const registered = this._handlers.get(action);
    if (typeof registered === 'function') {
      try {
        return registered(prev, ast);
      } catch (err) {
        return {
          ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
          error: `handler "${action}" falhou: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}`,
        };
      }
    }

    // 2. Handlers built-in
    try {
      switch (action) {
        case 'status':     return this.status(prev);
        case 'on':         return this.toggle(prev, true);
        case 'off':        return this.toggle(prev, false);
        case 'mode':       return this.mode(prev, ast);
        case 'flight':     return this.flight(prev, ast);
        case 'counts':     return this.counts(prev);
        case 'logs':       return this.logs(prev, ast);
        case 'traces':     return this.traces(prev, ast);
        case 'invariants': return this.invariants(prev, ast);
        case 'contracts':  return this.contracts(prev, ast);
        case 'health':     return this.health(prev);
        case 'rules':      return this.rules(prev, ast);
        case 'smoke':      return this.smoke(prev);
        case 'snapshot':   return this.snapshot(prev);
        case 'clear':      return this.clear(prev);

        case 'rca':        return this.rca(prev, ast);
        case 'inject':     return this.inject(prev, ast);
        case 'fuzz':       return this.fuzz(prev, ast);
        case 'replay':     return this.replay(prev, ast);
        case 'bundle':     return this.bundle(prev, ast);

        case 'test':       return this.test(prev, ast);
        case 'baseline':   return this.baseline(prev, ast);

        // NOTA: `narrative` NÃO está aqui. É registrado via bus
        // pelo NarrativeSystem. Se o sistema narrativo não estiver
        // no pipeline, o dispatch retorna o erro abaixo.

        default:
          return {
            ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
            error: `diag.${action} não suportado`,
          };
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: err?.message ?? String(err),
      };
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 4
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  status(prev) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const st = suite.status();
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: {
        kind: 'diagnostics',
        title: '🔬 diag.status',
        data: { status: {
          installed: st.installed,
          mode: st.mode,
          sessionId: st.sessionId,
          uptimeMs: st.uptimeMs,
          env: st.env,
          recorderTotal: st.recorder?.total ?? 0,
          recorderInBuffer: st.recorder?.inBuffer ?? 0,
          loggerSize: st.logger?.size ?? 0,
          wrappedSystems: st.instrumentation?.systems?.length ?? 0,
          tracerTraces: st.tracer?.traces ?? 0,
          invariantViolations: st.checker?.totalViolations ?? 0,
          contractViolations: st.contracts?.totalViolations ?? 0,
          healthAnomalies: st.health?.anomalies ?? 0,
          expectationFailures: st.expectations?.failures ?? 0,
          pipelineReports: st.pipelineReport?.total ?? 0,
          replaySessions: st.replayEngine?.sessions ?? 0,
          injectionsActive: st.faultInjector?.active ?? 0,
        }},
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  toggle(prev, on) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    if (on) suite.start(); else suite.stop();
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: {
        kind: 'diagnostics',
        title: on ? '🔬 diag.on' : '🔬 diag.off',
        data: { status: { mode: suite.getMode(), enabled: on } },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  mode(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const mode = ast.value;
    if (!mode) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'uso: diag.mode <off|light|full|dev>' };
    suite.setMode(mode);
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: {
        kind: 'diagnostics',
        title: `🔬 modo → ${mode}`,
        data: { status: {
          mode: suite.getMode(),
          recorderEnabled: suite.recorder.enabled,
          loggerEnabled: suite.logger.enabled,
          tracerEnabled: suite.tracer.enabled,
          checkerEnabled: suite.checker.enabled,
          contractsEnabled: suite.contracts.enabled,
          healthEnabled: suite.health.enabled,
        }},
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  flight(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const n = ast.opts?.n ? parseInt(ast.opts.n, 10) : 100;
    const events = suite.flight(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 100);
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.flight (${events.length})`, data: { events }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  counts(prev) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const counts = suite.eventCounts();
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.counts (${Object.keys(counts).length} tipos)`, data: { counts }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  logs(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const n = ast.opts?.n ? parseInt(ast.opts.n, 10) : 100;
    const level = ast.opts?.level ?? null;
    const logs = suite.logs(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 100, level);
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.logs${level ? ` [${level}]` : ''} (${logs.length})`, data: { logs }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  traces(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const tracer = suite.tracer;
    if (!tracer) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.traces', data: { raw: 'Tracer indisponível.' } } };
    const n = ast.opts?.n ? parseInt(ast.opts.n, 10) : 10;
    const traces = tracer.getRecentTraces(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 10);
    const stats = tracer.stats();
    const rows = traces.map(t => {
      const tree = tracer.getTree(t.id);
      return { seq: t.startTs, event: t.name, tick: null, payload: { traceId: t.id, durationMs: t.durationMs, spanCount: t.spanIds?.length ?? 0, hasError: !!tree?.root?.exceptions?.length } };
    });
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.traces (${rows.length}/${stats.traces})`, data: { status: stats, events: rows }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  invariants(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const checker = suite.checker;
    if (!checker) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.invariants', data: { raw: 'InvariantChecker indisponível.' } } };
    try { checker.check(); } catch { /* isola */ }
    const n = ast.opts?.n ? parseInt(ast.opts.n, 10) : 20;
    const list = checker.violations({ limit: Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 20 });
    const stats = checker.stats();
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.invariants (${list.length}/${stats.totalViolations})`, data: { status: stats, events: list.map(v => ({ seq: v.ts, event: v.code, tick: v.tick, payload: { severity: v.severity, message: v.message, context: v.context } })) }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  contracts(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const guard = suite.contracts;
    if (!guard) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.contracts', data: { raw: 'ContractGuard indisponível.' } } };
    const n = ast.opts?.n ? parseInt(ast.opts.n, 10) : 20;
    const list = guard.violations(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 20);
    const stats = guard.stats();
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.contracts (${list.length}/${stats.totalViolations})`, data: { status: stats, events: list.map(v => ({ seq: v.ts, event: `contract:${v.type}`, tick: null, payload: { contract: v.contract, message: v.message } })) }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  health(prev) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const probes = suite.health;
    if (!probes) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.health', data: { raw: 'HealthProbes indisponível.' } } };
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.health', data: { status: probes.stats(), events: probes.detectedAnomalies(20).map(a => ({ seq: a.ts, event: a.code, tick: null, payload: { severity: a.severity, message: a.message, context: a.context } })) }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  rules(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const n = ast.opts?.n ? parseInt(ast.opts.n, 10) : 30;
    const events = suite.eventsByType('rule:evaluated', Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 30);
    const fired = events.filter(e => e.payload?.fired === true).length;
    const skipped = events.length - fired;
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.rules (fired: ${fired}, skipped: ${skipped})`, data: { status: { total: events.length, fired, skipped }, events: events.map(e => ({ seq: e.seq, event: e.event, tick: e.tick, payload: e.payload })) }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  smoke(prev) {
    if (this._smokeRunning) {
      return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.smoke', data: { raw: 'Smoke tests já estão rodando...' } } };
    }
    this._smokeRunning = true;
    const persist = this.machine?.systems?.get?.('PersistenceSystem') ?? null;
    const bus = this.bus;
    SmokeTests.run({ machine: this.machine, world: this.world, bus, persist })
      .then(report => {
        bus.emit('render:right', {
          kind: 'diagnostics',
          title: `🔬 smoke ${report.ok ? '✓' : '✗'} (${report.passed}/${report.total})`,
          data: { status: { ok: report.ok, passed: report.passed, failed: report.failed, total: report.total }, events: report.results.map(r => ({ seq: null, event: r.name, tick: null, payload: { ok: r.ok, ms: r.ms, error: r.error ?? null } })) },
          sticky: true,
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.smoke — erro', data: { raw: err.message } });
      })
      .finally(() => { this._smokeRunning = false; });
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.smoke', data: { raw: 'Rodando smoke tests...' } } };
  }

  snapshot(prev) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const snap = suite.snapshot();
    const json = JSON.stringify(snap, null, 2);
    return {
      ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
      right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.snapshot (${(json.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`, data: { status: snap.meta, raw: json.slice(0, 5000) + (json.length > 5000 ? '\n... (truncado)' : '') }, sticky: true },
    };
  }

  clear(prev) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    suite.clear();
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.clear', data: { status: { cleared: true } } } };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 5/6
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  rca(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const rca = suite.rca;
    if (!rca) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.rca', data: { raw: 'RootCauseAnalyzer indisponível.' } } };
    const n = ast.opts?.n ? parseInt(ast.opts.n, 10) : 30;
    const recent = suite.flight(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 30);
    const errorEvent = recent.slice().reverse().find(e => e.event === 'system:error' || e.event === 'rule:error' || e.event === 'persist:failed');
    if (errorEvent) {
      const report = rca.analyze({ error: errorEvent.payload?.error ?? errorEvent.payload?.message ?? 'erro', line: errorEvent.payload?.line ?? null, traceId: errorEvent.payload?.traceId ?? null, recorder: suite.recorder, tracer: suite.tracer, checker: suite.checker, machine: this.machine, world: this.world });
      const markdown = rca.toMarkdown(report);
      return {
        ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false,
        right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.rca — ${report.probableCause.category}`, data: { status: { category: report.probableCause.category, confidence: `${(report.probableCause.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%`, summary: report.summary }, events: report.evidence.slice(-10).map(e => ({ seq: e.ts, event: e.kind, tick: null, payload: { text: e.text } })), raw: markdown }, sticky: true },
      };
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.rca — nenhum erro recente', data: { status: { analyzed: 0 }, raw: `Nenhum erro recente. Últimos ${recent.length} eventos inspecionados.` }, sticky: true } };
  }

  inject(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const injector = suite.faultInjector;
    if (!injector) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.inject', data: { raw: 'FaultInjector indisponível.' } } };
    const positional = ast.positional ?? [];
    const kind = positional[0] ?? ast.opts?.kind ?? null;
    if (!kind) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.inject (${injector.list().length} ativas)`, data: { status: injector.stats(), events: injector.list().map(i => ({ seq: i.startedAt, event: i.kind, tick: null, payload: { id: i.id, target: i.target, remainingMs: i.remainingMs } })) }, sticky: true } };
    if (kind === 'help' || kind === 'kinds') return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.inject — kinds válidos', data: { raw: 'slow | throw | drop | corrupt | stale | missing\nSintaxe: diag.inject <kind> [target] [ms=X] [probability=0..1]' }, sticky: true } };
    if (kind === 'list') return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.inject list (${injector.list().length})`, data: { status: injector.stats(), events: injector.list().map(i => ({ seq: i.startedAt, event: i.kind, tick: null, payload: { id: i.id, target: i.target, remainingMs: i.remainingMs } })) }, sticky: true } };
    if (kind === 'clear' || kind === 'ejectAll') { const n = injector.ejectAll(); return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.inject clear (${n})`, data: { status: { removed: n } } } }; }
    if (kind === 'eject') { const id = positional[1]; if (!id) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'uso: diag.inject eject <id>' }; const ok = injector.eject(id); return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.inject eject ${id}`, data: { status: { ok } } } }; }
    const target = positional[1] ?? ast.opts?.target ?? null;
    const result = injector.inject(kind, { target, ms: ast.opts?.ms ? parseInt(ast.opts.ms, 10) : 300, probability: ast.opts?.probability ? parseFloat(ast.opts.probability) : 1, ttlMs: ast.opts?.ttlMs ? parseInt(ast.opts.ttlMs, 10) : undefined, component: ast.opts?.component, message: ast.opts?.message });
    if (result.ok === false) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: result.error };
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.inject ${kind}${target ? ` em ${target}` : ''}`, data: { status: { id: result.id, kind: result.kind, target: result.target, expiresInMs: result.expiresAt - Date.now() }, raw: `Injeção ativa.` }, sticky: true } };
  }

  fuzz(prev, ast) {
    if (this._fuzzRunning) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.fuzz', data: { raw: 'Fuzzer já está rodando...' } } };
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const fuzzer = suite.fuzzer;
    if (!fuzzer) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.fuzz', data: { raw: 'Fuzzer indisponível.' } } };
    const positional = ast.positional ?? [];
    const iterations = positional[0] ? parseInt(positional[0], 10) : 500;
    const seed = ast.opts?.seed ? parseInt(ast.opts.seed, 10) : undefined;
    this._fuzzRunning = true;
    const bus = this.bus;
    fuzzer.run({ machine: this.machine, iterations: Number.isFinite(iterations) ? iterations : 500, seed: Number.isFinite(seed) ? seed : null, isolate: true })
      .then(result => {
        if (result.ok === false) { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.fuzz — erro', data: { raw: result.error } }); return; }
        bus.emit('render:right', {
          kind: 'diagnostics',
          title: `🔬 diag.fuzz — ${result.findings.length} findings / ${result.iterations} iter (seed ${result.seed})`,
          data: { status: { iterations: result.iterations, findings: result.findings.length, crashes: result.crashes.length, durationMs: result.durationMs, seed: result.seed, verbsCovered: result.coverage.verbs.length, actionsCovered: result.coverage.actions.length }, events: result.findings.slice(0, 40).map(f => ({ seq: f.iteration, event: f.threw ? 'throw' : 'halt', tick: f.tick, payload: { line: f.line, error: f.error } })), raw: result.findings.length === 0 ? '✅ Nenhum crash encontrado.' : null },
          sticky: true,
        });
      })
      .catch(err => { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.fuzz — erro', data: { raw: err.message } }); })
      .finally(() => { this._fuzzRunning = false; });
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.fuzz', data: { raw: `Rodando ${iterations} iterações...` } } };
  }

  replay(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const engine = suite.replayEngine;
    if (!engine) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.replay', data: { raw: 'ReplayEngine indisponível.' } } };
    const positional = ast.positional ?? [];
    const sub = positional[0] ?? (ast.subtype ?? 'list');

    if (sub === 'start') {
      const name = positional[1] ?? null;
      const session = engine.startSession(name);
      return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.replay start — ${session.id}`, data: { status: { sessionId: session.id, recording: true }, raw: `Gravação iniciada. Use \`diag.replay stop\`.` }, sticky: true } };
    }
    if (sub === 'stop') {
      const session = engine.endSession();
      if (!session) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.replay stop', data: { raw: 'Nenhuma sessão ativa.' } } };
      return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.replay stop — ${session.id}`, data: { status: { sessionId: session.id, commandCount: session.commands.length, durationMs: session.endedAt - session.startedAt } }, sticky: true } };
    }
    if (sub === 'clear') { engine.clearSessions(); return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.replay clear', data: { status: { cleared: true } } } }; }
    if (sub === 'export') {
      const id = positional[1]; if (!id) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'uso: diag.replay export <id>' };
      const json = engine.exportSession(id, true);
      if (!json) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `sessão não encontrada: ${id}` };
      return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.replay export ${id}`, data: { status: { sessionId: id, size: json.length }, raw: json.slice(0, 4000) }, sticky: true } };
    }
    if (sub === 'run') {
      const id = positional[1]; if (!id) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'uso: diag.replay run <id>' };
      const session = engine.getSession(id);
      if (!session) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `sessão não encontrada: ${id}` };
      const result = engine.replay(session, { machine: this.machine, captureFinal: true });
      const diff = session.finalSnapshot && result.actualSnapshot ? engine.compare(session.finalSnapshot, result.actualSnapshot) : null;
      return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.replay run ${id} (${result.executed} cmds)`, data: { status: { executed: result.executed, failed: result.failed, durationMs: result.durationMs, equal: diff?.equal ?? null }, events: result.errors.slice(0, 20).map(e => ({ seq: e.seq, event: 'error', tick: e.tick, payload: { line: e.line, error: e.error } })) }, sticky: true } };
    }
    const sessions = engine.listSessions();
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.replay (${sessions.length} sessões)`, data: { status: { recording: engine.isRecording(), activeId: engine.activeSession?.id ?? null, total: sessions.length }, events: sessions.map(s => ({ seq: s.startedAt, event: s.id, tick: null, payload: { commands: s.commandCount, durationMs: s.durationMs, ended: !!s.endedAt } })) }, sticky: true } };
  }

  bundle(prev, ast) {
    if (this._bundleBuilding) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.bundle', data: { raw: 'Bundle já está sendo construído...' } } };
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const builder = suite.reportBuilder;
    if (!builder) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 diag.bundle', data: { raw: 'ReportBuilder indisponível.' } } };
    const name = ast.positional?.[0] ?? `bundle-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    this._bundleBuilding = true;
    try {
      const bundle = builder.build({
        name,
        includeWorld: ast.opts?.includeWorld !== 'false',
        includeTimelines: ast.opts?.includeTimelines !== 'false',
        includeSnapshots: ast.opts?.includeSnapshots === 'true',
        includeEvents: ast.opts?.includeEvents !== 'false',
        includeLogs: ast.opts?.includeLogs !== 'false',
        includeTraces: ast.opts?.includeTraces !== 'false',
        includeExpectations: ast.opts?.includeExpectations !== 'false',
        includePipeline: ast.opts?.includePipeline !== 'false',
        includeInvariants: ast.opts?.includeInvariants !== 'false',
        includeContracts: ast.opts?.includeContracts !== 'false',
        includeHealth: ast.opts?.includeHealth !== 'false',
        includeSession: ast.opts?.includeSession !== 'false',
        includeRca: ast.opts?.includeRca !== 'false',
        includeSchemas: ast.opts?.includeSchemas !== 'false',
        userNote: ast.opts?.note ?? null,
      });
      const size = builder.estimate(bundle);
      const dl = builder.download(bundle, ast.opts?.format === 'ndjson' ? 'ndjson' : 'json');
      return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🔬 diag.bundle — ${name}`, data: { status: { name, sections: bundle.meta?.sectionKeys?.length ?? 0, sizeBytes: size, filename: dl.filename ?? '(falha)', downloadOk: dl.ok }, raw: `Bundle: ${(size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB\n${dl.ok ? `Download: ${dl.filename}` : 'Falha no download'}` }, sticky: true } };
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `falha no bundle: ${err.message}` };
    } finally {
      this._bundleBuilding = false;
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Onda 5
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  test(prev, ast) {
    if (this._testRunning) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🧪 diag.test', data: { raw: 'Bateria já está rodando.' } } };
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    if (typeof suite.runBattery !== 'function') return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🧪 diag.test', data: { raw: 'runBattery() indisponível.' } } };
    const phases = ast.positional?.[0] ?? ast.opts?.phases ?? 'all';
    const seed = ast.opts?.seed ? parseInt(ast.opts.seed, 10) : 42;
    const iterations = ast.opts?.iterations ? parseInt(ast.opts.iterations, 10) : 500;
    this._testRunning = true;
    const bus = this.bus;
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const initialPayload = { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🧪 Bateria iniciada — ${phases}`, data: { raw: `Fases: ${phases}\nSeed: ${seed}\nIterações: ${iterations}` }, sticky: true };
    bus.emit('render:right', initialPayload);
    suite.runBattery({
      phases, seed, iterations,
      onProgress: ({ phase, result, index, total }) => {
        const icon = result.skipped ? '⏭' : (result.ok ? '✅' : '❌');
        bus.emit('test:battery:progress', { phase, index, total, ok: result.ok, skipped: result.skipped, summary: result.summary, durationMs: result.durationMs });
        bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🧪 [${index + 1}/${total}] ${icon} ${phase} — ${result.summary}`, data: { raw: `Fase atual: ${phase}\n${index + 1} de ${total}` }, sticky: true });
      },
    })
      .then(report => {
        const durationMs = Date.now() - t0;
        const ok = report.summary?.ok === true;
        const passCount = report.summary?.totalPassed ?? 0;
        const failCount = report.summary?.totalFailed ?? 0;
        const skipCount = report.summary?.totalSkipped ?? 0;
        bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `🧪 Bateria ${ok ? '✓ APROVADA' : '✗ REPROVADA'} — ${passCount}✓ ${failCount}✗ ${skipCount}⏭`, data: { testReport: report, status: { ok, passed: passCount, failed: failCount, skipped: skipCount, durationMs, seed: report.meta?.seed ?? seed } }, sticky: true });
        bus.emit('test:battery:complete', report);
      })
      .catch(err => { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🧪 diag.test — erro', data: { raw: err?.message ?? String(err) } }); bus.emit('test:battery:error', { error: err?.message ?? String(err) }); })
      .finally(() => { this._testRunning = false; });
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: initialPayload };
  }

  baseline(prev, ast) {
    const suite = this._getSuite();
    if (!suite) return this._noSuite(prev);
    const sub = String(ast.positional?.[0] ?? ast.subtype ?? 'list').toLowerCase();
    const name = ast.positional?.[1] ?? ast.opts?.name ?? null;
    const bus = this.bus;
    import('./golden-baseline.js').then(({ GoldenBaseline }) => {
      const baseline = new GoldenBaseline();
      switch (sub) {
        case 'list': return baseline.list().then(list => { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `📦 Baselines (${list.length})`, data: { status: { count: list.length }, events: list.map(b => ({ seq: b.capturedAt, event: b.name, tick: b.tick, payload: { entityCount: b.entityCount, hash: b.hash } })), raw: list.length === 0 ? 'Nenhum baseline.' : null }, sticky: true }); });
        case 'capture': { if (!name) throw new Error('uso: diag.baseline capture <name>'); return baseline.capture(name, this.machine, { tick: this.machine.getTick(), source: 'diag.baseline' }).then(result => { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `📦 Baseline — ${result.name}`, data: { status: { name: result.name, capturedAt: result.capturedAt, entityCount: result.entityCount }, raw: `Baseline "${result.name}" salvo.` }, sticky: true }); }); }
        case 'compare': { if (!name) throw new Error('uso: diag.baseline compare <name>'); return baseline.compare(name, this.machine).then(cmp => { const equal = cmp.equal === true; bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `📦 ${equal ? '✓' : '✗'} ${name}`, data: { status: { equal, baselineAt: cmp.baselineAt ?? null, baselineCount: cmp.baselineCount ?? null, currentCount: cmp.currentCount ?? null, reason: cmp.reason ?? null }, counts: cmp.diff?.stats ?? null, raw: equal ? `Idêntico a "${name}".` : `Diverge de "${name}".` }, sticky: true }); }); }
        case 'delete': { if (!name) throw new Error('uso: diag.baseline delete <name>'); return baseline.delete(name).then(() => { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `📦 Baseline removido — ${name}`, data: { status: { name, deleted: true } } }); }); }
        case 'clear': return baseline.clear().then(n => { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `📦 Baselines removidos (${n})`, data: { status: { removed: n } } }); });
        case 'stats': return baseline.stats().then(s => { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `📦 Baselines — ${s.count} salvos`, data: { status: { count: s.count, totalBytes: s.totalBytes, totalKB: (s.totalBytes / 1024).toFixed(1) } }, sticky: true }); });
        default: throw new Error(`sub desconhecido: "${sub}"`);
      }
    }).catch(err => { bus.emit('render:right', { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `📦 diag.baseline ${sub} — erro`, data: { raw: err?.message ?? String(err) } }); });
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: `📦 diag.baseline ${sub}`, data: { raw: 'Processando...' } } };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Helpers
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _getSuite() {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    const app = window.__NarrativeApp;
    if (!app || !app.diag) return null;
    return app.diag;
  }

  _noSuite(prev) {
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, right: { kind: 'diagnostics', title: '🔬 DiagnosticsSuite indisponível', data: { raw: 'Verifique window.__NarrativeApp.diag.' } } };
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file config.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Configuração central da DiagnosticsSuite.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index, diagnostics/structured-logger,
 *             diagnostics/flight-recorder, diagnostics/instrumentation
 * @level 9
 *
 * Modos de operação:
 *   off    → nada gravado, zero overhead
 *   light  → eventos-chave apenas (mutations, erros, regras)
 *   full   → tudo: eventos, logs, spans, invariantes, contratos,
 *            expectativas, pipeline, RCA, snapshots
 *   dev    → full + health probes + fuzzer + fault injector + replay
 *
 * Fase 8 — LUME: adicionada categoria `narrative` com eventos do
 * subsistema narrativo.
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Limpeza (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   Removidos `narrativeEventNames`, `isNarrativeEvent` e `categoryOf`
 *   — nunca importados. A categoria `narrative` em
 *   `DIAG_EVENT_CATEGORIES` permanece (é lida por filtros da UI).
 */

/**
 * Modos válidos.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
export const DIAG_MODES = Object.freeze(['off', 'light', 'full', 'dev']);

/**
 * Defaults globais da suíte.
 * @type {Readonly<Object>}
 */
export const DIAG_DEFAULTS = Object.freeze({
  mode: 'full',
  ringSize: 10_000,
  logRingSize: 5_000,
  spanRingSize: 2_000,
  includeEvents: true,
  includeLogs: true,
  includeSpans: true,
  autoStart: true,
  timestamp: true,
  sessionId: null,
});

/**
 * Categorização de eventos do bus, para facilitar filtros e agrupamento.
 * Não restringe o que é gravado — só classifica.
 *
 * @type {Readonly<Object<string, ReadonlyArray<string>>>}
 */
export const DIAG_EVENT_CATEGORIES = Object.freeze({
  lifecycle: Object.freeze([
    'boot:complete',
    'machine:reset',
    'machine:restored',
    'world:cleared',
    'world:destroyed',
    'tick:advanced',
    'system:registered',
  ]),
  mutation: Object.freeze([
    'entity:created',
    'entity:destroyed',
    'component:added',
    'component:updated',
    'component:removed',
  ]),
  link: Object.freeze([
    'links:pruned',
    'link-index:rebuilt',
    'link-index:drift',
  ]),
  rule: Object.freeze([
    'rule:fired',
    'rule:skipped',
    'rule:cycle',
    'rule:error',
    'rule:overflow',
    'rule:evaluated',
  ]),
  render: Object.freeze([
    'render:left',
    'render:right',
    'render:annotation',
  ]),
  persist: Object.freeze([
    'persist:flush',
    'persist:saved',
    'persist:failed',
  ]),
  ui: Object.freeze([
    'ui:menu:open',
    'ui:menu:close',
    'ui:snippet:insert',
    'ui:flash-error',
    'ui:roll:start',
    'ui:roll:committed',
    'ui:roll:cancelled',
    'ui:inline:activated',
    'ui:inline:committed',
    'ui:inline:cancelled',
    'ui:shortcut',
    'ui:panel:toggle',
    'ui:panel:left:toggle',
    'ui:panel:right:toggle',
    'ui:history:jump',
    'ui:block:revealed',
  ]),
  export: Object.freeze([
    'export:ready',
  ]),
  diagnostics: Object.freeze([
    'diag:suite:installed',
    'diag:suite:mode-changed',
    'diag:handleLine:start',
    'diag:handleLine:end',
    'diag:system:run',
    'diag:system:error',
    'diag:contract:violated',
    'diag:health:anomaly',
  ]),
  validation: Object.freeze([
    'validation:warnings',
    'validation:soft-fail',
    'pipeline:system-missing',
  ]),
  narrative: Object.freeze([
    'narrative:preview',
    'narrative:suggest',
    'narrative:diagnostic',
    'narrative:act:applied',
    'narrative:act:focus',
    'narrative:degraded',
    'narr:mode:set',
    'narr:mode:changed',
    'narr:override:set',
    'narr:override:clear',
    'narr:override:clearAll',
    'narr:lexicon:forget',
    'narr:lexicon:clearAll',
  ]),
});

/**
 * Cria uma configuração mesclando defaults com overrides.
 * Ignora chaves desconhecidas para evitar poluição.
 * @param {Object} [overrides={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function createConfig(overrides = {}) {
  const out = { ...DIAG_DEFAULTS };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(overrides || {})) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(DIAG_DEFAULTS, k)) {
      out[k] = v;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Detecta se está em ambiente de desenvolvimento.
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isDevEnvironment() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const host = window.location?.hostname ?? '';
    return host === 'localhost' || host === '127.0.0.1' || host === '';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Escolhe o modo default com base no ambiente.
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function pickDefaultMode() {
  return isDevEnvironment() ? 'full' : 'light';
}

/**
 * Matriz de features por modo.
 *
 * @type {Readonly<Object<string, Readonly<Object<string, boolean>>>>}
 */
const MODE_MATRIX = Object.freeze({
  off: Object.freeze({
    events: false, logs: false, spans: false,
    invariants: false, contracts: false,
    expectations: false, pipeline: false,
    rca: false, snapshot: false,
    health: false, fuzz: false, injection: false, replay: false,
  }),
  light: Object.freeze({
    events: true, logs: false, spans: false,
    invariants: false, contracts: false,
    expectations: false, pipeline: false,
    rca: false, snapshot: false,
    health: false, fuzz: false, injection: false, replay: false,
  }),
  full: Object.freeze({
    events: true, logs: true, spans: true,
    invariants: true, contracts: true,
    expectations: true, pipeline: true,
    rca: true, snapshot: true,
    health: false, fuzz: false, injection: false, replay: false,
  }),
  dev: Object.freeze({
    events: true, logs: true, spans: true,
    invariants: true, contracts: true,
    expectations: true, pipeline: true,
    rca: true, snapshot: true,
    health: true, fuzz: true, injection: true, replay: true,
  }),
});

/**
 * Lista de todas as features conhecidas.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
export const DIAG_FEATURES = Object.freeze([
  'events', 'logs', 'spans',
  'invariants', 'contracts',
  'expectations', 'pipeline',
  'rca', 'snapshot',
  'health', 'fuzz', 'injection', 'replay',
]);

/**
 * Verifica se um modo inclui uma feature.
 * @param {string} mode
 * @param {string} feature
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function modeIncludes(mode, feature) {
  return MODE_MATRIX[mode]?.[feature] ?? false;
}

/**
 * Retorna a matriz completa de um modo.
 * @param {string} mode
 * @returns {Object<string, boolean>}
 */
export function modeMatrix(mode) {
  const m = MODE_MATRIX[mode];
  return m ? { ...m } : {};
}

/**
 * Lista as features ativas num modo.
 * @param {string} mode
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function enabledFeatures(mode) {
  const m = MODE_MATRIX[mode];
  if (!m) return [];
  return DIAG_FEATURES.filter((f) => m[f] === true);
}

/**
 * Valida se uma string é um modo conhecido.
 * @param {string} mode
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isValidMode(mode) {
  return DIAG_MODES.includes(mode);
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file contract-guard.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Pré/pós-condições em funções críticas (Design by Contract).
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index (Fase 4+), systems/diagnostics-system (Fase 4)
 * @level 9
 *
 * Uso:
 *   const guard = new ContractGuard({ bus });
 *   guard.define('world.createEntity', {
 *     pre: (components) => typeof components === 'object',
 *     post: (result, args) => typeof result === 'string' && result.length > 0,
 *   });
 *   guard.wrap(world, 'createEntity', 'world.createEntity');
 *   guard.violations();
 */

export class ContractGuard {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {Object} [opts.bus] — EventBus opcional (para emitir eventos)
   * @param {number} [opts.maxViolations=200]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.enabled=true]
   */
  constructor({ bus = null, maxViolations = 200, enabled = true } = {}) {
    this.bus = bus;
    this.maxViolations = Math.max(1, maxViolations);
    this.enabled = !!enabled;

    /** @type {Map<string, Object>} */
    this.contracts = new Map();

    /** @type {Array<Object>} */
    this.history = [];

    /** @type {Array<{target:Object, method:string, original:Function}>} */
    this._wrapped = [];

    this._totalViolations = 0;
    this._totalChecks = 0;
  }

  // ── Registro ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Define um contrato.
   * @param {string} name
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {(args:any[]) => boolean} [opts.pre]
   * @param {(result:any, args:any[]) => boolean} [opts.post]
   * @param {string} [opts.description]
   * @returns {ContractGuard}
   */
  define(name, { pre = null, post = null, description = '' } = {}) {
    if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name) {
      throw new Error('[ContractGuard] nome inválido');
    }
    this.contracts.set(name, {
      name,
      pre: typeof pre === 'function' ? pre : null,
      post: typeof post === 'function' ? post : null,
      description: String(description || ''),
    });
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Remove um contrato.
   * @param {string} name
   */
  undefine(name) {
    this.contracts.delete(name);
  }

  // ── Wrap ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Envolve um método de um objeto para aplicar o contrato.
   * @param {Object} target
   * @param {string} method
   * @param {string} contractName
   * @returns {ContractGuard}
   */
  wrap(target, method, contractName) {
    if (!target || typeof target[method] !== 'function') {
      throw new Error(`[ContractGuard] ${method} não é função`);
    }
    if (!this.contracts.has(contractName)) {
      throw new Error(`[ContractGuard] contrato "${contractName}" não definido`);
    }

    const original = target[method].bind(target);
    const contract = this.contracts.get(contractName);
    const self = this;

    target[method] = function guarded(...args) {
      if (!self.enabled) return original(...args);

      self._totalChecks++;

      // Pre
      if (contract.pre) {
        let preOk = false;
        let preError = null;
        try {
          preOk = contract.pre(args) !== false;
        } catch (err) {
          preError = err.message;
        }
        if (!preOk) {
          self._record({
            type: 'pre',
            contract: contractName,
            message: preError
              ? `pre-condition lançou: ${preError}`
              : `pre-condition falhou`,
            args: self._safeArgs(args),
          });
        }
      }

      // Executa
      let result;
      let execError = null;
      try {
        result = original(...args);
      } catch (err) {
        execError = err;
        self._record({
          type: 'exception',
          contract: contractName,
          message: `exceção em execução: ${err.message}`,
          stack: (err.stack ?? '').split('\n').slice(0, 5).join(' | '),
          args: self._safeArgs(args),
        });
        throw err;
      }

      // Post
      if (contract.post) {
        let postOk = false;
        let postError = null;
        try {
          postOk = contract.post(result, args) !== false;
        } catch (err) {
          postError = err.message;
        }
        if (!postOk) {
          self._record({
            type: 'post',
            contract: contractName,
            message: postError
              ? `post-condition lançou: ${postError}`
              : `post-condition falhou`,
            args: self._safeArgs(args),
            result: self._safeValue(result),
          });
        }
      }

      return result;
    };

    this._wrapped.push({ target, method, original });
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Restaura todos os métodos envolvidos.
   */
  unwrapAll() {
    for (const { target, method, original } of this._wrapped) {
      target[method] = original;
    }
    this._wrapped = [];
  }

  // ── Consultas ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Violações registradas (mais recentes primeiro).
   * @param {number} [limit]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  violations(limit = null) {
    const out = this.history.slice().reverse();
    if (Number.isFinite(limit) && limit > 0) return out.slice(0, limit);
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Lista os contratos registrados.
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  list() {
    return Array.from(this.contracts.values()).map(c => ({
      name: c.name,
      description: c.description,
      hasPre: !!c.pre,
      hasPost: !!c.post,
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  stats() {
    return {
      contracts: this.contracts.size,
      wrapped: this._wrapped.length,
      totalChecks: this._totalChecks,
      totalViolations: this._totalViolations,
      inHistory: this.history.length,
      enabled: this.enabled,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Serializa.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  toJSON() {
    return {
      stats: this.stats(),
      contracts: this.list(),
      violations: this.violations(),
    };
  }

  // ── Controle ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  setEnabled(v) { this.enabled = !!v; }

  clear() {
    this.history = [];
    this._totalViolations = 0;
    this._totalChecks = 0;
  }

  destroy() {
    this.unwrapAll();
    this.contracts.clear();
    this.clear();
    this.enabled = false;
  }

  // ── Internos ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** @private */
  _record(v) {
    v.ts = Date.now();
    this._totalViolations++;
    this.history.push(v);
    while (this.history.length > this.maxViolations) this.history.shift();

    this._emit('diag:contract:violated', v);
  }

  /** @private */
  _emit(event, payload) {
    if (this.bus && typeof this.bus.emit === 'function') {
      try { this.bus.emit(event, payload); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }
  }

  /** @private */
  _safeArgs(args) {
    try {
      return args.map(a => this._safeValue(a));
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  /** @private */
  _safeValue(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return v;
    if (typeof v === 'string') return v.slice(0, 200);
    if (typeof v === 'number' || typeof v === 'boolean') return v;
    if (typeof v === 'function') return '[Function]';
    try {
      const s = JSON.stringify(v);
      if (s.length <= 300) return v;
      return { _truncated: true, _preview: s.slice(0, 300) };
    } catch {
      return { _unsafe: true, _type: typeof v };
    }
  }
}
```
