```javascript
/**
 * @file expectation-tracker.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Rastreia o que era esperado vs o que aconteceu em cada comando.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index, diagnostics/instrumentation, diagnostics/report-builder
 * @level 9
 *
 * Fluxo (Fase 5/6):
 *   1. declare(line, ast, ctx)         → cria uma entrada com expectativas
 *   2. recordEvent(commandId, evt, pl) → alimenta eventos observados
 *   3. observe(commandId, result, ctx) → preenche o real e calcula diff
 *
 * O wire é feito pelo `Instrumentation`:
 *   - `_wrapSystem` chama `declare()` logo após o ParseSystem produzir AST.
 *   - `_wireBusForExpectations` anexa um wildcard `'*'` ao bus que chama
 *     `recordEvent()` para cada evento emitido durante o comando.
 *   - `_wrapHandleLine` chama `observe()` no `finally`, depois de todos os
 *     sistemas rodarem, passando `tickAfter`.
 *
 * API pública:
 *   declare(line, ast, ctx?)              → commandId
 *   recordEvent(commandId, event, payload) → void
 *   recordEvents(commandId, events[])      → void   (bulk)
 *   observe(commandId, result, ctx?)       → entry
 *   get(commandId)                         → entry | null
 *   getAll()                               → entry[]
 *   getFailures()                          → entry[]
 *   stats()                                → stats
 *   toJSON()                               → { stats, entries }
 *   setEnabled(bool)                       → this
 *   clear()                                → void
 *   destroy()                              → void
 *
 * Motivos de discrepância detectados pelo `_compare()`:
 *   - `mutated`: esperava mutar, não mutou (ou vice-versa)
 *   - `halt`: pipeline parou quando não devia (ou não parou quando devia)
 *   - `tickAdvanced`: mutou mas tick não avançou
 *   - `events.missing`: eventos esperados não foram observados
 *   - `error`: erro inesperado em comando que deveria mutar
 */

/**
 * Deriva expectativas a partir do AST + contexto.
 *
 * Mapeia verbos e ações para:
 *   - `mutated`: o comando deve mutar o mundo?
 *   - `events`: quais eventos o bus deve emitir?
 *   - `halt`: o pipeline deve parar?
 *
 * @param {Object} ast
 * @param {Object} ctx
 * @returns {{ mutated:boolean, events:string[], halt:boolean }}
 * @private
 */
function deriveExpectations(ast, ctx) {
  const base = { mutated: false, events: [], halt: false };
  if (!ast) return base;

  const verb = ast.verb;
  const action = ast.action;

  // ── Mutations ────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'mut') {
    return {
      mutated: true,
      events: ['component:updated', 'tick:advanced'],
      halt: false,
    };
  }

  // ── Entities ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'ent') {
    if (action === 'create') {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['entity:created', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    if (action === 'delete') {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['entity:destroyed', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    // show / list
    return base;
  }

  // ── Identity ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'id') {
    if (['rename', 'describe', 'retype'].includes(action)) {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['component:updated', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    return base;
  }

  // ── Instantiation ────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'inst') {
    if (['mark', 'unmark', 'create', 'destroy', 'sync'].includes(action)) {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['component:updated', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    if (['reparent', 'unset', 'policy'].includes(action)) {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['component:updated', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    // chain, resolve, list
    return base;
  }

  // ── Link mutation vs query ───────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'link') {
    if (['set', 'add', 'pull', 'clear'].includes(action)) {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['component:updated', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    return base;
  }

  // ── Rules ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'rul') {
    if (action === 'add') {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['entity:created', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    if (['off', 'on', 'del'].includes(action)) {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['component:updated', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    if (action === 'run') {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    return base;
  }

  // ── Snippets ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'snip') {
    if (typeof action === 'string' && action.startsWith('create')) {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['entity:created', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    if (action === 'delete') {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['entity:destroyed', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    return base;
  }

  // ── Knowledge ────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'kno') {
    if (['learn', 'forget'].includes(action)) {
      return { mutated: true, events: ['component:updated', 'tick:advanced'], halt: false };
    }
    return base;
  }

  // ── Fork ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'frk') {
    if (['create', 'delete', 'merge'].includes(action)) {
      return { mutated: true, events: [], halt: false };
    }
    // switch / list
    return base;
  }

  // ── Export (não muta, gera arquivo) ──────────────────────
  if (verb === 'exp') {
    return { mutated: false, events: ['export:ready'], halt: false };
  }

  // ── Queries e leitura (nunca mutam) ──────────────────────
  if (['que', 'at', 'whe', 'tim', 'aud', 'sea', 'help'].includes(verb)) {
    return base;
  }

  // ── Dif (nunca muta) ─────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'dif') {
    return base;
  }

  // ── Diagnostics (nunca muta) ─────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'diag') {
    return base;
  }

  // ── Slash commands ───────────────────────────────────────
  if (verb === 'slash') {
    // /save emite persist:flush; /reset emite machine:reset-requested
    if (ast.command === 'save') {
      return { mutated: false, events: ['persist:flush'], halt: false };
    }
    if (ast.command === 'reset') {
      return { mutated: false, events: ['machine:reset-requested'], halt: false };
    }
    return base;
  }

  return base;
}

export class ExpectationTracker {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {number} [opts.maxEntries=500]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.enabled=true]
   */
  constructor({ maxEntries = 500, enabled = true } = {}) {
    this.maxEntries = Math.max(1, maxEntries);
    this.enabled = !!enabled;

    /** @type {Map<string, Object>} commandId → Entry */
    this.entries = new Map();

    /** @type {Array<string>} ordem de inserção */
    this._order = [];

    /** Contador monotônico para IDs únicos dentro da sessão */
    this._seq = 0;

    /** Rastreia total histórico (não limitado pelo ring) */
    this._totalDeclared = 0;
    this._totalObserved = 0;
    this._totalFailures = 0;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // API principal
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Declara uma expectativa antes de rodar o comando.
   *
   * Chamado pelo `Instrumentation` logo após o `ParseSystem` produzir AST.
   * Se `enabled === false`, retorna string vazia (falsy) sem efeito colateral.
   *
   * @param {string} line
   * @param {Object} ast
   * @param {Object} [ctx={}]
   * @param {string} [ctx.kind] — 'command' | 'slash-command' | ...
   * @param {string} [ctx.tick] — tick ANTES da execução
   * @returns {string} commandId (string vazia se disabled)
   */
  declare(line, ast, ctx = {}) {
    if (!this.enabled) return '';

    const commandId = this._nextId();
    const expected = deriveExpectations(ast, ctx);

    const entry = {
      commandId,
      line: String(line ?? ''),
      ast: ast
        ? {
            verb: ast.verb ?? null,
            action: ast.action ?? null,
            subtype: ast.subtype ?? null,
          }
        : null,
      kind: ctx.kind ?? null,
      tickBefore: ctx.tick ?? null,
      declaredAt: Date.now(),

      expected,

      events: [],
      actual: null,
      diff: null,
      observedAt: null,
    };

    this.entries.set(commandId, entry);
    this._order.push(commandId);
    this._totalDeclared++;
    this._evict();

    return commandId;
  }

  /**
   * Registra um evento observado entre declare e observe.
   *
   * Chamado pelo wildcard `'*'` do bus anexado pelo `Instrumentation`.
   * Se o `commandId` não existir mais (foi evictado) ou não for passado,
   * é no-op silencioso.
   *
   * @param {string} commandId
   * @param {string} event
   * @param {any} [payload=null]
   */
  recordEvent(commandId, event, payload = null) {
    if (!commandId) return;
    const entry = this.entries.get(commandId);
    if (!entry) return;

    entry.events.push({
      event: String(event),
      payload: this._safePayload(payload),
      ts: Date.now(),
    });
  }

  /**
   * Registra vários eventos de uma vez.
   *
   * Útil quando o consumidor faz buffering antes de flushar.
   *
   * @param {string} commandId
   * @param {Array<{event:string, payload?:any}>} events
   */
  recordEvents(commandId, events) {
    if (!commandId || !Array.isArray(events)) return;
    const entry = this.entries.get(commandId);
    if (!entry) return;

    for (const e of events) {
      if (!e || !e.event) continue;
      entry.events.push({
        event: String(e.event),
        payload: this._safePayload(e.payload ?? null),
        ts: e.ts ?? Date.now(),
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Observa o resultado real e calcula diff.
   *
   * Chamado pelo `Instrumentation` no `finally` do `_wrapHandleLine`,
   * depois de todos os sistemas terem rodado.
   *
   * @param {string} commandId
   * @param {Object} result — SystemResult de machine.handleLine
   * @param {Object} [ctx={}]
   * @param {string} [ctx.tickAfter] — tick DEPOIS da execução
   * @returns {Object|null} entry preenchida, ou null se não existir
   */
  observe(commandId, result, ctx = {}) {
    if (!commandId) return null;
    const entry = this.entries.get(commandId);
    if (!entry) return null;

    entry.actual = {
      ok: result?.ok !== false,
      mutated: result?.mutated === true,
      halt: result?.halt === true,
      error: result?.error ?? null,
      tickAfter: ctx.tickAfter ?? null,
      tickAdvanced: entry.tickBefore !== null && ctx.tickAfter !== null
        ? entry.tickBefore !== ctx.tickAfter
        : null,
    };
    entry.observedAt = Date.now();
    entry.diff = this._compare(entry);

    this._totalObserved++;
    if (entry.diff.hasDiscrepancies) {
      this._totalFailures++;
    }

    return this.get(commandId);
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Consultas
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Retorna uma entrada (cópia rasa).
   * @param {string} commandId
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  get(commandId) {
    const entry = this.entries.get(commandId);
    return entry ? this._copy(entry) : null;
  }

  /**
   * Todas as entradas (cópias).
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  getAll() {
    return this._order
      .map(id => this.get(id))
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  /**
   * Entradas com discrepâncias (mais recentes primeiro).
   * @param {number} [limit]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  getFailures(limit = null) {
    const out = this.getAll()
      .filter(e => e.diff?.hasDiscrepancies === true)
      .reverse();
    if (Number.isFinite(limit) && limit > 0) return out.slice(0, limit);
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas resumidas.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  stats() {
    const all = this.getAll();
    const failures = all.filter(e => e.diff?.hasDiscrepancies);

    return {
      total: all.length,
      failures: failures.length,
      maxEntries: this.maxEntries,
      failureRate: all.length > 0 ? failures.length / all.length : 0,
      totalDeclared: this._totalDeclared,
      totalObserved: this._totalObserved,
      totalFailures: this._totalFailures,
      enabled: this.enabled,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Serializa.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  toJSON() {
    return {
      stats: this.stats(),
      entries: this.getAll(),
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Controle
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Liga/desliga.
   * @param {boolean} v
   * @returns {ExpectationTracker} this
   */
  setEnabled(v) {
    this.enabled = !!v;
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Limpa entradas e contadores.
   */
  clear() {
    this.entries.clear();
    this._order = [];
    this._seq = 0;
    this._totalDeclared = 0;
    this._totalObserved = 0;
    this._totalFailures = 0;
  }

  /**
   * Destrói.
   */
  destroy() {
    this.clear();
    this.enabled = false;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Compara expected vs actual e produz diff.
   * @param {Object} entry
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _compare(entry) {
    const expected = entry.expected;
    const actual = entry.actual;
    const discrepancies = [];

    // 1. mutated
    if (expected.mutated !== actual.mutated) {
      discrepancies.push({
        field: 'mutated',
        expected: expected.mutated,
        actual: actual.mutated,
      });
    }

    // 2. halt
    if (expected.halt !== actual.halt) {
      discrepancies.push({
        field: 'halt',
        expected: expected.halt,
        actual: actual.halt,
      });
    }

    // 3. tick advancement (só quando ambos esperavam mutação e mutaram)
    if (expected.mutated && actual.mutated) {
      if (actual.tickAdvanced === false) {
        discrepancies.push({
          field: 'tickAdvanced',
          expected: true,
          actual: false,
          note: 'mutated=true mas tick não avançou',
        });
      }
    }

    // 4. eventos esperados não observados
    const observedEventNames = new Set(entry.events.map(e => e.event));
    const missingEvents = expected.events.filter(e => !observedEventNames.has(e));
    if (missingEvents.length > 0) {
      discrepancies.push({
        field: 'events.missing',
        expected: missingEvents,
        actual: Array.from(observedEventNames),
      });
    }

    // 5. erro inesperado em comando que deveria mutar
    if (actual.error && expected.mutated) {
      discrepancies.push({
        field: 'error',
        expected: null,
        actual: actual.error,
      });
    }

    // 6. halt inesperado com erro — sinal mais forte de problema
    if (actual.halt === true && actual.error && expected.halt !== true) {
      // já coberto pelo item 2, mas registramos a nota para o consumidor
      const haltDisc = discrepancies.find(d => d.field === 'halt');
      if (haltDisc) haltDisc.note = `halt inesperado: ${actual.error}`;
    }

    return {
      hasDiscrepancies: discrepancies.length > 0,
      discrepancies,
      missingEvents,
      observedEventCount: entry.events.length,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Cópia defensiva de uma entrada (não expõe referências internas).
   * @param {Object} entry
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _copy(entry) {
    return {
      commandId: entry.commandId,
      line: entry.line,
      ast: entry.ast ? { ...entry.ast } : null,
      kind: entry.kind,
      tickBefore: entry.tickBefore,
      declaredAt: entry.declaredAt,
      observedAt: entry.observedAt,
      expected: {
        ...entry.expected,
        events: [...entry.expected.events],
      },
      actual: entry.actual ? { ...entry.actual } : null,
      events: entry.events.map(e => ({ ...e })),
      diff: entry.diff
        ? {
            hasDiscrepancies: entry.diff.hasDiscrepancies,
            discrepancies: entry.diff.discrepancies.map(d => ({ ...d })),
            missingEvents: [...entry.diff.missingEvents],
            observedEventCount: entry.diff.observedEventCount,
          }
        : null,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Evict do mais antigo quando o ring está cheio.
   * @private
   */
  _evict() {
    while (this.entries.size > this.maxEntries) {
      const oldestId = this._order.shift();
      if (oldestId !== undefined) {
        this.entries.delete(oldestId);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Gera um commandId único dentro da sessão.
   * Formato: `cmd-<seq>-<ts36>`
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _nextId() {
    this._seq++;
    const t = Date.now().toString(36);
    return `cmd-${this._seq}-${t}`;
  }

  /**
   * Converte payload em algo serializável, com fallback seguro.
   * @param {any} payload
   * @returns {any}
   * @private
   */
  _safePayload(payload) {
    if (payload === null || payload === undefined) return null;
    if (
      typeof payload === 'string' ||
      typeof payload === 'number' ||
      typeof payload === 'boolean'
    ) {
      return payload;
    }
    try {
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
    } catch {
      return { _unsafe: true, _type: typeof payload };
    }
  }
}
```

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 13.1 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file fault-injector.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Injeta falhas controladas para testar robustez (modo dev).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index (Fase 6+), systems/diagnostics-system (Fase 6+)
 * @level 9
 *
 * Tipos de injeção:
 *   slow     → adiciona delay em system.run
 *   throw    → força exceção em system.run
 *   drop     → suprime emissão de eventos do bus
 *   corrupt  → corrompe um componente após addComponent
 *   stale    → força marcação Stale indevida
 *   missing  → simula sistema ausente no pipeline
 *
 * Uso:
 *   const inj = new FaultInjector({ bus, machine });
 *   inj.inject('slow', { target: 'MutationSystem', ms: 300 });
 *   inj.inject('throw', { target: 'RuleSystem' });
 *   inj.list();
 *   inj.eject('slow');
 *   inj.ejectAll();
 *
 * Segurança:
 *   - Cada injeção tem TTL (default 30s) — auto-remove.
 *   - `dev` mode obrigatório: ignora se não estiver em `dev`.
 *   - Cada injeção é reversível (unwrap).
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 30_000;
const MAX_ACTIVE = 10;

const INJECTION_KINDS = Object.freeze(['slow', 'throw', 'drop', 'corrupt', 'stale', 'missing']);

export class FaultInjector {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {Object} [opts.bus]
   * @param {Object} [opts.machine]
   * @param {number} [opts.defaultTtlMs=30000]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.allowInProd=false]
   */
  constructor({
    bus = null,
    machine = null,
    defaultTtlMs = DEFAULT_TTL_MS,
    allowInProd = false,
  } = {}) {
    this.bus = bus;
    this.machine = machine;
    this.defaultTtlMs = Math.max(1000, defaultTtlMs);
    this.allowInProd = !!allowInProd;

    /** @type {Map<string, Object>} id → injection */
    this.active = new Map();

    /** @type {Array<Object>} */
    this.log = [];

    this._idCounter = 0;
  }

  // ── Anexar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Anexa bus e machine.
   * @param {Object} bus
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @returns {FaultInjector}
   */
  attach(bus, machine = null) {
    this.bus = bus || this.bus;
    this.machine = machine || this.machine;
    return this;
  }

  // ── Diagnóstico de ambiente ─────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  isDevMode() {
    if (this.allowInProd) return true;
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    try {
      const app = window.__NarrativeApp;
      const mode = app?.diag?.getMode?.();
      return mode === 'dev';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // ── API principal ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Injeta uma falha.
   * @param {'slow'|'throw'|'drop'|'corrupt'|'stale'|'missing'} kind
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {string} [opts.target] — nome do sistema ou do evento
   * @param {number} [opts.ms=300] — para 'slow'
   * @param {number} [opts.ttlMs] — tempo de vida
   * @param {number} [opts.probability=1] — 0..1
   * @param {Object} [opts.payload] — para 'corrupt'
   * @returns {Object} injection ou { ok: false, error }
   */
  inject(kind, opts = {}) {
    if (!INJECTION_KINDS.includes(kind)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `kind inválido: ${kind}` };
    }
    if (!this.isDevMode()) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'fault injection requer modo dev' };
    }
    if (this.active.size >= MAX_ACTIVE) {
      return { ok: false, error: `máximo de ${MAX_ACTIVE} injeções simultâneas` };
    }

    const id = this._nextId(kind);
    const ttlMs = Math.max(1000, Number(opts.ttlMs) || this.defaultTtlMs);

    const injection = {
      id,
      kind,
      target: opts.target ?? null,
      params: { ...opts, ttlMs },
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      expiresAt: Date.now() + ttlMs,
      removeFn: null,
      timer: null,
    };

    const setup = this._setupInjection(injection);
    if (setup.ok === false) {
      return setup;
    }
    injection.removeFn = setup.removeFn ?? null;

    injection.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      try { this.eject(id); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }, ttlMs);

    this.active.set(id, injection);
    this._recordLog('inject', injection);

    return {
      ok: true,
      id,
      kind,
      target: injection.target,
      expiresAt: injection.expiresAt,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Remove uma injeção.
   * @param {string} id
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  eject(id) {
    const inj = this.active.get(id);
    if (!inj) return false;

    try { inj.removeFn?.(); } catch { /* isola */ }
    if (inj.timer) clearTimeout(inj.timer);

    this.active.delete(id);
    this._recordLog('eject', inj);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Remove todas as injeções.
   * @returns {number}
   */
  ejectAll() {
    let n = 0;
    for (const id of Array.from(this.active.keys())) {
      if (this.eject(id)) n++;
    }
    return n;
  }

  /**
   * Lista as injeções ativas.
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  list() {
    const now = Date.now();
    return Array.from(this.active.values()).map(i => ({
      id: i.id,
      kind: i.kind,
      target: i.target,
      startedAt: i.startedAt,
      expiresAt: i.expiresAt,
      remainingMs: Math.max(0, i.expiresAt - now),
      params: { ...i.params },
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Histórico de injeções/ejeções.
   * @param {number} [limit=50]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  history(limit = 50) {
    const out = this.log.slice(-Math.max(1, limit));
    return out.map(e => ({ ...e, params: e.params ? { ...e.params } : null }));
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  stats() {
    return {
      active: this.active.size,
      totalInjections: this.log.filter(e => e.action === 'inject').length,
      totalEjections: this.log.filter(e => e.action === 'eject').length,
      kinds: INJECTION_KINDS,
      devMode: this.isDevMode(),
      maxActive: MAX_ACTIVE,
      defaultTtlMs: this.defaultTtlMs,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Destrói (remove tudo).
   */
  destroy() {
    this.ejectAll();
    this.log = [];
    this.bus = null;
    this.machine = null;
  }

  // ── Setup por tipo ──────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _setupInjection(injection) {
    switch (injection.kind) {
      case 'slow':     return this._setupSlow(injection);
      case 'throw':    return this._setupThrow(injection);
      case 'drop':     return this._setupDrop(injection);
      case 'corrupt':  return this._setupCorrupt(injection);
      case 'stale':    return this._setupStale(injection);
      case 'missing':  return this._setupMissing(injection);
      default:         return { ok: false, error: `kind não implementado: ${injection.kind}` };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Envolve system.run para adicionar delay.
   * @private
   */
  _setupSlow({ target, params }) {
    const systems = this._systemsToPatch(target);
    if (systems.length === 0) {
      return { ok: false, error: `nenhum sistema para "slow"${target ? ` (${target})` : ''}` };
    }

    const ms = Math.max(1, Number(params.ms) || 300);
    const probability = this._clampProb(params.probability);

    const restores = [];
    for (const [name, system] of systems) {
      const original = system.run.bind(system);
      system.run = function slowRun(...args) {
        if (Math.random() < probability) {
          const until = Date.now() + ms;
          while (Date.now() < until) { /* busy wait — intencional */ }
        }
        return original(...args);
      };
      restores.push(() => { system.run = original; });
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      removeFn: () => { for (const r of restores) r(); },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Envolve system.run para lançar.
   * @private
   */
  _setupThrow({ target, params }) {
    const systems = this._systemsToPatch(target);
    if (systems.length === 0) {
      return { ok: false, error: `nenhum sistema para "throw"` };
    }

    const probability = this._clampProb(params.probability);
    const message = String(params.message || '[FaultInjector] throw forçado');

    const restores = [];
    for (const [name, system] of systems) {
      const original = system.run.bind(system);
      system.run = function throwRun(...args) {
        if (Math.random() < probability) {
          throw new Error(`${message} (em ${name})`);
        }
        return original(...args);
      };
      restores.push(() => { system.run = original; });
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      removeFn: () => { for (const r of restores) r(); },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Intercepta bus.emit e suprime o evento alvo.
   * @private
   */
  _setupDrop({ target, params }) {
    if (!this.bus || typeof this.bus.emit !== 'function') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'bus indisponível para "drop"' };
    }
    if (!target) {
      return { ok: false, error: '"drop" requer target (nome do evento)' };
    }

    const probability = this._clampProb(params.probability);
    const bus = this.bus;
    const original = bus.emit.bind(bus);
    let dropped = 0;

    bus.emit = function dropEmit(event, payload) {
      if (event === target && Math.random() < probability) {
        dropped++;
        return;
      }
      return original(event, payload);
    };

    return {
      ok: true,
      removeFn: () => { bus.emit = original; },
      getDropped: () => dropped,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Corrompe um componente após `component:added`.
   * @private
   */
  _setupCorrupt({ params }) {
    if (!this.bus) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'bus indisponível para "corrupt"' };
    }
    const component = params.component || COMPONENT_NAMES.STATS;
    const probability = this._clampProb(params.probability);
    const payloadPatch = params.payload ?? { __injected: true };

    const unsub = this.bus.on('component:added', ({ id, name }) => {
      if (name !== component) return;
      if (Math.random() >= probability) return;
      try {
        const world = this.machine?.world;
        if (!world) return;
        const current = world.get(id, name);
        if (!current) return;
        world.set(id, name, payloadPatch);
      } catch { /* isola */ }
    });

    return {
      ok: true,
      removeFn: () => { try { unsub(); } catch { /* noqa */ } },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Marca entidades como Stale após entity:created.
   * @private
   */
  _setupStale({ params }) {
    if (!this.bus) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'bus indisponível para "stale"' };
    }
    const probability = this._clampProb(params.probability);
    const limit = Math.max(1, Number(params.limit) || 5);
    let marked = 0;

    const unsub = this.bus.on('entity:created', ({ id }) => {
      if (Math.random() >= probability) return;
      if (marked >= limit) return;
      try {
        const world = this.machine?.world;
        if (!world) return;
        if (world.has(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE)) return;
        world.addComponent(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE, {
          value: true,
          at: this.machine?.getTick?.() ?? 'T0',
          cause: '[FaultInjector] stale',
        });
        marked++;
      } catch { /* isola */ }
    });

    return {
      ok: true,
      removeFn: () => { try { unsub(); } catch { /* noqa */ } },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Remove um sistema temporariamente do machine.
   * @private
   */
  _setupMissing({ target }) {
    if (!this.machine || !target) {
      return { ok: false, error: '"missing" requer machine + target' };
    }
    const systems = this.machine.systems;
    if (!systems || !systems.has(target)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `sistema não encontrado: ${target}` };
    }

    const original = systems.get(target);
    systems.delete(target);

    return {
      ok: true,
      removeFn: () => { if (!systems.has(target)) systems.set(target, original); },
    };
  }

  // ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _systemsToPatch(target) {
    if (!this.machine || !this.machine.systems) return [];
    if (target) {
      const s = this.machine.systems.get(target);
      return s ? [[target, s]] : [];
    }
    return Array.from(this.machine.systems.entries());
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _clampProb(v) {
    const n = Number(v);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 1;
    if (n < 0) return 0;
    if (n > 1) return 1;
    return n;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _nextId(kind) {
    this._idCounter++;
    const t = Date.now().toString(36);
    return `inj-${kind}-${this._idCounter}-${t}`;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _recordLog(action, injection) {
    this.log.push({
      action,
      id: injection.id,
      kind: injection.kind,
      target: injection.target,
      ts: Date.now(),
      params: { ...injection.params },
    });
    if (this.log.length > 200) this.log.shift();
  }

  /**
   * Kinds válidos.
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  static kinds() {
    return [...INJECTION_KINDS];
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file flight-recorder.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Ring buffer de eventos do bus. Sobrevive a reset() do Machine.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index
 * @level 9
 *
 * Diferença do structured-logger:
 *   - logger → mensagens curadas ("restore falhou")
 *   - recorder → TODOS os eventos do bus e do pipeline, com payload
 *
 * Uso:
 *   const rec = new FlightRecorder({ sessionId, maxEvents: 10000 });
 *   rec.attach(bus, { machine });
 *   rec.last(100);
 *   rec.toNDJSON();
 */

export class FlightRecorder {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {string} [opts.sessionId]
   * @param {number} [opts.maxEvents=10000]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.enabled=true]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.includePayload=true]
   */
  constructor({ sessionId = null, maxEvents = 10_000, enabled = true, includePayload = true } = {}) {
    this.sessionId = sessionId || `r-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    this.maxEvents = Math.max(1, maxEvents);
    this.enabled = !!enabled;
    this.includePayload = !!includePayload;

    /** @type {Array<Object>} */
    this.events = [];
    this.seq = 0;

    /** @type {Map<string, number>} */
    this.counters = new Map();

    /** @type {Array<Function>} */
    this._unsubs = [];

    /** @type {Object|null} */
    this._machine = null;

    /** @type {Object|null} */
    this._bus = null;

    this._startedAt = Date.now();
  }

  // ── Anexar ao bus ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Anexa o recorder a um EventBus.
   * @param {Object} bus — EventBus
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {Object} [opts.machine] — Machine (opcional, para ler tick)
   * @returns {FlightRecorder} this
   */
  attach(bus, { machine = null } = {}) {
    if (!bus || typeof bus.on !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('[FlightRecorder] bus inválido');
    }
    if (this._bus === bus) return this;

    this.detach();

    this._bus = bus;
    this._machine = machine;

    // Wildcard
    const unsub = bus.on('*', ({ event, payload }) => {
      this.record(event, payload);
    });
    this._unsubs.push(unsub);

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Remove listeners.
   */
  detach() {
    for (const unsub of this._unsubs) {
      try { unsub(); } catch { /* noop */ }
    }
    this._unsubs = [];
    this._bus = null;
  }

  // ── Registro ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Registra um evento.
   * @param {string} event
   * @param {any} [payload=null]
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  record(event, payload = null) {
    if (!this.enabled) return null;

    const entry = {
      seq: ++this.seq,
      ts: Date.now(),
      sessionId: this.sessionId,
      event: String(event),
      tick: this._machine?.getTick?.() ?? null,
      payload: this.includePayload ? this._safe(payload) : null,
    };

    this._push(entry);
    this._bumpCounter(event);

    return entry;
  }

  /**
   * Atalho para eventos internos da suíte.
   * Prefixa com `diag:` automaticamente.
   * @param {string} kind
   * @param {any} [data=null]
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  recordCustom(kind, data = null) {
    return this.record(`diag:${kind}`, data);
  }

  // ── Consultas ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Filtra eventos.
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {string} [opts.event] — nome exato
   * @param {number} [opts.since=0] — timestamp mínimo
   * @param {string} [opts.tick] — filtra por tick
   * @param {number} [opts.limit] — últimas N
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  entries({ event = null, since = 0, tick = null, limit = null } = {}) {
    let out = this.events;
    if (event) out = out.filter(e => e.event === event);
    if (tick) out = out.filter(e => e.tick === tick);
    if (since > 0) out = out.filter(e => e.ts >= since);
    if (Number.isFinite(limit) && limit > 0) out = out.slice(-limit);
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Últimas N entradas.
   * @param {number} [n=100]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  last(n = 100) {
    const k = Math.max(1, Math.floor(n));
    return this.events.slice(-k);
  }

  /**
   * Mapa de contagens por evento.
   * @returns {Object<string, number>}
   */
  counts() {
    const out = {};
    for (const [k, v] of this.counters) out[k] = v;
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Contagem de um evento específico.
   * @param {string} event
   * @returns {number}
   */
  countOf(event) {
    return this.counters.get(event) ?? 0;
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas resumidas.
   * @returns {{ total:number, inBuffer:number, maxEvents:number, uniqueEvents:number, uptimeMs:number }}
   */
  stats() {
    return {
      total: this.seq,
      inBuffer: this.events.length,
      maxEvents: this.maxEvents,
      uniqueEvents: this.counters.size,
      uptimeMs: Date.now() - this._startedAt,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Cópia do buffer.
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  dump() {
    return [...this.events];
  }

  // ── Serialização ────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Serializa o buffer inteiro em NDJSON.
   * @returns {string}
   */
  toNDJSON() {
    const lines = [];
    for (const e of this.events) {
      try {
        lines.push(JSON.stringify(e));
      } catch {
        // ignora entradas não-serializáveis
      }
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  // ── Controle ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Liga/desliga.
   * @param {boolean} v
   */
  setEnabled(v) {
    this.enabled = !!v;
  }

  /**
   * Limpa o buffer e os contadores.
   */
  clear() {
    this.events.length = 0;
    this.counters.clear();
  }

  /**
   * Limpa tudo, incluindo listeners.
   */
  destroy() {
    this.detach();
    this.clear();
    this.seq = 0;
    this.enabled = false;
  }

  // ── Internos ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _push(entry) {
    this.events.push(entry);
    if (this.events.length > this.maxEvents) {
      this.events.shift();
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _bumpCounter(event) {
    const n = (this.counters.get(event) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.counters.set(event, n);
  }

  /**
   * Deep clone seguro, com fallback para payloads não-serializáveis
   * (funções, circular, Map/Set, DOM, etc.).
   * @private
   */
  _safe(payload) {
    if (payload === null || payload === undefined) return null;

    if (typeof payload === 'string' || typeof payload === 'number' || typeof payload === 'boolean') {
      return payload;
    }

    try {
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
    } catch {
      // Fallback: resumo tipo
      return {
        _unsafe: true,
        _type: typeof payload,
        _ctor: payload?.constructor?.name ?? null,
        _keys: typeof payload === 'object' && payload !== null
          ? Object.keys(payload).slice(0, 20)
          : null,
      };
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file fuzzer.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Gera comandos aleatórios para descobrir crashes em entradas inesperadas.
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index (Fase 6+), systems/diagnostics-system (Fase 6+)
 * @level 9
 *
 * Estratégias:
 *   - verbos conhecidos + ações válidas + alvos aleatórios
 *   - verbos conhecidos + ações inválidas
 *   - strings com caracteres especiais (unicode, zero-width, aspas, chaves)
 *   - valores extremos (negativos, muito grandes, vazios)
 *   - caminhos profundos, listas vazias, JSON malformado
 *
 * Segurança:
 *   - Executa em um Machine isolado (sandbox) quando possível.
 *   - Se não houver sandbox, salva snapshot antes e restaura depois.
 *   - Nunca chama `flush` de persistência.
 *   - Teto de N iterações.
 *
 * Uso:
 *   const fuzzer = new Fuzzer();
 *   const result = await fuzzer.run({ machine, iterations: 500, seed: 42 });
 *   result.findings;      // comandos que lançaram exceção
 *   result.crashes;       // subconjunto com stack
 *   result.coverage;      // verbos/ações testados
 */

import { KNOWN_PREFIXES, ENTITY_TYPES } from '../core/constants.js';

const DEFAULT_ITERATIONS = 500;

const VERB_ACTIONS = Object.freeze({
  ent: ['create', 'show', 'list', 'delete'],
  id: ['show', 'rename', 'describe', 'retype'],
  inst: ['mark', 'unmark', 'create', 'destroy', 'list', 'sync', 'chain', 'resolve', 'reparent', 'unset', 'policy'],
  mut: ['add', 'set', 'sub', 'push', 'pull', 'flag', 'enum', 'text'],
  link: ['set', 'add', 'pull', 'clear', 'where', 'to', 'from', 'tree'],
  que: ['at', 'when', 'timeline', 'knowledge', 'where'],
  sea: ['find', 'in', 'tag', 'help'],
  at: ['show'],
  whe: ['show'],
  tim: ['show', 'rule'],
  aud: ['links', 'identities', 'instances', 'continuity', 'references', 'rules', 'snippets'],
  kno: ['learn', 'forget', 'show', 'at'],
  frk: ['create', 'switch', 'list', 'delete', 'merge'],
  dif: ['vs', 'export'],
  rul: ['add', 'list', 'find', 'show', 'run', 'sim', 'off', 'on', 'del'],
  snip: ['create', 'create.template', 'create.menu', 'create.command', 'find', 'list', 'tree', 'rename', 'delete'],
  exp: ['pdf', 'json', 'csv', 'snippets', 'all'],
  help: ['commands', 'snippets', 'components', 'cheatsheet', 'tutorial'],
  diag: ['status', 'on', 'off', 'mode', 'flight', 'counts', 'logs', 'invariants', 'contracts', 'health', 'rules', 'smoke', 'snapshot', 'clear'],
});

const SUBTYPES = Object.freeze({
  mut: ['stats', 'list'],
  inst: [null, 'mark', 'unmark', 'create', 'destroy', 'list', 'sync'],
  link: [null, 'set', 'add', 'pull', 'clear', 'where', 'to', 'from', 'tree'],
});

const PATH_FIELDS = Object.freeze(['fear', 'hp', 'value', 'x', 'y', '__proto__', 'constructor', '']);

const VALUE_STRINGS = Object.freeze([
  '', ' ', 'a', 'abc', '0', '-1', '9999999999999999999', 'NaN', 'Infinity',
  'null', 'undefined', 'true', 'false',
  "'", '"', '`', '\\', '\\n', '\\t',
  '{', '}', '[', ']', '(', ')', '<', '>',
  '🎲', '日本語', '\u200b', '\u2063', 'é', 'ñ', 'ç',
  'a=b', 'a,b', 'a.b.c.d', '!!!', '@@@', '%%%',
]);

export class Fuzzer {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {number} [opts.defaultIterations=500]
   * @param {number} [opts.maxIterations=5000]
   * @param {number} [opts.seed=0]
   */
  constructor({
    defaultIterations = DEFAULT_ITERATIONS,
    maxIterations = 5000,
    seed = 0,
  } = {}) {
    this.defaultIterations = Math.max(1, defaultIterations);
    this.maxIterations = Math.max(1, maxIterations);
    this._seed = Number.isFinite(seed) && seed !== 0 ? seed : Date.now() % 0x7fffffff;
    this._rng = this._makeRng(this._seed);

    this._running = false;
    this._coverage = { verbs: new Set(), actions: new Set(), combos: new Set() };
    this._findings = [];
  }

  // ── API principal ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Roda N iterações contra o machine.
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {Object} opts.machine
   * @param {number} [opts.iterations]
   * @param {number} [opts.seed] — se passado, reinicia o RNG
   * @param {boolean} [opts.isolate=true] — tenta rodar em sandbox
   * @param {Function} [opts.onIteration] — callback(opcional) por iteração
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   */
  async run({
    machine,
    iterations = this.defaultIterations,
    seed = null,
    isolate = true,
    onIteration = null,
  } = {}) {
    if (this._running) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'fuzzer já em execução' };
    }
    if (!machine || typeof machine.handleLine !== 'function') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'machine inválido' };
    }

    const n = Math.min(Math.max(1, iterations), this.maxIterations);
    if (Number.isFinite(seed) && seed !== 0) {
      this._seed = seed;
      this._rng = this._makeRng(seed);
    }

    this._running = true;
    this._coverage = { verbs: new Set(), actions: new Set(), combos: new Set() };
    this._findings = [];

    // Snapshot de segurança
    const safety = isolate ? this._safetySnapshot(machine) : null;

    const t0 = this._now();
    const commands = [];

    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const line = this._generate();
        commands.push(line);

        let result = null;
        let threw = null;
        try {
          result = machine.handleLine(line);
        } catch (err) {
          threw = err;
        }

        const finding = {
          iteration: i + 1,
          line,
          ok: result?.ok !== false && !threw,
          threw: !!threw,
          error: threw?.message ?? (result?.ok === false ? result.error : null),
          stack: threw?.stack ? threw.stack.split('\n').slice(0, 5).join(' | ') : null,
          mutated: result?.mutated === true,
          tick: typeof machine.getTick === 'function' ? machine.getTick() : null,
        };

        // Consideramos "finding" só se lançou exceção ou deu halt silencioso
        if (finding.threw || (result && result.ok === false && result.halt)) {
          this._findings.push(finding);
        }

        if (typeof onIteration === 'function') {
          try { onIteration(finding, i); } catch { /* isola */ }
        }
      }
    } finally {
      // Restaura estado de segurança se aplicável
      if (safety) {
        try { this._restoreSafety(machine, safety); } catch { /* isola */ }
      }
      this._running = false;
    }

    const durationMs = this._round(this._now() - t0);

    return {
      ok: true,
      iterations: n,
      seed: this._seed,
      durationMs,
      findings: this._findings.slice(),
      crashes: this._findings.filter(f => f.threw),
      coverage: {
        verbs: Array.from(this._coverage.verbs).sort(),
        actions: Array.from(this._coverage.actions).sort(),
        combos: Array.from(this._coverage.combos).sort(),
      },
      commandSample: commands.slice(0, 30),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verifica se está rodando.
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  isRunning() {
    return this._running;
  }

  /**
   * Seed atual.
   * @returns {number}
   */
  getSeed() {
    return this._seed;
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas da última execução.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  stats() {
    return {
      running: this._running,
      seed: this._seed,
      findings: this._findings.length,
      crashes: this._findings.filter(f => f.threw).length,
      verbsCovered: this._coverage.verbs.size,
      actionsCovered: this._coverage.actions.size,
    };
  }

  // ── Geração ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Gera uma linha aleatória.
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _generate() {
    const strategy = this._pick(0.15);
    if (strategy) return this._generateWeird();

    const verb = this._pickFrom(KNOWN_PREFIXES.filter(v => v !== 'diag'));
    const actions = VERB_ACTIONS[verb] || ['show'];
    const action = this._pickFrom(actions);

    this._coverage.verbs.add(verb);
    this._coverage.actions.add(`${verb}.${action}`);
    this._coverage.combos.add(`${verb}.${action}`);

    const head = this._buildHead(verb, action);
    const args = this._buildArgs(verb, action);

    return args.length > 0 ? `${head} ${args.join(' ')}` : head;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _buildHead(verb, action) {
    // Adiciona subtype para verbos que aceitam
    if (verb === 'mut' && ['add', 'set', 'sub'].includes(action)) {
      return `mut.${action}.stats`;
    }
    if (verb === 'mut' && ['push', 'pull'].includes(action)) {
      return `mut.${action}.list`;
    }
    if (verb === 'mut' && action === 'flag') {
      return `mut.flag.${this._pickFrom(['on', 'off'])}`;
    }
    if (verb === 'link' && ['set', 'add', 'pull', 'clear'].includes(action)) {
      return `link.${action}.${this._randomRel()}`;
    }
    if (verb === 'inst' && action === 'create') {
      return `inst.create`;
    }
    return `${verb}.${action}`;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _buildArgs(verb, action) {
    const out = [];
    const argc = 1 + Math.floor(this._rng() * 3);

    for (let i = 0; i < argc; i++) {
      out.push(this._randomToken(verb, action));
    }

    // Para mut.*, garante path.field
    if (verb === 'mut' && ['add', 'set', 'sub', 'push', 'pull'].includes(action)) {
      const target = this._randomToken(verb, action);
      const field = this._pickFrom(PATH_FIELDS) || 'value';
      out[0] = `${target}.${field}`;
    }

    return out;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _randomToken(verb, action) {
    const r = this._rng();
    if (r < 0.20) return this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS);
    if (r < 0.40) return this._randomNumber();
    if (r < 0.60) return this._randomEntityName();
    if (r < 0.80) return `${this._randomEntityName()}.${this._pickFrom(PATH_FIELDS) || 'value'}`;
    return this._randomKeyValue();
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _randomEntityName() {
    const letters = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
    const n = 1 + Math.floor(this._rng() * 10);
    let s = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      s += letters[Math.floor(this._rng() * letters.length)];
    }
    // Capitaliza às vezes
    if (this._rng() < 0.5) s = s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
    return s;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _randomNumber() {
    const r = this._rng();
    if (r < 0.3) return String(Math.floor(this._rng() * 100));
    if (r < 0.5) return String(-Math.floor(this._rng() * 100));
    if (r < 0.7) return String(Math.floor(this._rng() * 1e15));
    if (r < 0.85) return this._rng().toFixed(6);
    return '0';
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _randomRel() {
    const rels = ['location', 'owner', 'parent', 'inventory', 'members', 'rival', 'peer', 'x', ''];
    return this._pickFrom(rels) || 'rel';
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _randomKeyValue() {
    const keys = ['k', 'x', 'type', 'value', 'flags', 'tags', 'description', ''];
    const vals = ['v', '1', '', 'true', 'null', "a'b", 'a"b'];
    const k = this._pickFrom(keys) || 'k';
    const v = this._pickFrom(vals);
    return `${k}=${v}`;
  }

  /**
   * Gera linha "weird" com caracteres especiais.
   * @private
   */
  _generateWeird() {
    const patterns = [
      () => '',
      () => ' ',
      () => '\t',
      () => '\n',
      () => '...',
      () => 'a.b.c.d.e',
      () => '.'.repeat(10),
      () => `ent.create.${this._pickFrom(ENTITY_TYPES)} ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}`,
      () => `mut.add.stats ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}.${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)} ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}`,
      () => `link.set.${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)} ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)} ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}`,
      () => `/diag.inject ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}`,
      () => `/unknown ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}`,
      () => `sea.find ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}`,
      () => `rul.add ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)} ON: ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)} DO: ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}`,
      () => `snip.create.menu ${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)} opts='${this._pickFrom(VALUE_STRINGS)}'`,
    ];
    return this._pickFrom(patterns)();
  }

  // ── Segurança ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Tira snapshot do estado atual para restaurar depois.
   * @private
   */
  _safetySnapshot(machine) {
    try {
      const world = machine.world;
      if (!world) return null;
      const entities = {};
      for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
        entities[id] = world.componentsOf(id);
      }
      return {
        entities,
        tick: machine.state?.tick ?? 'T0',
        tickNumber: machine.state?.tickNumber ?? 0,
        timeline: machine.state?.timeline ?? 'main',
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Restaura o snapshot de segurança.
   * @private
   */
  _restoreSafety(machine, safety) {
    const world = machine.world;
    if (!world) return;

    world.clear();
    for (const [id, comps] of Object.entries(safety.entities)) {
      world.createEntity(comps, { id });
    }

    if (machine.state) {
      machine.state.tick = safety.tick;
      machine.state.tickNumber = safety.tickNumber;
      machine.state.timeline = safety.timeline;
    }

    try { machine.links?.rebuild?.(world); } catch { /* isola */ }
    try { machine.ids?.rebuildFromWorld?.(world); } catch { /* isola */ }
  }

  // ── RNG ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Cria um PRNG determinístico (mulberry32).
   * @param {number} seed
   * @returns {() => number}
   * @private
   */
  _makeRng(seed) {
    let a = seed >>> 0;
    return function mulberry32() {
      a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
      let t = a;
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _pickFrom(arr) {
    if (!arr || arr.length === 0) return '';
    return arr[Math.floor(this._rng() * arr.length)];
  }

  /**
   * Retorna true com probabilidade p.
   * @private
   */
  _pick(p) {
    return this._rng() < p;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _now() {
    if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
      return performance.now();
    }
    return Date.now();
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _round(n) {
    return Math.round(Number(n) * 1000) / 1000;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file golden-baseline.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Captura, armazena e compara baselines de estado do mundo.
 * @imports core/utils/object (deepClone, deepEqual), core/utils/time (nowISO)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/test-battery
 * @level 9
 *
 * Baseline = snapshot determinístico de `machine.world` após rodar uma
 * sequência fixa de comandos. Comparar um novo estado contra o baseline
 * detecta regressões estruturais (entidades que sumiram, campos que
 * mudaram de valor, links que se romperam).
 *
 * Armazenamento:
 *   - Se `adapter` for injetado → usa adapter.get/set/delete/list (async)
 *   - Caso contrário          → usa localStorage direto (fallback)
 *
 * Prefixo de chave: `narr:diag:baseline:<name>`
 *
 * Uso:
 *   const baseline = new GoldenBaseline();
 *   await baseline.capture('main', machine);
 *   const cmp = await baseline.compare('main', machine);
 *   if (!cmp.equal) console.log(cmp.diff);
 */

import { deepClone, deepEqual } from '../core/utils/object.js';
import { nowISO } from '../core/utils/time.js';

const DEFAULT_PREFIX = 'narr:diag:baseline:';
const BASELINE_VERSION = 1;
const LS_PREFIX = 'narr:';

export class GoldenBaseline {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {Object} [opts.adapter=null]  — StorageAdapter opcional
   * @param {string} [opts.prefix]
   * @param {number} [opts.maxBaselines=50]  — limite de baselines mantidos
   */
  constructor({
    adapter = null,
    prefix = DEFAULT_PREFIX,
    maxBaselines = 50,
  } = {}) {
    this.adapter = adapter;
    this.prefix = prefix;
    this.maxBaselines = Math.max(1, maxBaselines);
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // API principal
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Captura o estado atual e salva como baseline.
   *
   * @param {string} name
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} [meta={}]  — dados livres (ex: { seed, note })
   * @returns {Promise<{ ok:boolean, name:string, capturedAt:string, entityCount:number }>}
   */
  async capture(name, machine, meta = {}) {
    this._assertName(name);
    this._assertMachine(machine);

    const snapshot = this._captureWorld(machine.world);
    const payload = {
      version: BASELINE_VERSION,
      name: String(name),
      capturedAt: nowISO(),
      tick: machine.state?.tick ?? null,
      timeline: machine.state?.timeline ?? null,
      entityCount: snapshot.count,
      hash: this._hash(snapshot.entities),
      snapshot,
      meta: deepClone(meta),
    };

    await this._write(name, payload);
    await this._enforceLimit();

    return {
      ok: true,
      name: payload.name,
      capturedAt: payload.capturedAt,
      entityCount: payload.entityCount,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Compara o estado atual contra um baseline salvo.
   *
   * @param {string} name
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @returns {Promise<{
   *   equal:boolean,
   *   name:string,
   *   reason?:string,
   *   baselineAt?:string,
   *   baselineCount?:number,
   *   currentCount?:number,
   *   diff?:Object,
   * }>}
   */
  async compare(name, machine) {
    this._assertName(name);
    this._assertMachine(machine);

    const stored = await this.get(name);
    if (!stored) {
      return { equal: false, name, reason: 'baseline não encontrada' };
    }

    const current = this._captureWorld(machine.world);
    const currentHash = this._hash(current.entities);

    // Atalho por hash — se bate, é igual
    if (stored.hash && stored.hash === currentHash) {
      return {
        equal: true,
        name,
        baselineAt: stored.capturedAt,
        baselineCount: stored.entityCount,
        currentCount: current.count,
        diff: null,
      };
    }

    // Diff detalhado
    const equal = deepEqual(stored.snapshot.entities, current.entities);

    return {
      equal,
      name,
      baselineAt: stored.capturedAt,
      baselineCount: stored.entityCount,
      currentCount: current.count,
      diff: equal ? null : this._diffWorlds(stored.snapshot, current),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Lista metadados dos baselines salvos.
   * @returns {Promise<Array<{name:string, capturedAt:string, entityCount:number, tick:string, hash:string}>>}
   */
  async list() {
    const names = await this._listNames();
    const out = [];

    for (const name of names) {
      const stored = await this.get(name);
      if (!stored) continue;
      out.push({
        name: stored.name,
        capturedAt: stored.capturedAt,
        entityCount: stored.entityCount,
        tick: stored.tick,
        hash: stored.hash,
      });
    }

    out.sort((a, b) => (b.capturedAt ?? '').localeCompare(a.capturedAt ?? ''));
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Recupera um baseline completo.
   * @param {string} name
   * @returns {Promise<Object|null>}
   */
  async get(name) {
    this._assertName(name);
    const raw = await this._read(name);
    if (!raw) return null;

    try {
      const parsed = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
      if (parsed?.version !== BASELINE_VERSION) return null;
      return parsed;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Remove um baseline.
   * @param {string} name
   * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
   */
  async delete(name) {
    this._assertName(name);
    await this._delete(name);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Remove todos os baselines.
   * @returns {Promise<number>} — quantidade removida
   */
  async clear() {
    const names = await this._listNames();
    for (const name of names) {
      await this._delete(name);
    }
    return names.length;
  }

  /**
   * Verifica se um baseline existe.
   * @param {string} name
   * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
   */
  async has(name) {
    const stored = await this.get(name);
    return stored !== null;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Captura do mundo
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Captura o estado atual do World como objeto plano.
   * @param {Object} world
   * @returns {{ entities:Object, count:number }}
   * @private
   */
  _captureWorld(world) {
    const entities = {};
    const ids = world.allEntities();

    for (const id of ids) {
      const comps = world.componentsOf(id);
      entities[id] = comps ? deepClone(comps) : {};
    }

    return { entities, count: ids.length };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Diff
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Diff compacto entre dois snapshots.
   * @param {Object} baseline — { entities, count }
   * @param {Object} current  — { entities, count }
   * @returns {{ added:string[], removed:string[], changed:Array<{id:string, components:string[]}>, stats:Object }}
   * @private
   */
  _diffWorlds(baseline, current) {
    const baseIds = new Set(Object.keys(baseline.entities ?? {}));
    const curIds = new Set(Object.keys(current.entities ?? {}));

    const added = [];
    const removed = [];
    const changed = [];

    for (const id of curIds) {
      if (!baseIds.has(id)) added.push(id);
    }
    for (const id of baseIds) {
      if (!curIds.has(id)) removed.push(id);
    }

    for (const id of baseIds) {
      if (!curIds.has(id)) continue;

      const a = baseline.entities[id] ?? {};
      const b = current.entities[id] ?? {};
      const comps = new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)]);
      const diffComps = [];

      for (const c of comps) {
        if (!deepEqual(a[c], b[c])) diffComps.push(c);
      }

      if (diffComps.length > 0) changed.push({ id, components: diffComps });
    }

    return {
      added: added.sort(),
      removed: removed.sort(),
      changed: changed.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),
      stats: {
        baselineCount: baseline.count ?? baseIds.size,
        currentCount: current.count ?? curIds.size,
        added: added.length,
        removed: removed.length,
        changed: changed.length,
      },
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Hash
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Hash determinístico (djb2) sobre a forma canônica dos dados.
   * Não é criptográfico — só serve para atalho de comparação.
   * @param {any} value
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _hash(value) {
    const canonical = this._canonicalize(value);
    let h = 5381;
    for (let i = 0; i < canonical.length; i++) {
      h = ((h << 5) + h) ^ canonical.charCodeAt(i);
      h |= 0;
    }
    return Math.abs(h).toString(36);
  }

  /**
   * Stringify canônico (chaves ordenadas) para hash estável.
   * @param {any} v
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _canonicalize(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return 'null';
    if (typeof v === 'number') return Number.isFinite(v) ? String(v) : 'NaN';
    if (typeof v === 'boolean') return v ? '1' : '0';
    if (typeof v === 'string') return JSON.stringify(v);

    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      return '[' + v.map(x => this._canonicalize(x)).join(',') + ']';
    }

    if (typeof v === 'object') {
      const keys = Object.keys(v).sort();
      const parts = [];
      for (const k of keys) {
        parts.push(JSON.stringify(k) + ':' + this._canonicalize(v[k]));
      }
      return '{' + parts.join(',') + '}';
    }

    return JSON.stringify(String(v));
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Storage — caminho com adapter
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * @private
   */
  async _read(name) {
    const key = this._keyFor(name);

    if (this.adapter && typeof this.adapter.get === 'function') {
      return await this.adapter.get(key);
    }
    return this._lsGet(key);
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  async _write(name, payload) {
    const key = this._keyFor(name);
    const json = JSON.stringify(payload);

    if (this.adapter && typeof this.adapter.set === 'function') {
      await this.adapter.set(key, json);
      return;
    }
    this._lsSet(key, json);
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  async _delete(name) {
    const key = this._keyFor(name);

    if (this.adapter && typeof this.adapter.delete === 'function') {
      await this.adapter.delete(key);
      return;
    }
    this._lsRemove(key);
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  async _listNames() {
    const out = [];

    if (this.adapter && typeof this.adapter.list === 'function') {
      const keys = await this.adapter.list();
      for (const k of keys) {
        if (typeof k === 'string' && k.startsWith(this.prefix)) {
          out.push(k.slice(this.prefix.length));
        }
      }
      return out;
    }

    // Fallback localStorage
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return [];
      for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        const k = localStorage.key(i);
        if (k && k.startsWith(LS_PREFIX + this.prefix)) {
          out.push(k.slice((LS_PREFIX + this.prefix).length));
        }
      }
    } catch { /* isola */ }

    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Remove baselines mais antigos se ultrapassar o limite.
   * @private
   */
  async _enforceLimit() {
    const names = await this.list();
    if (names.length <= this.maxBaselines) return;

    const excess = names.slice(this.maxBaselines);
    for (const entry of excess) {
      await this._delete(entry.name);
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // localStorage fallback
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _lsGet(key) {
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return null;
      const v = localStorage.getItem(LS_PREFIX + key);
      return v === null ? null : String(v);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _lsSet(key, value) {
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return false;
      localStorage.setItem(LS_PREFIX + key, String(value));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _lsRemove(key) {
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return false;
      localStorage.removeItem(LS_PREFIX + key);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Helpers
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _keyFor(name) {
    return this.prefix + String(name);
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _assertName(name) {
    if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name) {
      throw new Error('[GoldenBaseline] name obrigatório (string não vazia)');
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _assertMachine(machine) {
    if (!machine || !machine.world || typeof machine.world.allEntities !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('[GoldenBaseline] machine inválido (precisa de .world)');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Diagnóstico: bytes usados por todos os baselines.
   * @returns {Promise<number>}
   */
  async bytesInUse() {
    const names = await this._listNames();
    let bytes = 0;
    for (const name of names) {
      const raw = await this._read(name);
      if (raw) bytes += raw.length;
    }
    return bytes;
  }

  /**
   * Diagnóstico: estatísticas.
   * @returns {Promise<{ count:number, totalBytes:number, names:string[] }>}
   */
  async stats() {
    const names = await this._listNames();
    const bytes = await this.bytesInUse();
    return { count: names.length, totalBytes: bytes, names };
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file health-probes.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Sondas de saúde rodando em intervalos, com histórico e detecção de anomalias.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index (Fase 4+), systems/diagnostics-system (Fase 4)
 * @level 9
 *
 * Sondas:
 *   - memory: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize
 *   - entities: world.entities.size
 *   - tick: machine.state.tickNumber
 *   - busHandlers: bus.size()
 *   - persistFreshness: Date.now() - persist.lastFlushAt
 *
 * Anomalias detectadas:
 *   - entidades caíram > 50% em 1 s
 *   - bus handlers mudaram > 200 em 1 s
 *   - memória cresceu > 50 MB em 60 s
 *   - persist sem flush há > 5 min
 */

const DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS = 5_000;
const MAX_HISTORY = 720; // 1 hora a 5s

export class HealthProbes {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {number} [opts.intervalMs=5000]
   * @param {number} [opts.maxHistory=720]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.enabled=true]
   * @param {Object} [opts.bus]
   */
  constructor({ intervalMs = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS, maxHistory = MAX_HISTORY, enabled = true, bus = null } = {}) {
    this.intervalMs = Math.max(500, intervalMs);
    this.maxHistory = Math.max(10, maxHistory);
    this.enabled = !!enabled;
    this.bus = bus;

    /** @type {Array<Object>} */
    this.history = [];

    /** @type {Array<Object>} */
    this.anomalies = [];

    this._timer = null;
    this._machine = null;
    this._world = null;
    this._persist = null;
  }

  // ── Ciclo de vida ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Inicia as sondas.
   * @param {Object} deps
   * @param {Object} deps.machine
   * @param {Object} deps.world
   * @param {Object} [deps.persist]
   */
  start({ machine, world, persist = null } = {}) {
    this._machine = machine;
    this._world = world;
    this._persist = persist;

    if (!this.enabled) return this;

    this._probe();
    this._timer = setInterval(() => {
      try { this._probe(); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }, this.intervalMs);

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Para as sondas.
   */
  stop() {
    if (this._timer) {
      clearInterval(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
    return this;
  }

  // ── Sondagem ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Executa uma sondagem manual.
   * @returns {Object} snapshot
   */
  probe() {
    return this._probe();
  }

  /** @private */
  _probe() {
    const snap = this._capture();
    this.history.push(snap);
    while (this.history.length > this.maxHistory) this.history.shift();

    const detected = this._detectAnomalies(snap);
    for (const a of detected) {
      this.anomalies.push(a);
      this._emit('diag:health:anomaly', a);
    }
    while (this.anomalies.length > this.maxHistory) this.anomalies.shift();

    return snap;
  }

  /** @private */
  _capture() {
    const mem = this._readMemory();
    return {
      ts: Date.now(),
      memoryBytes: mem,
      entities: this._world?.entities?.size ?? null,
      tick: this._machine?.state?.tickNumber ?? null,
      tickLabel: this._machine?.state?.tick ?? null,
      busHandlers: this._readBusSize(),
      persistAgeMs: this._readPersistAge(),
    };
  }

  // ── Detecção de anomalias ───────────────────────────────────

  /** @private */
  _detectAnomalies(snap) {
    const out = [];
    const prev = this.history.length >= 2 ? this.history[this.history.length - 2] : null;
    if (!prev) return out;

    // Entidades caíram > 50% em 1 s
    if (snap.entities !== null && prev.entities !== null) {
      const dtMs = snap.ts - prev.ts;
      if (dtMs <= 2_000 && prev.entities > 10) {
        const drop = prev.entities - snap.entities;
        if (drop > prev.entities * 0.5) {
          out.push({
            code: 'ENTITIES_DROPPED',
            severity: 'warning',
            message: `entidades caíram de ${prev.entities} para ${snap.entities} em ${dtMs}ms`,
            context: { before: prev.entities, after: snap.entities, dtMs },
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Bus handlers mudaram drasticamente em 1 s
    if (snap.busHandlers !== null && prev.busHandlers !== null) {
      const dtMs = snap.ts - prev.ts;
      if (dtMs <= 2_000) {
        const delta = Math.abs(snap.busHandlers - prev.busHandlers);
        if (delta > 200) {
          out.push({
            code: 'BUS_HANDLERS_SWING',
            severity: 'warning',
            message: `handlers do bus oscilaram ${delta} em ${dtMs}ms`,
            context: { before: prev.busHandlers, after: snap.busHandlers, delta, dtMs },
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Persist sem flush > 5 min
    if (snap.persistAgeMs !== null && snap.persistAgeMs > 5 * 60_000) {
      out.push({
        code: 'PERSIST_STALE',
        severity: 'warning',
        message: `último flush há ${Math.round(snap.persistAgeMs / 1000)}s`,
        context: { persistAgeMs: snap.persistAgeMs },
      });
    }

    // Memória cresceu > 50 MB nos últimos 60 s
    if (snap.memoryBytes !== null) {
      const cutoff = snap.ts - 60_000;
      const older = this.history.find(h => h.ts >= cutoff && h.memoryBytes !== null);
      if (older && older.memoryBytes !== null) {
        const growth = snap.memoryBytes - older.memoryBytes;
        if (growth > 50 * 1024 * 1024) {
          out.push({
            code: 'MEMORY_GROWTH',
            severity: 'warning',
            message: `memória cresceu ${(growth / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB em 60s`,
            context: { before: older.memoryBytes, after: snap.memoryBytes, growthBytes: growth },
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return out;
  }

  // ── Consultas ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Snapshot atual.
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  current() {
    return this.history.length ? { ...this.history[this.history.length - 1] } : null;
  }

  /**
   * Histórico (cópia).
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  samples() {
    return this.history.map(h => ({ ...h }));
  }

  /**
   * Anomalias detectadas (mais recentes primeiro).
   * @param {number} [limit]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  detectedAnomalies(limit = null) {
    const out = this.anomalies.slice().reverse();
    if (Number.isFinite(limit) && limit > 0) return out.slice(0, limit);
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  stats() {
    const cur = this.current();
    return {
      samples: this.history.length,
      maxHistory: this.maxHistory,
      anomalies: this.anomalies.length,
      intervalMs: this.intervalMs,
      running: this._timer !== null,
      lastSample: cur,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Serializa.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  toJSON() {
    return {
      stats: this.stats(),
      samples: this.samples(),
      anomalies: this.detectedAnomalies(),
    };
  }

  // ── Controle ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  setEnabled(v) { this.enabled = !!v; }

  clear() {
    this.history = [];
    this.anomalies = [];
  }

  destroy() {
    this.stop();
    this.clear();
    this._machine = null;
    this._world = null;
    this._persist = null;
  }

  // ── Internos ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** @private */
  _readMemory() {
    try {
      if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.memory) {
        return performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize ?? null;
      }
    } catch { /* noop */ }
    return null;
  }

  /** @private */
  _readBusSize() {
    try {
      return this._machine?.bus?.size?.() ?? null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /** @private */
  _readPersistAge() {
    try {
      const last = this._persist?.lastFlushAt;
      if (typeof last !== 'number') return null;
      return Date.now() - last;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /** @private */
  _emit(event, payload) {
    if (this.bus && typeof this.bus.emit === 'function') {
      try { this.bus.emit(event, payload); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }
  }
}
```
