```javascript
/**
 * @file index.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description DiagnosticsSuite — orquestrador central.
 * @imports diagnostics/config, diagnostics/structured-logger,
 *          diagnostics/flight-recorder, diagnostics/instrumentation,
 *          diagnostics/tracer, diagnostics/invariant-checker,
 *          diagnostics/contract-guard, diagnostics/health-probes,
 *          diagnostics/expectation-tracker, diagnostics/pipeline-report,
 *          diagnostics/snapshot-dumper, diagnostics/replay-engine,
 *          diagnostics/root-cause-analyzer, diagnostics/fuzzer,
 *          diagnostics/fault-injector, diagnostics/report-builder,
 *          diagnostics/test-battery
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 9
 *
 * Uso no boot.js:
 *   const diag = new DiagnosticsSuite();
 *   diag.install(machine, world, bus, { persist });
 *   window.__NarrativeApp.diag = diag;
 *
 * Comandos públicos:
 *   diag.start() / stop() / setMode(mode)
 *   diag.status()
 *   diag.flight(n) / logs(n) / eventsByType(evt) / eventCounts()
 *   diag.snapshot() / toNDJSON() / clear()
 *   diag.runBattery(opts) / getLastBatteryReport()
 *   diag.detach() / destroy()
 *
 * Estado da arte:
 *   - Fase 1: logger + recorder + instrumentation
 *   - Fase 4: comandos diag.* básicos
 *   - Fase 5: Tracer, InvariantChecker, ContractGuard, HealthProbes,
 *             ExpectationTracker, PipelineReport, SnapshotDumper
 *   - Fase 6: ReplayEngine, RootCauseAnalyzer, Fuzzer, FaultInjector,
 *             ReportBuilder
 *   - Onda 5: TestBattery (bateria de testes automáticos)
 */

import {
  createConfig,
  pickDefaultMode,
  isDevEnvironment,
  modeIncludes,
  isValidMode,
  DIAG_MODES,
} from './config.js';

import { StructuredLogger } from './structured-logger.js';
import { FlightRecorder } from './flight-recorder.js';
import { Instrumentation } from './instrumentation.js';

// ── Fase 5 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import { Tracer } from './tracer.js';
import { InvariantChecker } from './invariant-checker.js';
import { ContractGuard } from './contract-guard.js';
import { HealthProbes } from './health-probes.js';
import { ExpectationTracker } from './expectation-tracker.js';
import { PipelineReport } from './pipeline-report.js';
import { SnapshotDumper } from './snapshot-dumper.js';

// ── Fase 6 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import { ReplayEngine } from './replay-engine.js';
import { RootCauseAnalyzer } from './root-cause-analyzer.js';
import { Fuzzer } from './fuzzer.js';
import { FaultInjector } from './fault-injector.js';
import { ReportBuilder } from './report-builder.js';

// ── Onda 5 — Bateria de testes automáticos ─────────────────────
import { TestBattery } from './test-battery.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Aliases de feature → feature da MODE_MATRIX
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const FEATURE_ALIASES = Object.freeze({
  expectations: 'invariants',
  pipeline:     'spans',
  replay:       'events',
  rca:          'contracts',
  snapshot:     'invariants',
});

export class DiagnosticsSuite {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {string} [opts.mode] — 'off' | 'light' | 'full' | 'dev'
   * @param {string} [opts.sessionId]
   * @param {number} [opts.ringSize=10000]
   * @param {number} [opts.logRingSize=5000]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.autoStart=true]
   */
  constructor(opts = {}) {
    const base = {
      mode: opts.mode ?? pickDefaultMode(),
      sessionId: opts.sessionId ?? null,
      ringSize: opts.ringSize ?? 10_000,
      logRingSize: opts.logRingSize ?? 5_000,
      autoStart: opts.autoStart !== false,
    };
    this.config = createConfig(base);

    if (!isValidMode(this.config.mode)) {
      throw new Error(`[DiagnosticsSuite] modo inválido: ${this.config.mode}`);
    }

    this.sessionId = this.config.sessionId || this._genSessionId();

    // ── Fase 1 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    /** @type {StructuredLogger} */
    this.logger = new StructuredLogger({
      sessionId: this.sessionId,
      maxEntries: this.config.logRingSize,
      enabled: modeIncludes(this.config.mode, 'logs'),
    });

    /** @type {FlightRecorder} */
    this.recorder = new FlightRecorder({
      sessionId: this.sessionId,
      maxEvents: this.config.ringSize,
      enabled: modeIncludes(this.config.mode, 'events'),
      includePayload: true,
    });

    // ── Fase 5 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    /** @type {Tracer} */
    this.tracer = new Tracer({
      maxTraces: 100,
      enabled: this._featureEnabled('spans'),
    });

    /** @type {InvariantChecker} */
    this.checker = new InvariantChecker({
      enabled: this._featureEnabled('invariants'),
    });

    /** @type {ContractGuard} */
    this.contracts = new ContractGuard({
      bus: null,
      enabled: this._featureEnabled('contracts'),
    });

    /** @type {HealthProbes} */
    this.health = new HealthProbes({
      intervalMs: 5_000,
      enabled: this._featureEnabled('health'),
      bus: null,
    });

    /** @type {ExpectationTracker} */
    this.expectations = new ExpectationTracker({
      enabled: this._featureEnabled('expectations'),
    });

    /** @type {PipelineReport} */
    this.pipelineReport = new PipelineReport({
      slowThresholdMs: 50,
      enabled: this._featureEnabled('pipeline'),
    });

    /** @type {SnapshotDumper} */
    this.snapshotDumper = new SnapshotDumper();

    // ── Fase 6 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    /** @type {ReplayEngine} */
    this.replayEngine = new ReplayEngine({
      autoRecord: this._featureEnabled('replay'),
    });

    /** @type {RootCauseAnalyzer} */
    this.rca = new RootCauseAnalyzer();

    /** @type {Fuzzer} */
    this.fuzzer = new Fuzzer();

    /** @type {FaultInjector} */
    this.faultInjector = new FaultInjector({
      bus: null,
      machine: null,
    });

    /** @type {ReportBuilder} */
    this.reportBuilder = new ReportBuilder();

    /** @type {TestBattery|null} — criado lazy em runBattery() */
    this.testBattery = null;

    // ── Instrumentation (recebe TODAS as deps) ─────────────
    /** @type {Instrumentation} */
    this.instrumentation = new Instrumentation({
      recorder: this.recorder,
      logger: this.logger,
      tracer: this.tracer,
      expectations: this.expectations,
      pipelineReport: this.pipelineReport,
      replayEngine: this.replayEngine,
      rca: this.rca,
      enabled: modeIncludes(this.config.mode, 'events'),
    });

    this.installed = false;
    this.machine = null;
    this.world = null;
    this.bus = null;
    this.persist = null;

    /** @type {Array<Function>} */
    this._unsubs = [];

    this._startedAt = null;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Instalação
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Anexa a suíte ao Machine.
   * Idempotente — segunda chamada não faz nada.
   *
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} world
   * @param {Object} bus
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {Object} [opts.persist] — PersistenceSystem (opcional)
   * @returns {DiagnosticsSuite} this
   */
  install(machine, world, bus, opts = {}) {
    if (this.installed) {
      this.logger.warn('suite', 'install() chamado duas vezes — ignorando');
      return this;
    }
    if (!machine || !bus) {
      throw new Error('[DiagnosticsSuite] machine e bus obrigatórios');
    }

    this.machine = machine;
    this.world = world;
    this.bus = bus;
    this.persist = opts.persist ?? null;

    // ── 1. Recorder assina o bus (wildcard) ────────────────
    this.recorder.attach(bus, { machine });

    // ── 2. Alimenta bus nas classes que precisam ───────────
    if (!this.contracts.bus) this.contracts.bus = bus;
    if (!this.health.bus) this.health.bus = bus;
    this.faultInjector.attach(bus, machine);

    // ── 3. Instrumenta handleLine + systems ────────────────
    this.instrumentation.instrumentMachine(machine);

    // ── 4. Attach das classes de saúde e análise ───────────
    this.checker.attach(bus, {
      machine,
      world,
      ids: machine.ids ?? null,
      links: machine.links ?? null,
    });

    this.health.start({
      machine,
      world,
      persist: this.persist,
    });

    this.snapshotDumper.attach({
      machine,
      world,
      persist: this.persist,
    });

    // ── 5. Contratos em métodos críticos ───────────────────
    this._defineAndWrapContracts(world, machine);

    // ── 6. ReportBuilder recebe todas as deps ──────────────
    this.reportBuilder.attach({
      machine,
      world,
      persist: this.persist,
      recorder: this.recorder,
      logger: this.logger,
      tracer: this.tracer,
      checker: this.checker,
      contracts: this.contracts,
      health: this.health,
      expectations: this.expectations,
      pipelineReport: this.pipelineReport,
      snapshotDumper: this.snapshotDumper,
      replayEngine: this.replayEngine,
      rca: this.rca,
    });

    // ── 7. Wire de logging por evento ──────────────────────
    this._wireLogging();

    this.installed = true;
    this._startedAt = Date.now();

    this.logger.info('suite', 'DiagnosticsSuite instalado', {
      mode: this.config.mode,
      sessionId: this.sessionId,
      env: isDevEnvironment() ? 'dev' : 'prod',
    });

    this.recorder.recordCustom('suite:installed', {
      mode: this.config.mode,
      sessionId: this.sessionId,
    });

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Remove a suíte do Machine.
   */
  detach() {
    // Contratos primeiro (restaura métodos do World)
    this.contracts.unwrapAll();

    // Instrumentation (restaura handleLine + systems)
    this.instrumentation.uninstrumentMachine();

    // Health probes
    this.health.stop();

    // Checker / FaultInjector / SnapshotDumper
    this.checker.detach();
    this.faultInjector.detach?.();
    this.snapshotDumper.detach();

    // Recorder
    this.recorder.detach();

    // Listeners de logging
    for (const unsub of this._unsubs) {
      try { unsub(); } catch { /* noop */ }
    }
    this._unsubs = [];

    this.installed = false;
    this.logger.info('suite', 'detached');
  }

  /**
   * Destrói a suíte completamente.
   */
  destroy() {
    this.detach();

    this.recorder.destroy();
    this.logger.destroy();
    this.tracer.destroy();
    this.checker.destroy();
    this.contracts.destroy();
    this.health.destroy();
    this.expectations.destroy();
    this.pipelineReport.destroy();
    this.snapshotDumper.detach();
    this.replayEngine.clearSessions();
    this.fuzzer.ejectAll?.();
    this.faultInjector.destroy();
    this.reportBuilder.detach();

    this.machine = null;
    this.world = null;
    this.bus = null;
    this.persist = null;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Controle de modo
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Liga captura (respeitando o modo atual).
   */
  start() {
    this.recorder.setEnabled(modeIncludes(this.config.mode, 'events'));
    this.logger.setEnabled(modeIncludes(this.config.mode, 'logs'));
    this.instrumentation.setEnabled(modeIncludes(this.config.mode, 'events'));

    this.tracer.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('spans'));
    this.checker.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('invariants'));
    this.contracts.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('contracts'));
    this.health.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('health'));
    this.expectations.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('expectations'));
    this.pipelineReport.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('pipeline'));

    this.logger.info('suite', 'started');
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Desliga captura sem remover wrappers.
   */
  stop() {
    this.recorder.setEnabled(false);
    this.logger.setEnabled(false);
    this.instrumentation.setEnabled(false);

    this.tracer.setEnabled(false);
    this.checker.setEnabled(false);
    this.contracts.setEnabled(false);
    this.health.setEnabled(false);
    this.expectations.setEnabled(false);
    this.pipelineReport.setEnabled(false);

    this.logger.info('suite', 'stopped');
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Troca o modo.
   * @param {'off'|'light'|'full'|'dev'} mode
   */
  setMode(mode) {
    if (!isValidMode(mode)) {
      throw new Error(`[DiagnosticsSuite] modo inválido: ${mode}`);
    }
    this.config.mode = mode;

    this.recorder.setEnabled(modeIncludes(mode, 'events'));
    this.logger.setEnabled(modeIncludes(mode, 'logs'));
    this.instrumentation.setEnabled(modeIncludes(mode, 'events'));

    this.tracer.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('spans'));
    this.checker.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('invariants'));
    this.contracts.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('contracts'));
    this.health.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('health'));
    this.expectations.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('expectations'));
    this.pipelineReport.setEnabled(this._featureEnabled('pipeline'));

    this.logger.info('suite', `mode → ${mode}`);
    this.recorder.recordCustom('suite:mode-changed', { mode });
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Retorna o modo atual.
   * @returns {string}
   */
  getMode() {
    return this.config.mode;
  }

  /**
   * Lista os modos válidos.
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  static modes() {
    return [...DIAG_MODES];
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Consultas
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Status completo da suíte.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  status() {
    return {
      installed: this.installed,
      mode: this.config.mode,
      sessionId: this.sessionId,
      uptimeMs: this._startedAt ? Date.now() - this._startedAt : 0,
      env: isDevEnvironment() ? 'dev' : 'prod',

      recorder: this._safeStats(this.recorder),
      logger: {
        size: this.logger.size(),
        minLevel: this.logger.minLevel,
      },
      instrumentation: {
        wrapped: this.instrumentation.isWrapped(),
        wrappedCount: this.instrumentation.wrappedCount(),
        systems: this.instrumentation.wrappedSystems(),
      },

      tracer: this._safeStats(this.tracer),
      checker: this._safeStats(this.checker),
      contracts: this._safeStats(this.contracts),
      health: this._safeStats(this.health),
      expectations: this._safeStats(this.expectations),
      pipelineReport: this._safeStats(this.pipelineReport),

      snapshotDumper: {
        attached: typeof this.snapshotDumper.isAttached === 'function'
          ? this.snapshotDumper.isAttached()
          : false,
      },
      replayEngine: {
        recording: this.replayEngine.isRecording(),
        sessions: this.replayEngine.size(),
      },
      fuzzer: this._safeStats(this.fuzzer),
      faultInjector: this._safeStats(this.faultInjector),
      reportBuilder: {
        attached: !!this.reportBuilder._machine,
      },
      testBattery: this.testBattery
        ? {
            configured: true,
            seed: this.testBattery.seed,
            iterations: this.testBattery.iterations,
            running: this.testBattery.running,
            lastReport: this.testBattery.lastReport
              ? {
                  ok: this.testBattery.lastReport.summary?.ok ?? null,
                  passed: this.testBattery.lastReport.summary?.totalPassed ?? 0,
                  failed: this.testBattery.lastReport.summary?.totalFailed ?? 0,
                  skipped: this.testBattery.lastReport.summary?.totalSkipped ?? 0,
                  durationMs: this.testBattery.lastReport.meta?.durationMs ?? 0,
                  generatedAt: this.testBattery.lastReport.meta?.generatedAtISO ?? null,
                }
              : null,
          }
        : {
            configured: false,
          },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Últimos N eventos do flight recorder.
   * @param {number} [n=100]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  flight(n = 100) {
    return this.recorder.last(n);
  }

  /**
   * Últimos N logs.
   * @param {number} [n=100]
   * @param {string} [level=null]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  logs(n = 100, level = null) {
    return this.logger.entries({ limit: n, level });
  }

  /**
   * Eventos filtrados por nome.
   * @param {string} event
   * @param {number} [limit=100]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  eventsByType(event, limit = 100) {
    return this.recorder.entries({ event, limit });
  }

  /**
   * Contagens por tipo de evento.
   * @returns {Object<string, number>}
   */
  eventCounts() {
    return this.recorder.counts();
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Bateria de testes (Onda 5)
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Roda a bateria de testes automáticos.
   *
   * Cria o `TestBattery` na primeira chamada (lazy). Em chamadas
   * subsequentes, reutiliza a instância e permite reconfigurar
   * `seed` e `iterations` via opts.
   *
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {string|string[]} [opts.phases='all'] — preset ('all'|'fast'|'minimal') ou lista
   * @param {number} [opts.seed=42]               — seed do fuzzer
   * @param {number} [opts.iterations=500]        — iterações do fuzzer
   * @param {Function} [opts.onProgress=null]     — callback({ phase, result, index, total })
   * @param {boolean} [opts.stopOnFirstFailure=false]
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} BatteryReport (ver test-reporter.js)
   */
  async runBattery(opts = {}) {
    if (!this.testBattery) {
      this.testBattery = new TestBattery({
        seed: opts.seed ?? 42,
        iterations: opts.iterations ?? 500,
        suite: this,
      });
    } else {
      // Permite reconfigurar entre execuções
      if (Number.isFinite(opts.seed)) {
        this.testBattery.seed = opts.seed;
      }
      if (Number.isFinite(opts.iterations)) {
        this.testBattery.iterations = Math.max(1, opts.iterations);
      }
    }

    this.logger.info('suite', 'battery iniciada', {
      phases: opts.phases ?? 'all',
      seed: this.testBattery.seed,
      iterations: this.testBattery.iterations,
    });

    const report = await this.testBattery.runAll(opts);

    this.logger.info('suite', 'battery concluída', {
      ok: report?.summary?.ok ?? null,
      passed: report?.summary?.totalPassed ?? 0,
      failed: report?.summary?.totalFailed ?? 0,
      skipped: report?.summary?.totalSkipped ?? 0,
      durationMs: report?.meta?.durationMs ?? 0,
    });

    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Retorna o último relatório da bateria (ou null).
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  getLastBatteryReport() {
    return this.testBattery?.lastReport ?? null;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Output
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Snapshot completo do estado da suíte.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  snapshot() {
    const snap = {
      meta: {
        sessionId: this.sessionId,
        mode: this.config.mode,
        generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        uptimeMs: this._startedAt ? Date.now() - this._startedAt : 0,
      },
      status: this.status(),

      recorder: {
        stats: this.recorder.stats(),
        events: this.recorder.dump(),
      },
      logger: {
        size: this.logger.size(),
        entries: this.logger.dump(),
      },
    };

    snap.tracer = this._safeToJSON(this.tracer);
    snap.invariants = this._safeToJSON(this.checker);
    snap.contracts = this._safeToJSON(this.contracts);
    snap.health = this._safeToJSON(this.health);
    snap.expectations = this._safeToJSON(this.expectations);
    snap.pipeline = this._safeToJSON(this.pipelineReport);

    snap.replay = this._safeCall(() => ({
      recording: this.replayEngine.isRecording(),
      sessions: this.replayEngine.listSessions(),
      activeCommands: this.replayEngine.activeSession?.commands ?? [],
    }), null);

    snap.fuzzer = this._safeStats(this.fuzzer);
    snap.injections = this._safeStats(this.faultInjector);

    snap.snapshotDumper = this._safeCall(
      () => this.snapshotDumper.dumpCompact(),
      null
    );

    if (this.testBattery?.lastReport) {
      snap.testBattery = {
        summary: this.testBattery.lastReport.summary,
        meta: this.testBattery.lastReport.meta,
        phases: this.testBattery.lastReport.phases.map(p => ({
          phase: p.phase,
          ok: p.ok,
          skipped: p.skipped,
          durationMs: p.durationMs,
          summary: p.summary,
          failureCount: Array.isArray(p.failures) ? p.failures.length : 0,
        })),
      };
    }

    return snap;
  }

  /**
   * Serializa tudo em NDJSON (eventos + logs + violações).
   * @returns {string}
   */
  toNDJSON() {
    const lines = [];

    lines.push(JSON.stringify({
      kind: 'meta',
      sessionId: this.sessionId,
      mode: this.config.mode,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    }));

    for (const e of this.recorder.dump()) {
      try {
        lines.push(JSON.stringify({ kind: 'event', ...e }));
      } catch { /* ignora */ }
    }

    for (const l of this.logger.dump()) {
      try {
        lines.push(JSON.stringify({ kind: 'log', ...l }));
      } catch { /* ignora */ }
    }

    this._appendNDJSONSafe(lines, 'trace', () =>
      this.tracer.getAllTraces().map(t => ({
        id: t.id,
        name: t.name,
        durationMs: t.durationMs,
        spanCount: t.spanIds?.length ?? 0,
      }))
    );

    this._appendNDJSONSafe(lines, 'invariant', () => this.checker.violations());
    this._appendNDJSONSafe(lines, 'contract',  () => this.contracts.violations());
    this._appendNDJSONSafe(lines, 'health',    () => this.health.detectedAnomalies());
    this._appendNDJSONSafe(lines, 'expectation', () => this.expectations.getFailures());
    this._appendNDJSONSafe(lines, 'pipeline',  () => this.pipelineReport.getWithAnomalies());

    this._appendNDJSONSafe(lines, 'injection', () =>
      this.faultInjector.list?.() ?? []
    );

    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  /**
   * Limpa buffers (mantém instrumentação e modo).
   */
  clear() {
    this.recorder.clear();
    this.logger.clear();
    this.tracer.clear();
    this.checker.clear();
    this.contracts.clear();
    this.health.clear();
    this.expectations.clear();
    this.pipelineReport.clear();
    this.logger.info('suite', 'buffers limpos');
    return this;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Verifica se uma feature está habilitada no modo atual,
   * resolvendo aliases para a MODE_MATRIX.
   * @param {string} feature
   * @returns {boolean}
   * @private
   */
  _featureEnabled(feature) {
    const target = FEATURE_ALIASES[feature] ?? feature;
    return modeIncludes(this.config.mode, target);
  }

  /**
   * Define e aplica contratos em métodos críticos do World e Machine.
   * @private
   */
  _defineAndWrapContracts(world, machine) {
    if (!this.contracts.enabled) return;

    // world.createEntity
    this.contracts.define('world.createEntity', {
      pre: (args) => args && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0] === 'object',
      post: (result) => typeof result === 'string' && result.length > 0,
      description: 'createEntity deve devolver id não vazio',
    });
    this.contracts.wrap(world, 'createEntity', 'world.createEntity');

    // world.destroyEntity
    this.contracts.define('world.destroyEntity', {
      pre: (args) => typeof args?.[0] === 'string' && args[0].length > 0,
      post: (result) => typeof result === 'boolean',
      description: 'destroyEntity deve devolver boolean',
    });
    this.contracts.wrap(world, 'destroyEntity', 'world.destroyEntity');

    // world.addComponent
    this.contracts.define('world.addComponent', {
      pre: (args) =>
        typeof args?.[0] === 'string' && args[0].length > 0 &&
        typeof args?.[1] === 'string' && args[1].length > 0,
      description: 'addComponent precisa id e nome válidos',
    });
    this.contracts.wrap(world, 'addComponent', 'world.addComponent');

    // world.set
    this.contracts.define('world.set', {
      pre: (args) =>
        typeof args?.[0] === 'string' && args[0].length > 0 &&
        typeof args?.[1] === 'string' && args[1].length > 0,
      description: 'world.set precisa id e nome válidos',
    });
    this.contracts.wrap(world, 'set', 'world.set');
  }

  /**
   * Registra handlers de logging por evento do bus.
   * @private
   */
  _wireLogging() {
    if (!this.bus) return;

    const wire = (evt, level, msg) => {
      const unsub = this.bus.on(evt, (payload) => {
        this.logger[level]('events', msg, payload);
      });
      this._unsubs.push(unsub);
    };

    // Informações
    wire('boot:complete',        'info',  'boot completo');
    wire('machine:reset',        'info',  'machine reset');
    wire('machine:restored',     'info',  'machine restaurado');
    wire('world:cleared',        'info',  'world limpo');
    wire('links:pruned',         'info',  'links podados');
    wire('stale:propagated',     'info',  'stale propagado');
    wire('export:ready',         'info',  'export pronto');
    wire('rule:fired',           'info',  'regra disparou');

    // Warnings
    wire('rule:overflow',        'warn',  'rule overflow');
    wire('rule:cycle',           'warn',  'ciclo de regra detectado');
    wire('validation:warnings',  'warn',  'warnings de validação');
    wire('validation:soft-fail', 'warn',  'validação soft-fail');
    wire('link-index:drift',     'warn',  'drift no link-index');
    wire('pipeline:system-missing', 'warn', 'sistema ausente no pipeline');
    wire('diag:contract:violated', 'warn', 'contrato violado');
    wire('diag:health:anomaly',    'warn', 'anomalia de saúde');

    // Erros
    wire('persist:failed',       'error', 'falha ao persistir');
    wire('rule:error',           'error', 'erro em regra');
  }

  /**
   * Executa `fn()` com try/catch, devolvendo `fallback` em erro.
   * @private
   */
  _safeCall(fn, fallback = null) {
    try {
      return fn();
    } catch {
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Chama `.stats()` de uma classe com segurança.
   * @private
   */
  _safeStats(instance) {
    if (!instance || typeof instance.stats !== 'function') return null;
    try {
      return instance.stats();
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Chama `.toJSON()` de uma classe com segurança.
   * @private
   */
  _safeToJSON(instance) {
    if (!instance || typeof instance.toJSON !== 'function') return null;
    try {
      return instance.toJSON();
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Anexa um bloco NDJSON a partir de um array de entradas.
   * @private
   */
  _appendNDJSONSafe(lines, kind, producer) {
    let entries;
    try {
      entries = producer();
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return;

    for (const e of entries) {
      try {
        lines.push(JSON.stringify({ kind, ...e }));
      } catch { /* ignora entrada não serializável */ }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Gera um sessionId curto.
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _genSessionId() {
    const t = Date.now().toString(36);
    const r = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);
    return `diag-${t}-${r}`;
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Factory
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Cria uma nova DiagnosticsSuite.
 * @param {Object} [opts]
 * @returns {DiagnosticsSuite}
 */
export function createDiagnosticsSuite(opts = {}) {
  return new DiagnosticsSuite(opts);
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file instrumentation.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Envolve machine.handleLine e cada system.run com hooks de captura.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index
 * @level 9
 *
 * Contrato:
 *   - Zero mudança comportamental: os sistemas veem os mesmos args e retorno.
 *   - Reversível: uninstrumentMachine() restaura os métodos originais.
 *   - Isolado: falha em qualquer classe de diagnóstico nunca quebra o pipeline.
 *
 * O que é capturado:
 *   Recorder:
 *     - handleLine:start  → linha, timestamp
 *     - handleLine:end    → duração, ok, mutated, halt, error, kind, traceId
 *     - system:run        → nome, duração, ok, mutated, halt, traceId
 *     - system:error      → nome, stack, linha
 *
 *   Tracer:
 *     - startTrace('handleLine') / endTrace
 *     - startSpan(name) / endSpan / recordException por sistema
 *
 *   PipelineReport:
 *     - begin(traceId, line) / end(traceId, finalResult, expectedOrder)
 *     - recordSystem(traceId, name, {ms, ok, mutated, halt, error})
 *
 *   ReplayEngine:
 *     - record(line, {tick}) no início de cada handleLine
 *
 *   ExpectationTracker:
 *     - declare(line, ast, ctx) após ParseSystem produzir AST
 *     - recordEvent(commandId, event, payload) via wildcard do bus
 *     - observe(commandId, result, {tickAfter}) no fim do handleLine
 *
 *   RootCauseAnalyzer:
 *     - analyze({...}) ao capturar exceção em handleLine ou system.run
 */

export class Instrumentation {
  /**
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {Object} [opts.recorder]
   * @param {Object} [opts.logger]
   * @param {Object} [opts.tracer]
   * @param {Object} [opts.expectations]
   * @param {Object} [opts.pipelineReport]
   * @param {Object} [opts.replayEngine]
   * @param {Object} [opts.rca]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.enabled=true]
   */
  constructor({
    recorder = null,
    logger = null,
    tracer = null,
    expectations = null,
    pipelineReport = null,
    replayEngine = null,
    rca = null,
    enabled = true,
  } = {}) {
    this.recorder = recorder;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.tracer = tracer;
    this.expectations = expectations;
    this.pipelineReport = pipelineReport;
    this.replayEngine = replayEngine;
    this.rca = rca;
    this.enabled = !!enabled;

    /** @type {Map<string, Function>} */
    this._originals = new Map();

    /** @type {Object|null} */
    this._machine = null;

    /** @type {Array<Object>} pilha de contextos de comando (para nesting) */
    this._commandStack = [];

    /** @type {Function|null} unsubscribe do wildcard do bus */
    this._busUnsub = null;

    this._wrapped = false;
    this._startedAt = null;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Instrumentação
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Envolve o Machine inteiro: handleLine + todos os systems.
   * Idempotente — segunda chamada não faz nada.
   *
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @returns {Instrumentation} this
   */
  instrumentMachine(machine) {
    if (!machine) throw new Error('[Instrumentation] machine inválido');
    if (this._wrapped) return this;

    this._machine = machine;
    this._startedAt = Date.now();

    this._wrapHandleLine(machine);
    this._wrapAllSystems(machine);
    this._wireBusForExpectations(machine);

    this._wrapped = true;

    this.logger?.info('instrumentation', 'machine instrumentado', {
      systems: machine.systems?.size ?? 0,
    });

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Restaura os métodos originais.
   * @returns {Instrumentation} this
   */
  uninstrumentMachine() {
    if (!this._machine || !this._wrapped) return this;

    // Wildcard do bus (expectations)
    this._unwireBus();

    // handleLine
    const origHandle = this._originals.get('machine.handleLine');
    if (origHandle) {
      this._machine.handleLine = origHandle;
    }

    // systems
    if (this._machine.systems) {
      for (const [name, system] of this._machine.systems) {
        const key = `system.${name}`;
        const original = this._originals.get(key);
        if (original) {
          system.run = original;
        }
      }
    }

    this._originals.clear();
    this._commandStack = [];
    this._wrapped = false;
    this._machine = null;

    return this;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Consultas
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  isWrapped() {
    return this._wrapped;
  }

  wrappedCount() {
    return this._originals.size;
  }

  wrappedSystems() {
    const out = [];
    for (const key of this._originals.keys()) {
      if (key.startsWith('system.')) out.push(key.slice(7));
    }
    return out;
  }

  uptimeMs() {
    return this._startedAt ? Date.now() - this._startedAt : 0;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Controle
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Liga/desliga captura sem remover os wrappers.
   * @param {boolean} v
   */
  setEnabled(v) {
    this.enabled = !!v;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos — wrappers
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _wrapHandleLine(machine) {
    if (typeof machine.handleLine !== 'function') return;

    const original = machine.handleLine.bind(machine);
    const self = this;

    machine.handleLine = function instrumentedHandleLine(line) {
      if (!self.enabled) {
        return original(line);
      }

      const startedAt = self._now();
      const lineStr = String(line ?? '');

      // ── 1. Recorder: handleLine:start ────────────────────
      self._safeRecord('handleLine:start', { line: lineStr });

      // ── 2. Tracer: startTrace ────────────────────────────
      const traceId = self._safeCall(() =>
        self.tracer?.startTrace('handleLine', { line: lineStr })
      ) || null;

      // ── 3. PipelineReport: begin ─────────────────────────
      const reportId = self._safeCall(() =>
        self.pipelineReport?.begin(traceId, lineStr, null)
      ) || null;

      // ── 4. ReplayEngine: record ──────────────────────────
      self._safeCall(() =>
        self.replayEngine?.record(lineStr, { tick: self._getTick() })
      );

      // Contexto de comando empilhado (para nesting via CommandRunner)
      const cmdContext = {
        traceId,
        reportId,
        commandId: null,
        ast: null,
        line: lineStr,
      };
      self._commandStack.push(cmdContext);

      let result;
      let error = null;

      try {
        result = original(line);
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        error = err;

        // ── RCA: análise causal ────────────────────────────
        self._safeCall(() =>
          self.rca?.analyze({
            error: err,
            line: lineStr,
            traceId,
            recorder: self.recorder,
            tracer: self.tracer,
            checker: null,
            machine,
            world: machine.world,
          })
        );

        self._safeLog('error', 'instrumentation', `handleLine lançou: ${err.message}`, {
          line: lineStr,
          stack: self._shortStack(err),
        });
        self._safeRecord('system:error', {
          system: 'handleLine',
          line: lineStr,
          error: err.message,
          traceId,
        });
        throw err;
      } finally {
        self._commandStack.pop();

        const ms = self._round(self._now() - startedAt);

        // ── 5. ExpectationTracker: observe ─────────────────
        if (cmdContext.commandId && self.expectations) {
          self._safeCall(() =>
            self.expectations.observe(cmdContext.commandId, result ?? {}, {
              tickAfter: self._getTick(),
            })
          );
        }

        // ── 6. PipelineReport: end ─────────────────────────
        if (reportId && self.pipelineReport) {
          const expectedOrder = self._getExpectedOrder(machine, result);
          self._safeCall(() =>
            self.pipelineReport.end(reportId, result ?? {}, expectedOrder)
          );
        }

        // ── 7. Tracer: endTrace ────────────────────────────
        if (traceId && self.tracer) {
          self._safeCall(() =>
            self.tracer.endTrace(traceId, {
              ok: result?.ok !== false,
              mutated: result?.mutated === true,
              error: error ? error.message : (result?.error ?? null),
            })
          );
        }

        // ── 8. Recorder: handleLine:end ────────────────────
        self._safeRecord('handleLine:end', {
          line: lineStr,
          ms,
          ok: result?.ok !== false,
          mutated: result?.mutated === true,
          halt: result?.halt === true,
          kind: result?.kind ?? null,
          error: result?.error ?? (error ? error.message : null),
          traceId,
        });
      }
    };

    this._originals.set('machine.handleLine', original);
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _wrapAllSystems(machine) {
    if (!machine.systems || typeof machine.systems[Symbol.iterator] !== 'function') {
      return;
    }

    for (const [name, system] of machine.systems) {
      if (!system || typeof system.run !== 'function') continue;
      this._wrapSystem(name, system);
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _wrapSystem(name, system) {
    const original = system.run.bind(system);
    const self = this;

    system.run = function instrumentedRun(line, ctx, prev) {
      if (!self.enabled) {
        return original(line, ctx, prev);
      }

      const startedAt = self._now();
      const lineStr = String(line ?? '');
      const cmdCtx = self._currentCmdContext();
      const traceId = cmdCtx?.traceId ?? null;
      const reportId = cmdCtx?.reportId ?? null;

      // ── Tracer: startSpan ────────────────────────────────
      const spanId = (traceId && self.tracer)
        ? self._safeCall(() => self.tracer.startSpan(traceId, name))
        : null;

      let result;
      let error = null;

      try {
        result = original(line, ctx, prev);
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        error = err;

        self._safeLog('error', 'instrumentation', `system ${name} lançou`, {
          line: lineStr,
          error: err.message,
          stack: self._shortStack(err),
        });
        self._safeRecord('system:error', {
          system: name,
          line: lineStr,
          error: err.message,
          traceId,
        });

        // RCA também em erro de sistema
        self._safeCall(() =>
          self.rca?.analyze({
            error: err,
            line: lineStr,
            traceId,
            recorder: self.recorder,
            tracer: self.tracer,
          })
        );

        throw err;
      } finally {
        const ms = self._round(self._now() - startedAt);

        // ── Tracer: endSpan + recordException ──────────────
        if (spanId && self.tracer) {
          if (error) {
            self._safeCall(() => self.tracer.recordException(spanId, error));
          }
          self._safeCall(() =>
            self.tracer.endSpan(spanId, {
              ms,
              ok: result?.ok !== false,
              mutated: result?.mutated === true,
              halt: result?.halt === true,
            })
          );
        }

        // ── PipelineReport: recordSystem ───────────────────
        if (reportId && self.pipelineReport) {
          self._safeCall(() =>
            self.pipelineReport.recordSystem(reportId, name, {
              ms,
              ok: result?.ok !== false,
              mutated: result?.mutated === true,
              halt: result?.halt === true,
              error: error ? error.message : (result?.error ?? null),
            })
          );
        }

        // ── ExpectationTracker: declare após ParseSystem ───
        if (
          name === 'ParseSystem' &&
          cmdCtx &&
          !cmdCtx.commandId &&
          result?.ast &&
          self.expectations
        ) {
          const commandId = self._safeCall(() =>
            self.expectations.declare(lineStr, result.ast, {
              kind: result.kind ?? null,
              tick: self._getTick(),
            })
          );
          if (commandId) {
            cmdCtx.commandId = commandId;
            cmdCtx.ast = result.ast;
          }
        }

        // ── Recorder: system:run ───────────────────────────
        self._safeRecord('system:run', {
          system: name,
          line: lineStr,
          ms,
          ok: result?.ok !== false,
          mutated: result?.mutated === true,
          halt: result?.halt === true,
          hasError: !!error,
          traceId,
        });
      }
    };

    this._originals.set(`system.${name}`, original);
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos — bus wildcard para ExpectationTracker
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Anexa um wildcard ao bus para alimentar recordEvent do ExpectationTracker.
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @private
   */
  _wireBusForExpectations(machine) {
    if (!this.expectations) return;
    if (!machine?.bus || typeof machine.bus.on !== 'function') return;
    if (this._busUnsub) return;

    const self = this;
    this._busUnsub = machine.bus.on('*', ({ event, payload }) => {
      const cmdCtx = self._currentCmdContext();
      if (!cmdCtx || !cmdCtx.commandId) return;
      self._safeCall(() =>
        self.expectations.recordEvent(cmdCtx.commandId, event, payload)
      );
    });
  }

  /**
   * Remove o wildcard.
   * @private
   */
  _unwireBus() {
    if (this._busUnsub) {
      try { this._busUnsub(); } catch { /* noop */ }
      this._busUnsub = null;
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos — contexto e utilidades
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Retorna o contexto de comando atual (topo da pilha) ou null.
   * @returns {Object|null}
   * @private
   */
  _currentCmdContext() {
    if (this._commandStack.length === 0) return null;
    return this._commandStack[this._commandStack.length - 1];
  }

  /**
   * Tick atual do Machine.
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _getTick() {
    return this._machine?.state?.tick ?? 'T0';
  }

  /**
   * Deriva a ordem esperada de sistemas a partir do Machine.
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} result
   * @returns {string[]|null}
   * @private
   */
  _getExpectedOrder(machine, result) {
    try {
      const kind = result?.kind;
      if (!kind || !machine?.pipeline) return null;
      if (typeof machine.pipeline.orderFor !== 'function') return null;
      return machine.pipeline.orderFor(kind);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Executa `fn()` com try/catch, devolvendo `null` em erro.
   * @param {Function} fn
   * @returns {any}
   * @private
   */
  _safeCall(fn) {
    try {
      return fn();
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Nunca lança. Se o recorder falhar, ignora.
   * @private
   */
  _safeRecord(kind, data) {
    try {
      this.recorder?.recordCustom?.(kind, data);
    } catch {
      // isolado
    }
  }

  /**
   * Nunca lança.
   * @private
   */
  _safeLog(level, module, msg, data) {
    try {
      this.logger?.[level]?.(module, msg, data);
    } catch {
      // isolado
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _now() {
    if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
      return performance.now();
    }
    return Date.now();
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _round(n) {
    return Math.round(Number(n) * 1000) / 1000;
  }

  /**
   * Retorna as 5 primeiras linhas do stack trace.
   * @private
   */
  _shortStack(err) {
    if (!err || typeof err.stack !== 'string') return null;
    return err.stack.split('\n').slice(0, 5).join(' | ');
  }
}
```

### projeto_narrative-write/diagnostics/invariant-checker.js

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 14.9 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file invariant-checker.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Valida invariantes que nunca devem quebrar, após cada mutação.
 * @imports core/constants, core/utils/time
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index (Fase 4+), systems/diagnostics-system (Fase 4)
 * @level 9
 *
 * Uso:
 *   const checker = new InvariantChecker();
 *   checker.attach(bus, { machine, world, ids, links });
 *   checker.check();          // roda tudo agora
 *   checker.violations();     // histórico
 *   checker.stats();          // resumo
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';
import { tickToNumber } from '../core/utils/time.js';

export class InvariantChecker {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {number} [opts.maxViolations=200]
   * @param {number} [opts.debounceMs=80]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.enabled=true]
   */
  constructor({ maxViolations = 200, debounceMs = 80, enabled = true } = {}) {
    this.maxViolations = Math.max(1, maxViolations);
    this.debounceMs = Math.max(0, debounceMs);
    this.enabled = !!enabled;

    /** @type {Array<Object>} */
    this.history = [];

    /** @type {Map<string, number>} */
    this.countsByCode = new Map();

    /** @type {Array<Function>} */
    this._unsubs = [];

    this._machine = null;
    this._world = null;
    this._ids = null;
    this._links = null;

    this._timer = null;
    this._scheduled = false;

    this._runs = 0;
    this._totalViolations = 0;
  }

  // ── Anexar ao bus ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @param {Object} bus
   * @param {Object} deps
   * @param {Object} deps.machine
   * @param {Object} deps.world
   * @param {Object} [deps.ids]
   * @param {Object} [deps.links]
   * @returns {InvariantChecker}
   */
  attach(bus, { machine, world, ids = null, links = null } = {}) {
    if (!bus || typeof bus.on !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('[InvariantChecker] bus inválido');
    }
    if (!machine || !world) {
      throw new Error('[InvariantChecker] machine e world obrigatórios');
    }
    if (this._machine) this.detach();

    this._machine = machine;
    this._world = world;
    this._ids = ids ?? machine.ids ?? null;
    this._links = links ?? machine.links ?? null;

    const trigger = () => this.schedule();

    this._unsubs.push(bus.on('entity:created', trigger));
    this._unsubs.push(bus.on('entity:destroyed', trigger));
    this._unsubs.push(bus.on('component:added', trigger));
    this._unsubs.push(bus.on('component:updated', trigger));
    this._unsubs.push(bus.on('component:removed', trigger));
    this._unsubs.push(bus.on('links:pruned', trigger));
    this._unsubs.push(bus.on('tick:advanced', trigger));

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Remove listeners.
   */
  detach() {
    for (const unsub of this._unsubs) {
      try { unsub(); } catch { /* noop */ }
    }
    this._unsubs = [];
    this._machine = null;
    this._world = null;
    this._ids = null;
    this._links = null;
    if (this._timer) {
      clearTimeout(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
    this._scheduled = false;
  }

  // ── Agendamento ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Agenda uma verificação (debounced).
   */
  schedule() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    if (this._scheduled) return;
    this._scheduled = true;

    if (this._timer) clearTimeout(this._timer);
    this._timer = setTimeout(() => {
      this._scheduled = false;
      this._timer = null;
      try {
        this.check();
      } catch {
        // isola erro do checker
      }
    }, this.debounceMs);
  }

  // ── Execução ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Roda todas as invariantes e grava violações.
   * @returns {Array<Object>} violações encontradas nesta passagem
   */
  check() {
    if (!this._world || !this._machine) return [];

    this._runs++;

    const found = [];

    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkIdentityPresent());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkIdentityFields());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkShortcodesConsistency());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkLinksDangling());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkInstanceOfValid());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkDerivesFromAcyclic());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkTickNumberConsistency());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkTimelineHasSnapshot());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkNoUndefinedComponents());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkIdentityCountMatches());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkLinkIndexBounds());
    this._safeRun(found, () => this._checkTextsNotNull());

    for (const v of found) {
      v.ts = Date.now();
      v.tick = this._machine.getTick?.() ?? null;
      this._record(v);
    }

    return found;
  }

  // ── Consultas ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Violações registradas (mais recentes primeiro).
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {string} [opts.code]
   * @param {string} [opts.severity]
   * @param {number} [opts.limit]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  violations({ code = null, severity = null, limit = null } = {}) {
    let out = this.history;
    if (code) out = out.filter(v => v.code === code);
    if (severity) out = out.filter(v => v.severity === severity);
    out = out.slice().reverse();
    if (Number.isFinite(limit) && limit > 0) out = out.slice(0, limit);
    return out.map(v => ({ ...v, context: { ...v.context } }));
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  stats() {
    return {
      runs: this._runs,
      totalViolations: this._totalViolations,
      inHistory: this.history.length,
      maxViolations: this.maxViolations,
      byCode: Object.fromEntries(this.countsByCode),
      enabled: this.enabled,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Serializa.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  toJSON() {
    return {
      stats: this.stats(),
      violations: this.violations(),
    };
  }

  // ── Controle ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  setEnabled(v) { this.enabled = !!v; }

  clear() {
    this.history = [];
    this.countsByCode.clear();
    this._runs = 0;
    this._totalViolations = 0;
  }

  destroy() {
    this.detach();
    this.clear();
    this.enabled = false;
  }

  // ── Invariantes ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** @private */
  _checkIdentityPresent() {
    const violations = [];
    for (const id of this._world.allEntities()) {
      if (!this._world.has(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)) {
        violations.push({
          code: 'IDENTITY_MISSING',
          severity: 'error',
          message: `entidade "${id}" não tem Identity`,
          context: { entityId: id },
        });
      }
    }
    return violations;
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkIdentityFields() {
    const violations = [];
    for (const id of this._world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = this._world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (!ident) continue;
      if (typeof ident.id !== 'string' || ident.id.length === 0) {
        violations.push({
          code: 'IDENTITY_INVALID_ID',
          severity: 'error',
          message: `Identity.id vazio em "${id}"`,
          context: { entityId: id, id: ident.id },
        });
      }
      if (typeof ident.name !== 'string' || ident.name.length === 0) {
        violations.push({
          code: 'IDENTITY_INVALID_NAME',
          severity: 'error',
          message: `Identity.name vazio em "${id}"`,
          context: { entityId: id, name: ident.name },
        });
      }
    }
    return violations;
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkShortcodesConsistency() {
    if (!this._ids) return [];
    const violations = [];
    for (const [shortcode, entityId] of this._ids.byShortcode) {
      if (!this._world.hasEntity(entityId)) {
        violations.push({
          code: 'SHORTCODE_ORPHAN',
          severity: 'error',
          message: `shortcode "${shortcode}" aponta para entidade inexistente "${entityId}"`,
          context: { shortcode, entityId },
        });
      }
    }
    return violations;
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkLinksDangling() {
    const violations = [];
    const ids = new Set(this._world.allEntities());
    for (const id of this._world.allEntities()) {
      const links = this._world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      if (!links) continue;
      for (const [rel, value] of Object.entries(links)) {
        const targets = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
        for (const to of targets) {
          if (typeof to !== 'string' || !to) continue;
          if (!ids.has(to)) {
            violations.push({
              code: 'LINK_DANGLING',
              severity: 'error',
              message: `link "${rel}" de "${id}" aponta para "${to}" inexistente`,
              context: { from: id, rel, to },
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return violations;
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkInstanceOfValid() {
    const violations = [];
    for (const id of this._world.allEntities()) {
      const instOf = this._world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF);
      if (!instOf?.id) continue;
      if (!this._world.hasEntity(instOf.id)) {
        violations.push({
          code: 'INSTANCE_OF_ORPHAN',
          severity: 'error',
          message: `InstanceOf de "${id}" aponta para "${instOf.id}" inexistente`,
          context: { entityId: id, blueprint: instOf.id },
        });
      } else if (!this._world.has(instOf.id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IS_BLUEPRINT)) {
        violations.push({
          code: 'INSTANCE_OF_NOT_BLUEPRINT',
          severity: 'warning',
          message: `InstanceOf de "${id}" aponta para "${instOf.id}" que não é blueprint`,
          context: { entityId: id, blueprint: instOf.id },
        });
      }
    }
    return violations;
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkDerivesFromAcyclic() {
    const violations = [];
    const entities = this._world.allEntities();
    const visited = new Set();
    const inStack = new Set();

    const visit = (id, path) => {
      if (inStack.has(id)) {
        violations.push({
          code: 'DERIVES_FROM_CYCLE',
          severity: 'error',
          message: `ciclo em DerivesFrom: ${path.join(' → ')} → ${id}`,
          context: { cycle: [...path, id] },
        });
        return;
      }
      if (visited.has(id)) return;
      inStack.add(id);
      const derives = this._world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM)?.ids ?? [];
      for (const parent of derives) {
        if (this._world.hasEntity(parent)) {
          visit(parent, [...path, id]);
        }
      }
      inStack.delete(id);
      visited.add(id);
    };

    for (const id of entities) visit(id, []);
    return violations;
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkTickNumberConsistency() {
    const st = this._machine.state;
    if (!st) return [];
    const expected = tickToNumber(st.tick);
    if (st.tickNumber !== expected) {
      return [{
        code: 'TICK_NUMBER_MISMATCH',
        severity: 'error',
        message: `state.tickNumber (${st.tickNumber}) ≠ tickToNumber(${st.tick}) (${expected})`,
        context: { tick: st.tick, tickNumber: st.tickNumber, expected },
      }];
    }
    return [];
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkTimelineHasSnapshot() {
    const timeline = this._machine.systems?.get?.('TimelineSystem');
    if (!timeline) return [];
    const violations = [];
    for (const [name, tl] of timeline.timelines) {
      if (!tl.snapshots || tl.snapshots.size === 0) {
        violations.push({
          code: 'TIMELINE_EMPTY',
          severity: 'error',
          message: `timeline "${name}" sem snapshots`,
          context: { timeline: name },
        });
      }
    }
    return violations;
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkNoUndefinedComponents() {
    const violations = [];
    for (const [name, map] of this._world.components) {
      for (const [id, data] of map) {
        if (data === undefined) {
          violations.push({
            code: 'COMPONENT_UNDEFINED',
            severity: 'error',
            message: `componente "${name}" da entidade "${id}" está undefined`,
            context: { entityId: id, component: name },
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return violations;
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkIdentityCountMatches() {
    const entities = this._world.entities.size;
    const identityCount = this._world.componentCount(COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    if (entities !== identityCount) {
      return [{
        code: 'IDENTITY_COUNT_MISMATCH',
        severity: 'warning',
        message: `${entities} entidades mas ${identityCount} com Identity`,
        context: { entities, identityCount },
      }];
    }
    return [];
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkLinkIndexBounds() {
    if (!this._links) return [];
    if (this._links.forward.size > this._world.entities.size) {
      return [{
        code: 'LINK_INDEX_OVERSIZE',
        severity: 'warning',
        message: `LinkIndex.forward (${this._links.forward.size}) > entidades (${this._world.entities.size})`,
        context: {
          forward: this._links.forward.size,
          entities: this._world.entities.size,
        },
      }];
    }
    return [];
  }

  /** @private */
  _checkTextsNotNull() {
    const violations = [];
    for (const id of this._world.allEntities()) {
      const texts = this._world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TEXTS);
      if (!texts) continue;
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(texts)) {
        if (v === null || v === undefined) {
          violations.push({
            code: 'TEXT_NULL_VALUE',
            severity: 'warning',
            message: `Texts.${k} de "${id}" é null/undefined`,
            context: { entityId: id, field: k },
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return violations;
  }

  // ── Internos ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** @private */
  _safeRun(out, fn) {
    try {
      const res = fn();
      if (Array.isArray(res)) {
        for (const v of res) out.push(v);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      out.push({
        code: 'INVARIANT_CHECK_ERROR',
        severity: 'error',
        message: `erro em invariante: ${err.message}`,
        context: { stack: (err.stack ?? '').split('\n').slice(0, 3).join(' | ') },
      });
    }
  }

  /** @private */
  _record(v) {
    this._totalViolations++;
    const n = (this.countsByCode.get(v.code) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.countsByCode.set(v.code, n);

    this.history.push(v);
    while (this.history.length > this.maxViolations) this.history.shift();
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file pipeline-report.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Relatório por comando: quais sistemas rodaram, em que ordem, com que resultado.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index (Fase 4+), systems/diagnostics-system (Fase 4)
 * @level 9
 *
 * Uso típico (pelo DiagnosticsSystem na Fase 4):
 *   const traceId = report.begin(traceId, line, kind);
 *   for (const sys of ranSystems) {
 *     report.recordSystem(traceId, sys.name, { ms, ok, mutated, halt, error });
 *   }
 *   report.end(traceId, finalResult, expectedPipelineOrder);
 *
 * API:
 *   begin / recordSystem / end
 *   get / getAll / getSlowest / getWithAnomalies
 *   stats / toJSON / clear
 */

const DEFAULT_SLOW_MS = 50;

export class PipelineReport {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {number} [opts.maxReports=100]
   * @param {number} [opts.slowThresholdMs=50]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.enabled=true]
   */
  constructor({ maxReports = 100, slowThresholdMs = DEFAULT_SLOW_MS, enabled = true } = {}) {
    this.maxReports = Math.max(1, maxReports);
    this.slowThresholdMs = Math.max(1, slowThresholdMs);
    this.enabled = !!enabled;

    /** @type {Map<string, Object>} traceId → Report */
    this.reports = new Map();

    /** @type {Array<string>} */
    this._order = [];
  }

  // ── Ciclo de vida ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Inicia um relatório para uma trace.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @param {string} line
   * @param {string} kind
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  begin(traceId, line, kind) {
    if (!this.enabled) return null;
    if (!traceId) return null;

    const report = {
      traceId,
      line: String(line ?? ''),
      kind: kind ?? null,
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      endedAt: null,
      durationMs: null,
      systems: [],
      skipped: [],
      final: null,
      anomalies: [],
    };

    this.reports.set(traceId, report);
    this._order.push(traceId);
    this._evict();

    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Registra a execução de um sistema.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @param {string} name
   * @param {Object} info — { ms, ok, mutated, halt, error }
   */
  recordSystem(traceId, name, info = {}) {
    const report = this.reports.get(traceId);
    if (!report) return;

    const ms = Number(info.ms) || 0;
    const entry = {
      name: String(name),
      ms: Math.round(ms * 1000) / 1000,
      ok: info.ok !== false,
      mutated: info.mutated === true,
      halt: info.halt === true,
      error: info.error ?? null,
    };

    report.systems.push(entry);

    if (entry.ok === false) {
      report.anomalies.push(`system ${name} returned ok:false`);
    }
    if (entry.halt === true) {
      report.anomalies.push(`system ${name} halted pipeline`);
    }
    if (entry.error) {
      report.anomalies.push(`system ${name} error: ${entry.error}`);
    }
    if (entry.ms > this.slowThresholdMs) {
      report.anomalies.push(`system ${name} slow (${entry.ms.toFixed(1)}ms > ${this.slowThresholdMs}ms)`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Finaliza o relatório.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @param {Object} finalResult — resultado final de machine.handleLine
   * @param {string[]} [expectedOrder] — ordem esperada de sistemas (para detectar skipped)
   */
  end(traceId, finalResult, expectedOrder = null) {
    const report = this.reports.get(traceId);
    if (!report) return;

    report.endedAt = Date.now();
    report.durationMs = report.endedAt - report.startedAt;
    report.final = {
      ok: finalResult?.ok !== false,
      mutated: finalResult?.mutated === true,
      halt: finalResult?.halt === true,
      error: finalResult?.error ?? null,
    };

    // Detecta sistemas esperados que não rodaram
    if (Array.isArray(expectedOrder) && expectedOrder.length > 0) {
      const ran = new Set(report.systems.map(s => s.name));
      const skipped = expectedOrder.filter(n => !ran.has(n));
      // Remove duplicatas de DiagnosticsSystem (aparece duas vezes)
      const uniqueSkipped = Array.from(new Set(skipped));
      report.skipped = uniqueSkipped;
      if (uniqueSkipped.length > 0) {
        report.anomalies.push(`systems skipped: ${uniqueSkipped.join(', ')}`);
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Consultas ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Retorna um relatório.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  get(traceId) {
    const r = this.reports.get(traceId);
    return r ? this._copy(r) : null;
  }

  /**
   * Todos os relatórios.
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  getAll() {
    return this._order.map(id => this.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
  }

  /**
   * N relatórios mais lentos.
   * @param {number} [n=10]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  getSlowest(n = 10) {
    const sorted = this.getAll()
      .filter(r => r.durationMs !== null)
      .sort((a, b) => b.durationMs - a.durationMs);
    return sorted.slice(0, Math.max(1, n));
  }

  /**
   * Relatórios com anomalias.
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  getWithAnomalies() {
    return this.getAll().filter(r => r.anomalies.length > 0);
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  stats() {
    const all = this.getAll();
    const withAnomalies = all.filter(r => r.anomalies.length > 0);
    const durations = all.map(r => r.durationMs).filter(d => typeof d === 'number');
    const avg = durations.length > 0
      ? durations.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / durations.length
      : 0;
    const max = durations.length > 0 ? Math.max(...durations) : 0;

    return {
      total: all.length,
      withAnomalies: withAnomalies.length,
      avgDurationMs: Math.round(avg * 1000) / 1000,
      maxDurationMs: max,
      slowThresholdMs: this.slowThresholdMs,
      maxReports: this.maxReports,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Serializa.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  toJSON() {
    return {
      stats: this.stats(),
      reports: this.getAll(),
    };
  }

  // ── Controle ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Liga/desliga.
   * @param {boolean} v
   */
  setEnabled(v) {
    this.enabled = !!v;
  }

  /**
   * Define o threshold de lentidão.
   * @param {number} ms
   */
  setSlowThreshold(ms) {
    if (Number.isFinite(ms) && ms > 0) {
      this.slowThresholdMs = ms;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Limpa.
   */
  clear() {
    this.reports.clear();
    this._order = [];
  }

  /**
   * Destrói.
   */
  destroy() {
    this.clear();
    this.enabled = false;
  }

  // ── Internos ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _copy(report) {
    return {
      traceId: report.traceId,
      line: report.line,
      kind: report.kind,
      startedAt: report.startedAt,
      endedAt: report.endedAt,
      durationMs: report.durationMs,
      systems: report.systems.map(s => ({ ...s })),
      skipped: [...report.skipped],
      final: report.final ? { ...report.final } : null,
      anomalies: [...report.anomalies],
    };
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _evict() {
    while (this.reports.size > this.maxReports) {
      const oldestId = this._order.shift();
      this.reports.delete(oldestId);
    }
  }
}
```
