/**
 * @file test-battery.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Orquestrador da bateria completa de testes automáticos.
 * @imports diagnostics/scenario-library, diagnostics/sandbox,
 *          diagnostics/regression-runner, diagnostics/golden-baseline,
 *          diagnostics/test-reporter, diagnostics/smoke-tests,
 *          diagnostics/fuzzer, diagnostics/replay-engine,
 *          diagnostics/contract-guard, diagnostics/invariant-checker,
 *          diagnostics/system-canary
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index (Onda 5), systems/diagnostics-system (Onda 5)
 * @level 9
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * AS 8 FASES
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   #  Fase         Verifica                                      Custo
 *   ─  ──────────   ──────────────────────────────────────────── ─────
 *   0  canary       sandbox registra os mesmos 32 sistemas do boot baixo
 *   1  smoke        10 testes de sanidade do motor               baixo
 *   2  contracts    pré/pós-condições em métodos críticos        baixo
 *   3  invariants   12 invariantes estruturais                   médio
 *   4  scenarios    55 cenários determinísticos (isolados)       médio
 *   5  fuzz         N comandos aleatórios (seed)                 alto
 *   6  replay       gravação + reprodução + comparação           médio
 *   7  regression   compara estado contra baseline salvo         baixo
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Fase 0 — canary (adicionada na Fase 2 da auditoria 25/09/2026)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Compara a lista de sistemas do boot (lida de
 * `window.__NarrativeApp.machine.systems`) com a lista estática
 * `SANDBOX_SYSTEM_NAMES`. Se divergirem, as fases `narrative`,
 * `phrase` e `diagnostics` da ScenarioLibrary estariam testando
 * contra um sandbox incompleto — falso positivo. O canário é a
 * primeira linha de defesa.
 *
 * Se `window.__NarrativeApp` não existir (ambiente Node, testes
 * programáticos), a fase é pulada com `skipped: true`.
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * PRESETS
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   'all' / 'full'   → todas as 8 fases (~6s)
 *   'fast'           → canary + smoke + contracts + scenarios (~2s)
 *   'minimal'        → canary + smoke (~400ms)
 *   'thorough'       → alias de 'all'
 *   'scenarios,fuzz' → lista explícita
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * DETERMINISMO
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   - Toda fase rodada em sandbox isolado (Machine nova por fase)
 *   - Fuzz usa `seed` determinística (mulberry32)
 *   - Sem timers, sem `Math.random()` fora do Fuzzer
 *   - Duas execuções com mesma seed → resultados idênticos
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * ISOLAMENTO DE FALHAS
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   - Cada fase é envolvida em try/catch; exceção = PhaseResult{ ok:false }
 *   - Bateria continua para a próxima fase
 *   - `stopOnFirstFailure: true` interrompe após a primeira falha
 *   - Sandbox sempre descartado em `finally`
 */

import { SmokeTests }          from './smoke-tests.js';
import { Fuzzer }              from './fuzzer.js';
import { ReplayEngine }        from './replay-engine.js';
import { ContractGuard }       from './contract-guard.js';
import { InvariantChecker }    from './invariant-checker.js';

import { createSandbox, SANDBOX_SYSTEM_NAMES } from './sandbox.js';
import { SCENARIOS }           from './scenario-library.js';
import { RegressionRunner }    from './regression-runner.js';
import { GoldenBaseline }      from './golden-baseline.js';
import { TestReporter }        from './test-reporter.js';
import { SystemCanary }        from './system-canary.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Constantes públicas
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Ordem canônica das fases.
 * `canary` primeiro — é a linha de base da honestidade do sandbox.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
export const PHASE_ORDER = Object.freeze([
  'canary',
  'smoke',
  'contracts',
  'invariants',
  'scenarios',
  'fuzz',
  'replay',
  'regression',
]);

/**
 * Presets nomeados.
 * @type {Readonly<Object<string, ReadonlyArray<string>>>}
 */
export const PHASE_PRESETS = Object.freeze({
  all:      PHASE_ORDER,
  full:     PHASE_ORDER,
  thorough: PHASE_ORDER,
  fast:     Object.freeze(['canary', 'smoke', 'contracts', 'scenarios']),
  minimal:  Object.freeze(['canary', 'smoke']),
});

/**
 * Nome do baseline usado pela fase de regressão.
 * @type {string}
 */
export const REGRESSION_BASELINE_NAME = '__battery_regression__';

/**
 * Comandos determinísticos rodados antes de capturar/comparar o baseline.
 * Alterar esta lista invalida baselines antigos (por design).
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
export const REGRESSION_COMMANDS = Object.freeze([
  'ent.create.character RegAlpha',
  'ent.create.character RegBeta',
  'ent.create.location RegCidade',
  'link.set.location RegAlpha RegCidade',
  'link.set.location RegBeta RegCidade',
  'link.add.peer RegAlpha RegBeta',
  'mut.add.stats RegAlpha.fear 3',
  'mut.add.stats RegAlpha.courage 5',
  'mut.add.stats RegBeta.fear 1',
  'mut.flag.on RegAlpha alive',
  'mut.push.list RegAlpha.inventory RegSelo',
  'mut.enum RegAlpha.role soldado',
]);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TestBattery
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export class TestBattery {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {number} [opts.seed=42]           — seed do fuzzer
   * @param {number} [opts.iterations=500]    — iterações do fuzzer
   * @param {Object} [opts.suite=null]        — DiagnosticsSuite (opcional)
   * @param {TestReporter} [opts.reporter=null] — injeta reporter custom
   */
  constructor({
    seed = 42,
    iterations = 500,
    suite = null,
    reporter = null,
  } = {}) {
    this.seed = Number.isFinite(seed) ? seed : 42;
    this.iterations = Number.isFinite(iterations) ? Math.max(1, iterations) : 500;
    this.suite = suite;
    this.reporter = reporter || new TestReporter();

    /** @type {Object|null} último report gerado */
    this.lastReport = null;

    /** @type {boolean} true enquanto a bateria roda */
    this.running = false;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // API principal
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Executa as fases solicitadas.
   *
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {string|string[]} [opts.phases='all'] — preset, lista ou CSV
   * @param {Function} [opts.onProgress=null]     — callback({ phase, result, index, total })
   * @param {boolean} [opts.stopOnFirstFailure=false]
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} BatteryReport (ver test-reporter.js)
   */
  async runAll({
    phases = 'all',
    onProgress = null,
    stopOnFirstFailure = false,
  } = {}) {
    if (this.running) {
      return this.lastReport || this.reporter.summarize([], {
        durationMs: 0,
        seed: this.seed,
        iterations: this.iterations,
      });
    }

    this.running = true;
    const t0 = this._now();
    const wanted = this._resolvePhases(phases);
    const results = [];

    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < wanted.length; i++) {
        const phaseName = wanted[i];
        let phaseResult;

        try {
          phaseResult = await this._runPhase(phaseName);
        } catch (err) {
          phaseResult = this._explodedPhase(phaseName, err);
        }

        results.push(phaseResult);

        if (typeof onProgress === 'function') {
          try {
            onProgress({
              phase: phaseName,
              result: phaseResult,
              index: i,
              total: wanted.length,
            });
          } catch { /* isola */ }
        }

        if (stopOnFirstFailure && !phaseResult.ok && !phaseResult.skipped) {
          break;
        }
      }
    } finally {
      this.running = false;
    }

    const durationMs = this._now() - t0;
    const report = this._finalize(results, durationMs);
    this.lastReport = report;
    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Retorna o último report (ou null se nunca rodou).
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  getLastReport() {
    return this.lastReport;
  }

  /**
   * Resolve uma spec de fases para lista de nomes válidos.
   * @param {string|string[]} spec
   * @returns {string[]}
   * @private
   */
  _resolvePhases(spec) {
    if (!spec) return [...PHASE_PRESETS.all];

    if (Array.isArray(spec)) {
      const out = spec
        .map(s => String(s).toLowerCase().trim())
        .filter(p => PHASE_ORDER.includes(p));
      return out.length > 0 ? out : [...PHASE_PRESETS.all];
    }

    const key = String(spec).toLowerCase().trim();

    if (PHASE_PRESETS[key]) {
      return [...PHASE_PRESETS[key]];
    }

    const list = key
      .split(',')
      .map(s => s.trim())
      .filter(p => PHASE_ORDER.includes(p));

    return list.length > 0 ? list : [...PHASE_PRESETS.all];
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Dispatcher
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * @param {string} phase
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _runPhase(phase) {
    switch (phase) {
      case 'canary':     return this._phaseCanary();
      case 'smoke':      return this._phaseSmoke();
      case 'contracts':  return this._phaseContracts();
      case 'invariants': return this._phaseInvariants();
      case 'scenarios':  return this._phaseScenarios();
      case 'fuzz':       return this._phaseFuzz();
      case 'replay':     return this._phaseReplay();
      case 'regression': return this._phaseRegression();
      default:
        return this._skip(phase, `fase desconhecida: ${phase}`);
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 0 — Canary
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Compara a lista de sistemas do boot com `SANDBOX_SYSTEM_NAMES`.
   *
   * Objetivo: detectar divergência entre boot e sandbox ANTES de rodar
   * as demais fases. Se o sandbox registrar menos/menos/ordem diferente
   * de sistemas, os cenários das categorias `narrative`, `phrase` e
   * `diagnostics` estariam testando contra um pipeline incompleto.
   *
   * Não cria sandbox — usa a lista estática `SANDBOX_SYSTEM_NAMES`.
   * A verificação de que a lista estática corresponde ao registro de
   * fato acontece implicitamente nas demais fases (smoke, scenarios,
   * etc.), que criam sandboxes reais.
   *
   * @returns {Object} PhaseResult
   * @private
   */
  _phaseCanary() {
    const t0 = this._now();

    const bootNames = this._getBootSystemNames();
    if (!bootNames) {
      return this._skip('canary', 'boot não disponível — pulando comparação');
    }

    const canary = new SystemCanary();
    const report = canary.compare(bootNames, SANDBOX_SYSTEM_NAMES);

    const failures = [];
    if (!report.ok) {
      if (report.missingInSandbox.length > 0) {
        failures.push({
          message: `sandbox não registra: ${report.missingInSandbox.join(', ')}`,
          missing: report.missingInSandbox,
        });
      }
      if (report.extraInSandbox.length > 0) {
        failures.push({
          message: `sandbox registra sistema não presente no boot: ${report.extraInSandbox.join(', ')}`,
          extra: report.extraInSandbox,
        });
      }
      if (report.orderMismatch) {
        failures.push({
          message: 'ordem de registro difere entre boot e sandbox',
        });
      }
    }

    const summary = report.ok
      ? `${report.bootCount} sistemas em sincronia`
      : `${report.bootCount} boot vs ${report.sandboxCount} sandbox`;

    return {
      phase: 'canary',
      ok: report.ok,
      skipped: false,
      reason: null,
      durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
      summary,
      data: {
        bootCount: report.bootCount,
        sandboxCount: report.sandboxCount,
        missingInSandbox: report.missingInSandbox,
        extraInSandbox: report.extraInSandbox,
        orderMismatch: report.orderMismatch,
      },
      failures,
      error: null,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Lê a lista de nomes de sistema registrados no boot.
   *
   * Retorna `null` se o contexto de boot não está disponível
   * (ambiente Node, testes programáticos). Neste caso, a fase é
   * pulada com `skipped: true` em vez de reportar 32 "missing".
   *
   * @returns {string[]|null}
   * @private
   */
  _getBootSystemNames() {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;

    const app = window.__NarrativeApp;
    if (!app) return null;
    if (!app.machine) return null;
    if (!app.machine.systems) return null;
    if (typeof app.machine.systems.keys !== 'function') return null;

    return Array.from(app.machine.systems.keys());
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 1 — Smoke
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Roda os 10 testes básicos do SmokeTests contra um sandbox fresco.
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _phaseSmoke() {
    const t0 = this._now();

    return await this._withSandbox(async (sb) => {
      const persist = sb.machine.systems.get('PersistenceSystem');

      const report = await SmokeTests.run({
        machine: sb.machine,
        world:   sb.world,
        bus:     sb.bus,
        persist,
      });

      return {
        phase: 'smoke',
        ok: report.ok,
        skipped: false,
        reason: null,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        summary: `${report.passed}/${report.total}`,
        data: {
          passed: report.passed,
          failed: report.failed,
          total: report.total,
          results: report.results.map(r => ({
            name: r.name,
            ok: r.ok,
            ms: r.ms,
            error: r.error ?? null,
          })),
        },
        failures: report.results
          .filter(r => !r.ok)
          .map(r => ({ name: r.name, error: r.error ?? 'falhou' })),
        error: null,
      };
    }, { seedEntities: true });
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 2 — Contracts
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Define e envolve os 4 contratos canônicos em métodos do World.
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _phaseContracts() {
    const t0 = this._now();

    return await this._withSandbox(async (sb) => {
      const guard = new ContractGuard({ enabled: true });

      guard.define('world.createEntity', {
        pre: (args) => args && args[0] !== null && typeof args[0] === 'object',
        post: (result) => typeof result === 'string' && result.length > 0,
        description: 'createEntity deve devolver id não vazio',
      });
      guard.define('world.destroyEntity', {
        pre: (args) => typeof args?.[0] === 'string' && args[0].length > 0,
        post: (result) => typeof result === 'boolean',
        description: 'destroyEntity deve devolver boolean',
      });
      guard.define('world.addComponent', {
        pre: (args) =>
          typeof args?.[0] === 'string' && args[0].length > 0 &&
          typeof args?.[1] === 'string' && args[1].length > 0,
        description: 'addComponent precisa id e nome válidos',
      });
      guard.define('world.set', {
        pre: (args) =>
          typeof args?.[0] === 'string' && args[0].length > 0 &&
          typeof args?.[1] === 'string' && args[1].length > 0,
        description: 'world.set precisa id e nome válidos',
      });

      guard.wrap(sb.world, 'createEntity',  'world.createEntity');
      guard.wrap(sb.world, 'destroyEntity', 'world.destroyEntity');
      guard.wrap(sb.world, 'addComponent',  'world.addComponent');
      guard.wrap(sb.world, 'set',           'world.set');

      let validProbeOk = true;
      try {
        const id = sb.world.createEntity({
          Identity: { id: 'CTR-001', name: 'Valid', type: 'custom' },
        });
        sb.world.addComponent(id, 'Tags', { values: ['probe'] });
        sb.world.set(id, 'Tags', { values: ['probe', 'ok'] });
        sb.world.destroyEntity(id);
      } catch {
        validProbeOk = false;
      }
      const validViolations = guard.violations();
      const validCount = validViolations.length;

      try { sb.world.createEntity(null); }            catch { /* esperado */ }
      try { sb.world.destroyEntity(null); }           catch { /* esperado */ }
      try { sb.world.addComponent(null, 'X', {}); }   catch { /* esperado */ }
      try { sb.world.set(null, 'X', {}); }            catch { /* esperado */ }

      const allViolations = guard.violations();
      const totalCount = allViolations.length;
      const invalidCount = totalCount - validCount;

      guard.unwrapAll();
      guard.contracts.clear();

      const pass =
        validProbeOk &&
        validCount === 0 &&
        invalidCount > 0;

      const failures = [];
      if (!validProbeOk) {
        failures.push({ message: 'probe válido lançou exceção inesperada' });
      }
      if (validCount > 0) {
        for (const v of validViolations.slice(0, 5)) {
          failures.push({
            reason: 'falso-positivo',
            message: `${v.contract} violou em chamada válida (${v.type})`,
          });
        }
      }
      if (invalidCount === 0) {
        failures.push({
          message: 'probes inválidos não dispararam nenhuma violação',
        });
      }

      return {
        phase: 'contracts',
        ok: pass,
        skipped: false,
        reason: null,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        summary: `${validCount} falso-positivo(s), ${invalidCount} detectada(s)`,
        data: {
          validViolations: validCount,
          invalidViolations: invalidCount,
          totalViolations: totalCount,
          sample: allViolations.slice(0, 5).map(v => ({
            contract: v.contract,
            type: v.type,
            message: v.message,
          })),
        },
        failures,
        error: null,
      };
    }, { seedEntities: false });
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 3 — Invariants
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Roda uma sequência de mutações no sandbox e checa os 12 invariantes.
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _phaseInvariants() {
    const t0 = this._now();

    return await this._withSandbox(async (sb) => {
      const stressCommands = [
        'ent.create.character Inv1',
        'ent.create.character Inv2',
        'ent.create.location InvLoc',
        'link.set.location Inv1 InvLoc',
        'link.add.peer Inv1 Inv2',
        'mut.add.stats Inv1.fear 5',
        'mut.push.list Inv1.inventory InvItem',
        'mut.flag.on Inv1 alive',
        'mut.enum Inv1.role soldado',
        'inst.mark Inv1',
      ];
      for (const cmd of stressCommands) {
        try { sb.machine.handleLine(cmd); } catch { /* isola */ }
      }

      const checker = new InvariantChecker({ enabled: true });
      checker.attach(sb.bus, {
        machine: sb.machine,
        world:   sb.world,
        ids:     sb.machine.ids,
        links:   sb.machine.links,
      });

      checker.check();

      const violations = checker.violations();
      const stats = checker.stats();

      checker.detach();

      return {
        phase: 'invariants',
        ok: violations.length === 0,
        skipped: false,
        reason: null,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        summary: `${violations.length} violação(ões)`,
        data: {
          totalViolations: violations.length,
          byCode: stats.byCode ?? {},
          runs: stats.runs ?? 0,
        },
        failures: violations.slice(0, 10).map(v => ({
          code: v.code,
          severity: v.severity,
          message: v.message,
          context: v.context,
        })),
        error: null,
      };
    }, { seedEntities: true });
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 4 — Scenarios
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Roda o catálogo completo em modo ISOLADO (sandbox por cenário).
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _phaseScenarios() {
    const t0 = this._now();

    const runner = new RegressionRunner({ seedEntities: true });
    const report = await runner.run({ scenarios: SCENARIOS });

    const summary = RegressionRunner.summarize(report);
    const failures = RegressionRunner.failures(report).slice(0, 20);

    return {
      phase: 'scenarios',
      ok: report.failed === 0,
      skipped: false,
      reason: null,
      durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
      summary: `${report.passed}/${report.total}`,
      data: {
        passed: report.passed,
        failed: report.failed,
        total: report.total,
        byCategory: summary.byCategory,
      },
      failures,
      error: null,
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 5 — Fuzz
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Roda N iterações do fuzzer com seed determinística.
   *
   * Critério de aprovação: `crashes.length === 0`.
   *
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _phaseFuzz() {
    const t0 = this._now();

    return await this._withSandbox(async (sb) => {
      const fuzzer = new Fuzzer();

      const result = await fuzzer.run({
        machine: sb.machine,
        iterations: this.iterations,
        seed: this.seed,
        isolate: true,
      });

      if (result.ok === false) {
        return {
          phase: 'fuzz',
          ok: false,
          skipped: false,
          reason: null,
          durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
          summary: 'fuzzer falhou',
          data: null,
          failures: [{ message: result.error ?? 'erro desconhecido' }],
          error: result.error ?? 'fuzzer falhou',
        };
      }

      const findings = result.findings ?? [];
      const crashes = result.crashes ?? [];
      const ok = crashes.length === 0;

      return {
        phase: 'fuzz',
        ok,
        skipped: false,
        reason: null,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        summary: `${result.iterations} iter · seed ${result.seed} · ${findings.length} findings`,
        data: {
          iterations: result.iterations,
          seed: result.seed,
          findings: findings.length,
          crashes: crashes.length,
          verbsCovered: result.coverage?.verbs?.length ?? 0,
          actionsCovered: result.coverage?.actions?.length ?? 0,
        },
        failures: findings.slice(0, 20).map(f => ({
          iteration: f.iteration,
          command: f.line,
          error: f.error ?? 'desconhecido',
        })),
        error: null,
      };
    }, { seedEntities: true });
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 6 — Replay
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Grava uma sequência num sandbox A, reproduz num sandbox B,
   * e compara os estados finais.
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _phaseReplay() {
    const t0 = this._now();
    const engine = new ReplayEngine({ maxSessions: 5 });

    const commands = [
      'ent.create.character ReplayHero',
      'ent.create.location ReplayTown',
      'link.set.location ReplayHero ReplayTown',
      'mut.add.stats ReplayHero.fear 3',
      'mut.push.list ReplayHero.inventory ReplayItem',
      'mut.flag.on ReplayHero alive',
    ];

    // ── Gravação ─────────────────────────────────────────
    const sbA = await createSandbox({ seedEntities: true });
    const sessionName = `__battery_replay_${Date.now().toString(36)}__`;
    const recordErrors = [];

    try {
      engine.startSession(sessionName);

      for (const cmd of commands) {
        try {
          const r = sbA.machine.handleLine(cmd);
          if (r && r.ok === false) {
            recordErrors.push({ command: cmd, error: r.error ?? 'erro' });
          }
        } catch (err) {
          recordErrors.push({ command: cmd, error: err.message });
        }
        engine.record(cmd, { tick: sbA.machine.getTick() });
      }

      const snapshotA = this._captureWorld(sbA.world);
      engine.endSession(snapshotA);
    } finally {
      try { sbA.dispose(); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }

    // ── Reprodução ───────────────────────────────────────
    const session = engine.getSession(sessionName);
    if (!session) {
      return this._skip('replay', 'sessão de gravação não pôde ser criada');
    }

    const sbB = await createSandbox({ seedEntities: true });
    let replayResult;
    try {
      replayResult = engine.replay(session, {
        machine: sbB.machine,
        captureFinal: true,
      });
    } finally {
      try { sbB.dispose(); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }

    // ── Comparação ───────────────────────────────────────
    const diff = session.finalSnapshot && replayResult.actualSnapshot
      ? engine.compare(session.finalSnapshot, replayResult.actualSnapshot)
      : null;

    try { engine.clearSessions(); } catch { /* isola */ }

    const executed = replayResult.executed ?? 0;
    const failed = replayResult.failed ?? 0;
    const equal = diff?.equal === true;
    const ok = replayResult.ok !== false && equal && recordErrors.length === 0;

    const failures = [];
    if (recordErrors.length > 0) {
      for (const e of recordErrors.slice(0, 5)) {
        failures.push({ command: e.command, error: e.error });
      }
    }
    if (diff && diff.equal === false) {
      failures.push({
        message: 'estado final divergiu após replay',
        reason: JSON.stringify(diff.stats ?? {}),
      });
    }

    return {
      phase: 'replay',
      ok,
      skipped: false,
      reason: null,
      durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
      summary: equal ? `estado idêntico (${executed} cmds)` : `diverge (${executed} cmds)`,
      data: {
        executed,
        failed,
        diff: diff?.stats ?? null,
        sessionId: session.id,
      },
      failures,
      error: null,
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fase 7 — Regression
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Roda uma sequência fixa de comandos e compara contra baseline salvo.
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   * @private
   */
  async _phaseRegression() {
    const t0 = this._now();

    const baseline = new GoldenBaseline();
    const exists = await baseline.has(REGRESSION_BASELINE_NAME);

    return await this._withSandbox(async (sb) => {
      for (const cmd of REGRESSION_COMMANDS) {
        try { sb.machine.handleLine(cmd); } catch { /* isola */ }
      }

      if (!exists) {
        try {
          await baseline.capture(REGRESSION_BASELINE_NAME, sb.machine, {
            note: 'captura automática pela TestBattery',
            commands: REGRESSION_COMMANDS.length,
          });

          return {
            phase: 'regression',
            ok: true,
            skipped: true,
            reason: 'baseline capturado (primeira execução)',
            durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
            summary: 'baseline capturado',
            data: {
              captured: true,
              name: REGRESSION_BASELINE_NAME,
              commands: REGRESSION_COMMANDS.length,
            },
            failures: [],
            error: null,
          };
        } catch (err) {
          return {
            phase: 'regression',
            ok: false,
            skipped: false,
            reason: null,
            durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
            summary: 'falha ao capturar baseline',
            data: null,
            failures: [{ message: err.message }],
            error: err.message,
          };
        }
      }

      const cmp = await baseline.compare(REGRESSION_BASELINE_NAME, sb.machine);

      return {
        phase: 'regression',
        ok: cmp.equal === true,
        skipped: false,
        reason: null,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        summary: cmp.equal
          ? `bate "${REGRESSION_BASELINE_NAME}"`
          : `diverge de "${REGRESSION_BASELINE_NAME}"`,
        data: {
          equal: cmp.equal,
          baselineAt: cmp.baselineAt ?? null,
          baselineCount: cmp.baselineCount ?? null,
          currentCount: cmp.currentCount ?? null,
          diff: cmp.diff ?? null,
        },
        failures: cmp.equal
          ? []
          : [{
              message: 'estado diverge do baseline',
              reason: cmp.reason ?? `added=${cmp.diff?.stats?.added ?? 0}, removed=${cmp.diff?.stats?.removed ?? 0}, changed=${cmp.diff?.stats?.changed ?? 0}`,
            }],
        error: null,
      };
    }, { seedEntities: true });
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Helpers
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Cria sandbox, roda fn, descarta. Sempre limpa.
   * @template T
   * @param {(sb:Object) => Promise<T>} fn
   * @param {Object} [opts]
   * @returns {Promise<T>}
   * @private
   */
  async _withSandbox(fn, opts = {}) {
    const sb = await createSandbox(opts);
    try {
      return await fn(sb);
    } finally {
      try { sb.dispose(); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Captura o estado do World no formato esperado pelo ReplayEngine.
   * @param {Object} world
   * @returns {{ entities:Object, count:number }}
   * @private
   */
  _captureWorld(world) {
    const entities = {};
    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      entities[id] = world.componentsOf(id);
    }
    return { entities, count: world.allEntities().length };
  }

  /**
   * Monta um PhaseResult de "pulada".
   * @param {string} phase
   * @param {string} reason
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _skip(phase, reason) {
    return {
      phase,
      ok: true,
      skipped: true,
      reason,
      durationMs: 0,
      summary: `skip: ${reason}`,
      data: null,
      failures: [],
      error: null,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Monta um PhaseResult para uma fase que explodiu antes de rodar.
   * @param {string} phase
   * @param {Error} err
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _explodedPhase(phase, err) {
    return {
      phase,
      ok: false,
      skipped: false,
      reason: null,
      durationMs: 0,
      summary: 'erro fatal na fase',
      data: null,
      failures: [{ message: err?.message ?? String(err) }],
      error: err?.message ?? String(err),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Consolida as fases num report.
   * @param {Array<Object>} phases
   * @param {number} durationMs
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _finalize(phases, durationMs) {
    return this.reporter.summarize(phases, {
      durationMs,
      seed: this.seed,
      iterations: this.iterations,
    });
  }

  /**
   * @returns {number}
   * @private
   */
  _now() {
    if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
      return performance.now();
    }
    return Date.now();
  }

  /**
   * @param {number} n
   * @returns {number}
   * @private
   */
  _round(n) {
    return Math.round(Number(n) * 1000) / 1000;
  }
}

````javascript
/**
 * @file test-reporter.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Consolida phases em relatório e serializa (JSON / NDJSON / Markdown).
 * @imports core/utils/dom (triggerDownload)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/test-battery
 * @level 9
 *
 * Formato do report:
 *   {
 *     meta:    { appName, appVersion, generatedAt, durationMs, seed, iterations },
 *     summary: { ok, totalPassed, totalFailed, totalSkipped, totalPhases },
 *     phases:  [ PhaseResult, ... ],
 *   }
 *
 * Formato de um PhaseResult:
 *   {
 *     phase:      string,       // 'smoke' | 'contracts' | ...
 *     ok:         boolean,      // aprovado?
 *     skipped:    boolean,      // pulado?
 *     reason:     string|null,  // motivo do skip (se aplicável)
 *     durationMs: number,
 *     summary:    string,       // texto curto ('10/10' ou '3 violations')
 *     data:       Object,       // dados específicos da fase
 *     failures:   Array,        // lista de falhas (para exibição)
 *     error:      string|null,  // erro de topo (fase explodiu)
 *   }
 */

import { triggerDownload } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

const DEFAULT_APP_NAME = 'narrative-ecs';
const DEFAULT_APP_VERSION = '1.0';

export class TestReporter {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {string} [opts.appName]
   * @param {string} [opts.appVersion]
   */
  constructor({
    appName = DEFAULT_APP_NAME,
    appVersion = DEFAULT_APP_VERSION,
  } = {}) {
    this.appName = appName;
    this.appVersion = appVersion;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Construção do report
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Monta um report a partir das fases + metadados.
   *
   * @param {Array<Object>} phases
   * @param {Object} [meta={}]
   * @param {number} [meta.durationMs=0]
   * @param {number} [meta.seed=null]
   * @param {number} [meta.iterations=null]
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  summarize(phases, meta = {}) {
    const list = Array.isArray(phases) ? phases : [];

    const totalPassed = list.filter(p => p.ok && !p.skipped).length;
    const totalFailed = list.filter(p => !p.ok && !p.skipped).length;
    const totalSkipped = list.filter(p => p.skipped).length;

    return {
      meta: {
        appName: this.appName,
        appVersion: this.appVersion,
        generatedAt: Date.now(),
        generatedAtISO: new Date().toISOString(),
        durationMs: Number.isFinite(meta.durationMs) ? meta.durationMs : 0,
        seed: meta.seed ?? null,
        iterations: meta.iterations ?? null,
        phaseCount: list.length,
      },
      summary: {
        ok: totalFailed === 0,
        totalPassed,
        totalFailed,
        totalSkipped,
        totalPhases: list.length,
      },
      phases: list.map(p => this._normalizePhase(p)),
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Serialização
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Serializa em JSON.
   * @param {Object} report
   * @param {boolean} [pretty=true]
   * @returns {string}
   */
  toJSON(report, pretty = true) {
    try {
      return pretty
        ? JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)
        : JSON.stringify(report);
    } catch (err) {
      return JSON.stringify({
        meta: { error: `falha ao serializar: ${err.message}` },
        summary: { ok: false },
        phases: [],
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Serializa em NDJSON — uma linha por fase + cabeçalho.
   * Mais estável para pipelines.
   * @param {Object} report
   * @returns {string}
   */
  toNDJSON(report) {
    const lines = [];
    try {
      lines.push(JSON.stringify({ kind: 'meta', ...report.meta }));
      lines.push(JSON.stringify({ kind: 'summary', ...report.summary }));
      for (const p of report.phases ?? []) {
        lines.push(JSON.stringify({ kind: 'phase', ...p }));
      }
    } catch { /* ignora entradas não-serializáveis */ }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  /**
   * Serializa em Markdown legível por humano e por IA.
   * @param {Object} report
   * @returns {string}
   */
  toMarkdown(report) {
    if (!report) return '# Relatório vazio\n';

    const m = report.meta ?? {};
    const s = report.summary ?? {};
    const lines = [];

    const icon = s.ok ? '✅' : '❌';
    const verdict = s.ok ? 'APROVADO' : 'REPROVADO';

    lines.push(`# ${icon} Bateria de Testes — ${verdict}`);
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(`**App:** ${m.appName ?? '?'} v${m.appVersion ?? '?'}`);
    lines.push(`**Gerado em:** ${m.generatedAtISO ?? '—'}`);
    lines.push(`**Duração:** ${this._fmtMs(m.durationMs)}`);
    if (m.seed !== null && m.seed !== undefined) {
      lines.push(`**Seed:** \`${m.seed}\``);
    }
    if (m.iterations !== null && m.iterations !== undefined) {
      lines.push(`**Iterações (fuzz):** ${m.iterations}`);
    }
    lines.push('');

    // Placar
    lines.push('## Placar');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('| Métrica | Valor |');
    lines.push('|---|---:|');
    lines.push(`| Fases totais | ${s.totalPhases ?? 0} |`);
    lines.push(`| Aprovadas | ${s.totalPassed ?? 0} |`);
    lines.push(`| Reprovadas | ${s.totalFailed ?? 0} |`);
    lines.push(`| Puladas | ${s.totalSkipped ?? 0} |`);
    lines.push('');

    // Tabela de fases
    lines.push('## Fases');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('| # | Fase | Status | Duração | Resumo |');
    lines.push('|---:|---|---|---:|---|');
    (report.phases ?? []).forEach((p, i) => {
      const status = p.skipped
        ? '⏭ skip'
        : (p.ok ? '✅ ok' : '❌ fail');
      lines.push(`| ${i + 1} | \`${p.phase}\` | ${status} | ${this._fmtMs(p.durationMs)} | ${this._esc(p.summary ?? '')} |`);
    });
    lines.push('');

    // Detalhes de falhas
    const failed = (report.phases ?? []).filter(p => !p.ok && !p.skipped);
    if (failed.length > 0) {
      lines.push('## Falhas detalhadas');
      lines.push('');
      for (const p of failed) {
        lines.push(`### ❌ \`${p.phase}\``);
        if (p.error) {
          lines.push('');
          lines.push('**Erro de topo:**');
          lines.push('');
          lines.push('```');
          lines.push(String(p.error));
          lines.push('```');
        }
        if (Array.isArray(p.failures) && p.failures.length > 0) {
          lines.push('');
          lines.push(`**${p.failures.length} falha(s):**`);
          lines.push('');
          for (const f of p.failures.slice(0, 20)) {
            lines.push(`- ${this._esc(this._formatFailure(f))}`);
          }
          if (p.failures.length > 20) {
            lines.push(`- … mais ${p.failures.length - 20} no JSON completo`);
          }
        }
        lines.push('');
      }
    }

    // Puladas
    const skipped = (report.phases ?? []).filter(p => p.skipped);
    if (skipped.length > 0) {
      lines.push('## Fases puladas');
      lines.push('');
      for (const p of skipped) {
        lines.push(`- \`${p.phase}\` — ${p.reason ?? '(sem motivo)'}`);
      }
      lines.push('');
    }

    // Como interpretar
    lines.push('## Como interpretar');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('- **smoke**: 10 testes de sanidade do motor');
    lines.push('- **contracts**: pré/pós-condições em métodos críticos do World');
    lines.push('- **invariants**: 12 invariantes estruturais (shortcodes, links, ciclos)');
    lines.push('- **scenarios**: catálogo determinístico de comandos');
    lines.push('- **fuzz**: N comandos aleatórios; falha = achou crash');
    lines.push('- **replay**: grava + reproduz sessão; falha = não-determinismo');
    lines.push('- **regression**: compara contra baseline salvo');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('---');
    lines.push(`*Gerado por TestReporter @ ${m.appName}*`);

    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Blob / Download
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Cria um Blob a partir do report.
   * @param {Object} report
   * @param {'json'|'ndjson'|'md'} [format='json']
   * @returns {Blob}
   */
  toBlob(report, format = 'json') {
    const content =
      format === 'ndjson' ? this.toNDJSON(report) :
      format === 'md'     ? this.toMarkdown(report) :
                            this.toJSON(report);

    const mime =
      format === 'ndjson' ? 'application/x-ndjson' :
      format === 'md'     ? 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8' :
                            'application/json';

    return new Blob([content], { type: mime });
  }

  /**
   * Nome de arquivo padrão.
   * @param {Object} report
   * @param {'json'|'ndjson'|'md'} [ext='json']
   * @returns {string}
   */
  filename(report, ext = 'json') {
    const ts = new Date(report?.meta?.generatedAt ?? Date.now())
      .toISOString()
      .replace(/[:.]/g, '-')
      .slice(0, 19);
    const verdict = report?.summary?.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
    return `test-battery-${verdict}-${ts}.${ext}`;
  }

  /**
   * Dispara download do report.
   * @param {Object} report
   * @param {'json'|'ndjson'|'md'} [format='json']
   * @returns {{ ok:boolean, filename?:string, error?:string }}
   */
  download(report, format = 'json') {
    try {
      if (typeof document === 'undefined') {
        return { ok: false, error: 'document indisponível' };
      }
      const blob = this.toBlob(report, format);
      const filename = this.filename(report, format);
      triggerDownload(blob, filename);
      return { ok: true, filename };
    } catch (err) {
      return { ok: false, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Estima tamanho em bytes.
   * @param {Object} report
   * @returns {number}
   */
  estimate(report) {
    try {
      return this.toJSON(report, false).length;
    } catch {
      return -1;
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Garante que uma fase tenha todos os campos esperados.
   * @private
   */
  _normalizePhase(p) {
    const src = p && typeof p === 'object' ? p : {};
    return {
      phase: String(src.phase ?? 'unknown'),
      ok: src.ok === true,
      skipped: src.skipped === true,
      reason: src.reason ?? null,
      durationMs: Number.isFinite(src.durationMs) ? src.durationMs : 0,
      summary: String(src.summary ?? ''),
      data: src.data ?? null,
      failures: Array.isArray(src.failures) ? src.failures : [],
      error: src.error ?? null,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Formata uma entrada de failure (aceita string ou objeto).
   * @private
   */
  _formatFailure(f) {
    if (f === null || f === undefined) return '(vazio)';
    if (typeof f === 'string') return f;
    if (typeof f !== 'object') return String(f);

    // Tenta extrair campos comuns
    const parts = [];
    if (f.scenario) parts.push(`[${f.scenario}]`);
    if (f.command)  parts.push(`"${f.command}"`);
    if (f.error)    parts.push(`→ ${f.error}`);
    if (f.reason)   parts.push(`(${f.reason})`);
    if (f.message)  parts.push(f.message);

    if (parts.length > 0) return parts.join(' ');

    try {
      const s = JSON.stringify(f);
      return s.length <= 200 ? s : s.slice(0, 197) + '...';
    } catch {
      return '(não serializável)';
    }
  }

  /**
   * Formata ms.
   * @private
   */
  _fmtMs(n) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
    if (n < 1000) return `${Math.round(n)}ms`;
    return `${(n / 1000).toFixed(2)}s`;
  }

  /**
   * Escapa pipes em tabelas Markdown.
   * @private
   */
  _esc(str) {
    return String(str ?? '').replace(/\|/g, '\\|').replace(/\n/g, ' ');
  }
}

```javascript
/**
 * @file tracer.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Árvore de spans hierárquicos (estilo OpenTelemetry simplificado).
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy diagnostics/index (Fase 4+), systems/diagnostics-system (Fase 4)
 * @level 9
 *
 * Modelo:
 *   Trace  = uma execução de handleLine (ou operação de alto nível)
 *   Span   = uma operação dentro da trace (ex: system.run('ParseSystem'))
 *
 * Hierarquia:
 *   trace
 *     └─ rootSpan
 *          ├─ childSpan
 *          │    └─ grandchildSpan
 *          └─ childSpan
 *
 * API:
 *   startTrace(name, attrs) → traceId
 *   startSpan(traceId, name, attrs, parentId?) → spanId
 *   endSpan(spanId, attrs?)
 *   recordException(spanId, error)
 *   addEvent(spanId, name, attrs)
 *
 * Consultas:
 *   getTrace(traceId) / getSpan(spanId) / getTree(traceId)
 *   getRecentTraces(n) / getSpansOfTrace(traceId)
 *   stats() / toJSON() / clear()
 */

/**
 * Gera um id curto e único.
 * @param {string} prefix
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function genId(prefix) {
  const t = Date.now().toString(36);
  const r = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);
  return `${prefix}-${t}${r}`;
}

/**
 * Timestamp monotônico em ms.
 * @returns {number}
 * @private
 */
function now() {
  if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
    return performance.now();
  }
  return Date.now();
}

export class Tracer {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {number} [opts.maxTraces=100] — número máximo de traces no ring buffer
   * @param {boolean} [opts.enabled=true]
   */
  constructor({ maxTraces = 100, enabled = true } = {}) {
    this.maxTraces = Math.max(1, maxTraces);
    this.enabled = !!enabled;

    /** @type {Map<string, Object>} traceId → TraceMeta */
    this.traces = new Map();

    /** @type {Map<string, Object>} spanId → Span */
    this.spans = new Map();

    /** @type {Array<string>} ordem de inserção dos traceIds */
    this._traceOrder = [];

    /** @type {Object|null} rastreia a última trace aberta */
    this._activeTraceId = null;

    this._counter = 0;
  }

  // ── Ciclo de vida da trace ──────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Inicia uma nova trace.
   * @param {string} name
   * @param {Object} [attrs={}]
   * @returns {string} traceId
   */
  startTrace(name, attrs = {}) {
    if (!this.enabled) return '';

    const id = genId('tr');
    const trace = {
      id,
      name: String(name || 'trace'),
      startTs: now(),
      endTs: null,
      durationMs: null,
      rootSpanId: null,
      spanIds: [],
      attrs: { ...attrs },
    };

    this.traces.set(id, trace);
    this._traceOrder.push(id);
    this._activeTraceId = id;
    this._evict();

    return id;
  }

  /**
   * Finaliza uma trace.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @param {Object} [attrs={}]
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  endTrace(traceId, attrs = {}) {
    const trace = this.traces.get(traceId);
    if (!trace) return null;

    trace.endTs = now();
    trace.durationMs = this._round(trace.endTs - trace.startTs);
    Object.assign(trace.attrs, attrs);

    if (this._activeTraceId === traceId) {
      this._activeTraceId = null;
    }
    return trace;
  }

  // ── Ciclo de vida do span ───────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Inicia um novo span.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @param {string} name
   * @param {Object} [attrs={}]
   * @param {string} [parentId] — se omitido, usa o último span aberto na trace
   * @returns {string} spanId
   */
  startSpan(traceId, name, attrs = {}, parentId = undefined) {
    if (!this.enabled) return '';

    const trace = this.traces.get(traceId);
    if (!trace) return '';

    let resolvedParent = parentId;
    if (resolvedParent === undefined) {
      // Usa o span mais recente que ainda está aberto
      for (let i = trace.spanIds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const candidate = this.spans.get(trace.spanIds[i]);
        if (candidate && candidate.endTs === null) {
          resolvedParent = candidate.id;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (resolvedParent === undefined) resolvedParent = null;
    }

    const id = genId('sp');
    const span = {
      id,
      traceId,
      parentId: resolvedParent,
      name: String(name || 'span'),
      startTs: now(),
      endTs: null,
      durationMs: null,
      attrs: { ...attrs },
      events: [],
      exceptions: [],
      children: [],
    };

    this.spans.set(id, span);
    trace.spanIds.push(id);

    if (span.parentId === null) {
      if (trace.rootSpanId === null) {
        trace.rootSpanId = id;
      }
    } else {
      const parent = this.spans.get(span.parentId);
      if (parent) parent.children.push(id);
    }

    this._counter++;
    return id;
  }

  /**
   * Finaliza um span.
   * @param {string} spanId
   * @param {Object} [attrs={}]
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  endSpan(spanId, attrs = {}) {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (!span) return null;
    if (span.endTs !== null) return span;

    span.endTs = now();
    span.durationMs = this._round(span.endTs - span.startTs);
    Object.assign(span.attrs, attrs);
    return span;
  }

  /**
   * Registra uma exceção num span.
   * @param {string} spanId
   * @param {Error|Object|string} error
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  recordException(spanId, error) {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (!span) return null;

    const entry = {
      ts: now(),
      message: String(error?.message ?? error ?? 'erro desconhecido'),
      name: String(error?.name ?? 'Error'),
      stack: typeof error?.stack === 'string'
        ? error.stack.split('\n').slice(0, 6).join(' | ')
        : null,
    };
    span.exceptions.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }

  /**
   * Adiciona um evento a um span.
   * @param {string} spanId
   * @param {string} name
   * @param {Object} [attrs={}]
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  addEvent(spanId, name, attrs = {}) {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (!span) return null;

    const entry = {
      ts: now(),
      name: String(name),
      attrs: { ...attrs },
    };
    span.events.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }

  // ── Consultas ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Retorna metadados de uma trace.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  getTrace(traceId) {
    const trace = this.traces.get(traceId);
    return trace ? { ...trace, spanIds: [...trace.spanIds], attrs: { ...trace.attrs } } : null;
  }

  /**
   * Retorna um span.
   * @param {string} spanId
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  getSpan(spanId) {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    return span ? this._copySpan(span) : null;
  }

  /**
   * Retorna todos os spans de uma trace.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  getSpansOfTrace(traceId) {
    const trace = this.traces.get(traceId);
    if (!trace) return [];
    return trace.spanIds
      .map(id => this.spans.get(id))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map(s => this._copySpan(s));
  }

  /**
   * Retorna a árvore hierárquica de uma trace.
   * @param {string} traceId
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  getTree(traceId) {
    const trace = this.traces.get(traceId);
    if (!trace) return null;

    const root = trace.rootSpanId ? this.spans.get(trace.rootSpanId) : null;
    return {
      trace: this.getTrace(traceId),
      root: root ? this._buildTreeNode(root) : null,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Últimas N traces.
   * @param {number} [n=10]
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  getRecentTraces(n = 10) {
    const k = Math.max(1, Math.floor(n));
    const ids = this._traceOrder.slice(-k);
    return ids.map(id => this.getTrace(id)).filter(Boolean);
  }

  /**
   * Todas as traces.
   * @returns {Array<Object>}
   */
  getAllTraces() {
    return this._traceOrder.map(id => this.getTrace(id)).filter(Boolean);
  }

  /**
   * Estatísticas resumidas.
   * @returns {{ traces:number, spans:number, maxTraces:number, activeTraceId:string|null, uptimeMs:number }}
   */
  stats() {
    return {
      traces: this.traces.size,
      spans: this.spans.size,
      maxTraces: this.maxTraces,
      activeTraceId: this._activeTraceId,
      uptimeMs: 0,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Retorna a trace atualmente aberta.
   * @returns {string|null}
   */
  activeTraceId() {
    return this._activeTraceId;
  }

  // ── Controle ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Liga/desliga.
   * @param {boolean} v
   */
  setEnabled(v) {
    this.enabled = !!v;
  }

  /**
   * Limpa tudo.
   */
  clear() {
    this.traces.clear();
    this.spans.clear();
    this._traceOrder = [];
    this._activeTraceId = null;
    this._counter = 0;
  }

  /**
   * Destrói.
   */
  destroy() {
    this.clear();
    this.enabled = false;
  }

  // ── Serialização ────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Serializa tudo em JSON.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  toJSON() {
    return {
      stats: this.stats(),
      traces: this.getAllTraces().map(t => ({
        ...t,
        tree: this.getTree(t.id),
      })),
    };
  }

  // ── Internos ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _copySpan(span) {
    return {
      id: span.id,
      traceId: span.traceId,
      parentId: span.parentId,
      name: span.name,
      startTs: span.startTs,
      endTs: span.endTs,
      durationMs: span.durationMs,
      attrs: { ...span.attrs },
      events: span.events.map(e => ({ ...e, attrs: { ...e.attrs } })),
      exceptions: span.exceptions.map(e => ({ ...e })),
      children: [...span.children],
    };
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _buildTreeNode(span) {
    const node = this._copySpan(span);
    node.children = span.children
      .map(id => this.spans.get(id))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map(child => this._buildTreeNode(child));
    return node;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _evict() {
    while (this.traces.size > this.maxTraces) {
      const oldestId = this._traceOrder.shift();
      const oldTrace = this.traces.get(oldestId);
      if (!oldTrace) continue;

      for (const spanId of oldTrace.spanIds) {
        this.spans.delete(spanId);
      }
      this.traces.delete(oldestId);
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _round(n) {
    return Math.round(Number(n) * 1000) / 1000;
  }
}

```javascript
/**
 * @file ui-battery.js
 * @module diagnostics
 * @description Orquestrador da bateria de testes de UI.
 * @imports diagnostics/ui-harness, diagnostics/sandbox, diagnostics/test-reporter,
 *          ui/*, editor/editor
 * @importedBy boot.js (efeito colateral), diagnostics/index (Fase F)
 * @level 9
 *
 * Fase E — cenários da fase `flow` rodam contra um pipeline sandbox
 * real (createSandbox de diagnostics/sandbox.js), não contra o
 * minimal machine. Isso permite testar o fluxo completo:
 * comando → pipeline → eventos → UI reage.
 */

import {
  createPhaseContext,
  createSandbox as createUISandbox,
  createMinimalMachine,
  getStylesHref,
  flushRAF,
  flushMicrotasks,
  AssertionError,
  assertVisible,
  assertHidden,
  assertHasClass,
  assertNotHasClass,
  assertText,
  assertValue,
  assertSelector,
  assertNoSelector,
  assertCount,
  assertEmitCount,
  assertEmitWith,
} from './ui-harness.js';

import { createSandbox as createPipelineSandbox } from './sandbox.js';

import { UI_SCENARIOS, UI_PHASE_ORDER } from './ui-scenario-library.js';
import { TestReporter } from './test-reporter.js';

import { ToastManager } from '../ui/toast.js';
import { ModalManager } from '../ui/modal.js';
import { PanelLeft } from '../ui/panel-left.js';
import { PanelRight } from '../ui/panel-right.js';
import { FloatingMenu } from '../ui/floating-menu.js';
import { KeyboardRouter } from '../ui/keyboard-router.js';
import { FocusManager } from '../ui/focus-manager.js';
import { ShortcutRegistry } from '../ui/shortcut-registry.js';
import { RollOverlay } from '../ui/roll-overlay.js';
import { PlayOverlay } from '../ui/play-overlay.js';
import { HistoryPanel } from '../ui/history-panel.js';
import { CommandGuide } from '../ui/command-guide.js';
import { Editor } from '../editor/editor.js';

const COMPONENT_REGISTRY = {
  ToastManager,
  ModalManager,
  PanelLeft,
  PanelRight,
  FloatingMenu,
  KeyboardRouter,
  FocusManager,
  ShortcutRegistry,
  RollOverlay,
  PlayOverlay,
  HistoryPanel,
  CommandGuide,
  Editor,
};

export class UIBattery {
  constructor({ reporter = null } = {}) {
    this.reporter = reporter || new TestReporter();
    this.running = false;
    this.lastReport = null;
  }

  async runAll({
    scenarios = UI_SCENARIOS,
    phases = 'all',
    stopOnFirstFailure = false,
    onProgress = null,
  } = {}) {
    if (this.running) return this.lastReport;
    this.running = true;

    const t0 = this._now();
    const wanted = this._resolvePhases(phases);
    const grouped = this._groupByPhase(scenarios, wanted);
    const phaseResults = [];

    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < wanted.length; i++) {
        const phaseName = wanted[i];
        const list = grouped[phaseName] || [];

        if (list.length === 0) {
          phaseResults.push(this._skipPhase(phaseName, 'sem cenários'));
          continue;
        }

        let result;
        try {
          result = await this._runPhase(phaseName, list, onProgress, i, wanted.length);
        } catch (err) {
          result = this._explodedPhase(phaseName, err);
        }

        phaseResults.push(result);
        if (stopOnFirstFailure && !result.ok && !result.skipped) break;
      }
    } finally {
      this.running = false;
    }

    const report = this.reporter.summarize(phaseResults, {
      durationMs: this._now() - t0,
      seed: null,
      iterations: null,
    });
    this.lastReport = report;
    return report;
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Execução de fase
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async _runPhase(phaseName, scenarios, onProgress, phaseIndex, phaseTotal) {
    const t0 = this._now();
    let ctx = null;
    let creationError = null;

    try {
      try {
        ctx = await createPhaseContext({ cssHref: getStylesHref() });
      } catch (err) {
        creationError = err;
        throw err;
      }

      const results = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < scenarios.length; i++) {
        const scenario = scenarios[i];
        const result = await this._runScenario(ctx, scenario);
        results.push(result);

        if (typeof onProgress === 'function') {
          try {
            onProgress({
              phase: phaseName,
              scenario: scenario.name,
              result,
              index: i,
              total: scenarios.length,
            });
          } catch { /* isola */ }
        }
      }

      const passed = results.filter(r => r.ok).length;
      const failed = results.filter(r => !r.ok).length;

      const phaseData = {
        passed,
        failed,
        total: scenarios.length,
        results,
      };
      if (ctx.warning) phaseData.warning = ctx.warning;

      return {
        phase: phaseName,
        ok: failed === 0,
        skipped: false,
        reason: ctx.warning ?? null,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        summary: `${passed}/${scenarios.length}${ctx.warning ? ' (fallback)' : ''}`,
        data: phaseData,
        failures: results
          .filter(r => !r.ok)
          .map(r => ({
            scenario: r.name,
            error: r.error,
            stack: r.stack,
            assertion: r.assertion,
          })),
        error: null,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        phase: phaseName,
        ok: false,
        skipped: false,
        reason: null,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        summary: 'erro fatal na fase',
        data: {
          creationError: creationError ? {
            message: creationError.message,
            stack: creationError.stack,
          } : null,
        },
        failures: [{
          message: err?.message ?? String(err),
          stack: err?.stack ?? null,
        }],
        error: err?.message ?? String(err),
        stack: err?.stack ?? null,
      };
    } finally {
      if (ctx) {
        try { await ctx.destroy(); } catch { /* isola */ }
      }
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Execução de cenário
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async _runScenario(ctx, scenario) {
    const t0 = this._now();
    let uiSandbox = null;
    let pipelineSandbox = null;

    try {
      uiSandbox = createUISandbox(ctx);
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        name: scenario.name,
        category: scenario.category,
        ok: false,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        failures: [{ message: `sandbox falhou: ${err.message}`, stack: err.stack }],
        error: `sandbox falhou: ${err.message}`,
        stack: err.stack,
        assertion: null,
      };
    }

    try {
      let machine;

      if (scenario.phase === 'flow') {
        // Fase E — pipeline real (29 sistemas + world seedado).
        pipelineSandbox = await createPipelineSandbox({ seedEntities: true });
        machine = pipelineSandbox.machine;
      } else {
        machine = createMinimalMachine();
      }

      const scenarioCtx = {
        sandbox: uiSandbox,
        machine,
        world: machine.world,
        bus: machine.bus,
        win: ctx.win,
        doc: ctx.doc,
        // Primitivos
        ToastManager,
        ModalManager,
        PanelLeft,
        PanelRight,
        FloatingMenu,
        // Editor/teclado/foco
        Editor,
        KeyboardRouter,
        FocusManager,
        ShortcutRegistry,
        // Overlays
        RollOverlay,
        PlayOverlay,
        HistoryPanel,
        CommandGuide,
      };

      if (typeof scenario.setup === 'function') {
        await scenario.setup(scenarioCtx);
      }
      if (typeof scenario.act === 'function') {
        await scenario.act(scenarioCtx);
      }

      await flushMicrotasks();
      await flushRAF(ctx.win);

      const expectList = typeof scenario.expect === 'function'
        ? await scenario.expect(scenarioCtx)
        : (scenario.expect || []);

      const failures = [];
      for (const check of expectList) {
        try {
          await this._runCheck(scenarioCtx, check);
        } catch (err) {
          failures.push({
            check: check.check ?? check.name ?? 'inline',
            message: err.message,
            expected: err.expected,
            actual: err.actual,
            snapshot: err.snapshot,
            stack: err.stack,
          });
        }
      }

      return {
        name: scenario.name,
        category: scenario.category,
        ok: failures.length === 0,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        failures,
        error: null,
        stack: null,
        assertion: failures[0] ?? null,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        name: scenario.name,
        category: scenario.category,
        ok: false,
        durationMs: this._round(this._now() - t0),
        failures: [{ message: err.message, stack: err.stack }],
        error: err.message,
        stack: err.stack,
        assertion: null,
      };
    } finally {
      if (uiSandbox) {
        try { uiSandbox.destroy(); } catch { /* isola */ }
      }
      if (pipelineSandbox) {
        try { pipelineSandbox.dispose(); } catch { /* isola */ }
      }
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Checks
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async _runCheck(ctx, check) {
    if (typeof check.fn === 'function') {
      const result = await check.fn(ctx);
      if (result === false) {
        throw new AssertionError(`check "${check.name ?? 'inline'}" retornou false`);
      }
      return;
    }

    const container = ctx.sandbox.container;
    const findNode = (sel) => {
      if (!sel) return container;
      const found = container.querySelector(sel);
      if (!found) {
        throw new AssertionError(
          `check "${check.check}": seletor "${sel}" não encontrado`,
          { expected: sel, actual: '(ausente)' }
        );
      }
      return found;
    };

    switch (check.check) {
      case 'visible':     return assertVisible(findNode(check.selector));
      case 'hidden':      return assertHidden(findNode(check.selector));
      case 'hasClass':    return assertHasClass(findNode(check.selector), check.className);
      case 'notHasClass': return assertNotHasClass(findNode(check.selector), check.className);
      case 'text':        return assertText(findNode(check.selector), check.equal);
      case 'value':       return assertValue(findNode(check.selector), check.equal);
      case 'count':       return assertCount(container, check.selector, check.equal);
      case 'selector':    return assertSelector(container, check.selector);
      case 'noSelector':  return assertNoSelector(container, check.selector);
      case 'emitCount':   return assertEmitCount(check.spy, check.equal);
      case 'emitWith':    return assertEmitWith(check.spy, check.predicate);
      default:
        throw new AssertionError(`check desconhecido: "${check.check}"`);
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Helpers
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _resolvePhases(spec) {
    if (!spec || spec === 'all') return [...UI_PHASE_ORDER];
    if (Array.isArray(spec)) {
      const list = spec.filter(p => UI_PHASE_ORDER.includes(p));
      return list.length > 0 ? list : [...UI_PHASE_ORDER];
    }
    const list = String(spec)
      .split(',')
      .map(s => s.trim())
      .filter(p => UI_PHASE_ORDER.includes(p));
    return list.length > 0 ? list : [...UI_PHASE_ORDER];
  }

  _groupByPhase(scenarios, phases) {
    const groups = {};
    for (const phase of phases) groups[phase] = [];
    for (const s of scenarios) {
      if (groups[s.phase]) groups[s.phase].push(s);
    }
    return groups;
  }

  _skipPhase(phase, reason) {
    return {
      phase,
      ok: true,
      skipped: true,
      reason,
      durationMs: 0,
      summary: `skip: ${reason}`,
      data: null,
      failures: [],
      error: null,
    };
  }

  _explodedPhase(phase, err) {
    return {
      phase,
      ok: false,
      skipped: false,
      reason: null,
      durationMs: 0,
      summary: 'erro fatal na fase',
      data: null,
      failures: [{
        message: err?.message ?? String(err),
        stack: err?.stack ?? null,
      }],
      error: err?.message ?? String(err),
      stack: err?.stack ?? null,
    };
  }

  _now() {
    if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
      return performance.now();
    }
    return Date.now();
  }

  _round(n) {
    return Math.round(Number(n) * 1000) / 1000;
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Serialização e exportação
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function serializeReport(report, pretty = true) {
  const seen = new WeakSet();
  const cleaned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(report, (key, value) => {
    if (typeof value === 'function') return '[Function]';
    if (typeof value === 'symbol') return '[Symbol]';
    if (value instanceof Node) return '[DOMNode]';
    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
      if (seen.has(value)) return '[Circular]';
      seen.add(value);
    }
    return value;
  }));
  return pretty ? JSON.stringify(cleaned, null, 2) : JSON.stringify(cleaned);
}

function downloadReport(report, filename) {
  try {
    const verdict = report?.summary?.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
    const ts = new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .replace(/[:.]/g, '-')
      .slice(0, 19);
    const name = filename || `ui-battery-${verdict}-${ts}.json`;
    const json = serializeReport(report, true);
    const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = name;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    return { ok: true, filename: name };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

async function copyReport(report) {
  try {
    const json = serializeReport(report, true);
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(json);
      return { ok: true, bytes: json.length };
    }
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = json;
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    return { ok: true, bytes: json.length };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

function describeFailures(report) {
  if (!report || !Array.isArray(report.phases)) {
    console.warn('[ui-battery] report inválido');
    return;
  }

  const rows = [];
  for (const phase of report.phases) {
    if (phase.ok || phase.skipped) continue;
    const failed = phase.data?.results?.filter(r => !r.ok) ?? [];
    for (const r of failed) {
      rows.push({
        phase: phase.phase,
        cenário: r.name,
        categoria: r.category,
        erro: (r.error || r.failures?.[0]?.message || '?').slice(0, 100),
      });
    }
    if (failed.length === 0 && phase.failures?.length > 0) {
      rows.push({
        phase: phase.phase,
        cenário: '(fase)',
        categoria: '—',
        erro: (phase.failures[0].message || '?').slice(0, 100),
      });
    }
  }

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    console.log('✅ Nenhuma falha.');
    return;
  }
  console.table(rows);
  console.log('Dica: window.__UIBattery.exportReport(report) para baixar o JSON completo.');
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Conveniência para o console
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export async function runUIBattery(opts = {}) {
  const battery = new UIBattery();
  const report = await battery.runAll(opts);
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.__lastUIReport = report;
  return report;
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.__UIBattery = {
    UIBattery,
    runUIBattery,
    UI_SCENARIOS,
    UI_PHASE_ORDER,

    serializeReport,
    downloadReport,
    copyReport,
    describeFailures,

    exportReport: (report, filename) => downloadReport(report, filename),
    copyReport: (report) => copyReport(report),
  };
}
