```javascript
/**
 * @file narrative-diagnostics.js
 * @module narrative-language/diagnostics
 * @description Fábrica canônica de NarrativeDiagnostic. Centraliza a
 *              criação de diagnósticos em todas as fases do pipeline
 *              narrativo, garantindo formato consistente e códigos
 *              válidos.
 * @imports narrative-language/ir/schema
 * @importedBy narrative-language/pipeline/interpreter,
 *             narrative-language/ir/validator,
 *             narrative-language/ir/source-map,
 *             narrative-language/index,
 *             systems/narrative-system (F5),
 *             diagnostics/config (F8)
 * @level N2
 *
 * Contrato:
 *   makeDiagnostic(code, span, opts)         → NarrativeDiagnostic
 *   makeAmbiguousRefDiagnostic(ref, cands, span, opts) → NarrativeDiagnostic
 *   makeLowConfidenceDiagnostic(act, thr, opts)        → NarrativeDiagnostic
 *   makeIrInvalidDiagnostic(errors, opts)              → NarrativeDiagnostic
 *   makeExecutionDiagnostic(phase, msg, span, opts)    → NarrativeDiagnostic
 *
 * Determinismo: todos os diagnósticos têm forma estável, independente de
 * ordem de criação. Ordenação é feita por `sortDiagnostics`.
 *
 * Nunca lança. Em entrada degenerada devolve diagnóstico sintético com
 * código EXECUTION_FAILED.
 */

import {
  DIAGNOSTIC_CODES,
  DIAGNOSTIC_SEVERITIES,
  DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES,
} from '../ir/schema.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTANTES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Severidades em ordem crescente de gravidade.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 * @private
 */
const _SEVERITY_ORDER = Object.freeze(['info', 'warning', 'error']);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS INTERNOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Sanitiza um SourceSpan; devolve null se malformado.
 * @param {any} span
 * @returns {Object|null}
 * @private
 */
function _sanitizeSpan(span) {
  if (!span || typeof span !== 'object') return null;
  if (typeof span.start !== 'number' || span.start < 0) return null;
  if (typeof span.end !== 'number' || span.end < span.start) return null;
  return {
    start: span.start,
    end: span.end,
    line: typeof span.line === 'number' ? span.line : 1,
    column: typeof span.column === 'number' ? span.column : 0,
    raw: typeof span.raw === 'string' ? span.raw : '',
  };
}

/**
 * Valida um código. Se desconhecido, devolve a meta default.
 * @param {string} code
 * @returns {{ severity:string, phase:string, message:string }}
 * @private
 */
function _metaFor(code) {
  const entry = DIAGNOSTIC_CODES[code];
  if (entry) return entry;
  return {
    severity: 'info',
    phase: 'execution',
    message: `Diagnóstico ${code}`,
  };
}

/**
 * Garante que uma lista é array de strings.
 * @param {any} v
 * @returns {string[]}
 * @private
 */
function _stringList(v) {
  if (!Array.isArray(v)) return [];
  return v.filter((x) => typeof x === 'string' && x.length > 0);
}

/**
 * Serializa um objeto de forma segura para o campo context.
 * Remove referências circulares. Trunca strings muito longas.
 * @param {any} v
 * @param {number} [depth=0]
 * @returns {any}
 * @private
 */
function _safeContext(v, depth = 0) {
  if (depth > 4) return '[deep]';
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return v;
  if (typeof v === 'string') {
    return v.length > 500 ? v.slice(0, 497) + '...' : v;
  }
  if (typeof v === 'number' || typeof v === 'boolean') return v;
  if (typeof v === 'function') return '[Function]';

  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    if (v.length > 20) {
      return [
        ...v.slice(0, 20).map((x) => _safeContext(x, depth + 1)),
        `... ${v.length - 20} itens`,
      ];
    }
    return v.map((x) => _safeContext(x, depth + 1));
  }

  if (typeof v === 'object') {
    const out = {};
    let count = 0;
    for (const [k, val] of Object.entries(v)) {
      if (count++ > 30) break;
      out[k] = _safeContext(val, depth + 1);
    }
    return out;
  }

  return String(v);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FÁBRICA PRINCIPAL
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Cria um NarrativeDiagnostic canônico.
 *
 * @param {string} code              — chave de DIAGNOSTIC_CODES ou código livre
 * @param {Object|null} [span]       — SourceSpan ou null
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @param {string}   [opts.severity] — override de severidade
 * @param {string}   [opts.phase]    — override de fase
 * @param {string}   [opts.message]  — override de mensagem
 * @param {string[]} [opts.suggestions]
 * @param {string[]} [opts.related]
 * @param {Object}   [opts.context]
 * @returns {Object} NarrativeDiagnostic
 */
export function makeDiagnostic(code, span = null, opts = {}) {
  const safeCode = typeof code === 'string' && code
    ? code
    : 'EXECUTION_FAILED';

  const meta = _metaFor(safeCode);

  const severity = DIAGNOSTIC_SEVERITIES.includes(opts.severity)
    ? opts.severity
    : meta.severity;

  const phase = DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES.includes(opts.phase)
    ? opts.phase
    : meta.phase;

  const message = typeof opts.message === 'string' && opts.message.length > 0
    ? opts.message
    : meta.message;

  return {
    severity,
    phase,
    code: safeCode,
    message,
    sourceSpan: _sanitizeSpan(span),
    suggestions: _stringList(opts.suggestions),
    related: _stringList(opts.related),
    context: opts.context ? _safeContext(opts.context) : null,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FÁBRICAS ESPECIALIZADAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Cria um diagnóstico de referência ambígua, com candidatos no contexto.
 *
 * @param {Object} ref        — Reference ({ raw, lemma })
 * @param {Array} candidates  — [{ entityId, name, score }]
 * @param {Object|null} span
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeAmbiguousRefDiagnostic(ref, candidates, span, opts = {}) {
  const raw = ref?.raw ?? ref?.lemma ?? '?';
  const cands = Array.isArray(candidates) ? candidates : [];

  const topNames = cands
    .slice(0, 3)
    .map((c) => c.name ?? c.entityId ?? '?')
    .join(', ');

  const message = cands.length > 0
    ? `Referência "${raw}" ambígua entre ${cands.length} candidatos: ${topNames}`
    : `Referência "${raw}" sem candidato resolvível`;

  return makeDiagnostic('REF_AMBIGUOUS', span, {
    ...opts,
    message,
    suggestions: opts.suggestions ?? [
      `Substitua "${raw}" por um nome explícito`,
    ],
    context: {
      ...(opts.context ?? {}),
      raw,
      lemma: ref?.lemma ?? null,
      candidates: cands.slice(0, 10).map((c) => ({
        entityId: c.entityId ?? null,
        name: c.name ?? null,
        score: typeof c.score === 'number' ? c.score : null,
      })),
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Cria um diagnóstico de referência não resolvida.
 *
 * @param {Object} ref
 * @param {Object|null} span
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeUnresolvedRefDiagnostic(ref, span, opts = {}) {
  const raw = ref?.raw ?? ref?.lemma ?? '?';
  return makeDiagnostic('REF_UNRESOLVED', span, {
    ...opts,
    message: opts.message ?? `Referência "${raw}" sem candidato resolvível`,
    context: {
      ...(opts.context ?? {}),
      raw,
      lemma: ref?.lemma ?? null,
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Cria um diagnóstico de baixa confiança de classificação.
 *
 * @param {Object} act       — NarrativeAct ou ClassificationResult
 * @param {number} [threshold=0.70]
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeLowConfidenceDiagnostic(act, threshold = 0.70, opts = {}) {
  const confidence = typeof act?.confidence === 'number' ? act.confidence : 0;
  const operations = Array.isArray(act?.operations) ? act.operations : [];

  const message = `Classificação com baixa confiança (${confidence.toFixed(2)} < ${threshold.toFixed(2)})`;

  return makeDiagnostic('SEM_OP_LOW_CONFIDENCE', act?.source ?? null, {
    ...opts,
    message,
    suggestions: opts.suggestions ?? [
      'Refraseie com verbo mais explícito',
      'Adicione sujeito explícito',
    ],
    context: {
      ...(opts.context ?? {}),
      confidence,
      threshold,
      operations,
      actId: act?.id ?? null,
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Cria um ou mais diagnósticos de validação do IR.
 * Se `errors` for um array, devolve um array de diagnósticos.
 * Se for um erro único, devolve um diagnóstico.
 *
 * @param {Object|Object[]} errors
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @returns {Object|Object[]}
 */
export function makeIrInvalidDiagnostic(errors, opts = {}) {
  if (Array.isArray(errors)) {
    return errors.map((e) => makeIrInvalidDiagnostic(e, opts));
  }

  const err = errors ?? {};
  const code = typeof err.code === 'string' ? err.code : 'IR_MISSING_FIELD';
  const message = typeof err.message === 'string'
    ? err.message
    : 'IR inválido';

  // Se já é um diagnóstico canônico, garante que segue o formato
  if (err.severity && err.phase && err.code && err.message) {
    return makeDiagnostic(err.code, err.sourceSpan, {
      ...opts,
      severity: err.severity,
      phase: err.phase,
      message: err.message,
      suggestions: err.suggestions,
      related: err.related,
      context: err.context,
    });
  }

  return makeDiagnostic(code, err.sourceSpan ?? null, {
    ...opts,
    message,
    suggestions: opts.suggestions ?? err.suggestions ?? [],
    related: opts.related ?? err.related ?? [],
    context: opts.context ?? err.context ?? null,
  });
}

/**
 * Cria um diagnóstico de execução (interpreter, adapter, etc.).
 *
 * @param {string} phase        — 'lexical' | 'syntactic' | 'semantic' | 'execution'
 * @param {string} message
 * @param {Object|null} [span]
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeExecutionDiagnostic(phase, message, span = null, opts = {}) {
  const code = opts.code ?? 'EXECUTION_FAILED';
  const safePhase = DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES.includes(phase) ? phase : 'execution';
  return makeDiagnostic(code, span, {
    ...opts,
    phase: safePhase,
    message: typeof message === 'string' ? message : 'Falha na execução',
  });
}

/**
 * Cria um diagnóstico de IR com erro de diagnóstico interno.
 * Usado pelo validator quando o IR contém diagnósticos `error`.
 *
 * @param {Object} act
 * @param {Object} innerDiag
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function makeIrHasErrorDiagnostic(act, innerDiag, opts = {}) {
  return makeDiagnostic('IR_HAS_ERROR_DIAGNOSTICS', act?.source ?? null, {
    ...opts,
    message: `Act "${act?.id ?? '?'}" carrega diagnóstico de erro: ${innerDiag?.code ?? '?'}`,
    related: innerDiag?.code ? [innerDiag.code] : [],
    context: {
      ...(opts.context ?? {}),
      actId: act?.id ?? null,
      innerCode: innerDiag?.code ?? null,
      innerMessage: innerDiag?.message ?? null,
    },
  });
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSULTAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Devolve a severidade default de um código.
 * @param {string} code
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function severityFor(code) {
  return _metaFor(code).severity;
}

/**
 * Devolve a fase default de um código.
 * @param {string} code
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function phaseFor(code) {
  return _metaFor(code).phase;
}

/**
 * Verifica se um diagnóstico tem severidade 'error'.
 * @param {Object} d
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isError(d) {
  return d?.severity === 'error';
}

/**
 * Verifica se um diagnóstico tem severidade 'warning'.
 * @param {Object} d
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isWarning(d) {
  return d?.severity === 'warning';
}

/**
 * Verifica se uma lista contém pelo menos um erro.
 * @param {Object[]} list
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function hasErrors(list) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return false;
  return list.some(isError);
}

/**
 * Conta diagnósticos por severidade.
 * @param {Object[]} list
 * @returns {{ error:number, warning:number, info:number }}
 */
export function countBySeverity(list) {
  const out = { error: 0, warning: 0, info: 0 };
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return out;
  for (const d of list) {
    if (!d || typeof d.severity !== 'string') continue;
    if (d.severity in out) out[d.severity]++;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Filtra diagnósticos por severidade.
 * @param {Object[]} list
 * @param {string} severity
 * @returns {Object[]}
 */
export function filterBySeverity(list, severity) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return [];
  return list.filter((d) => d?.severity === severity);
}

/**
 * Filtra diagnósticos por fase.
 * @param {Object[]} list
 * @param {string} phase
 * @returns {Object[]}
 */
export function filterByPhase(list, phase) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return [];
  return list.filter((d) => d?.phase === phase);
}

/**
 * Filtra diagnósticos por código.
 * @param {Object[]} list
 * @param {string} code
 * @returns {Object[]}
 */
export function filterByCode(list, code) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return [];
  return list.filter((d) => d?.code === code);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ORDENAÇÃO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Ordena diagnósticos de forma estável:
 *   1. severity desc (error > warning > info)
 *   2. sourceSpan.start asc (null no final)
 *   3. code asc lexicográfico
 *   4. message asc lexicográfico
 *
 * @param {Object[]} list
 * @returns {Object[]}
 */
export function sortDiagnostics(list) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return [];
  const copy = [...list];

  const sevIdx = (d) => {
    const idx = _SEVERITY_ORDER.indexOf(d?.severity);
    return idx < 0 ? 99 : 100 - idx; // maior = mais grave
  };

  copy.sort((a, b) => {
    const sa = sevIdx(a);
    const sb = sevIdx(b);
    if (sa !== sb) return sb - sa;

    const ast = a?.sourceSpan?.start;
    const bst = b?.sourceSpan?.start;
    const aHas = typeof ast === 'number';
    const bHas = typeof bst === 'number';

    if (aHas && bHas && ast !== bst) return ast - bst;
    if (aHas && !bHas) return -1;
    if (!aHas && bHas) return 1;

    const ac = String(a?.code ?? '');
    const bc = String(b?.code ?? '');
    if (ac !== bc) return ac.localeCompare(bc);

    return String(a?.message ?? '').localeCompare(String(b?.message ?? ''));
  });

  return copy;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SERIALIZAÇÃO E DEBUG
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Serializa diagnósticos em NDJSON (uma linha por diagnóstico).
 * @param {Object[]} list
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function toNDJSON(list) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return '';
  const lines = [];
  for (const d of list) {
    try {
      lines.push(JSON.stringify(d));
    } catch { /* isola */ }
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

/**
 * Converte um diagnóstico em uma linha legível.
 * @param {Object} d
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function toLine(d) {
  if (!d) return '';
  const span = d.sourceSpan
    ? `[${d.sourceSpan.start}-${d.sourceSpan.end}]`
    : '[—]';
  const icon = d.severity === 'error' ? '✗'
    : d.severity === 'warning' ? '⚠'
    : 'ℹ';
  return `${icon} ${span} ${d.code}: ${d.message}`;
}

/**
 * Devolve estatísticas de uma lista de diagnósticos.
 * @param {Object[]} list
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function diagnosticsStats(list) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) {
    return { total: 0, bySeverity: {}, byPhase: {}, byCode: {} };
  }

  const bySeverity = countBySeverity(list);
  const byPhase = {};
  const byCode = {};

  for (const d of list) {
    if (!d) continue;
    if (typeof d.phase === 'string') {
      byPhase[d.phase] = (byPhase[d.phase] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    if (typeof d.code === 'string') {
      byCode[d.code] = (byCode[d.code] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  return {
    total: list.length,
    bySeverity,
    byPhase,
    byCode,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS AGREGADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const NarrativeDiagnostics = Object.freeze({
  makeDiagnostic,
  makeAmbiguousRefDiagnostic,
  makeUnresolvedRefDiagnostic,
  makeLowConfidenceDiagnostic,
  makeIrInvalidDiagnostic,
  makeExecutionDiagnostic,
  makeIrHasErrorDiagnostic,
  severityFor,
  phaseFor,
  isError,
  isWarning,
  hasErrors,
  countBySeverity,
  filterBySeverity,
  filterByPhase,
  filterByCode,
  sortDiagnostics,
  toNDJSON,
  toLine,
  diagnosticsStats,
});

````javascript
/**
 * @file trace.js
 * @module narrative-language/diagnostics
 * @description Trace completo de uma análise narrativa. Reconstrói cada
 *              estágio do pipeline (segmenter → adapter → analyzer →
 *              resolver → classifier → dimensions → IR) para um ato,
 *              permitindo ao autor entender POR QUE o sistema classificou
 *              uma sentença daquela forma.
 * @imports narrative-language/pt-br/adapter,
 *          narrative-language/pipeline/segmenter,
 *          narrative-language/pipeline/analyzer,
 *          narrative-language/pipeline/resolver,
 *          narrative-language/acts/classifier,
 *          narrative-language/acts/dimensions
 * @importedBy narrative-language/diagnostics/diag-handlers
 * @level N2
 *
 * Contrato:
 *   trace(actId, ir, opts)   → Promise<TraceReport>
 *   toMarkdown(traceReport)  → string
 *   toJSON(traceReport)      → object
 *   listTraceableStages()    → string[]
 *
 * Determinismo: o trace re-executa o pipeline com a mesma entrada,
 * então para o mesmo IR o trace produz o mesmo resultado byte-a-byte.
 *
 * Nunca lança. Falhas devolvem TraceReport com `error` preenchido.
 */

import { Adapter } from '../pt-br/adapter.js';
import { analyze } from '../pipeline/analyzer.js';
import { resolve } from '../pipeline/resolver.js';
import { classify } from '../acts/classifier.js';
import { extractDimensions } from '../acts/dimensions.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTANTES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** @type {string} @private */
const _TRACE_VERSION = '1.0.0';

/**
 * Estágios rastreáveis, na ordem em que ocorrem.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 * @private
 */
const _STAGES = Object.freeze([
  'segmenter',
  'adapter',
  'analyzer',
  'resolver',
  'classifier',
  'dimensions',
  'ir',
]);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Encontra um ato no IR pelo id.
 * @private
 */
function _findAct(ir, actId) {
  if (!ir || !Array.isArray(ir.acts)) return null;
  return ir.acts.find((a) => a?.id === actId) ?? null;
}

/**
 * Encontra a sentença que originou um ato.
 * @private
 */
function _findSentence(ir, act) {
  if (!ir?._internal?.sentences) return null;
  const sid = act?.provenance?.sentenceId;
  if (!sid) return null;
  return ir._internal.sentences.find((s) => s.id === sid) ?? null;
}

/**
 * Trunca uma string longa.
 * @private
 */
function _trunc(s, n = 120) {
  const str = String(s ?? '');
  if (str.length <= n) return str;
  return str.slice(0, n - 3) + '...';
}

/**
 * Copia um objeto removendo funções e truncando strings muito longas.
 * @private
 */
function _safeCopy(v, depth = 0) {
  if (depth > 4) return '[deep]';
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return v;
  if (typeof v === 'string') return _trunc(v, 200);
  if (typeof v === 'number' || typeof v === 'boolean') return v;
  if (typeof v === 'function') return '[Function]';
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    if (v.length > 30) {
      return [
        ...v.slice(0, 30).map((x) => _safeCopy(x, depth + 1)),
        `... ${v.length - 30} itens`,
      ];
    }
    return v.map((x) => _safeCopy(x, depth + 1));
  }
  if (typeof v === 'object') {
    const out = {};
    let count = 0;
    for (const [k, val] of Object.entries(v)) {
      if (count++ > 40) break;
      out[k] = _safeCopy(val, depth + 1);
    }
    return out;
  }
  return String(v);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PIPELINE RE-RUN
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Re-executa o pipeline completo numa sentença e captura cada estágio.
 *
 * @param {Object} sentence
 * @param {Object} opts
 * @param {Map<string, Object>|null} opts.overrides
 * @param {Map<string, Object>|null} opts.lexicon
 * @returns {Promise<{
 *   stages: Array<{ name:string, data:Object, ms:number }>,
 *   error: string|null,
 *   model?: Object,
 *   resolution?: Object,
 *   classification?: Object,
 *   dimensions?: Object,
 * }>}
 * @private
 */
async function _runPipeline(sentence, opts) {
  const stages = [];

  // ── 1. Segmenter ──────────────────────────────────────
  const t0 = _now();
  stages.push({
    name: 'segmenter',
    data: {
      sentenceId: sentence.id,
      raw: sentence.raw,
      start: sentence.source?.start ?? 0,
      end: sentence.source?.end ?? 0,
      spanCount: (sentence.spans ?? []).length,
      spans: (sentence.spans ?? []).map((s) => ({
        id: s.id,
        raw: _trunc(s.raw, 80),
        relation: s.relation ?? null,
      })),
    },
    ms: _round(_now() - t0),
  });

  // ── 2. Adapter ────────────────────────────────────────
  const t1 = _now();
  let nlp;
  try {
    nlp = await Adapter.analyze(sentence.raw);
  } catch (err) {
    return { stages, error: `adapter falhou: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}` };
  }
  stages.push({
    name: 'adapter',
    data: {
      backend: nlp?.backend ?? 'unknown',
      tokenCount: nlp?.tokens?.length ?? 0,
      tokens: (nlp?.tokens ?? []).slice(0, 30).map((t) => ({
        text: t.text,
        pos: t.pos,
        lemma: t.lemma,
        features: _safeCopy(t.features ?? {}),
      })),
    },
    ms: _round(_now() - t1),
  });

  // ── 3. Analyzer ───────────────────────────────────────
  const t2 = _now();
  let model;
  try {
    model = analyze(sentence, nlp, {});
  } catch (err) {
    return { stages, error: `analyzer falhou: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}` };
  }
  stages.push({
    name: 'analyzer',
    data: {
      subject: model.subject
        ? { lemma: model.subject.lemma, pos: model.subject.pos, surface: model.subject.surface }
        : null,
      predicate: model.predicate,
      predicateLemma: model.predicateLemma,
      objects: (model.objects ?? []).map((o) => ({
        lemma: o.lemma,
        class: o.class,
        pos: o.pos,
      })),
      semanticRoles: _safeCopy(model.semanticRoles ?? {}),
      tense: model.tense ?? null,
      aspect: model.aspect ?? null,
      modality: model.modality ?? null,
      negation: model.negation ?? null,
      voice: model.voice ?? 'active',
      construction: model.construction?.id ?? null,
      diagnostics: (model.diagnostics ?? []).map((d) => ({
        code: d.code,
        message: _trunc(d.message, 120),
      })),
    },
    ms: _round(_now() - t2),
  });

  // ── 4. Resolver ───────────────────────────────────────
  const t3 = _now();
  const ctx = {
    userLexicon: opts?.lexicon instanceof Map ? opts.lexicon : null,
  };
  let resolution;
  try {
    resolution = resolve(model, ctx, opts?.overrides ?? null);
  } catch (err) {
    resolution = { references: [], diagnostics: [], confidence: 0 };
  }
  stages.push({
    name: 'resolver',
    data: {
      confidence: resolution.confidence ?? 0,
      references: (resolution.references ?? []).map((r) => ({
        kind: r.kind,
        entityId: r.entityId ?? null,
        raw: r.raw,
        lemma: r.lemma,
        resolvedFrom: r.resolvedFrom ?? null,
        confidence: r.confidence,
      })),
      diagnostics: (resolution.diagnostics ?? []).map((d) => ({
        code: d.code,
        message: _trunc(d.message, 120),
        candidates: (d.context?.candidates ?? []).map((c) => ({
          entityId: c.entityId,
          name: c.name,
          score: c.score,
        })),
      })),
    },
    ms: _round(_now() - t3),
  });

  // ── 5. Classifier ─────────────────────────────────────
  const t4 = _now();
  let classification;
  try {
    classification = classify(model, resolution, ctx);
  } catch (err) {
    classification = { candidates: [], selected: [], primary: null };
  }
  stages.push({
    name: 'classifier',
    data: {
      primary: classification.primary ?? null,
      selected: classification.selected ?? [],
      candidates: (classification.candidates ?? []).map((c) => ({
        operation: c.operation,
        confidence: c.confidence,
        evidence: (c.evidence ?? []).map((e) => ({
          source: e.source,
          value: _trunc(e.value, 60),
          reason: e.reason,
          weight: e.weight,
        })),
      })),
    },
    ms: _round(_now() - t4),
  });

  // ── 6. Dimensions ─────────────────────────────────────
  const t5 = _now();
  let dimensions;
  try {
    dimensions = extractDimensions(model, resolution, ctx);
  } catch (err) {
    dimensions = null;
  }
  stages.push({
    name: 'dimensions',
    data: dimensions
      ? {
          voice: dimensions.voice ?? null,
          focalization: dimensions.focalization ?? null,
          form: dimensions.form ?? null,
          tense: dimensions.tense ?? null,
          aspect: dimensions.aspect ?? null,
          modality: dimensions.modality ?? null,
          negation: dimensions.negation ?? null,
          epistemic: dimensions.epistemic ?? null,
        }
      : null,
    ms: _round(_now() - t5),
  });

  return {
    stages,
    error: null,
    model,
    resolution,
    classification,
    dimensions,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COMPARAÇÃO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Compara o ato do IR com o resultado da re-execução.
 * Verifica se o pipeline é determinístico (mesma entrada → mesma saída).
 *
 * @private
 */
function _compareWithAct(act, stages) {
  const dimsStage = stages.find((s) => s.name === 'dimensions')?.data;
  const classStage = stages.find((s) => s.name === 'classifier')?.data;

  const irOps = Array.isArray(act?.operations) ? [...act.operations].sort() : [];
  const newOps = Array.isArray(classStage?.selected) ? [...classStage.selected].sort() : [];

  const opsMatch = JSON.stringify(irOps) === JSON.stringify(newOps);

  const irConf = typeof act?.confidence === 'number' ? act.confidence : 0;
  const newConf = classStage?.candidates?.[0]?.confidence ?? 0;

  return {
    deterministic: opsMatch,
    operationsMatch: opsMatch,
    irOperations: irOps,
    replayedOperations: newOps,
    irConfidence: irConf,
    replayedConfidence: newConf,
    confidenceDelta: _round(newConf - irConf),
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PRINCIPAL
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Produz um TraceReport completo para um ato.
 *
 * @param {string} actId
 * @param {Object} ir        — NarrativeIR (deve ter `_internal.sentences`)
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @param {Map<string, Object>} [opts.overrides]
 * @param {Map<string, Object>} [opts.lexicon]
 * @returns {Promise<{
 *   version:string,
 *   actId:string,
 *   generatedAt:string,
 *   source:{ sentenceId:string, raw:string, start:number, end:number }|null,
 *   stages:Array<{ name:string, data:Object, ms:number }>,
 *   comparison:Object|null,
 *   error:string|null,
 * }>}
 */
export async function trace(actId, ir, opts = {}) {
  const report = {
    version: _TRACE_VERSION,
    actId,
    generatedAt: _isoNow(),
    source: null,
    stages: [],
    comparison: null,
    error: null,
  };

  if (!actId || typeof actId !== 'string') {
    report.error = 'actId ausente ou inválido';
    return report;
  }

  if (!ir) {
    report.error = 'IR ausente';
    return report;
  }

  const act = _findAct(ir, actId);
  if (!act) {
    report.error = `act não encontrado: ${actId}`;
    return report;
  }

  const sentence = _findSentence(ir, act);
  if (!sentence) {
    report.error = `sentença não encontrada para act ${actId}`;
    return report;
  }

  report.source = {
    sentenceId: sentence.id,
    raw: sentence.raw,
    start: sentence.source?.start ?? 0,
    end: sentence.source?.end ?? 0,
  };

  // Re-executa pipeline
  let result;
  try {
    result = await _runPipeline(sentence, opts);
  } catch (err) {
    report.error = `_runPipeline falhou: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}`;
    return report;
  }

  report.stages = result.stages;
  report.error = result.error;

  if (!result.error) {
    report.comparison = _compareWithAct(act, result.stages);

    // Estágio final: o próprio act do IR
    report.stages.push({
      name: 'ir',
      data: {
        actId: act.id,
        operations: act.operations,
        confidence: act.confidence,
        voice: act.voice,
        focalization: act.focalization,
        form: act.form,
        proposition: {
          predicate: act.proposition?.predicate,
          predicateLemma: act.proposition?.predicateLemma,
          roles: Object.keys(act.proposition?.roles ?? {}),
        },
        evidenceCount: Array.isArray(act.evidence) ? act.evidence.length : 0,
        referenceCount: Array.isArray(act.references) ? act.references.length : 0,
      },
      ms: 0,
    });
  }

  return report;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SERIALIZAÇÃO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Serializa um TraceReport em Markdown legível.
 *
 * @param {Object} report
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function toMarkdown(report) {
  if (!report) return '# Trace vazio\n';

  const lines = [];
  lines.push(`# Trace — \`${report.actId}\``);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`**Gerado em:** ${report.generatedAt}`);
  lines.push('');

  if (report.error) {
    lines.push('## ⚠ Erro');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('```');
    lines.push(String(report.error));
    lines.push('```');
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  if (report.source) {
    lines.push('## Origem');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(`- **Sentença:** \`${report.source.sentenceId}\``);
    lines.push(`- **Texto:** "${report.source.raw}"`);
    lines.push(`- **Offsets:** ${report.source.start}–${report.source.end}`);
    lines.push('');
  }

  lines.push('## Estágios do pipeline');
  lines.push('');

  for (const stage of report.stages) {
    lines.push(`### \`${stage.name}\` (${stage.ms}ms)`);
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('```json');
    try {
      lines.push(JSON.stringify(stage.data, null, 2));
    } catch {
      lines.push('(não serializável)');
    }
    lines.push('```');
    lines.push('');
  }

  if (report.comparison) {
    const c = report.comparison;
    lines.push('## Determinismo');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(`- **Bate com IR original:** ${c.deterministic ? '✓' : '✗'}`);
    lines.push(`- Operações (IR): \`${c.irOperations.join(', ')}\``);
    lines.push(`- Operações (replay): \`${c.replayedOperations.join(', ')}\``);
    lines.push(`- Confiança (IR): \`${c.irConfidence}\``);
    lines.push(`- Confiança (replay): \`${c.replayedConfidence}\``);
    lines.push(`- Delta: \`${c.confidenceDelta}\``);
    lines.push('');
  }

  lines.push('---');
  lines.push(`*Gerado por narrative-language/diagnostics/trace.js v${report.version}*`);

  return lines.join('\n');
}

/**
 * Serializa um TraceReport em JSON puro (safe-copy).
 * @param {Object} report
 * @returns {Object|null}
 */
export function toJSON(report) {
  if (!report) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(report));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Lista os estágios rastreáveis.
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function listTraceableStages() {
  return Array.from(_STAGES);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// UTILITÁRIOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function _isoNow() {
  try {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

/**
 * @returns {number}
 * @private
 */
function _now() {
  if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
    return performance.now();
  }
  return Date.now();
}

/**
 * @private
 */
function _round(n) {
  return Math.round(Number(n) * 100) / 100;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS AGREGADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const Trace = Object.freeze({
  trace,
  toMarkdown,
  toJSON,
  listTraceableStages,
});
````

/**

 * @module narrative-language/fixtures
 * @description Runner de fixtures end-to-end. Aceita fixtures em forma
 *              canônica (objeto JS), roda o pipeline completo
 *              (segmenter → analyzer → resolver → classifier → dimensions
 *              → interpreter), compara com o esperado e produz relatório
 *              estruturado (JSON, Markdown, texto).
 * @imports narrative-language/pt-br/adapter,

 * Total: 57 fixtures (45 originais + 12 novas).

 * Contrato:

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS INTERNOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function _now() {
  if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
    return performance.now();
  }
  return Date.now();
}

function _round(n) {
  return Math.round(Number(n) * 1000) / 1000;
}

/** @type {Readonly<Object<string, string>>} @private */
const _V1_TO_D = Object.freeze({
  'represent':   'D1',
  'describe':    'D2',
  'expose':      'D3',
  'interiorize': 'D4',
  'enunciate':   'D5',
  'evaluate':    'D6',
  'focalize':    'D7',
  'structure':   'D8',
});

function _operationOfDNumber(dnumber) {
  if (typeof dnumber !== 'string') return null;
  const m = /^(D\d+)/.exec(dnumber);
  return m ? m[1] : null;
}

function _collectActualSubtypes(act) {
  const out = {};

  const rich = act?.subtypes;
  if (rich && typeof rich === 'object' && !Array.isArray(rich)) {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(rich)) {
      if (typeof value === 'string' && /^D\d/.test(value)) {
        out[key] = value;
      } else if (value && typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.id === 'string') {
        out[key] = value.id;
      }
    }
  }

  const flat = act?.subtypesFlat;
  if (flat && typeof flat === 'object' && !Array.isArray(flat)) {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(flat)) {
      if (typeof value !== 'string') continue;
      if (!out[key]) out[key] = value;
      const dKey = _V1_TO_D[key];
      if (dKey && !out[dKey]) out[dKey] = value;
    }
  }

  return out;
}

/**
 * Normaliza o resultado de `interpretDocument`.
 * @param {Object} interpretResult
 * @param {string} input
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function normalizeForCompare(interpretResult, input) {
  const acts = Array.isArray(interpretResult?.acts) ? interpretResult.acts : [];
  const diagnostics = Array.isArray(interpretResult?.diagnostics) ? interpretResult.diagnostics : [];

  const normalizedActs = acts.map((a) => {
    const subtypes = {};
    const rich = a.subtypes ?? {};
    for (const [dOp, sub] of Object.entries(rich)) {
      const id = typeof sub === 'string' ? sub : sub?.id;
      if (id) subtypes[dOp] = id;
    }
    const flat = a.subtypesFlat ?? {};
    for (const [v1op, id] of Object.entries(flat)) {
      const dOp = _V1_TO_D[v1op];
      if (dOp && !subtypes[dOp]) subtypes[dOp] = id;
    }

    const axes = {};
    const rawAxes = a.axes ?? {};
    for (const [dOp, opAxes] of Object.entries(rawAxes)) {
      if (!opAxes || typeof opAxes !== 'object') continue;
      const copy = {};
      for (const [axis, value] of Object.entries(opAxes)) {
        if (typeof value === 'string') copy[axis] = value;
      }
      if (Object.keys(copy).length > 0) axes[dOp] = copy;
    }

    const traits = Array.isArray(a.traits) ? [...a.traits] : [];

    return {
      id: a.id,
      operations: Array.isArray(a.operations) ? [...a.operations].sort() : [],
      primaryOperation: a.operations?.[0] ?? null,
      subtypes,
      axes,
      traits,
      voice: a.voice?.kind ?? null,
      voiceSourceId: a.voice?.sourceId ?? null,
      focalization: a.focalization?.targetId ?? a.focalization?.kind ?? null,
      form: a.form ?? null,
      tense: a.tense ?? null,
      aspect: a.aspect ?? null,
      modality: a.modality ?? null,
      negation: a.negation ?? null,
      epistemic: a.epistemic ?? null,
      confidence: a.confidence ?? 0,
    };
  });

  const normalizedDiagnostics = diagnostics.map((d) => ({
    code: d.code ?? null,
    severity: d.severity ?? null,
    phase: d.phase ?? null,
    message: d.message ?? '',
  }));

  const proposals = [];
  try {
    for (const act of acts) {
      const props = project(act, { projection: 'simulate' });
      for (const p of props) {
        proposals.push({
          actId: p.actId,
          command: p.command,
          kind: p.kind,
          confidence: p.confidence,
          subtypeId: p.subtypeId ?? null,
          source: p.source ?? null,
        });
      }
    }
  } catch { /* isola */ }

  return {
    acts: normalizedActs,
    diagnostics: normalizedDiagnostics,
    proposals,
  };
}

function _isSubsetStrings(expected, actual) {
  if (!Array.isArray(expected) || expected.length === 0) return { ok: true, missing: [] };
  const set = new Set(Array.isArray(actual) ? actual : []);
  const missing = expected.filter((x) => !set.has(x));
  return { ok: missing.length === 0, missing };
}

function _compareSubtypes(expected, actual) {
  const diffs = [];
  if (!expected || typeof expected !== 'object') return diffs;

  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(expected)) {
    const expectedId = typeof val === 'string'
      ? val
      : (val && typeof val === 'object' ? val.id : null);
    if (!expectedId) continue;

    const actualId = actual?.[key];
    if (actualId !== expectedId) {
      diffs.push({
        field: `subtypes.${key}`,
        expected: expectedId,
        actual: actualId ?? null,
      });
    }
  }

  return diffs;
}

function _compareAxes(expected, actual) {
  const diffs = [];
  if (!expected || typeof expected !== 'object') return diffs;

  for (const [dOp, opAxes] of Object.entries(expected)) {
    if (!opAxes || typeof opAxes !== 'object') continue;
    const actualOp = actual?.[dOp] ?? {};

    for (const [axis, val] of Object.entries(opAxes)) {
      const aVal = actualOp[axis];
      if (aVal !== val) {
        diffs.push({
          field: `axes.${dOp}.${axis}`,
          expected: val,
          actual: aVal ?? null,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return diffs;
}

function _compareTraits(expected, actual) {
  if (!Array.isArray(expected) || expected.length === 0) return [];
  const sub = _isSubsetStrings(expected, actual);
  if (sub.ok) return [];
  return [{
    field: 'traits',
    expected,
    actual: Array.isArray(actual) ? actual : [],
    missing: sub.missing,
  }];
}

function _compareAct(expected, actual) {
  const diffs = [];

  if (Array.isArray(expected.operations)) {
    const sub = _isSubsetStrings(expected.operations, actual.operations);
    if (!sub.ok) {
      diffs.push({
        field: 'operations',
        expected: expected.operations,
        actual: actual.operations,
        missing: sub.missing,
      });
    }
  }

  if ('primaryOperation' in expected) {
    if (expected.primaryOperation !== actual.primaryOperation) {
      diffs.push({
        field: 'primaryOperation',
        expected: expected.primaryOperation,
        actual: actual.primaryOperation,
      });
    }
  }

  if (expected.subtypes) {
    diffs.push(..._compareSubtypes(expected.subtypes, actual.subtypes));
  }

  if (expected.axes) {
    diffs.push(..._compareAxes(expected.axes, actual.axes));
  }

  if (expected.traits) {
    diffs.push(..._compareTraits(expected.traits, actual.traits));
  }

  if ('voice' in expected) {
    if (expected.voice !== actual.voice) {
      diffs.push({ field: 'voice', expected: expected.voice, actual: actual.voice });
    }
  }

  if ('focalization' in expected) {
    const e = expected.focalization;
    const a = actual.focalization;
    if (e !== a) {
      diffs.push({ field: 'focalization', expected: e, actual: a });
    }
  }

  if ('form' in expected) {
    if (expected.form !== actual.form) {
      diffs.push({ field: 'form', expected: expected.form, actual: actual.form });
    }
  }

  if ('epistemic' in expected) {
    if (expected.epistemic !== actual.epistemic) {
      diffs.push({ field: 'epistemic', expected: expected.epistemic, actual: actual.epistemic });
    }
  }

  if ('tense' in expected) {
    if (expected.tense !== actual.tense) {
      diffs.push({ field: 'tense', expected: expected.tense, actual: actual.tense });
    }
  }

  if ('aspect' in expected) {
    if (expected.aspect !== actual.aspect) {
      diffs.push({ field: 'aspect', expected: expected.aspect, actual: actual.aspect });
    }
  }

  if ('modality' in expected) {
    if (expected.modality !== actual.modality) {
      diffs.push({ field: 'modality', expected: expected.modality, actual: actual.modality });
    }
  }

  if ('negation' in expected) {
    if (expected.negation !== actual.negation) {
      diffs.push({ field: 'negation', expected: expected.negation, actual: actual.negation });
    }
  }

  return diffs;
}

function _compareDiagnostics(expected, actual) {
  if (!Array.isArray(expected) || expected.length === 0) return [];

  const diffs = [];
  const actualCodes = new Set((actual ?? []).map((d) => d.code));

  for (const e of expected) {
    if (!e || typeof e.code !== 'string') continue;
    if (!actualCodes.has(e.code)) {
      diffs.push({
        field: 'diagnostics',
        expected: e.code,
        actual: null,
      });
    }
  }

  return diffs;
}

function _compareProposals(expected, actual) {
  if (!Array.isArray(expected) || expected.length === 0) return [];

  const diffs = [];
  const actualCommands = (actual ?? []).map((p) => p.command ?? '');

  for (const e of expected) {
    if (!e || typeof e.command !== 'string') continue;
    const found = actualCommands.some((c) => c.startsWith(e.command));
    if (!found) {
      diffs.push({
        field: 'proposals',
        expected: e.command,
        actual: actualCommands.slice(0, 5),
      });
    }
  }

  return diffs;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXECUÇÃO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

async function _runOne(fixture) {
  const result = {
    name: fixture.name ?? '?',
    level: fixture.level ?? '?',
    category: fixture.category ?? '?',
    input: String(fixture.input ?? ''),
    ok: false,
    durationMs: 0,
    failures: [],
    error: null,
    actual: null,
  };

  const t0 = _now();

  try {
    const interpretResult = await interpretDocument(result.input, fixture.context ?? {});
    const normalized = normalizeForCompare(interpretResult, result.input);
    result.actual = normalized;
  } catch (err) {
    result.error = err?.message ?? String(err);
    result.durationMs = _round(_now() - t0);
    return result;
  }

  const expectedActs = Array.isArray(fixture.expect?.acts) ? fixture.expect.acts : [];
  const actualActs = result.actual.acts;

  if (expectedActs.length !== actualActs.length) {
    result.failures.push({
      field: 'acts.length',
      expected: expectedActs.length,
      actual: actualActs.length,
    });
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(expectedActs.length, actualActs.length); i++) {
    const diffs = _compareAct(expectedActs[i], actualActs[i]);
    for (const d of diffs) {
      result.failures.push({ ...d, actIndex: i });
    }
  }

  const expectedDiags = Array.isArray(fixture.expect?.diagnostics) ? fixture.expect.diagnostics : [];
  const diagDiffs = _compareDiagnostics(expectedDiags, result.actual.diagnostics);
  for (const d of diagDiffs) result.failures.push(d);

  const expectedProps = Array.isArray(fixture.expect?.proposals) ? fixture.expect.proposals : [];
  const propDiffs = _compareProposals(expectedProps, result.actual.proposals);
  for (const d of propDiffs) result.failures.push(d);

  result.ok = result.failures.length === 0;
  result.durationMs = _round(_now() - t0);

  return result;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PRINCIPAL
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Roda uma lista de fixtures.
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @returns {Promise<Object>}
 */
export async function runFixtures(opts = {}) {
  const all = Array.isArray(opts.fixtures) ? opts.fixtures : CANONICAL_FIXTURES;

  const filtered = all.filter((f) => {
    if (opts.level && f.level !== opts.level) return false;
    if (opts.category && f.category !== opts.category) return false;
    if (opts.name && !String(f.name).includes(opts.name)) return false;
    return true;
  });

  try {
    if (!Adapter.isAvailable()) {
      await Adapter.init();
    }
  } catch { /* isola */ }

  const t0 = _now();
  const results = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < filtered.length; i++) {
    const fixture = filtered[i];
    let r;
    try {
      r = await _runOne(fixture);
    } catch (err) {
      r = {
        name: fixture.name,
        level: fixture.level,
        category: fixture.category,
        input: fixture.input,
        ok: false,
        durationMs: 0,
        failures: [],
        error: err?.message ?? String(err),
        actual: null,
      };
    }
    results.push(r);

    if (typeof opts.onProgress === 'function') {
      try {
        opts.onProgress({ result: r, index: i, total: filtered.length });
      } catch { /* isola */ }
    }

    if (opts.stopOnFirstFailure && !r.ok) break;
  }

  const passed = results.filter((r) => r.ok).length;
  const failed = results.length - passed;

  const byLevel = {};
  const byCategory = {};
  for (const r of results) {
    const lv = r.level ?? '?';
    const ct = r.category ?? '?';
    if (!byLevel[lv]) byLevel[lv] = { passed: 0, failed: 0 };
    if (!byCategory[ct]) byCategory[ct] = { passed: 0, failed: 0 };
    if (r.ok) { byLevel[lv].passed++; byCategory[ct].passed++; }
    else { byLevel[lv].failed++; byCategory[ct].failed++; }
  }

  return {
    ok: failed === 0,
    total: results.length,
    passed,
    failed,
    durationMs: _round(_now() - t0),
    results,
    byLevel,
    byCategory,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// RELATÓRIOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export function reportToMarkdown(report) {
  if (!report) return '# Fixtures vazio\n';

  const lines = [];
  const verdict = report.ok ? '✓ APROVADO' : '✗ REPROVADO';
  const icon = report.ok ? '✅' : '❌';

  lines.push(`# ${icon} Fixtures Narrativas — ${verdict}`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`**Total:** ${report.total}`);
  lines.push(`**Aprovadas:** ${report.passed}`);
  lines.push(`**Reprovadas:** ${report.failed}`);
  lines.push(`**Duração:** ${report.durationMs}ms`);
  lines.push('');

  if (report.byLevel) {
    lines.push('## Por nível');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('| Nível | Aprovadas | Reprovadas |');
    lines.push('|---|---:|---:|');
    for (const [level, st] of Object.entries(report.byLevel).sort()) {
      lines.push(`| ${level} | ${st.passed} | ${st.failed} |`);
    }
    lines.push('');
  }

  if (report.byCategory) {
    lines.push('## Por categoria');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('| Categoria | Aprovadas | Reprovadas |');
    lines.push('|---|---:|---:|');
    for (const [cat, st] of Object.entries(report.byCategory).sort()) {
      lines.push(`| ${cat} | ${st.passed} | ${st.failed} |`);
    }
    lines.push('');
  }

  lines.push('## Resultados');
  lines.push('');
  for (const r of report.results) {
    const mark = r.ok ? '✓' : '✗';
    lines.push(`### ${mark} \`${r.name}\` (${r.level} · ${r.category})`);
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(`- **Input:** "${r.input}"`);
    lines.push(`- **Duração:** ${r.durationMs}ms`);
    if (r.error) {
      lines.push(`- **Erro:** \`${r.error}\``);
    }
    if (!r.ok && r.failures.length > 0) {
      lines.push(`- **Falhas:** ${r.failures.length}`);
      lines.push('');
      for (const f of r.failures.slice(0, 10)) {
        const exp = JSON.stringify(f.expected);
        const act = JSON.stringify(f.actual);
        lines.push(`  - \`${f.field}\`: esperado=${exp}, real=${act}`);
      }
    }
    lines.push('');
  }

  lines.push('---');
  lines.push(`*Gerado por narrative-language/fixtures/runner.js*`);
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function reportToJSON(report) {
  if (!report) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(report));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function reportToText(report) {
  if (!report) return '';
  const lines = [];
  lines.push(`Fixtures: ${report.passed}/${report.total} passaram em ${report.durationMs}ms`);
  for (const r of report.results) {
    const mark = r.ok ? '✓' : '✗';
    const suffix = r.ok ? '' : ` [${r.failures.length} falha(s)]`;
    lines.push(`${mark} ${r.level} ${r.category} ${r.name}${suffix}`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSULTAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export function listFixtureCategories(fixtures) {
  const set = new Set();
  for (const f of fixtures ?? []) {
    if (f?.category) set.add(f.category);
  }
  return Array.from(set).sort();
}

export function listFixtureLevels(fixtures) {
  const set = new Set();
  for (const f of fixtures ?? []) {
    if (f?.level) set.add(f.level);
  }
  return Array.from(set).sort();
}

export function fixturesByLevel(fixtures, level) {
  return (fixtures ?? []).filter((f) => f?.level === level);
}

export function fixturesByCategory(fixtures, category) {
  return (fixtures ?? []).filter((f) => f?.category === category);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// REGISTRO DE FIXTURES EXTERNAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const _externalFixtures = [];

export function registerFixtures(fixtures) {
  const list = Array.isArray(fixtures) ? fixtures : [fixtures];
  for (const f of list) {
    if (f && typeof f.name === 'string' && typeof f.input === 'string') {
      _externalFixtures.push(f);
    }
  }
  return _externalFixtures.length;
}

export function clearRegisteredFixtures() {
  const n = _externalFixtures.length;
  _externalFixtures.length = 0;
  return n;
}

export function allFixtures() {
  return [...CANONICAL_FIXTURES, ..._externalFixtures];
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS AGREGADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const FixtureRunner = Object.freeze({
  CANONICAL_FIXTURES,
  runFixtures,
  reportToMarkdown,
  reportToJSON,
  reportToText,
  normalizeForCompare,
  listFixtureCategories,
  listFixtureLevels,
  fixturesByLevel,
  fixturesByCategory,
  registerFixtures,
  clearRegisteredFixtures,
  allFixtures,
});

/**
 * @file index.js
 * @module narrative-language
 * @description API pública do subsistema narrativo. Ponto de entrada único
 *              para o frontend PT-BR.
 * @imports narrative-language/config,
 *          narrative-language/mode,
 *          narrative-language/overrides,
 *          narrative-language/pt-br/adapter,
 *          narrative-language/pipeline/interpreter,
 *          narrative-language/ir/schema,
 *          narrative-language/ir/validator,
 *          narrative-language/ir/source-map,
 *          narrative-language/diagnostics/narrative-diagnostics
 * @importedBy systems/narrative-system (F5),
 *             diagnostics/trace (F8)
 * @level N4
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Bugfix P0-2 (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   `_cacheKey()` incluía `overrides` mas NÃO `userLexicon`. Quando o
 *   autor "aprendia" uma correção (`narr:lexicon:learn`), o mapa
 *   `_userLexicon` era atualizado, mas o cache de análise continuava
 *   devolvendo o resultado antigo para o mesmo texto. A preferência
 *   aprendida era silenciosamente ignorada a partir da primeira
 *   análise.
 *
 *   Correção: incluir as entradas de `userLexicon` relevantes para
 *   resolução (`prefer` + `context`) na chave de cache. O campo `uses`
 *   NÃO entra na chave porque não afeta a resolução.
 */

import { NARRATIVE_CONFIG, isProjectionValid, DEFAULT_PROJECTION } from './config.js';
import { readMode } from './mode.js';
import { Adapter } from './pt-br/adapter.js';
import {
  interpretDocument,
  interpretationStats,
} from './pipeline/interpreter.js';
import {
  IR_VERSION,
  DIAGNOSTIC_CODES,
} from './ir/schema.js';
import { validateIR } from './ir/validator.js';
import {
  buildSourceMap,
  stats as sourceMapStats,
  toJSON as sourceMapToJSON,
} from './ir/source-map.js';
import {
  makeDiagnostic,
  makeExecutionDiagnostic,
  makeIrInvalidDiagnostic,
  sortDiagnostics,
  hasErrors,
  countBySeverity,
  diagnosticsStats,
} from './diagnostics/narrative-diagnostics.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ESTADO INTERNO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Último IR válido. Nunca destruído por falha de análise.
 * @type {Object|null}
 * @private
 */
let _lastValidIR = null;

/**
 * Política de projeção ativa.
 * @type {string}
 * @private
 */
let _activeProjection = DEFAULT_PROJECTION;

/**
 * Cache LRU de análise.
 * Chave: hash do texto + hash do contexto (overrides, lexicon, projeção).
 * @type {Map<string, Object>}
 * @private
 */
const _cache = new Map();

/**
 * Estatísticas de execução.
 * @type {Object}
 * @private
 */
const _stats = {
  analyzed: 0,
  cached: 0,
  failed: 0,
  lastLatencyMs: 0,
  avgLatencyMs: 0,
  totalLatencyMs: 0,
};

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HASHING DETERMINÍSTICO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * FNV-1a hash de uma string, 32 bits, retorna base36.
 * Determinístico, sem dependências.
 * @param {string} str
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function _fnv1a(str) {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
    h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
  }
  return h.toString(36);
}

/**
 * Constrói uma chave de cache determinística a partir de texto + contexto.
 *
 * Campos considerados:
 *   - texto (diretamente)
 *   - ids das entidades em scene/recent/chapter/project (ordenados)
 *   - overrides do autor (chave + escolha)
 *   - userLexicon (lemma + prefer + context) — Fase 13.7
 *   - política de projeção ativa
 *
 * O campo `uses` de `userLexicon` NÃO entra na chave: não afeta
 * resolução, apenas telemetria.
 *
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {Object} ctx
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function _cacheKey(text, ctx) {
  const relevant = {
    text,
    scene: (ctx?.sceneEntities ?? []).map((e) => e?.id).sort(),
    recent: (ctx?.recentEntities ?? []).map((e) => e?.id).sort(),
    chapter: (ctx?.chapterEntities ?? []).map((e) => e?.id).sort(),
    project: (ctx?.projectEntities ?? []).map((e) => e?.id).sort(),
    overrides: ctx?.overrides instanceof Map
      ? Array.from(ctx.overrides.entries())
          .map(([k, v]) => [String(k), v?.chose ?? null])
          .sort(([a], [b]) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b)))
      : null,
    // Fase 13.7 — P0-2: incluir userLexicon na chave. Só `prefer` e
    // `context` importam para resolução (o resolver usa `prefer` para
    // computar o boost). `uses` é telemetria e fica fora.
    userLexicon: ctx?.userLexicon instanceof Map
      ? Array.from(ctx.userLexicon.entries())
          .map(([k, v]) => [String(k), v?.prefer ?? null, v?.context ?? null])
          .sort(([a], [b]) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b)))
      : null,
    projection: ctx?.projection ?? _activeProjection,
  };

  let canonical;
  try {
    canonical = JSON.stringify(relevant);
  } catch {
    canonical = String(text) + ':' + Date.now();
  }

  return `${_fnv1a(canonical)}:${text.length}`;
}

/**
 * Insere no cache com eviction FIFO.
 * @private
 */
function _cacheSet(key, value) {
  _cache.set(key, value);
  while (_cache.size > NARRATIVE_CONFIG.cacheSize) {
    const oldest = _cache.keys().next().value;
    if (oldest === undefined) break;
    _cache.delete(oldest);
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTRUÇÃO DO IR
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Constrói o objeto NarrativeIR a partir do resultado do interpreter.
 *
 * @param {Object} interpretResult
 * @param {Object} meta — { documentId, sourceHash, latencyMs }
 * @returns {Object} NarrativeIR
 * @private
 */
function _buildIR(interpretResult, meta) {
  const acts = interpretResult.acts ?? [];
  const diagnostics = interpretResult.diagnostics ?? [];
  const sentences = interpretResult.sentences ?? [];
  const spans = interpretResult.spans ?? [];
  const relations = interpretResult.relations ?? [];
  const sourceMap = interpretResult.sourceMap instanceof Map
    ? interpretResult.sourceMap
    : new Map();

  const index = _buildIndex(acts);

  const provenance = {
    segmenter: 'segmenter-1.0.0',
    nlpBackend: Adapter.backend(),
    classifier: 'classifier-1.0.0',
    lexicon: 'lexicon-1.0.0',
    latencyMs: meta.latencyMs ?? 0,
    sentenceCount: sentences.length,
    spanCount: spans.length,
    relationCount: relations.length,
  };

  return {
    version: IR_VERSION,
    documentId: meta.documentId ?? 'default',
    generatedAt: meta.generatedAt ?? '',
    sourceHash: meta.sourceHash ?? '',
    acts,
    diagnostics: sortDiagnostics(diagnostics),
    index,
    provenance,
    _internal: {
      sentences,
      spans,
      relations,
      sourceMap,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Constrói o índice canônico do IR.
 * @param {Array} acts
 * @returns {Object}
 * @private
 */
function _buildIndex(acts) {
  const byEntity = {};
  const byOperation = {};
  const bySpan = {};

  for (const act of acts) {
    if (!act?.id) continue;

    for (const op of act.operations ?? []) {
      if (!byOperation[op]) byOperation[op] = [];
      if (!byOperation[op].includes(act.id)) byOperation[op].push(act.id);
    }

    const refs = act.references ?? [];
    for (const ref of refs) {
      if (ref?.kind === 'entity' && ref.entityId) {
        if (!byEntity[ref.entityId]) byEntity[ref.entityId] = [];
        if (!byEntity[ref.entityId].includes(act.id)) {
          byEntity[ref.entityId].push(act.id);
        }
      }
    }

    const sid = act.provenance?.sentenceId;
    if (typeof sid === 'string' && sid) {
      bySpan[`${sid}.1`] = act.id;
    }
  }

  for (const k of Object.keys(byEntity)) byEntity[k].sort();
  for (const k of Object.keys(byOperation)) byOperation[k].sort();

  return { byEntity, byOperation, bySpan };
}

/**
 * Constrói um IR vazio mas estruturalmente válido, com um diagnóstico de erro.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {Object} diag
 * @returns {Object}
 * @private
 */
function _mkErrorIR(text, diag) {
  return {
    version: IR_VERSION,
    documentId: 'default',
    generatedAt: '',
    sourceHash: _fnv1a(String(text ?? '')),
    acts: [],
    diagnostics: [diag],
    index: { byEntity: {}, byOperation: {}, bySpan: {} },
    provenance: {
      segmenter: 'segmenter-1.0.0',
      nlpBackend: Adapter.backend(),
      classifier: 'classifier-1.0.0',
      lexicon: 'lexicon-1.0.0',
      latencyMs: 0,
      error: true,
    },
    _internal: {
      sentences: [],
      spans: [],
      relations: [],
      sourceMap: new Map(),
    },
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA — ANÁLISE ASSÍNCRONA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Analisa um texto. Assíncrono. Nunca lança.
 *
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {Object} [context={}]
 * @returns {Promise<NarrativeIR>}
 */
export async function analyze(text, context = {}) {
  const t0 = _now();
  const source = String(text ?? '');

  if (source.length === 0) {
    const ir = _mkErrorIR(source, makeDiagnostic(
      'EXECUTION_FAILED',
      null,
      { message: 'Texto vazio', severity: 'info', phase: 'execution' }
    ));
    _lastValidIR = ir;
    return ir;
  }

  const key = _cacheKey(source, context);
  if (_cache.has(key)) {
    _stats.cached++;
    const cached = _cache.get(key);
    _cache.delete(key);
    _cache.set(key, cached);
    return cached;
  }

  try {
    if (!Adapter.isAvailable()) {
      await Adapter.init();
    }
  } catch {
    // Heurística sempre disponível — segue mesmo assim
  }

  let result;
  try {
    result = await interpretDocument(source, context);
  } catch (err) {
    _stats.failed++;
    const diag = makeExecutionDiagnostic(
      'execution',
      `Interpreter falhou: ${err.message}`,
      null,
      { code: 'EXECUTION_FAILED' }
    );
    const ir = _mkErrorIR(source, diag);
    _lastValidIR = ir;
    return ir;
  }

  const latencyMs = _now() - t0;
  _stats.lastLatencyMs = Math.round(latencyMs * 100) / 100;
  _stats.totalLatencyMs += latencyMs;
  _stats.analyzed++;
  _stats.avgLatencyMs = _stats.analyzed > 0
    ? Math.round((_stats.totalLatencyMs / _stats.analyzed) * 100) / 100
    : 0;

  const ir = _buildIR(result, {
    documentId: context.documentId ?? 'default',
    sourceHash: _fnv1a(source),
    generatedAt: _isoNow(),
    latencyMs: _stats.lastLatencyMs,
  });

  let validation;
  try {
    validation = validateIR(ir);
  } catch (err) {
    validation = {
      ok: false,
      errors: [makeExecutionDiagnostic(
        'validation',
        `Validator falhou: ${err.message}`,
        null,
        { code: 'IR_MISSING_FIELD' }
      )],
    };
  }

  if (!validation.ok && Array.isArray(validation.errors)) {
    const validationDiags = makeIrInvalidDiagnostic(validation.errors);
    const list = Array.isArray(validationDiags)
      ? validationDiags
      : [validationDiags];
    ir.diagnostics = sortDiagnostics([...ir.diagnostics, ...list]);
  }

  if (!hasErrors(ir.diagnostics)) {
    _lastValidIR = ir;
  }

  _cacheSet(key, ir);

  return ir;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA — ANÁLISE SÍNCRONA (FAST PASS)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Versão síncrona. Reusa último IR se o texto não mudou desde então.
 *
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {Object} [context={}]
 * @returns {NarrativeIR}
 */
export function analyzeSync(text, context = {}) {
  const source = String(text ?? '');
  const key = _cacheKey(source, context);

  if (_cache.has(key)) {
    _stats.cached++;
    return _cache.get(key);
  }

  if (_lastValidIR && _lastValidIR.sourceHash === _fnv1a(source)) {
    return _lastValidIR;
  }

  return {
    version: IR_VERSION,
    documentId: context.documentId ?? 'default',
    generatedAt: '',
    sourceHash: _fnv1a(source),
    acts: [],
    diagnostics: [],
    index: { byEntity: {}, byOperation: {}, bySpan: {} },
    provenance: {
      segmenter: 'segmenter-1.0.0',
      nlpBackend: Adapter.backend(),
      classifier: 'classifier-1.0.0',
      lexicon: 'lexicon-1.0.0',
      latencyMs: 0,
      fastPass: true,
    },
    _internal: {
      sentences: [],
      spans: [],
      relations: [],
      sourceMap: new Map(),
    },
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA — CONTROLE E ESTADO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Devolve o último IR válido, ou null se nunca houve análise bem-sucedida.
 * @returns {NarrativeIR|null}
 */
export function getLastIR() {
  return _lastValidIR;
}

/**
 * Define a política de projeção ativa.
 * @param {string} policy
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function setProjection(policy) {
  if (!isProjectionValid(policy)) return false;
  _activeProjection = policy;
  return true;
}

/**
 * Devolve a política de projeção ativa.
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function getProjection() {
  return _activeProjection;
}

/**
 * Devolve o modo narrativo atual, lido do storage.
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function getMode() {
  return readMode();
}

/**
 * Devolve estatísticas de execução.
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function stats() {
  const cacheSize = _cache.size;
  const cacheMax = NARRATIVE_CONFIG.cacheSize;
  return {
    analyzed: _stats.analyzed,
    cached: _stats.cached,
    failed: _stats.failed,
    lastLatencyMs: _stats.lastLatencyMs,
    avgLatencyMs: _stats.avgLatencyMs,
    cacheSize,
    cacheMax,
    cacheHitRate: (_stats.cached + _stats.analyzed) > 0
      ? Math.round((_stats.cached / (_stats.cached + _stats.analyzed)) * 100) / 100
      : 0,
    hasLastIR: _lastValidIR !== null,
    projection: _activeProjection,
    backend: Adapter.backend(),
    backendVersion: Adapter.version(),
  };
}

/**
 * Limpa o cache interno. Não afeta `_lastValidIR`.
 * @returns {number}
 */
export function clearCache() {
  const n = _cache.size;
  _cache.clear();
  return n;
}

/**
 * Reset completo (para testes).
 * @internal
 */
export function reset() {
  _cache.clear();
  _lastValidIR = null;
  _activeProjection = DEFAULT_PROJECTION;
  _stats.analyzed = 0;
  _stats.cached = 0;
  _stats.failed = 0;
  _stats.lastLatencyMs = 0;
  _stats.avgLatencyMs = 0;
  _stats.totalLatencyMs = 0;
  try {
    Adapter.clearCache();
  } catch { /* isola */ }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// UTILITÁRIOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Devolve o timestamp atual em ISO.
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function _isoNow() {
  try {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

/**
 * Devolve o timestamp monotônico em ms.
 * @returns {number}
 * @private
 */
function _now() {
  if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
    return performance.now();
  }
  return Date.now();
}

/**
 * Serializa um IR em JSON (com Maps convertidos).
 * @param {NarrativeIR} ir
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function irToJSON(ir) {
  if (!ir) return null;

  const internal = ir._internal ?? {};

  return {
    version: ir.version,
    documentId: ir.documentId,
    generatedAt: ir.generatedAt,
    sourceHash: ir.sourceHash,
    acts: ir.acts,
    diagnostics: ir.diagnostics,
    index: ir.index,
    provenance: ir.provenance,
    sourceMap: sourceMapToJSON(internal.sourceMap),
    sentences: internal.sentences,
    spans: internal.spans,
    relations: internal.relations,
  };
}

/**
 * Devolve um resumo legível do IR.
 * @param {NarrativeIR} ir
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function summarize(ir) {
  if (!ir) return null;

  const diagStats = diagnosticsStats(ir.diagnostics);
  const internal = ir._internal ?? {};

  return {
    version: ir.version,
    actCount: ir.acts?.length ?? 0,
    diagnosticCount: ir.diagnostics?.length ?? 0,
    diagnosticsBySeverity: diagStats.bySeverity,
    entityCount: Object.keys(ir.index?.byEntity ?? {}).length,
    operationCount: Object.keys(ir.index?.byOperation ?? {}).length,
    sourceMapStats: sourceMapStats(internal.sourceMap),
    provenance: ir.provenance,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS — RE-EXPORTS ÚTEIS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Config
export { NARRATIVE_CONFIG, DEFAULT_PROJECTION } from './config.js';
export {
  MODES,
  DEFAULT_MODE,
  isModeValid,
  isProjectionValid,
  isLevelInScope,
} from './config.js';

// Modo
export {
  readMode,
  writeMode,
  clearMode,
  nextMode,
  modeLabel,
  modeDescription,
  canMutate,
  canAnalyze,
} from './mode.js';

// IR schema
export {
  IR_VERSION,
  OPERATIONS,
  VOICE_KINDS,
  FOCALIZATION_KINDS,
  DISCOURSE_FORMS,
  SEMANTIC_ROLES,
  EPISTEMIC_KINDS,
  TEMPORAL_FRAMES,
  ASPECT_KINDS,
  MODALITY_KINDS,
  NEGATION_KINDS,
  DIAGNOSTIC_SEVERITIES,
  DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES,
  DIAGNOSTIC_CODES,
} from './ir/schema.js';

// Validator
export { validateIR, validateAct } from './ir/validator.js';

// Source map
export {
  buildSourceMap,
  actToSource,
  sourceToAct,
  sourceToActs,
  spanKeyFor,
} from './ir/source-map.js';

// Interpreter
export {
  interpret,
  interpretDocument,
  interpretationStats,
} from './pipeline/interpreter.js';

// Segmenter
export {
  segment,
  segmentSentence,
  segmentStats,
} from './pipeline/segmenter.js';

// Diagnostics
export {
  makeDiagnostic,
  makeAmbiguousRefDiagnostic,
  makeLowConfidenceDiagnostic,
  makeExecutionDiagnostic,
  sortDiagnostics,
  hasErrors,
  countBySeverity,
} from './diagnostics/narrative-diagnostics.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FACHADA CONGELADA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Fachada pública congelada.
 * @type {Readonly<Object>}
 */
export const API = Object.freeze({
  analyze,
  analyzeSync,
  getLastIR,
  summarize,
  irToJSON,
  setProjection,
  getProjection,
  getMode,
  stats,
  clearCache,
  reset,
});

export default API;

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const CATALOG_VERSION = '2.0.0';

// Traits são propriedades booleanas que cortam através das operações.

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CATALOG — objeto agregado
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Objeto agregado com todas as partes do catálogo.
 * @type {Readonly<Object>}
 */
export const CATALOG = Object.freeze({
  version: CATALOG_VERSION,
  operations: OPERATIONS,
  traits: TRAITS,
  aliases: ALIASES,
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSULTAS — operações
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Lista os IDs de todas as operações, em ordem D1..D8.
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function operationIds() {
  return Object.keys(OPERATIONS);
}

/**
 * Verifica se um ID é uma operação válida.
 * @param {string} op
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isValidOperation(op) {
  return typeof op === 'string' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(OPERATIONS, op);
}

/**
 * Devolve a operação completa, ou null.
 * @param {string} op
 * @returns {Object|null}
 */
export function getOperation(op) {
  return isValidOperation(op) ? OPERATIONS[op] : null;
}

/**
 * Devolve o label PT-BR da operação.
 * @param {string} op
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function labelForOperation(op) {
  return OPERATIONS[op]?.label ?? op;
}

/**
 * Devolve a cor da operação (hex).
 * @param {string} op
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function colorForOperation(op) {
  return OPERATIONS[op]?.color ?? null;
}

/**
 * Devolve o papel da operação: 'core' | 'mind' | 'coord'.
 * @param {string} op
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function roleForOperation(op) {
  return OPERATIONS[op]?.role ?? null;
}

/**
 * Verifica se a operação é coordenadora.
 * @param {string} op
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isCoordinator(op) {
  return OPERATIONS[op]?.role === 'coord';
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSULTAS — subtipos
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Lista os IDs de subtipos de uma operação.
 * @param {string} op
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function subtypeIds(op) {
  const operation = OPERATIONS[op];
  return operation ? Object.keys(operation.subtypes ?? {}) : [];
}

/**
 * Verifica se um ID é um subtipo válido (dentro de uma operação).
 * @param {string} op
 * @param {string} st
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isValidSubtype(op, st) {
  const operation = OPERATIONS[op];
  if (!operation) return false;
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(operation.subtypes ?? {}, st);
}

/**
 * Verifica se um ID é um subtipo válido em qualquer operação.
 * @param {string} st
 * @returns {{ operation:string, subtype:string }|null}
 */
export function findSubtypeOwner(st) {
  for (const op of operationIds()) {
    if (isValidSubtype(op, st)) {
      return { operation: op, subtype: st };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Devolve o subtipo completo (com label, parent, traits).
 * @param {string} st
 * @returns {Object|null}
 */
export function getSubtype(st) {
  const owner = findSubtypeOwner(st);
  if (!owner) return null;
  return OPERATIONS[owner.operation].subtypes[st] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Devolve o label PT-BR do subtipo.
 * @param {string} st
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function labelForSubtype(st) {
  return getSubtype(st)?.label ?? st;
}

/**
 * Devolve o parent de um subtipo (para herança), ou null.
 * @param {string} st
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function parentOf(st) {
  return getSubtype(st)?.parent ?? null;
}

/**
 * Devolve os traits declarados de um subtipo (incluindo os da operação).
 * @param {string} op
 * @param {string} st
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function traitsForSubtype(op, st) {
  const operation = OPERATIONS[op];
  if (!operation) return [];
  const subtype = operation.subtypes?.[st];
  if (!subtype) return [];
  return [
    ...(operation.traits ?? []),
    ...(subtype.traits ?? []),
  ];
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSULTAS — eixos
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Lista os nomes dos eixos de uma operação.
 * @param {string} op
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function axisNames(op) {
  const operation = OPERATIONS[op];
  return operation?.axes ? Object.keys(operation.axes) : [];
}

/**
 * Verifica se uma operação tem um eixo.
 * @param {string} op
 * @param {string} axis
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isValidAxis(op, axis) {
  const operation = OPERATIONS[op];
  if (!operation?.axes) return false;
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(operation.axes, axis);
}

/**
 * Verifica se um valor é válido para um eixo.
 * @param {string} op
 * @param {string} axis
 * @param {string} value
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isValidAxisValue(op, axis, value) {
  const operation = OPERATIONS[op];
  if (!operation?.axes) return false;
  const values = operation.axes[axis];
  return Array.isArray(values) && values.includes(value);
}

/**
 * Devolve os valores válidos de um eixo.
 * @param {string} op
 * @param {string} axis
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function axisValues(op, axis) {
  const operation = OPERATIONS[op];
  const values = operation?.axes?.[axis];
  return Array.isArray(values) ? [...values] : [];
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSULTAS — traits
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Verifica se um trait existe no catálogo.
 * @param {string} trait
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isValidTrait(trait) {
  return typeof trait === 'string' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(TRAITS, trait);
}

/**
 * Devolve o label PT-BR de um trait.
 * @param {string} trait
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function labelForTrait(trait) {
  return TRAITS[trait]?.label ?? trait;
}

/**
 * Lista todos os traits do catálogo.
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function traitNames() {
  return Object.keys(TRAITS);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSULTAS — aliases
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Resolve um nome v1 para o ID canônico v2.
 * Se `name` já for um ID v2, devolve-o inalterado.
 * @param {string} name
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
export function resolveAlias(name) {
  if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name) return null;
  if (ALIASES[name]) return ALIASES[name];
  // Já é um ID v2?
  if (isValidOperation(name)) return name;
  if (findSubtypeOwner(name)) return name;
  return null;
}

/**
 * Verifica se um nome é um alias registrado.
 * @param {string} name
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isAlias(name) {
  return typeof name === 'string' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ALIASES, name);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ESTATÍSTICAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Estatísticas do catálogo. Útil para validação e testes.
 * @returns {{
 *   version: string,
 *   operations: number,
 *   subtypes: number,
 *   subtypesByOperation: Object<string, number>,
 *   axes: number,
 *   axesByOperation: Object<string, number>,
 *   traits: number,
 *   aliases: number,
 * }}
 */
export function catalogStats() {
  const subtypesByOperation = {};
  const axesByOperation = {};
  let totalSubtypes = 0;
  let totalAxes = 0;

  for (const [opId, op] of Object.entries(OPERATIONS)) {
    const stCount = Object.keys(op.subtypes ?? {}).length;
    const axCount = Object.keys(op.axes ?? {}).length;
    subtypesByOperation[opId] = stCount;
    axesByOperation[opId] = axCount;
    totalSubtypes += stCount;
    totalAxes += axCount;
  }

  return {
    version: CATALOG_VERSION,
    operations: Object.keys(OPERATIONS).length,
    subtypes: totalSubtypes,
    subtypesByOperation,
    axes: totalAxes,
    axesByOperation,
    traits: Object.keys(TRAITS).length,
    aliases: Object.keys(ALIASES).length,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// LISTAGEM PLANA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Lista plana de todos os subtipos com metadados.
 * Útil para UI e para o comando `narr.catalog`.
 * @returns {Array<{ operation:string, id:string, label:string, traits:string[], parent:string|null }>}
 */
export function allSubtypes() {
  const out = [];
  for (const [opId, op] of Object.entries(OPERATIONS)) {
    for (const [stId, st] of Object.entries(op.subtypes ?? {})) {
      out.push({
        operation: opId,
        id: stId,
        label: st.label ?? stId,
        traits: [...(op.traits ?? []), ...(st.traits ?? [])],
        parent: st.parent ?? null,
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Lista plana de todos os eixos com metadados.
 * @returns {Array<{ operation:string, axis:string, values:string[] }>}
 */
export function allAxes() {
  const out = [];
  for (const [opId, op] of Object.entries(OPERATIONS)) {
    for (const [axis, values] of Object.entries(op.axes ?? {})) {
      out.push({
        operation: opId,
        axis,
        values: [...values],
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS AGREGADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Fachada congelada do catálogo.
 * @type {Readonly<Object>}
 */
export const Catalog = Object.freeze({
  // Constantes
  CATALOG_VERSION,
  CATALOG,
  OPERATIONS,
  TRAITS,
  ALIASES,

  // Operações
  operationIds,
  isValidOperation,
  getOperation,
  labelForOperation,
  colorForOperation,
  roleForOperation,
  isCoordinator,

  // Subtipos
  subtypeIds,
  isValidSubtype,
  findSubtypeOwner,
  getSubtype,
  labelForSubtype,
  parentOf,
  traitsForSubtype,

  // Eixos
  axisNames,
  isValidAxis,
  isValidAxisValue,
  axisValues,

  // Traits
