```javascript
/**
 * @file interpreter.js
 * @module narrative-language/pipeline
 * @description Núcleo do frontend narrativo. Combina segmenter + analyzer +
 *              resolver + classifier + dimensions para produzir NarrativeAct[].
 * @imports narrative-language/pt-br/adapter,
 *          narrative-language/pipeline/segmenter,
 *          narrative-language/pipeline/analyzer,
 *          narrative-language/pipeline/resolver,
 *          narrative-language/pipeline/discourse-analyzer,
 *          narrative-language/acts/classifier,
 *          narrative-language/acts/dimensions,
 *          narrative-language/ir/schema
 * @importedBy narrative-language/index
 * @level N3
 *
 * Fase 14 — Subtipos propagados para o NarrativeAct.
 * Estágio 5 — Propagação do catálogo canônico Norma C.
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Bugfix P0-7 (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   `_mkDiag` classificava `EXECUTION_FAILED` como `'warning'`. Como
 *   `narrative-language/index.js` só promove um IR a `_lastValidIR`
 *   quando `!hasErrors(diagnostics)`, IRs parcialmente falhos eram
 *   promovidos silenciosamente.
 *
 *   Correção: `EXECUTION_FAILED` agora é `'error'`. Uma tabela de
 *   severidades substitui o ternário rígido, permitindo override por
 *   código sem reescrever o formato.
 */

import { Adapter } from '../pt-br/adapter.js';
import { segment } from './segmenter.js';
import { analyze } from './analyzer.js';
import { resolve } from './resolver.js';
import { analyzeDiscourse } from './discourse-analyzer.js';
import { classify } from '../acts/classifier.js';
import { extractDimensions } from '../acts/dimensions.js';
import {
  OPERATIONS,
  SEMANTIC_ROLES,
} from '../ir/schema.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTANTES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Comprimento máximo de sentença processável.
 * @type {number}
 * @private
 */
const _MAX_SENTENCE_LENGTH = 400;

/**
 * Versão do interpreter (para provenance).
 * @type {string}
 * @private
 */
const _VERSION = 'interpreter-1.2.1';

/**
 * Mapa de severidade por código de diagnóstico.
 * Códigos ausentes caem em `'info'` (default seguro).
 *
 * @type {Readonly<Object<string, string>>}
 * @private
 */
const _SEVERITY_MAP = Object.freeze({
  EXECUTION_FAILED: 'error',
  SYN_NO_VERB:      'info',
  SYN_AMBIGUOUS_SUBJECT: 'info',
  SEM_OP_LOW_CONFIDENCE: 'info',
});

/**
 * Severidade default quando o código não está no mapa.
 * @type {string}
 * @private
 */
const _DEFAULT_SEVERITY = 'info';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Monta uma Reference a partir de um lemma + resolução.
 * @private
 */
function _mkReferenceFromLemma(lemma, resolution, raw) {
  const found = (resolution?.references ?? []).find(
    (r) => r.lemma === lemma || r.raw?.toLowerCase() === String(lemma).toLowerCase()
  );

  if (found) return found;

  return {
    kind: 'literal',
    entityId: null,
    raw: raw ?? lemma,
    lemma,
    resolvedFrom: null,
    confidence: 0.5,
  };
}

/**
 * Constrói o objeto `proposition` a partir do modelo e da resolução.
 * @private
 */
function _buildProposition(model, resolution) {
  const roles = {};

  for (const [roleName, lemma] of Object.entries(model.semanticRoles ?? {})) {
    if (!SEMANTIC_ROLES.includes(roleName)) continue;
    if (typeof lemma !== 'string' || !lemma) continue;

    roles[roleName] = _mkReferenceFromLemma(lemma, resolution, lemma);
  }

  return {
    predicate: model.predicate ?? '',
    predicateLemma: model.predicateLemma ?? '',
    roles,
  };
}

/**
 * Coleta todas as referências relevantes de uma sentença.
 * @private
 */
function _collectReferences(resolution) {
  if (!Array.isArray(resolution?.references)) return [];
  return resolution.references.slice();
}

/**
 * Cria um ID canônico para um ato.
 * @private
 */
function _mkActId(sentenceId, n) {
  return `act-${sentenceId}-${n}`;
}

/**
 * Cria um diagnóstico de execução do interpreter.
 *
 * Fase 13.7: usa `_SEVERITY_MAP` em vez de ternário rígido.
 *
 * @param {string} code
 * @param {string} message
 * @param {Object|null} span
 * @param {Object|null} [context=null]
 * @returns {Object}
 * @private
 */
function _mkDiag(code, message, span, context = null) {
  return {
    severity: _SEVERITY_MAP[code] ?? _DEFAULT_SEVERITY,
    phase: 'execution',
    code,
    message,
    sourceSpan: span ?? null,
    suggestions: [],
    related: [],
    context,
  };
}

/**
 * Constrói o objeto de proveniência para um ato.
 * @private
 */
function _mkProvenance(extras = {}) {
  return {
    segmenter: 'segmenter-1.0.0',
    nlpBackend: Adapter.backend(),
    classifier: 'classifier-2.0.0',
    lexicon: 'lexicon-2.0.0',
    catalog: '2.0.0',
    analyzedBy: _VERSION,
    analyzedAt: 0,
    ...extras,
  };
}

/**
 * Normaliza `subtypes` para formato rich (cópia defensiva).
 * Aceita: objeto rich (D-numbers), objeto flat (v1), ou undefined.
 * @private
 */
function _normalizeSubtypes(raw) {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) return {};

  const out = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(raw)) {
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.id === 'string') {
      out[key] = {
        operation: value.operation ?? key,
        id: value.id,
        label: value.label ?? value.id,
        confidence: typeof value.confidence === 'number' ? value.confidence : 0,
        source: value.source ?? 'unknown',
        reason: value.reason ?? '',
        value: value.value ?? '',
        traits: Array.isArray(value.traits) ? [...value.traits] : [],
        chain: Array.isArray(value.chain) ? [...value.chain] : [],
      };
      continue;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'string' && /^D\d/.test(value)) {
      out[key] = {
        operation: key,
        id: value,
        label: value,
        confidence: 0,
        source: 'flat',
        reason: '',
        value: '',
        traits: [],
        chain: [],
      };
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Normaliza `subtypesFlat` (v1) para formato plano.
 * @private
 */
function _normalizeSubtypesFlat(raw) {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) return {};
  const out = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(raw)) {
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      out[key] = value;
      continue;
    }
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.id === 'string') {
      out[key] = value.id;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Normaliza `axes` para cópia defensiva.
 * @private
 */
function _normalizeAxes(raw) {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) return {};
  const out = {};
  for (const [op, opAxes] of Object.entries(raw)) {
    if (!opAxes || typeof opAxes !== 'object') continue;
    const copy = {};
    for (const [axis, value] of Object.entries(opAxes)) {
      if (typeof value === 'string') copy[axis] = value;
    }
    if (Object.keys(copy).length > 0) out[op] = copy;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Normaliza `traits` para array de strings únicos.
 * Aceita: array, Set, ou undefined.
 * @private
 */
function _normalizeTraits(raw) {
  if (!raw) return [];
  if (raw instanceof Set) return Array.from(raw);
  if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
    return Array.from(new Set(raw.filter((t) => typeof t === 'string')));
  }
  return [];
}

/**
 * Constrói um NarrativeAct a partir das peças.
 * @private
 */
function _buildAct({ id, sentence, model, resolution, classification, dimensions }) {
  const operations = (classification.selected ?? []).filter((op) =>
    OPERATIONS.includes(op)
  );

  const finalOperations = operations.length > 0 ? operations : ['represent'];

  const confidence = classification.candidates?.[0]?.confidence ?? 0.5;

  const evidence = [];
  for (const c of classification.candidates ?? []) {
    for (const e of c.evidence ?? []) {
      evidence.push({
        source: e.source,
        value: e.value,
        reason: `[${c.operation}] ${e.reason}`,
        weight: e.weight,
      });
    }
  }

  const proposition = _buildProposition(model, resolution);
  const references = _collectReferences(resolution);

  let focalization = dimensions.focalization;
  if (finalOperations.includes('focalize') && !focalization) {
    const g = model.construction?.groups;
    const target = g?.focalizer ?? g?.perceiver ?? null;
    if (target) {
      focalization = { kind: 'character', targetId: target };
    } else {
      focalization = { kind: 'unknown', targetId: null };
    }
  }

  const subtypes     = _normalizeSubtypes(classification.subtypes);
  const subtypesFlat = _normalizeSubtypesFlat(classification.subtypesV1);
  const axes         = _normalizeAxes(classification.axes);
  const traits       = _normalizeTraits(classification.traits);

  return {
    id,
    kind: 'narrative-act',
    operations: finalOperations,
    subtypes,
    subtypesFlat,
    axes,
    traits,
    confidence: Math.round(confidence * 100) / 100,
    evidence,
    voice: dimensions.voice ?? { kind: 'narrator', sourceId: null },
    focalization,
    form: dimensions.form ?? 'narration',
    tense: dimensions.tense ?? null,
    aspect: dimensions.aspect ?? null,
    modality: dimensions.modality ?? null,
    negation: dimensions.negation ?? null,
    epistemic: dimensions.epistemic ?? null,
    proposition,
    references,
    discourseRelations: [],
    source: sentence.source,
    provenance: _mkProvenance({
      sentenceId: sentence.id,
      constructionId: model.construction?.id ?? null,
    }),
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PRINCIPAL — UMA SENTENÇA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Interpreta uma sentença.
 *
 * @param {Object} sentence — de segmenter.js
 * @param {Object} [context={}]
 * @returns {Promise<{ acts:NarrativeAct[], diagnostics:NarrativeDiagnostic[] }>}
 */
export async function interpret(sentence, context = {}) {
  const diagnostics = [];

  if (!sentence || typeof sentence.raw !== 'string' || sentence.raw.length === 0) {
    return { acts: [], diagnostics };
  }

  if (sentence.raw.length > _MAX_SENTENCE_LENGTH) {
    diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
      'SYN_NO_VERB',
      `Sentença longa demais (${sentence.raw.length} chars) — pulada`,
      sentence.source,
      { reason: 'too-long' }
    ));
    return { acts: [], diagnostics };
  }

  // ── 1. NLP analysis (async) ─────────────────────────────
  let nlp;
  try {
    nlp = await Adapter.analyze(sentence.raw);
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
      'EXECUTION_FAILED',
      `Adapter falhou: ${err.message}`,
      sentence.source
    ));
    return { acts: [], diagnostics };
  }

  // ── 2. Análise linguística ──────────────────────────────
  let model;
  try {
    model = analyze(sentence, nlp, context);
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
      'EXECUTION_FAILED',
      `Analyzer falhou: ${err.message}`,
      sentence.source
    ));
    return { acts: [], diagnostics };
  }

  // ── 3. Resolução de referências ─────────────────────────
  let resolution;
  try {
    resolution = resolve(model, context, context.overrides ?? null);
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
      'EXECUTION_FAILED',
      `Resolver falhou: ${err.message}`,
      sentence.source
    ));
    resolution = { references: [], diagnostics: [], confidence: 0 };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(resolution.diagnostics)) {
    diagnostics.push(...resolution.diagnostics);
  }

  // ── 4. Classificação ────────────────────────────────────
  let classification;
  try {
    classification = classify(model, resolution, context);
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
      'EXECUTION_FAILED',
      `Classifier falhou: ${err.message}`,
      sentence.source
    ));
    classification = {
      candidates: [],
      selected: [],
      primary: null,
      subtypes: {},
      subtypesV1: {},
      axes: {},
      traits: [],
      hints: { focalization: null, interiority: null, epistemic: null, rule: null },
    };
  }

  const topConf = classification.candidates?.[0]?.confidence ?? 0;
  if (topConf > 0 && topConf < 0.70) {
    diagnostics.push({
      severity: 'info',
      phase: 'semantic',
      code: 'SEM_OP_LOW_CONFIDENCE',
      message: `Classificação com baixa confiança (${topConf.toFixed(2)})`,
      sourceSpan: sentence.source,
      suggestions: [],
      related: [],
      context: {
        candidates: (classification.candidates ?? []).map((c) => ({
          operation: c.operation,
          confidence: c.confidence,
        })),
      },
    });
  }

  // ── 5. Dimensões ────────────────────────────────────────
  let dimensions;
  try {
    dimensions = extractDimensions(model, resolution, context);
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
      'EXECUTION_FAILED',
      `Dimensions falhou: ${err.message}`,
      sentence.source
    ));
    dimensions = {
      voice: { kind: 'narrator', sourceId: null },
      focalization: null,
      form: 'narration',
      tense: null,
      aspect: null,
      modality: null,
      negation: null,
      epistemic: 'fact',
    };
  }

  // ── 6. Monta o NarrativeAct ─────────────────────────────
  let act;
  try {
    act = _buildAct({
      id: _mkActId(sentence.id, 1),
      sentence,
      model,
      resolution,
      classification,
      dimensions,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
      'EXECUTION_FAILED',
      `Build do act falhou: ${err.message}`,
      sentence.source
    ));
    return { acts: [], diagnostics };
  }

  // ── 7. Diagnósticos locais do model ─────────────────────
  if (Array.isArray(model.diagnostics)) {
    for (const d of model.diagnostics) {
      diagnostics.push({
        ...d,
        sourceSpan: d.sourceSpan ?? sentence.source,
      });
    }
  }

  return { acts: [act], diagnostics };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PRINCIPAL — DOCUMENTO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Interpreta um documento inteiro.
 *
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {Object} [context={}]
 * @returns {Promise<{
 *   acts: NarrativeAct[],
 *   diagnostics: NarrativeDiagnostic[],
 *   sentences: Sentence[],
 *   spans: Span[],
 *   relations: DiscourseRelation[],
 *   sourceMap: Map<string, SourceSpan>,
 * }>}
 */
export async function interpretDocument(text, context = {}) {
  const acts = [];
  const diagnostics = [];
  const sourceMap = new Map();

  // ── 1. Segmentação ──────────────────────────────────────
  let seg;
  try {
    seg = segment(text);
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      acts: [],
      diagnostics: [_mkDiag('EXECUTION_FAILED', `Segmenter falhou: ${err.message}`, null)],
      sentences: [],
      spans: [],
      relations: [],
      sourceMap,
    };
  }

  // ── 2. Interpretação por sentença ───────────────────────
  for (const sentence of seg.sentences) {
    let result;
    try {
      result = await interpret(sentence, context);
    } catch (err) {
      diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
        'EXECUTION_FAILED',
        `Interpreter falhou em "${sentence.id}": ${err.message}`,
        sentence.source
      ));
      continue;
    }

    for (const act of result.acts) {
      acts.push(act);
      sourceMap.set(act.id, act.source);
    }
    for (const d of result.diagnostics) {
      diagnostics.push(d);
    }
  }

  // ── 3. Análise de discurso ──────────────────────────────
  let relations = [];
  try {
    relations = analyzeDiscourse(seg, context);
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.push(_mkDiag(
      'EXECUTION_FAILED',
      `Discourse analyzer falhou: ${err.message}`,
      null
    ));
  }

  // ── 4. Anexa relações aos atos correspondentes ──────────
  if (Array.isArray(relations) && relations.length > 0) {
    const actBySpan = new Map();
    for (const act of acts) {
      const sid = act.provenance?.sentenceId;
      if (sid) actBySpan.set(`${sid}.1`, act);
    }

    for (const rel of relations) {
      const from = actBySpan.get(rel.fromSpanId);
      const to = actBySpan.get(rel.toSpanId);

      if (from && to) {
        from.discourseRelations.push({
          kind: rel.kind,
          fromActId: from.id,
          toActId: to.id,
        });
      } else {
        const target = from ?? to;
        if (target) {
          target.discourseRelations.push({
            kind: rel.kind,
            fromActId: rel.fromSpanId,
            toActId: rel.toSpanId,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    acts,
    diagnostics,
    sentences: seg.sentences,
    spans: seg.spans,
    relations,
    sourceMap,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// UTILITÁRIOS DE DEBUG
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Devolve estatísticas de interpretação.
 *
 * @param {Object} result
 * @returns {Object}
 */
export function interpretationStats(result) {
  if (!result) return null;

  const opCounts = {};
  const subtypeCounts = {};
  const axesCounts = {};
  const traitCounts = {};

  for (const act of result.acts ?? []) {
    for (const op of act.operations ?? []) {
      opCounts[op] = (opCounts[op] ?? 0) + 1;
    }

    const subs = act.subtypes ?? {};
    for (const [dOp, sub] of Object.entries(subs)) {
      const key = `${dOp}:${sub.id ?? '?'}`;
      subtypeCounts[key] = (subtypeCounts[key] ?? 0) + 1;
    }

    const axes = act.axes ?? {};
    for (const [op, opAxes] of Object.entries(axes)) {
      for (const [axis, value] of Object.entries(opAxes ?? {})) {
        const key = `${op}.${axis}=${value}`;
        axesCounts[key] = (axesCounts[key] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
    }

    const traits = Array.isArray(act.traits) ? act.traits : [];
    for (const t of traits) {
      traitCounts[t] = (traitCounts[t] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  return {
    actCount: result.acts?.length ?? 0,
    sentenceCount: result.sentences?.length ?? 0,
    spanCount: result.spans?.length ?? 0,
    diagnosticCount: result.diagnostics?.length ?? 0,
    relationsCount: result.relations?.length ?? 0,
    operations: opCounts,
    subtypes: subtypeCounts,
    axes: axesCounts,
    traits: traitCounts,
  };
}

/**
 * Versão do interpreter.
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function version() {
  return _VERSION;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS AGREGADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const Interpreter = Object.freeze({
  interpret,
  interpretDocument,
  interpretationStats,
  version,
});
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file resolver.js
 * @module narrative-language/pipeline
 * @description Resolução de referências (pronomes, sintagmas definidos) para
 *              entidades do contexto. Aplica overrides do autor e preferências
 *              aprendidas (user-lexicon). Emite diagnósticos de ambiguidade.
 * @imports narrative-language/ir/schema,
 *          narrative-language/pt-br/lexicon,
 *          narrative-language/user-lexicon
 * @importedBy narrative-language/pipeline/interpreter,
 *             narrative-language/acts/dimensions,
 *             narrative-language/index
 * @level N2
 *
 * Fase 7 — LUME:
 *   - `_collectCandidates` consulta user-lexicon e aplica boost.
 *   - `_resolveToken` computa chaves candidatas (`<sid>.t<i>` e
 *     `<sid>.o<offset>`) para localizar overrides em múltiplos formatos.
 *   - `_collectExplicit` também aplica boost de lexicon.
 */

import {
  DIAGNOSTIC_CODES,
  DIAGNOSTIC_SEVERITIES,
} from '../ir/schema.js';
import { classOf as lexClassOf } from '../pt-br/lexicon.js';
import { boostFor as lexiconBoostFor } from '../user-lexicon.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTANTES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Pronomes pessoais e suas propriedades de gênero/número.
 * @type {Readonly<Object<string, { gender:string|null, number:string, person:number }>>}
 * @private
 */
const _PRONOUNS = Object.freeze({
  'ele':     { gender: 'masculine', number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'ela':     { gender: 'feminine',  number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'eles':    { gender: 'masculine', number: 'plural',   person: 3 },
  'elas':    { gender: 'feminine',  number: 'plural',   person: 3 },
  'você':    { gender: null,        number: 'singular', person: 2 },
  'vocês':   { gender: null,        number: 'plural',   person: 2 },
  'eu':      { gender: null,        number: 'singular', person: 1 },
  'nós':     { gender: null,        number: 'plural',   person: 1 },
  'isto':    { gender: null,        number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'isso':    { gender: null,        number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'aquilo':  { gender: null,        number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'este':    { gender: 'masculine', number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'esta':    { gender: 'feminine',  number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'esse':    { gender: 'masculine', number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'essa':    { gender: 'feminine',  number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'aquele':  { gender: 'masculine', number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'aquela':  { gender: 'feminine',  number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'o':       { gender: 'masculine', number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'a':       { gender: 'feminine',  number: 'singular', person: 3 },
  'os':      { gender: 'masculine', number: 'plural',   person: 3 },
  'as':      { gender: 'feminine',  number: 'plural',   person: 3 },
});

/**
 * Confiança por fonte de resolução.
 * @type {Readonly<Object<string, number>>}
 * @private
 */
const _SOURCE_CONFIDENCE = Object.freeze({
  override:     1.00,
  explicit:     0.98,
  scene:        0.85,
  recent:       0.70,
  chapter:      0.55,
  project:      0.40,
  unresolved:   0.00,
});

/**
 * Limite abaixo do qual dois candidatos são considerados empatados.
 * @type {number}
 * @private
 */
const _AMBIGUITY_THRESHOLD = 0.15;

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS INTERNOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function _isPronoun(lemma) {
  return lemma in _PRONOUNS;
}

function _mkDiag(code, message, span, context = null) {
  const meta = DIAGNOSTIC_CODES[code] ?? {
    severity: 'warning',
    phase: 'referential',
  };
  return {
    severity: meta.severity,
    phase: meta.phase,
    code,
    message,
    sourceSpan: span,
    suggestions: [],
    related: [],
    context,
  };
}

function _mkReference(kind, entityId, raw, lemma, resolvedFrom, confidence) {
  return {
    kind,
    entityId: kind === 'entity' ? entityId : null,
    raw: String(raw ?? ''),
    lemma: String(lemma ?? raw ?? ''),
    resolvedFrom,
    confidence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, confidence)),
  };
}

function _compareCandidates(a, b) {
  if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
  return String(a.entityId).localeCompare(String(b.entityId));
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COLETA DE CANDIDATOS (com lexicon boost)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Coleta todos os candidatos possíveis para uma referência pronominal.
 * Aplica boost de user-lexicon se `lexicon` for fornecido.
 *
 * @param {Object} pronoun — { gender, number, person, lemma }
 * @param {Object} ctx
 * @param {Map<string, Object>|null} lexicon
 * @returns {Candidate[]}
 * @private
 */
function _collectCandidates(pronoun, ctx, lexicon) {
  const out = [];
  const seenIds = new Set();

  const push = (entity, source) => {
    if (!entity || !entity.id) return;
    if (seenIds.has(entity.id)) return;
    seenIds.add(entity.id);

    if (pronoun.gender && entity.gender && entity.gender !== pronoun.gender) return;
    if (pronoun.number && entity.number && entity.number !== pronoun.number) return;

    let score = _SOURCE_CONFIDENCE[source] ?? 0.3;

    // Boost do lexicon — só quando o lemma do pronome tem preferência
    if (lexicon && pronoun.lemma) {
      try {
        const boost = lexiconBoostFor(pronoun.lemma, entity.id, lexicon);
        if (boost > 0) score = Math.min(1, score + boost);
      } catch { /* isola */ }
    }

    out.push({
      entityId: entity.id,
      name: entity.name ?? entity.id,
      shortId: entity.shortId ?? '',
      gender: entity.gender ?? null,
      number: entity.number ?? null,
      source,
      score,
    });
  };

  for (const e of ctx.sceneEntities ?? []) push(e, 'scene');
  for (const e of ctx.recentEntities ?? []) push(e, 'recent');
  for (const e of ctx.chapterEntities ?? []) push(e, 'chapter');
  for (const e of ctx.projectEntities ?? []) push(e, 'project');

  return out.sort(_compareCandidates);
}

/**
 * Coleta candidatos para referência explícita (nome próprio).
 * Também aplica boost de lexicon.
 *
 * @param {string} raw
 * @param {string} lemma
 * @param {Object} ctx
 * @param {Map<string, Object>|null} lexicon
 * @returns {Candidate[]}
 * @private
 */
function _collectExplicit(raw, lemma, ctx, lexicon) {
  const target = String(raw ?? lemma ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!target) return [];

  const out = [];
  const seenIds = new Set();
  const all = [
    ...(ctx.sceneEntities ?? []),
    ...(ctx.recentEntities ?? []),
    ...(ctx.chapterEntities ?? []),
    ...(ctx.projectEntities ?? []),
  ];

  for (const e of all) {
    if (!e || !e.id || seenIds.has(e.id)) continue;
    const name = String(e.name ?? '').toLowerCase();
    const shortId = String(e.shortId ?? '').toLowerCase();
    if (name === target || shortId === target || name.split(/\s+/)[0] === target) {
      seenIds.add(e.id);

      let score = _SOURCE_CONFIDENCE.explicit;
      if (lexicon) {
        try {
          const boost = lexiconBoostFor(target, e.id, lexicon);
          if (boost > 0) score = Math.min(1, score + boost);
        } catch { /* isola */ }
      }

      out.push({
        entityId: e.id,
        name: e.name ?? e.id,
        shortId: e.shortId ?? '',
        gender: e.gender ?? null,
        number: e.number ?? null,
        source: 'explicit',
        score,
      });
    }
  }

  return out.sort(_compareCandidates);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// APLICAÇÃO DE OVERRIDES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Aplica um override a candidatos. Tenta todas as chaves fornecidas
 * em ordem; a primeira que casar ganha.
 *
 * @param {string[]} keys
 * @param {Candidate[]} candidates
 * @param {Map<string, Object>} overrides
 * @returns {{ candidates:Candidate[], applied:boolean, choseId:string|null, usedKey:string|null }}
 * @private
 */
function _applyOverride(keys, candidates, overrides) {
  if (!overrides || !(overrides instanceof Map)) {
    return { candidates, applied: false, choseId: null, usedKey: null };
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(keys) || keys.length === 0) {
    return { candidates, applied: false, choseId: null, usedKey: null };
  }

  let ov = null;
  let usedKey = null;

  for (const k of keys) {
    if (!k) continue;
    const entry = overrides.get(k);
    if (entry && entry.chose) {
      ov = entry;
      usedKey = k;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!ov) return { candidates, applied: false, choseId: null, usedKey: null };

  const chosen = candidates.find((c) => c.entityId === ov.chose);
  if (!chosen) {
    return {
      candidates: [{
        entityId: ov.chose,
        name: ov.chose,
        shortId: '',
        gender: null,
        number: null,
        source: 'override',
        score: _SOURCE_CONFIDENCE.override,
      }],
      applied: true,
      choseId: ov.chose,
      usedKey,
    };
  }

  return {
    candidates: [{ ...chosen, source: 'override', score: _SOURCE_CONFIDENCE.override }],
    applied: true,
    choseId: ov.chose,
    usedKey,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// RESOLUÇÃO POR TOKEN
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function _isReferenceToken(token) {
  if (!token || typeof token.lemma !== 'string') return false;
  if (token.pos === 'PRON') return true;
  if (token.pos === 'PROPN') return true;
  return false;
}

/**
 * Computa todas as chaves canônicas para um token. O resolver tenta
 * em ordem de prioridade (`.o<offset>` primeiro, depois `.t<index>`).
 *
 * @param {string} sentenceId
 * @param {number} tokenIndex
 * @param {Object} token
 * @returns {string[]}
 * @private
 */
function _keysForToken(sentenceId, tokenIndex, token) {
  const keys = [];
  const sid = String(sentenceId || 's1');

  const offset = token?.source?.start;
  if (typeof offset === 'number') {
    keys.push(`${sid}.o${offset}`);
  }
  keys.push(`${sid}.t${tokenIndex}`);
  return keys;
}

/**
 * Resolve um único token de referência.
 *
 * @param {Object} token
 * @param {number} tokenIndex
 * @param {Object} ctx
 * @param {Map<string, Object>} overrides
 * @param {Map<string, Object>|null} lexicon
 * @param {string} sentenceId
 * @returns {{ reference:Object, diagnostic:Object|null }}
 * @private
 */
function _resolveToken(token, tokenIndex, ctx, overrides, lexicon, sentenceId) {
  const raw = token.text;
  const lemma = (token.lemma ?? raw ?? '').toLowerCase();

  const keys = _keysForToken(sentenceId, tokenIndex, token);

  // ── Caso A: pronome ────────────────────────────────────
  if (_isPronoun(lemma)) {
    const info = _PRONOUNS[lemma];
    const pronoun = {
      gender: info.gender,
      number: info.number,
      person: info.person,
      lemma,
    };

    const all = _collectCandidates(pronoun, ctx, lexicon);
    const { candidates, applied } = _applyOverride(keys, all, overrides);

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return {
        reference: _mkReference('unresolved', null, raw, lemma, null, 0),
        diagnostic: _mkDiag(
          'REF_UNRESOLVED',
          `Referência "${raw}" sem candidato resolvível`,
          token.source ?? null,
          { raw, lemma, keys }
        ),
      };
    }

    if (applied) {
      return {
        reference: _mkReference(
          'entity', candidates[0].entityId, raw, lemma, 'override', 1.0
        ),
        diagnostic: null,
      };
    }

    if (candidates.length >= 2) {
      const [a, b] = candidates;
      if (Math.abs(a.score - b.score) < _AMBIGUITY_THRESHOLD) {
        return {
          reference: _mkReference(
            'unresolved', null, raw, lemma, null, a.score
          ),
          diagnostic: _mkDiag(
            'REF_AMBIGUOUS',
            `Referência "${raw}" ambígua entre ${candidates.length} candidatos`,
            token.source ?? null,
            {
              raw,
              lemma,
              keys,
              candidates: candidates.slice(0, 5).map((c) => ({
                entityId: c.entityId,
                name: c.name,
                score: c.score,
              })),
            }
          ),
        };
      }
    }

    return {
      reference: _mkReference(
        'entity',
        candidates[0].entityId,
        raw,
        lemma,
        candidates[0].source,
        candidates[0].score
      ),
      diagnostic: null,
    };
  }

  // ── Caso B: nome próprio ───────────────────────────────
  if (token.pos === 'PROPN') {
    const all = _collectExplicit(raw, lemma, ctx, lexicon);
    const { candidates, applied } = _applyOverride(keys, all, overrides);

    if (applied) {
      return {
        reference: _mkReference(
          'entity', candidates[0].entityId, raw, lemma, 'override', 1.0
        ),
        diagnostic: null,
      };
    }

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return {
        reference: _mkReference('literal', null, raw, lemma, 'proper', 0.5),
        diagnostic: null,
      };
    }

    return {
      reference: _mkReference(
        'entity',
        candidates[0].entityId,
        raw,
        lemma,
        'explicit',
        _SOURCE_CONFIDENCE.explicit
      ),
      diagnostic: null,
    };
  }

  return { reference: null, diagnostic: null };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PRINCIPAL
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Resolve todas as referências de um LinguisticModel.
 *
 * @param {Object} model      — de analyzer.js
 * @param {Object} [ctx={}]   — contexto narrativo
 * @param {Map<string, Object>} [overrides=null]  — overrides do autor
 * @returns {ResolutionResult}
 */
export function resolve(model, ctx = {}, overrides = null) {
  if (!model || !Array.isArray(model.tokens)) {
    return {
      references: [],
      diagnostics: [],
      confidence: 0,
      unresolvedCandidates: [],
    };
  }

  const references = [];
  const diagnostics = [];
  const unresolvedCandidates = [];
  const sentenceId = model.sentenceId ?? 's1';

  // Lexicon: passado via ctx.userLexicon
  const lexicon = ctx.userLexicon instanceof Map ? ctx.userLexicon : null;

  for (let i = 0; i < model.tokens.length; i++) {
    const token = model.tokens[i];
    if (!_isReferenceToken(token)) continue;

    let result;
    try {
      result = _resolveToken(token, i, ctx, overrides, lexicon, sentenceId);
    } catch {
      result = {
        reference: _mkReference('unresolved', null, token.text, token.lemma, null, 0),
        diagnostic: null,
      };
    }

    if (result.reference) references.push(result.reference);
    if (result.diagnostic) {
      diagnostics.push(result.diagnostic);
      if (result.diagnostic.context?.candidates) {
        for (const c of result.diagnostic.context.candidates) {
          unresolvedCandidates.push({
            entityId: c.entityId,
            name: c.name,
            shortId: '',
            gender: null,
            number: null,
            source: 'ambiguous',
            score: c.score,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const resolved = references.filter((r) => r.kind === 'entity');
  const confidence = resolved.length > 0
    ? resolved.reduce((s, r) => s + r.confidence, 0) / resolved.length
    : (references.length > 0 ? 0.5 : 1.0);

  return {
    references,
    diagnostics,
    confidence: Math.round(confidence * 100) / 100,
    unresolvedCandidates,
  };
}

/**
 * Aplica overrides a uma lista de candidatos (para UI).
 * @param {string[]|string} keys
 * @param {Candidate[]} candidates
 * @param {Map<string, Object>} overrides
 * @returns {{ candidates:Candidate[], applied:boolean, choseId:string|null, usedKey:string|null }}
 */
export function applyOverride(keys, candidates, overrides) {
  const keyList = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
  return _applyOverride(keyList, candidates, overrides);
}

/**
 * Lista os pronomes reconhecidos.
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function listPronouns() {
  return Object.keys(_PRONOUNS);
}

/**
 * Devolve as propriedades de um pronome, ou null.
 * @param {string} lemma
 * @returns {Object|null}
 */
export function pronounInfo(lemma) {
  const info = _PRONOUNS[lemma];
  return info ? { ...info, lemma } : null;
}

/**
 * Devolve as confidences por fonte (para debug/UI).
 * @returns {Readonly<Object<string, number>>}
 */
export function sourceConfidences() {
  return _SOURCE_CONFIDENCE;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS AGREGADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const Resolver = Object.freeze({
  resolve,
  applyOverride,
  listPronouns,
  pronounInfo,
  sourceConfidences,
});
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file segmenter.js
 * @module narrative-language/pipeline
 * @description Segmentação de texto em sentenças e spans com offsets
 *              absolutos preservados. Respeita abreviações, números
 *              decimais, travessões de diálogo e reticências.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy narrative-language/pipeline/interpreter,
 *             narrative-language/index
 * @level N1
 *
 * Contrato:
 *   segment(text) → { sentences: Sentence[], spans: Span[], text: string }
 *
 * Determinismo: IDs são posicionais (`s1`, `s2`, ...), estáveis sob
 * re-segmentação do mesmo texto. Reanálise da mesma string produz
 * exatamente os mesmos IDs.
 *
 * Escopo (Fase 1):
 *   - Detecção de fim de sentença (. ! ? … ?! !?)
 *   - Respeito a abreviações (Dr. Sr. Sra. etc.)
 *   - Respeito a números decimais (3.14)
 *   - Detecção de discurso direto com travessão (—)
 *   - Segmentação de spans internos (coordenação, subordinação)
 *
 * Fora de escopo (fases posteriores):
 *   - Análise semântica de spans
 *   - Detecção de encaixes complexos
 *   - Estrutura de parágrafos (retorna flat)
 */

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTANTES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Abreviações que NÃO terminam sentença.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
const ABBREVIATIONS = Object.freeze([
  'dr', 'dra', 'sr', 'sra', 'srta',
  'prof', 'profa', 'eng', 'engª',
  'etc', 'ex', 'obs', 'p.ex', 'pag',
  'av', 'r', 'tv', 'ed',
  'a.c', 'd.c', 'aC', 'dC',
]);

/**
 * Marcadores de coordenação que separam spans dentro de uma sentença.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
const COORD_MARKERS = Object.freeze([
  ' e ', ' mas ', ' ou ', ' porém ', ' contudo ', ' entretanto ',
  ' todavia ', ' nem ', ' portanto ',
]);

/**
 * Marcadores de subordinação que iniciam spans dependentes.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
const SUBORD_MARKERS = Object.freeze([
  'quando ', 'se ', 'enquanto ', 'porque ', 'embora ',
  'caso ', 'conforme ', 'segundo ', 'depois que ',
  'antes que ', 'sempre que ', 'assim que ',
]);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DETECÇÃO DE FIM DE SENTENÇA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Verifica se um `.` na posição `i` é decimal (parte de número).
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {number} i
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */
function _isDecimalPoint(text, i) {
  if (i <= 0 || i >= text.length - 1) return false;
  const prev = text[i - 1];
  const next = text[i + 1];
  return /\d/.test(prev) && /\d/.test(next);
}

/**
 * Verifica se um `.` na posição `i` fecha uma abreviação conhecida.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {number} i
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */
function _isAbbreviation(text, i) {
  // Pega a palavra antes do ponto (até 10 chars para trás)
  let j = i - 1;
  while (j >= 0 && /[A-Za-zÀ-ÿ.]/.test(text[j]) && i - j < 12) j--;
  const word = text.slice(j + 1, i).toLowerCase().replace(/\./g, '');
  return ABBREVIATIONS.includes(word);
}

/**
 * Verifica se um `.` na posição `i` é fim real de sentença.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {number} i
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */
function _isSentenceEnd(text, i) {
  const ch = text[i];

  if (ch === '!' || ch === '?') return true;
  if (ch === '…') return true;

  if (ch === '.') {
    if (_isDecimalPoint(text, i)) return false;
    if (_isAbbreviation(text, i)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SEGMENTAÇÃO DE SENTENÇAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * @typedef {Object} SourceSpan
 * @property {number} start
 * @property {number} end
 * @property {number} line
 * @property {number} column
 * @property {string} raw
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} Sentence
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {string} raw
 * @property {SourceSpan} source
 * @property {Span[]} spans
 * @property {number} paragraphIndex
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} Span
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {string} raw
 * @property {SourceSpan} source
 * @property {string|null} parentId
 * @property {string|null} relation
 */

/**
 * Encontra o índice do primeiro caractere não-whitespace a partir de i.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {number} i
 * @returns {number}
 * @private
 */
function _skipWhitespace(text, i) {
  while (i < text.length && /\s/.test(text[i])) i++;
  return i;
}

/**
 * Converte um offset absoluto para {line, column} (1-based line, 0-based column).
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {number} offset
 * @returns {{ line:number, column:number }}
 * @private
 */
function _offsetToLineCol(text, offset) {
  let line = 1;
  let lastNL = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < offset && i < text.length; i++) {
    if (text[i] === '\n') {
      line++;
      lastNL = i;
    }
  }
  return { line, column: offset - lastNL - 1 };
}

/**
 * Segmenta o texto em sentenças, preservando offsets absolutos.
 * @param {string} text
 * @returns {Sentence[]}
 * @private
 */
function _segmentSentences(text) {
  const sentences = [];
  const n = text.length;
  let i = 0;
  let paragraphIndex = 0;
  let sentenceIndex = 0;

  while (i < n) {
    // Pula whitespace inicial
    const start = _skipWhitespace(text, i);

    // Detecta mudança de parágrafo (linha em branco)
    if (start > i) {
      const skipped = text.slice(i, start);
      if ((skipped.match(/\n/g) || []).length >= 2) {
        paragraphIndex++;
      }
    }

    if (start >= n) break;

    // Encontra fim da sentença
    let end = start;
    while (end < n) {
      if (_isSentenceEnd(text, end)) {
        end++;
        // Captura caracteres extras: ?! !? !!! ???
        while (end < n && /[!?…]/.test(text[end])) end++;
        break;
      }
      // Nova linha dupla também termina (mesmo sem pontuação)
      if (text[end] === '\n' && end + 1 < n && text[end + 1] === '\n') {
        break;
      }
      end++;
    }

    if (end <= start) end = start + 1;

    const raw = text.slice(start, end);
    const trimmed = raw.trim();
    if (trimmed.length === 0) {
      i = end;
      continue;
    }

    const realStart = start + raw.indexOf(trimmed[0]);
    const realEnd = realStart + trimmed.length;

    const { line, column } = _offsetToLineCol(text, realStart);

    sentenceIndex++;
    sentences.push({
      id: `s${sentenceIndex}`,
      raw: trimmed,
      source: {
        start: realStart,
        end: realEnd,
        line,
        column,
        raw: trimmed,
      },
      spans: [],       // preenchido abaixo
      paragraphIndex,
    });

    i = end;
  }

  return sentences;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SEGMENTAÇÃO DE SPANS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Verifica se a sentença é discurso direto (começa com travessão).
 * @param {string} s
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */
function _isDirectSpeech(s) {
  return s.startsWith('—') || s.startsWith('–') || s.startsWith('--');
}

/**
 * Segmenta uma sentença em spans internos.
 *
 * Estratégia:
 *   1. Discurso direto (travessão) → 1 span (o conteúdo)
 *   2. Subordinação (se/quando/... ) → 2 spans: principal + dependente
 *   3. Coordenação (e/mas/ou...) → N spans
 *   4. Caso contrário → 1 span
 *
 * @param {Sentence} sentence
 * @param {string} fullText
 * @returns {Span[]}
 * @private
 */
function _segmentSpans(sentence, fullText) {
  const s = sentence.raw;
  const sBase = sentence.source.start;
  const spans = [];

  // Caso 1: discurso direto — span único
  if (_isDirectSpeech(s)) {
    spans.push(_mkSpan(sentence.id, 1, s, sBase, fullText, null, null));
    return spans;
  }

  // Caso 2: subordinação inicial (quando/se/enquanto/...)
  for (const marker of SUBORD_MARKERS) {
    const lower = s.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.startsWith(marker)) {
      const commaIdx = s.indexOf(',');
      if (commaIdx > 0) {
        const head = s.slice(0, commaIdx).trim();
        const tail = s.slice(commaIdx + 1).trim();
        if (head.length > 0 && tail.length > 0) {
          const headOffset = s.indexOf(head);
          const tailOffset = s.lastIndexOf(tail);
          spans.push(_mkSpan(
            sentence.id, 1, head, sBase + headOffset, fullText, null, null
          ));
          spans.push(_mkSpan(
            sentence.id, 2, tail, sBase + tailOffset, fullText,
            `${sentence.id}.1`, 'subordinate'
          ));
          return spans;
        }
      }
      // Sem vírgula: tenta split por verbo
      break;
    }
  }

  // Caso 3: coordenação (e/mas/ou/...)
  for (const marker of COORD_MARKERS) {
    if (s.includes(marker)) {
      const parts = s.split(marker);
      if (parts.length === 2) {
        const a = parts[0].trim();
        const b = parts[1].trim();
        if (a.length > 0 && b.length > 0) {
          const relation = marker.trim() === 'mas' || marker.trim() === 'porém' ||
                           marker.trim() === 'contudo' || marker.trim() === 'entretanto' ||
                           marker.trim() === 'todavia'
            ? 'contrast'
            : 'sequence';

          const aOffset = s.indexOf(a);
          const bOffset = s.lastIndexOf(b);

          spans.push(_mkSpan(
            sentence.id, 1, a, sBase + aOffset, fullText, null, null
          ));
          spans.push(_mkSpan(
            sentence.id, 2, b, sBase + bOffset, fullText, null, relation
          ));
          return spans;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Caso 4: default — 1 span
  spans.push(_mkSpan(sentence.id, 1, s, sBase, fullText, null, null));
  return spans;
}

/**
 * Cria um objeto Span.
 * @private
 */
function _mkSpan(sentenceId, index, raw, absoluteStart, fullText, parentId, relation) {
  const start = absoluteStart;
  const end = absoluteStart + raw.length;
  const { line, column } = _offsetToLineCol(fullText, start);
  return {
    id: `${sentenceId}.${index}`,
    raw,
    source: { start, end, line, column, raw },
    parentId,
    relation,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Segmenta um texto completo em sentenças e spans.
 *
 * @param {string} text
 * @returns {{ sentences: Sentence[], spans: Span[], text: string }}
 */
export function segment(text) {
  const original = String(text ?? '');

  if (original.length === 0) {
    return { sentences: [], spans: [], text: original };
  }

  let sentences;
  try {
    sentences = _segmentSentences(original);
  } catch {
    // Fallback: uma sentença única com o texto todo
    sentences = original.trim() ? [{
      id: 's1',
      raw: original.trim(),
      source: {
        start: original.indexOf(original.trim()),
        end: original.indexOf(original.trim()) + original.trim().length,
        line: 1,
        column: 0,
        raw: original.trim(),
      },
      spans: [],
      paragraphIndex: 0,
    }] : [];
  }

  // Preenche spans de cada sentença
  const allSpans = [];
  for (const sentence of sentences) {
    try {
      sentence.spans = _segmentSpans(sentence, original);
    } catch {
      sentence.spans = [{
        id: `${sentence.id}.1`,
        raw: sentence.raw,
        source: sentence.source,
        parentId: null,
        relation: null,
      }];
    }
    allSpans.push(...sentence.spans);
  }

  return {
    sentences,
    spans: allSpans,
    text: original,
  };
}

/**
 * Segmenta uma única sentença em spans. Utilitário para testes e
 * para reprocessamento parcial (F9+).
 *
 * @param {Sentence} sentence
 * @param {string} [fullText]
 * @returns {Span[]}
 */
export function segmentSentence(sentence, fullText = null) {
  if (!sentence || typeof sentence.raw !== 'string') return [];
  try {
    return _segmentSpans(sentence, fullText ?? sentence.raw);
  } catch {
    return [{
      id: `${sentence.id}.1`,
      raw: sentence.raw,
      source: sentence.source,
      parentId: null,
      relation: null,
    }];
  }
}

/**
 * Devolve estatísticas de segmentação (útil para diagnóstico).
 * @param {{ sentences: Sentence[], spans: Span[] }} result
 * @returns {{ sentenceCount:number, spanCount:number, avgSpansPerSentence:number, paragraphs:number }}
 */
export function segmentStats(result) {
  const sCount = result?.sentences?.length ?? 0;
  const spCount = result?.spans?.length ?? 0;
  const paragraphs = sCount > 0
    ? Math.max(...result.sentences.map((s) => s.paragraphIndex ?? 0)) + 1
    : 0;
  return {
    sentenceCount: sCount,
    spanCount: spCount,
    avgSpansPerSentence: sCount > 0 ? Math.round((spCount / sCount) * 100) / 100 : 0,
    paragraphs,
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS AGREGADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const Segmenter = Object.freeze({
  segment,
  segmentSentence,
  segmentStats,
  ABBREVIATIONS,
  COORD_MARKERS,
  SUBORD_MARKERS,
});
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file adapter.js
 * @module narrative-language/pt-br
 * @description Interface plugável com backend NLP para PT-BR. Suporta
 *              spaCy via HTTP (recomendado), wink-nlp e NLP.js (via
 *              import dinâmico) e fallback heurístico puro. Nunca lança.
 *              Sempre devolve análise estruturalmente válida.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy narrative-language/pt-br/constructions,
 *             narrative-language/pipeline/analyzer,
 *             narrative-language/index,
 *             boot.js
 * @level N1
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * CONTRATO PÚBLICO
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   Adapter.init({ backend })    → Promise<boolean>
 *   Adapter.analyze(sentence)    → Promise<NLPAnalysis>
 *   Adapter.isAvailable()        → boolean
 *   Adapter.version()            → string
 *   Adapter.backend()            → string
 *   Adapter.clearCache()         → void
 *   Adapter.destroy()            → void
 *   Adapter.probe()              → Promise<{ ok, backend, version, latencyMs }>
 *   Adapter.setBackendUrl(url)   → boolean
 *   Adapter.getBackendUrl()      → string
 *   Adapter.stats()              → Object
 *   Adapter.resetStats()         → void
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * BACKENDS
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   'spacy'      → backend HTTP (padrão). Requer servidor Python
 *                  rodando `tools/spacy-server/`. Fallback silencioso
 *                  para heurística quando indisponível.
 *
 *   'wink-nlp'   → biblioteca client-side. Detecção via import()
 *                  dinâmico. Hoje delega para heurística (wrapper
 *                  definitivo pendente de instalação do pacote).
 *
 *   'nlp.js'     → alternativa client-side. Mesmo comportamento.
 *
 *   'heuristic'  → puro JS, sempre disponível, qualidade L0–L3.
 *                  Fallback universal — nunca falha.
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * NLPAnalysis (formato canônico de retorno)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   {
 *     tokens: Token[],
 *     tree: Object|null,
 *     sentence: string,
 *     backend: string,       // 'spacy' | 'heuristic' | ...
 *     version: string,       // ex: 'spacy-pt-lg'
 *   }
 *
 *   Token:
 *     {
 *       text: string,
 *       lemma: string,
 *       pos: string,         // uma das POS_TAGS
 *       dep: string,         // dependência sintática (vazio na heurística)
 *       head: number,        // índice do head (-1 na heurística)
 *       features: Object,    // { tense, aspect, mood, person, number, gender }
 *       source: { start, end }  // offsets relativos à sentença
 *     }
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * DETERMINISMO
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   - Não usa Math.random na semântica
 *   - Não usa wall-clock (o timestamp só aparece em telemetria)
 *   - Cache FIFO com limite fixo
 *   - Duas chamadas com a mesma sentença devolvem o mesmo objeto
 *     (deep-equal), independentemente do backend ativo
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * CONFIGURAÇÃO
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   URL do servidor spaCy é lida de localStorage:
 *     localStorage.setItem('narr:config:nlp:url', 'http://...')
 *
 *   Ou via API:
 *     Adapter.setBackendUrl('http://192.168.1.5:8000')
 *
 *   Trocar backend em runtime limpa o cache automaticamente.
 */

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTANTES PÚBLICAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Backends reconhecidos.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
export const BACKENDS = Object.freeze(['spacy', 'wink-nlp', 'nlp.js', 'heuristic']);

/**
 * Backend default. Cai para heurística se indisponível.
 * @type {string}
 */
export const DEFAULT_BACKEND = 'spacy';

/**
 * POS tags canônicas (Universal Dependencies simplificado).
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
export const POS_TAGS = Object.freeze([
  'VERB', 'NOUN', 'ADJ', 'ADV', 'PRON', 'DET',
  'ADP', 'CCONJ', 'SCONJ', 'NUM', 'PROPN', 'PUNCT', 'INTJ',
]);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTANTES PRIVADAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** @type {string} @private */
const _NLP_URL_KEY = 'narr:config:nlp:url';

/** @type {string} @private */
const _NLP_URL_DEFAULT = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';

/** @type {number} @private */
const _NLP_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;

/** @type {number} @private */
const _NLP_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 1500;

/** @type {number} @private */
const _CACHE_MAX = 500;

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HEURÍSTICA — DICIONÁRIOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** @private */
const _PRONOUNS = new Set([
  'eu', 'tu', 'ele', 'ela', 'nós', 'vós', 'eles', 'elas',
  'você', 'vocês', 'o', 'a', 'os', 'as', 'lhe', 'lhes',
  'me', 'te', 'se', 'nos', 'vos', 'mim', 'ti', 'si',
  'isto', 'isso', 'aquilo', 'este', 'esta', 'estes', 'estas',
  'esse', 'essa', 'esses', 'essas', 'aquele', 'aquela',
  'aqueles', 'aquelas', 'quem', 'qual', 'quais',
]);

/** @private */
const _DETERMINERS = new Set([
  'o', 'a', 'os', 'as', 'um', 'uma', 'uns', 'umas',
  'meu', 'minha', 'meus', 'minhas',
  'seu', 'sua', 'seus', 'suas',
  'nosso', 'nossa', 'nossos', 'nossas',
  'este', 'esta', 'estes', 'estas',
  'esse', 'essa', 'esses', 'essas',
  'aquele', 'aquela', 'aqueles', 'aquelas',
  'algum', 'alguma', 'alguns', 'algumas',
  'nenhum', 'nenhuma', 'nenhuns', 'nenhumas',
  'todo', 'toda', 'todos', 'todas',
  'outro', 'outra', 'outros', 'outras',
]);

/** @private */
const _PREPOSITIONS = new Set([
  'a', 'ante', 'após', 'até', 'com', 'contra', 'de', 'desde',
  'em', 'entre', 'para', 'per', 'por', 'sem', 'sob', 'sobre',
  'trás', 'durante', 'mediante', 'conforme', 'segundo',
]);

/** @private */
const _CONJUNCTIONS_COORD = new Set([
  'e', 'ou', 'mas', 'porém', 'contudo', 'todavia', 'entretanto',
  'nem', 'tampouco', 'logo', 'portanto', 'pois',
]);

/** @private */
const _CONJUNCTIONS_SUBORD = new Set([
  'que', 'se', 'quando', 'enquanto', 'porque', 'como', 'embora',
  'caso', 'conquanto', 'conforme', 'segundo', 'posto', 'visto',
  'ainda', 'logo', 'assim', 'depois', 'antes',
]);

/** @private */
const _NEGATIONS = new Set([
  'não', 'nunca', 'jamais', 'nem', 'tampouco', 'sequer',
]);

/** @private */
const _MODAL_ADVERBS = new Set([
  'talvez', 'provavelmente', 'possivelmente', 'certamente',
  'decerto', 'porventura', 'acaso',
]);

/** @private */
const _VERB_SUFFIX_PERFECT = ['ou', 'eu', 'iu'];
/** @private */
const _VERB_SUFFIX_IMPERFECT = ['ava', 'ávamos', 'avam', 'ia', 'íamos', 'iam'];
/** @private */
const _VERB_SUFFIX_GERUND = ['ando', 'endo', 'indo'];
/** @private */
const _VERB_SUFFIX_INF = ['ar', 'er', 'ir', 'or'];
/** @private */
const _VERB_SUFFIX_SUBJ = ['sse', 'ssem', 'sseis'];
/** @private */
const _VERB_SUFFIX_FUTURE = ['rei', 'rás', 'rá', 'remos', 'reis', 'rão'];
/** @private */
const _VERB_SUFFIX_COND = ['ria', 'rias', 'ríamos', 'ríeis', 'riam'];
/** @private */
const _VERB_SUFFIX_PARTICIPLE = ['ado', 'ada', 'ados', 'adas', 'ido', 'ida', 'idos', 'idas'];

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HEURÍSTICA — TOKENIZAÇÃO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * @param {string} ch
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */
function _isPunct(ch) {
  return ch === '.' || ch === ',' || ch === ';' || ch === ':' ||
         ch === '!' || ch === '?' || ch === '…' ||
         ch === '(' || ch === ')' || ch === '[' || ch === ']' ||
         ch === '{' || ch === '}' ||
         ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === '`' ||
         ch === '—' || ch === '–' || ch === '-' ||
         ch === '«' || ch === '»';
}

/**
 * @param {string} ch
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */
function _isSpace(ch) {
  return ch === ' ' || ch === '\t' || ch === '\n' || ch === '\r';
}

/**
 * Tokeniza uma sentença preservando offsets absolutos.
 * @param {string} sentence
 * @param {number} [baseOffset=0]
 * @returns {Array<{ text:string, start:number, end:number }>}
 * @private
 */
function _tokenize(sentence, baseOffset = 0) {
  const tokens = [];
  const n = sentence.length;
  let i = 0;

  while (i < n) {
    while (i < n && _isSpace(sentence[i])) i++;
    if (i >= n) break;

    const start = i;

    // Pontuação: cada caractere é um token próprio
    if (_isPunct(sentence[i])) {
      const ch = sentence[i];
      let j = i + 1;
      while (j < n && sentence[j] === ch && (ch === '!' || ch === '?' || ch === '.')) j++;
      if (j < n && (sentence[j] === '!' || sentence[j] === '?') && sentence[j] !== ch) {
        j++;
      }
      tokens.push({
        text: sentence.slice(i, j),
        start: baseOffset + i,
        end: baseOffset + j,
      });
      i = j;
      continue;
    }

    // Palavra
    let j = i;
    while (j < n && !_isSpace(sentence[j]) && !_isPunct(sentence[j])) j++;

    if (j === i) j = i + 1;

    tokens.push({
      text: sentence.slice(i, j),
      start: baseOffset + i,
      end: baseOffset + j,
    });
    i = j;
  }

  return tokens;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HEURÍSTICA — MORFOLOGIA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * @param {string} word
 * @param {string[]} suffixes
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */
function _endsWith(word, suffixes) {
  for (const s of suffixes) {
    if (word.length > s.length && word.endsWith(s)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Classifica um token quanto à POS. Puramente heurístico.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {boolean} isFirstWord
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function _classifyPOS(text, isFirstWord) {
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();

  if (_isPunct(text)) return 'PUNCT';
  if (/^\d+([.,]\d+)?$/.test(text)) return 'NUM';

  if (_PRONOUNS.has(lower)) return 'PRON';
  if (_DETERMINERS.has(lower)) return 'DET';
  if (_PREPOSITIONS.has(lower)) return 'ADP';
  if (_CONJUNCTIONS_COORD.has(lower)) return 'CCONJ';
  if (_CONJUNCTIONS_SUBORD.has(lower)) return 'SCONJ';

  if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_PERFECT))  return 'VERB';
  if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_GERUND))   return 'VERB';
  if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_SUBJ))     return 'VERB';
  if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_FUTURE))   return 'VERB';
  if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_COND))     return 'VERB';
  if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_IMPERFECT) && lower.length > 4) return 'VERB';
  if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_INF) && lower.length > 3) return 'VERB';
  if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_PARTICIPLE) && lower.length > 5) return 'ADJ';

  if (lower.endsWith('mente') && lower.length > 7) return 'ADV';

  if (_endsWith(lower, ['oso', 'osa', 'osos', 'osas', 'ivo', 'iva', 'ável', 'ível'])) {
    return 'ADJ';
  }

  if (!isFirstWord && /^[A-ZÁÉÍÓÚÂÊÔÃÕÇ]/.test(text)) return 'PROPN';

  if (lower.length > 0) return 'NOUN';

  return 'PUNCT';
}

/**
 * Extrai features morfológicas de um token.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {string} pos
 * @returns {Object}
 * @private
 */
function _extractFeatures(text, pos) {
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  const feat = {};

  if (pos === 'VERB') {
    if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_PERFECT))        feat.tense = 'past';
    else if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_IMPERFECT)) feat.tense = 'past';
    else if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_GERUND))    feat.aspect = 'ongoing';
    else if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_INF))       feat.mood = 'infinitive';
    else if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_SUBJ))      feat.mood = 'subjunctive';
    else if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_FUTURE))    feat.tense = 'future';
    else if (_endsWith(lower, _VERB_SUFFIX_COND))      feat.mood = 'conditional';

    if (_endsWith(lower, ['ou', 'eu', 'iu', 'a', 'e', 'ava', 'ia'])) {
      feat.person = 3;
      feat.number = 'singular';
    } else if (_endsWith(lower, ['am', 'em', 'ram', 'avam', 'iam'])) {
      feat.person = 3;
      feat.number = 'plural';
    } else if (_endsWith(lower, ['o'])) {
      feat.person = 1;
      feat.number = 'singular';
    } else if (_endsWith(lower, ['mos'])) {
      feat.person = 1;
      feat.number = 'plural';
    }
  }

  if (pos === 'NOUN' || pos === 'ADJ' || pos === 'PROPN') {
    if (lower.endsWith('s') && lower.length > 3) {
      feat.number = 'plural';
    } else {
      feat.number = 'singular';
    }
    if (lower.endsWith('a') || lower.endsWith('as')) {
      feat.gender = 'feminine';
    } else if (lower.endsWith('o') || lower.endsWith('os')) {
      feat.gender = 'masculine';
    }
  }

  return feat;
}

/**
 * Lematiza um token. Heurístico, baseado em regras de sufixo.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {string} pos
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function _lemmatize(text, pos) {
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();

  if (pos === 'VERB') {
    if (_endsWith(lower, ['ar', 'er', 'ir', 'or'])) return lower;
    if (lower.endsWith('ando')) return lower.slice(0, -4) + 'ar';
    if (lower.endsWith('endo')) return lower.slice(0, -4) + 'er';
    if (lower.endsWith('indo')) return lower.slice(0, -4) + 'ir';
    if (lower.endsWith('ou')) return lower.slice(0, -2) + 'ar';
    if (lower.endsWith('eu')) return lower.slice(0, -2) + 'er';
    if (lower.endsWith('iu')) return lower.slice(0, -2) + 'ir';
    if (lower.endsWith('ava')) return lower.slice(0, -3) + 'ar';
    if (lower.endsWith('ia'))  return lower.slice(0, -2) + 'er';
    if (lower.endsWith('sse')) return lower.slice(0, -3) + 'r';
    if (lower.endsWith('rei') || lower.endsWith('rá') || lower.endsWith('rás')) {
      return lower.replace(/r(ei|á|ás|emos|eis|ão)$/, 'r');
    }
    return lower;
  }

  if ((pos === 'NOUN' || pos === 'ADJ') && lower.endsWith('s') && lower.length > 3) {
    return lower.slice(0, -1);
  }

  if (pos === 'ADJ' && lower.endsWith('a') && lower.length > 3) {
    return lower.slice(0, -1) + 'o';
  }

  return lower;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HEURÍSTICA — ANÁLISE COMPLETA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Analisa uma sentença usando o backend heurístico.
 * @param {string} sentence
 * @returns {Object} NLPAnalysis
 * @private
 */
function _analyzeHeuristic(sentence) {
  const rawTokens = _tokenize(sentence, 0);
  const tokens = rawTokens.map((t, idx) => {
    const pos = _classifyPOS(t.text, idx === 0);
    const lemma = _lemmatize(t.text, pos);
    const features = _extractFeatures(t.text, pos);

    return {
      text: t.text,
      lemma,
      pos,
      dep: '',
      head: -1,
      features,
      source: { start: t.start, end: t.end },
    };
  });

  return {
    tokens,
    tree: null,
    sentence,
    backend: 'heuristic',
    version: 'heuristic-1.0.0',
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONFIG — URL DO SERVIDOR
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Lê a URL do servidor spaCy de localStorage.
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function _readNlpUrl() {
  try {
    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return _NLP_URL_DEFAULT;
    const v = localStorage.getItem(_NLP_URL_KEY);
    return v === null || v === '' ? _NLP_URL_DEFAULT : v;
  } catch {
    return _NLP_URL_DEFAULT;
  }
}

/**
 * Grava a URL do servidor spaCy em localStorage.
 * @param {string} url
 * @returns {boolean}
 * @private
 */
function _writeNlpUrl(url) {
  try {
    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return false;
    localStorage.setItem(_NLP_URL_KEY, String(url));
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SPAcy — NORMALIZAÇÃO DE RESULTADO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Remove chaves com valores null/undefined/vazios de features.
 * @param {Object} features
 * @returns {Object}
 * @private
 */
function _cleanFeatures(features) {
  if (!features || typeof features !== 'object') return {};
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(features)) {
    if (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '') out[k] = v;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Anexa offsets `source` a tokens que não os trazem.
 * Fallback defensivo: escaneia o texto original em sequência.
 *
 * @param {Array} tokens
 * @param {string} originalText
 * @returns {Array}
 * @private
 */
function _attachSources(tokens, originalText) {
  const text = String(originalText ?? '');
  let cursor = 0;

  for (const t of tokens) {
    if (t.source && typeof t.source.start === 'number') continue;

    const tText = String(t.text ?? '');
    if (!tText) {
      t.source = { start: cursor, end: cursor };
      continue;
    }

    const idx = text.indexOf(tText, cursor);
    if (idx >= 0) {
      t.source = { start: idx, end: idx + tText.length };
      cursor = idx + tText.length;
    } else {
      t.source = { start: cursor, end: cursor + tText.length };
      cursor += tText.length;
    }
  }

  return tokens;
}

/**
 * Converte o resultado do servidor spaCy para o formato canônico
 * NLPAnalysis consumido pelo analyzer.js.
 *
 * @param {Object} spacyResult
 * @param {string} originalText
 * @returns {Object} NLPAnalysis
 * @private
 */
function _normalizeSpacyResult(spacyResult, originalText) {
  const rawTokens = Array.isArray(spacyResult?.tokens) ? spacyResult.tokens : [];

  const tokens = rawTokens.map((t) => {
    const text = String(t.text ?? '');
    const lemma = String(t.lemma ?? text).toLowerCase();
    const pos = POS_TAGS.includes(t.pos) ? t.pos : 'NOUN';
    const dep = String(t.dep ?? '');
    const head = typeof t.head === 'number' ? t.head : -1;
    const features = _cleanFeatures(t.features);

    let source;
    if (typeof t.idx === 'number') {
      source = { start: t.idx, end: t.idx + text.length };
    } else if (t.source && typeof t.source.start === 'number') {
      source = { start: t.source.start, end: t.source.end };
    } else {
      source = null;
    }

    return { text, lemma, pos, dep, head, features, source };
  });

  _attachSources(tokens, originalText);

  return {
    tokens,
    tree: spacyResult?.tree ?? null,
    sentence: String(originalText ?? ''),
    backend: 'spacy',
    version: String(spacyResult?.version ?? 'spacy-unknown'),
  };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SPAcy — ADAPTER HTTP
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Cria um adapter spaCy contra uma URL base.
 *
 * @param {string} baseUrl
 * @returns {{ backend:string, analyze:(text:string) => Promise<Object> }}
 * @private
 */
function _spacyAdapter(baseUrl) {
  const url = String(baseUrl).replace(/\/+$/, '');

  return {
    backend: 'spacy',

    async analyze(text) {
      const controller = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined'
        ? new AbortController()
        : null;
      const timeoutId = controller
        ? setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), _NLP_TIMEOUT_MS)
        : null;

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${url}/analyze`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ text: String(text ?? '') }),
          signal: controller?.signal,
        });

        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
        }

        const data = await res.json();
        return _normalizeSpacyResult(data, text);
      } finally {
        if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      }
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Testa se um servidor spaCy está acessível.
 * Aceita qualquer resposta HTTP como sinal de vida.
 *
 * @param {string} url
 * @param {number} [timeoutMs=_NLP_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS]
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok:boolean, status?:number, error?:string, latencyMs:number }>}
 * @private
 */
async function _probeSpaCy(url, timeoutMs = _NLP_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS) {
  const t0 = _now();
  const controller = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined'
    ? new AbortController()
    : null;
  const timeoutId = controller
    ? setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs)
    : null;

  try {
    await fetch(String(url).replace(/\/+$/, ''), {
      method: 'HEAD',
      signal: controller?.signal,
    });
    return { ok: true, latencyMs: _round(_now() - t0) };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: err?.message ?? String(err),
      latencyMs: _round(_now() - t0),
    };
  } finally {
    if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ESTADO INTERNO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** @type {string} @private */
let _activeBackend = 'heuristic';

/** @type {Object|null} @private */
let _activeImpl = null;

/** @type {string} @private */
let _version = 'heuristic-1.0.0';

/** @type {boolean} @private */
let _initialized = false;

/**
 * Cache FIFO de análises.
 * Chave: texto da sentença. Valor: NLPAnalysis.
 * @type {Map<string, Object>}
 * @private
 */
const _cache = new Map();

/**
 * Contadores de telemetria.
 * @type {Object}
 * @private
 */
const _stats = {
  totalAnalyzed: 0,
  byBackend: { spacy: 0, heuristic: 0, 'wink-nlp': 0, 'nlp.js': 0 },
  fallbacks: 0,
  errors: 0,
  cacheHits: 0,
  cacheMisses: 0,
  totalLatencyMs: 0,
  slowCalls: 0,
};

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// UTILITÁRIOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** @returns {number} @private */
function _now() {
  if (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function') {
    return performance.now();
  }
  return Date.now();
}

/** @param {number} n @returns {number} @private */
function _round(n) {
  return Math.round(Number(n) * 1000) / 1000;
}

/**
 * Limpa o cache se a chave do backend mudou.
 * @param {string} oldBackend
 * @param {string} newBackend
 * @private
 */
function _invalidateCacheOnBackendChange(oldBackend, newBackend) {
  if (oldBackend === newBackend) return;
  _cache.clear();
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA — INICIALIZAÇÃO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Inicializa o adapter com um backend específico.
 * Idempotente. Nunca lança.
 *
 * @param {Object} [opts={}]
 * @param {string} [opts.backend='spacy']
 * @param {boolean} [opts.silent=false]
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>} sempre true
 */
async function init({ backend = DEFAULT_BACKEND, silent = false } = {}) {
  if (!BACKENDS.includes(backend)) {
    backend = 'heuristic';
  }

  const previousBackend = _activeBackend;

  if (_initialized && _activeBackend === backend) {
    return true;
  }

  // ── spaCy via HTTP ────────────────────────────────────────
  if (backend === 'spacy') {
    const url = _readNlpUrl();
    const probe = await _probeSpaCy(url);

    if (probe.ok) {
      _activeBackend = 'spacy';
      _activeImpl = _spacyAdapter(url);
      _version = 'spacy-pt-lg';
      _initialized = true;
      _invalidateCacheOnBackendChange(previousBackend, _activeBackend);

      if (!silent && typeof console !== 'undefined') {
        console.log(`[Adapter] spaCy conectado em ${url} (${probe.latencyMs}ms)`);
      }
      return true;
    }

    if (!silent && typeof console !== 'undefined') {
      console.warn(
        `[Adapter] spaCy indisponível em ${url} (${probe.error ?? 'timeout'}). ` +
        `Usando heurística. Configure via ` +
        `localStorage.setItem('${_NLP_URL_KEY}', 'http://...')`
      );
    }
    _activeBackend = 'heuristic';
    _activeImpl = null;
    _version = 'heuristic-1.0.0';
    _initialized = true;
    _invalidateCacheOnBackendChange(previousBackend, _activeBackend);
    return true;
  }

  // ── wink-nlp / nlp.js via import dinâmico ─────────────────
  if (backend === 'wink-nlp' || backend === 'nlp.js') {
    try {
      const mod = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ backend).catch(() => null);
      if (mod) {
        _activeBackend = 'heuristic';
        _activeImpl = null;
        _version = `${backend}-detected`;
        _initialized = true;
        _invalidateCacheOnBackendChange(previousBackend, _activeBackend);
        if (!silent && typeof console !== 'undefined') {
          console.warn(
            `[Adapter] ${backend} detectado mas wrapper não implementado — ` +
            `usando heurística.`
          );
        }
        return true;
      }
    } catch { /* cai para heurística */ }

    _activeBackend = 'heuristic';
    _activeImpl = null;
    _version = 'heuristic-1.0.0';
    _initialized = true;
    _invalidateCacheOnBackendChange(previousBackend, _activeBackend);
    return true;
  }

  // ── heurística explícita ──────────────────────────────────
  _activeBackend = 'heuristic';
  _activeImpl = null;
  _version = 'heuristic-1.0.0';
  _initialized = true;
  _invalidateCacheOnBackendChange(previousBackend, _activeBackend);
  return true;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA — ANÁLISE
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Analisa uma sentença. Nunca lança.
 *
 * @param {string} sentence
 * @returns {Promise<Object>} NLPAnalysis
 */
async function analyze(sentence) {
  const text = String(sentence ?? '');

  const cached = _cache.get(text);
  if (cached) {
    _stats.cacheHits++;
    return cached;
  }

  _stats.cacheMisses++;
  _stats.totalAnalyzed++;

  const t0 = _now();
  let result = null;

  if (_activeImpl && typeof _activeImpl.analyze === 'function') {
    try {
      result = await _activeImpl.analyze(text);
      if (result && Array.isArray(result.tokens)) {
        _stats.byBackend[_activeBackend] =
          (_stats.byBackend[_activeBackend] ?? 0) + 1;
      } else {
        throw new Error('resultado inválido do backend');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      _stats.errors++;
      _stats.fallbacks++;

      if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
        console.warn(
          `[Adapter] ${_activeBackend} falhou em runtime — ` +
          `caindo para heurística: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}`
        );
      }

      _activeImpl = null;
      _activeBackend = 'heuristic';
      _version = 'heuristic-1.0.0';
      _cache.clear();
      result = null;
    }
  }

  if (!result) {
    result = _analyzeHeuristic(text);
    _stats.byBackend.heuristic++;
  }

  const latencyMs = _now() - t0;
  _stats.totalLatencyMs += latencyMs;
  if (latencyMs > 500) {
    _stats.slowCalls++;
    if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
      console.warn(
        `[Adapter] análise lenta: ${_round(latencyMs)}ms para "${text.slice(0, 40)}..."`
      );
    }
  }

  _cache.set(text, result);
  while (_cache.size > _CACHE_MAX) {
    const oldest = _cache.keys().next().value;
    if (oldest === undefined) break;
    _cache.delete(oldest);
  }

  return result;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA — CONSULTAS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Verifica se o adapter está operacional.
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
function isAvailable() {
  return true;
}

/**
 * Versão do backend ativo.
 * @returns {string}
 */
function version() {
  return _version;
}

/**
 * Nome do backend ativo.
 * @returns {string}
 */
function backend() {
  return _activeBackend;
}

/**
 * Limpa o cache interno.
 */
function clearCache() {
  _cache.clear();
}

/**
 * Reseta o adapter para o estado inicial.
 * @internal
 */
function destroy() {
  _cache.clear();
  _activeImpl = null;
  _activeBackend = 'heuristic';
  _version = 'heuristic-1.0.0';
  _initialized = false;
  resetStats();
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA — PROBE / CONFIG
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Verifica o estado do backend ativo.
 * @returns {Promise<{ ok:boolean, backend:string, version:string, latencyMs:number, error?:string }>}
 */
async function probe() {
  if (_activeBackend === 'spacy') {
    const url = _readNlpUrl();
    const p = await _probeSpaCy(url);
    return {
      ok: p.ok,
      backend: 'spacy',
      version: _version,
      latencyMs: p.latencyMs,
      error: p.error,
    };
  }
  return {
    ok: true,
    backend: _activeBackend,
    version: _version,
    latencyMs: 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Define a URL do servidor spaCy. Persiste em localStorage.
 * @param {string} url
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
function setBackendUrl(url) {
  const cleanUrl = String(url ?? '').trim();
  if (!cleanUrl) return false;

  const wrote = _writeNlpUrl(cleanUrl);
  if (!wrote) return false;

  if (_activeBackend === 'spacy' || _activeBackend === 'heuristic') {
    _initialized = false;
    _activeBackend = 'heuristic';
    _activeImpl = null;
    _cache.clear();
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * Devolve a URL configurada do servidor spaCy.
 * @returns {string}
 */
function getBackendUrl() {
  return _readNlpUrl();
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// API PÚBLICA — TELEMETRIA
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Devolve estatísticas de uso.
 * @returns {Object}
 */
function stats() {
  const totalCalls = _stats.cacheHits + _stats.cacheMisses;
  return {
    initialized: _initialized,
    backend: _activeBackend,
    version: _version,
    backendUrl: _activeBackend === 'spacy' ? _readNlpUrl() : null,
    cacheSize: _cache.size,
    cacheMax: _CACHE_MAX,
    cacheHitRate: totalCalls > 0
      ? _round(_stats.cacheHits / totalCalls)
      : 0,
    totalAnalyzed: _stats.totalAnalyzed,
    byBackend: { ..._stats.byBackend },
    fallbacks: _stats.fallbacks,
    errors: _stats.errors,
    slowCalls: _stats.slowCalls,
    avgLatencyMs: _stats.cacheMisses > 0
      ? _round(_stats.totalLatencyMs / _stats.cacheMisses)
      : 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Zera contadores. Mantém cache e backend.
 */
function resetStats() {
  _stats.totalAnalyzed = 0;
  _stats.byBackend = { spacy: 0, heuristic: 0, 'wink-nlp': 0, 'nlp.js': 0 };
  _stats.fallbacks = 0;
  _stats.errors = 0;
  _stats.cacheHits = 0;
  _stats.cacheMisses = 0;
  _stats.totalLatencyMs = 0;
  _stats.slowCalls = 0;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const Adapter = Object.freeze({
  init,
  destroy,
  analyze,
  isAvailable,
  version,
  backend,
  probe,
  setBackendUrl,
  getBackendUrl,
  clearCache,
  stats,
  resetStats,
  BACKENDS,
  DEFAULT_BACKEND,
  POS_TAGS,
});

export {
  init,
  analyze,
  isAvailable,
  version,
  backend,
  clearCache,
  destroy,
  probe,
  setBackendUrl,
  getBackendUrl,
  stats,
  resetStats,
};
```
