```javascript
    subs: ['list', 'capture', 'compare', 'delete', 'clear', 'stats'],
    examples: [
      'diag.baseline list',
      'diag.baseline capture before-refactor',
      'diag.baseline compare before-refactor',
    ],
    builtin: true,
  });

  registry.defineSnippet('diag.narrative.', {
    kind: 'menu',
    description: 'Diagnóstico do subsistema narrativo — atos, trace, overrides, lexicon',
    subs: ['recent', 'why', 'stats', 'overrides', 'lexicon', 'replay', 'clear', 'help'],
    examples: [
      'diag.narrative.recent 10',
      'diag.narrative.why act-s1-1',
      'diag.narrative.stats',
      'diag.narrative.overrides',
      'diag.narrative.lexicon',
      'diag.narrative.replay act-s1-1',
      'diag.narrative.help',
    ],
    builtin: true,
  });

  // ── narr.* (Fase 5 + Estágio 10) ───────────────────────────

  registry.defineSnippet('narr.', {
    kind: 'menu',
    description: 'Modo narrativo — interpretação de prosa em português',
    subs: [
      'off', 'preview', 'suggest', 'auto',
      'status', 'stats', 'overrides', 'lexicon',
      'catalog',
    ],
    examples: [
      'narr.preview',
      'narr.auto',
      'narr.status',
      'narr.overrides',
      'narr.lexicon',
      'narr.catalog',
    ],
    builtin: true,
  });

  return registry;
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file schema-inspector.js
 * @module schemas
 * @description Consultas unificadas sobre os registries (componentes, snippets, comandos).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/help-system, schemas/bootstrap
 * @level 9
 */

import { KNOWN_PREFIXES, ENTITY_TYPES } from '../core/constants.js';

export class SchemaInspector {
  /**
   * @param {Object} worldRegistry    — ComponentRegistry (N2)
   * @param {Object} machineRegistry  — Registry (N2, catálogo de metadata)
   */
  constructor(worldRegistry, machineRegistry) {
    this.worldRegistry = worldRegistry;
    this.machineRegistry = machineRegistry;
  }

  // ── Componentes ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Descreve um componente (do registry de schemas).
   * @param {string} name
   * @returns {{
   *   name: string,
   *   exists: boolean,
   *   defaults: Object,
   *   required: string[],
   *   meta?: Object
   * }}
   */
  describeComponent(name) {
    const schema = this.worldRegistry?.get(name) ?? null;
    const meta = this.machineRegistry?.getComponent(name) ?? null;
    return {
      name,
      exists: !!schema,
      defaults: schema?.defaults ?? {},
      required: schema?.required ?? [],
      meta,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Lista todos os componentes registrados.
   * @returns {Array}
   */
  listComponents() {
    const names = this.worldRegistry?.all() ?? [];
    return names.map(name => this.describeComponent(name));
  }

  /**
   * Verifica se um componente tem schema.
   * @param {string} name
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  hasComponent(name) {
    return !!this.worldRegistry?.isDefined(name);
  }

  /**
   * Conta componentes registrados.
   * @returns {number}
   */
  countComponents() {
    return this.worldRegistry?.size() ?? 0;
  }

  // ── Snippets ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Lista snippets conhecidos no Registry de metadata.
   * @returns {Array}
   */
  listSnippets() {
    return this.machineRegistry?.getSnippets() ?? [];
  }

  /**
   * Busca um snippet por trigger exato.
   * @param {string} trigger
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  findSnippet(trigger) {
    return this.machineRegistry?.getSnippet(trigger) ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Snippets cujo trigger começa por um prefixo.
   * @param {string} prefix
   * @returns {Array}
   */
  findSnippetsByPrefix(prefix) {
    if (!prefix) return [];
    return (this.machineRegistry?.getSnippets() ?? [])
      .filter(s => s.trigger.startsWith(prefix))
      .sort((a, b) => a.trigger.localeCompare(b.trigger));
  }

  /**
   * Lista de prefixos builtin conhecidos.
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  knownPrefixes() {
    return KNOWN_PREFIXES.map(p => `${p}.`);
  }

  // ── Comandos ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Lista todos os comandos.
   * @returns {Array}
   */
  listCommands() {
    return this.machineRegistry?.getCommands() ?? [];
  }

  /**
   * Busca um comando por verbo.
   * @param {string} verb
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  findCommand(verb) {
    return this.machineRegistry?.getCommand(verb) ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Conta comandos registrados.
   * @returns {number}
   */
  countCommands() {
    return this.machineRegistry?.getCommands()?.length ?? 0;
  }

  // ── Agregações ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Resumo completo dos registries.
   * @returns {{
   *   components: number,
   *   snippets: number,
   *   commands: number,
   *   prefixes: number,
   *   types: number
   * }}
   */
  summarize() {
    return {
      components: this.countComponents(),
      snippets: this.listSnippets().length,
      commands: this.countCommands(),
      prefixes: KNOWN_PREFIXES.length,
      types: ENTITY_TYPES.length,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Monta cheatsheet compacto para o autor.
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  buildCheatsheet() {
    return {
      quickCommands: this.listCommands().slice(0, 8).map(c => ({
        c: c.verb ? `${c.verb}.` : '—',
        d: c.description ?? '',
      })),
      snippets: this.listSnippets().slice(0, 10).map(s => ({
        trigger: s.trigger,
        kind: s.kind ?? 'menu',
        description: s.description ?? '',
      })),
      components: this.listComponents().slice(0, 10).map(c => ({
        name: c.name,
        required: c.required,
      })),
    };
  }

  // ── Busca cross-registry ────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Busca textual em componentes, snippets e comandos.
   * @param {string} query
   * @returns {{ components:Array, snippets:Array, commands:Array }}
   */
  search(query) {
    const q = String(query || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return { components: [], snippets: [], commands: [] };

    const match = (text) => String(text || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);

    return {
      components: this.listComponents().filter(c =>
        match(c.name) || match(c.meta?.description)
      ),
      snippets: this.listSnippets().filter(s =>
        match(s.trigger) || match(s.description)
      ),
      commands: this.listCommands().filter(c =>
        match(c.verb) || match(c.description)
      ),
    };
  }

  // ── Validação ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Verifica se todos os registries estão populados.
   * @returns {{ ok:boolean, missing:string[] }}
   */
  audit() {
    const missing = [];
    if (this.countComponents() === 0) missing.push('components');
    if (this.listSnippets().length === 0) missing.push('snippets');
    if (this.countCommands() === 0) missing.push('commands');
    return { ok: missing.length === 0, missing };
  }
}
```

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 6.1 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file seed-builder.js
 * @module schemas
 * @description Converte seeds brutos em specs normalizadas, valida e agrupa.
 * @imports core/constants, components/identity, components/meta
 * @importedBy schemas/bootstrap
 * @level 9
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES, ENTITY_TYPES } from '../core/constants.js';
import { makeMeta } from '../components/meta.js';
import { isIdentity } from '../components/identity.js';

export class SeedBuilder {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts]
   * @param {string} [opts.tick='T0'] — tick em que os seeds são criados
   */
  constructor({ tick = 'T0' } = {}) {
    this.tick = tick;
    this.errors = [];
    this.warnings = [];
  }

  // ── Construção ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Normaliza uma lista de seeds brutos.
   * Retorna specs prontas para `world.createEntity`.
   *
   * @param {Array<{id:string, components:Object}>} rawSeeds
   * @returns {Array<{id:string, components:Object}>}
   */
  build(rawSeeds = []) {
    this.errors = [];
    this.warnings = [];
    const out = [];

    const seenIds = new Set();
    const seenShortcodes = new Set();

    for (const raw of rawSeeds) {
      const spec = this._normalize(raw);
      const validation = this._validate(spec, seenIds, seenShortcodes);

      if (!validation.ok) {
        this.errors.push({ raw, error: validation.error });
        continue;
      }

      seenIds.add(spec.id);
      const shortId = spec.components[COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY]?.id;
      if (shortId) seenShortcodes.add(shortId);

      out.push(spec);
    }

    return out;
  }

  // ── Normalização ────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _normalize(raw) {
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') {
      return { id: null, components: {} };
    }

    const id = String(raw.id ?? '');
    const components = { ...(raw.components ?? {}) };

    // Garante Meta — Fase 3: usa tick, não wall-clock
    if (!components[COMPONENT_NAMES.META]) {
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.META] = makeMeta({ builtin: true, tick: this.tick });
    } else {
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.META] = {
        createdAt: components[COMPONENT_NAMES.META].createdAt ?? this.tick,
        updatedAt: components[COMPONENT_NAMES.META].updatedAt ?? this.tick,
        builtin: true,
        dirty: false,
      };
    }

    return { id, components };
  }

  // ── Validação ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _validate(spec, seenIds, seenShortcodes) {
    if (!spec.id || typeof spec.id !== 'string') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'id ausente ou inválido' };
    }
    if (seenIds.has(spec.id)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `id duplicado: ${spec.id}` };
    }

    const identity = spec.components[COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY];
    if (!identity) {
      return { ok: false, error: `Identity ausente em ${spec.id}` };
    }
    if (!isIdentity(identity)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `Identity malformada em ${spec.id}` };
    }
    if (seenShortcodes.has(identity.id)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `shortcode duplicado: ${identity.id}` };
    }
    if (!ENTITY_TYPES.includes(identity.type) && !this._isSeedOnlyType(identity.type)) {
      this.warnings.push({
        id: spec.id,
        warning: `tipo desconhecido: ${identity.type}`,
      });
    }

    return { ok: true };
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _isSeedOnlyType(type) {
    return [
      'package', 'category', 'set',
      'phrase', 'placeholder-term',
    ].includes(type);
  }

  // ── Agrupamento ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Agrupa specs por `Identity.type`.
   * @param {Array} specs
   * @returns {Object<string, Array>}
   */
  groupByType(specs = []) {
    const groups = {};
    for (const spec of specs) {
      const type = spec.components[COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY]?.type ?? 'custom';
      if (!groups[type]) groups[type] = [];
      groups[type].push(spec);
    }
    return groups;
  }

  /**
   * Conta specs por tipo.
   * @param {Array} specs
   * @returns {Object<string, number>}
   */
  countByType(specs = []) {
    const counts = {};
    for (const spec of specs) {
      const type = spec.components[COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY]?.type ?? 'custom';
      counts[type] = (counts[type] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    return counts;
  }

  // ── Ordenação topológica ────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Ordena specs para que pais venham antes de filhos.
   * Detecta `Links.parent` para ordenar.
   * @param {Array} specs
   * @returns {Array}
   */
  orderByHierarchy(specs = []) {
    const byId = new Map(specs.map(s => [s.id, s]));
    const ordered = [];
    const visited = new Set();
    const visiting = new Set();

    const visit = (spec) => {
      if (visited.has(spec.id)) return;
      if (visiting.has(spec.id)) {
        this.warnings.push({ id: spec.id, warning: 'ciclo na hierarquia de seeds' });
        return;
      }
      visiting.add(spec.id);

      const parent = spec.components[COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS]?.parent;
      if (parent && byId.has(parent)) {
        visit(byId.get(parent));
      }
      visiting.delete(spec.id);
      visited.add(spec.id);
      ordered.push(spec);
    };

    for (const spec of specs) visit(spec);
    return ordered;
  }

  // ── Relatório ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Resumo da última execução de `build()`.
   * @returns {{errors:Array, warnings:Array}}
   */
  report() {
    return { errors: [...this.errors], warnings: [...this.warnings] };
  }

  /**
   * Limpa erros e warnings.
   */
  reset() {
    this.errors = [];
    this.warnings = [];
  }
}
```

### projeto_narrative-write/systems/audit-system.js

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 15.5 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file audit-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles aud.* — links, identities, instances, continuity,
 *              references, rules, snippets.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants, core/utils/time
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Stubs → Funcionalidades (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   `_continuity`, `_references` e `_snippets` eram stubs que retornavam
 *   `{ alerts: [] }`. Comandos `aud.continuity`, `aud.references` e
 *   `aud.snippets` existiam no parser e apareciam no autocomplete, mas
 *   nunca detectavam nada.
 *
 *   Implementação:
 *     - `_continuity`: regras com `ON:` que não resolvem para evento,
 *       tipo ou entidade; entidades `Stale` há muito tempo.
 *     - `_references`: `InstanceOf.id`, `DerivesFrom.ids` e `Links.parent`
 *       apontando para entidades inexistentes, ou com autorreferência.
 *     - `_snippets`: templates com placeholders sem Def, snippets do
 *       tipo `command` sem `runs`, snippets do tipo `menu` sem `options`.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES, ENTITY_TYPES } from '../core/constants.js';
import { tickToNumber } from '../core/utils/time.js';

/**
 * Limite (em ticks) a partir do qual uma entidade Stale é considerada
 * antiga o suficiente para gerar alerta de continuidade.
 * @type {number}
 */
const _STALE_AGE_THRESHOLD = 100;

export class AuditSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('AuditSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'aud') return prev;

    switch (ast.action) {
      case 'links':      return this._links(prev);
      case 'identities': return this._identities(prev);
      case 'instances':  return this._instances(prev);
      case 'continuity': return this._continuity(prev);
      case 'references': return this._references(prev);
      case 'rules':      return this._rules(prev);
      case 'snippets':   return this._snippets(prev);
      default:           return prev;
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // aud.links
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _links(prev) {
    const alerts = [];
    const ids = new Set(this.world.allEntities());

    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      const links = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      if (!links) continue;
      for (const [rel, value] of Object.entries(links)) {
        const targets = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
        for (const to of targets) {
          if (typeof to === 'string' && to && !ids.has(to)) {
            alerts.push({ level: 'error', code: 'LINK_DANGLING', from: id, rel, to });
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'alerts', title: `Auditoria de Links (${alerts.length})`, data: { alerts, summary: { total: alerts.length } }, sticky: true } };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // aud.identities
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _identities(prev) {
    const byId = new Map();
    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (!ident?.id) continue;
      if (!byId.has(ident.id)) byId.set(ident.id, []);
      byId.get(ident.id).push(id);
    }
    const duplicates = [];
    for (const [shortId, ids] of byId) {
      if (ids.length > 1) duplicates.push({ level: 'error', code: 'IDENTITY_DUPLICATE', shortId, ids });
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'alerts', title: `Identidades (${duplicates.length})`, data: { alerts: duplicates }, sticky: true } };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // aud.instances
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _instances(prev) {
    const alerts = [];
    const ids = new Set(this.world.allEntities());

    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      const instOf = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF);
      if (instOf && !ids.has(instOf.id)) {
        alerts.push({ level: 'error', code: 'INSTANCE_ORPHAN', instance: id, blueprint: instOf.id });
      }
      if (this.world.has(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE)) {
        const s = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE);
        alerts.push({ level: 'info', code: 'INSTANCE_STALE', instance: id, since: s.at });
      }
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'alerts', title: `Instâncias (${alerts.length})`, data: { alerts }, sticky: true } };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // aud.continuity — Fase 13.7
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Verifica continuidade narrativa:
   *   1. Regras com `ON:` que não casam com evento do bus, tipo de
   *      entidade conhecido, nem id/shortcode/nome de entidade existente.
   *   2. Entidades marcadas `Stale` há mais de `_STALE_AGE_THRESHOLD`
   *      ticks (indica herança quebrada sem resync).
   *
   * @param {Object} prev
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _continuity(prev) {
    const alerts = [];
    const world = this.world;

    // Índice de referências resolvíveis
    const knownRefs = new Set();
    const knownTypes = new Set(ENTITY_TYPES);

    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      knownRefs.add(id);
      const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (ident?.id) knownRefs.add(ident.id);
      if (ident?.name) knownRefs.add(ident.name);
    }

    // 1. Regras com ON: não resolvível
    for (const ruleId of world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE)) {
      const rule = world.get(ruleId, COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE);
      const ident = world.get(ruleId, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (!rule) continue;

      const on = String(rule.on || '').trim();
      if (!on) continue;

      const isEvent = on.includes(':');
      const isType = knownTypes.has(on);
      const isRef = knownRefs.has(on);

      if (!isEvent && !isType && !isRef) {
        alerts.push({
          level: 'warning',
          code: 'RULE_ON_UNKNOWN',
          rule: ident?.name ?? ruleId,
          on,
          message: `ON: "${on}" não é evento, tipo nem entidade existente`,
        });
      }
    }

    // 2. Entidades Stale antigas
    const currentTick = tickToNumber(this.getTick());
    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      const stale = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE);
      if (!stale) continue;
      const staleTick = tickToNumber(stale.at);
      const age = currentTick - staleTick;
      if (age > _STALE_AGE_THRESHOLD) {
        const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
        alerts.push({
          level: 'info',
          code: 'STALE_OLD',
          entity: ident?.name ?? id,
          since: stale.at,
          age,
          message: `entidade está stale há ${age} ticks`,
        });
      }
    }

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'alerts',
        title: `Continuidade (${alerts.length})`,
        data: { alerts },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // aud.references — Fase 13.7
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Verifica referências estruturais:
   *   - `InstanceOf.id` → entidade existente
   *   - `DerivesFrom.ids` → entidades existentes, sem autorreferência
   *   - `Links.parent` → entidade existente, sem autorreferência
   *
   * Complementa `_links` (que verifica todos os `Links.*`) e `_instances`
   * (que verifica órfãos + stale), com foco em grafos de herança e
   * hierarquia narrativa.
   *
   * @param {Object} prev
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _references(prev) {
    const alerts = [];
    const world = this.world;
    const ids = new Set(world.allEntities());

    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const name = ident?.name ?? id;

      // InstanceOf
      const instOf = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF);
      if (instOf?.id && !ids.has(instOf.id)) {
        alerts.push({
          level: 'error',
          code: 'INSTANCE_REF_MISSING',
          entity: name,
          target: instOf.id,
          message: `InstanceOf aponta para "${instOf.id}" inexistente`,
        });
      }

      // DerivesFrom
      const derives = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM)?.ids ?? [];
      for (const d of derives) {
        if (d === id) {
          alerts.push({
            level: 'error',
            code: 'DERIVES_SELF_REF',
            entity: name,
            message: `DerivesFrom inclui a própria entidade`,
          });
          continue;
        }
        if (!ids.has(d)) {
          alerts.push({
            level: 'error',
            code: 'DERIVES_REF_MISSING',
            entity: name,
            target: d,
            message: `DerivesFrom aponta para "${d}" inexistente`,
          });
        }
      }

      // Links.parent
      const links = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      const parent = links?.parent;
      if (parent) {
        if (parent === id) {
          alerts.push({
            level: 'error',
            code: 'PARENT_SELF_REF',
            entity: name,
            message: `Links.parent aponta para si mesma`,
          });
        } else if (!ids.has(parent)) {
          alerts.push({
            level: 'error',
            code: 'PARENT_REF_MISSING',
            entity: name,
            target: parent,
            message: `Links.parent aponta para "${parent}" inexistente`,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'alerts',
        title: `Referências (${alerts.length})`,
        data: { alerts },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // aud.rules
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _rules(prev) {
    const never = [];
    for (const id of this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE)) {
      const meta = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE_META);
      if ((meta?.firedCount ?? 0) === 0) {
        never.push({ level: 'info', code: 'RULE_NEVER_FIRED', rule: this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name });
      }
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'alerts', title: 'Regras', data: { alerts: never }, sticky: true } };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // aud.snippets — Fase 13.7
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Verifica coerência interna de snippets:
   *   - `template`: placeholders `{x}` no body sem def correspondente
   *   - `command`: sem `runs` (macros vazias)
   *   - `menu`: sem `options` (menus vazios)
   *   - `text`: sem `body`
   *
   * @param {Object} prev
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _snippets(prev) {
    const alerts = [];
    const world = this.world;

    for (const id of world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER)) {
      const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const trigger = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER)?.value ?? '';
      const type = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE)?.value;
      const body = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text ?? '';
      const defs = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.PLACEHOLDER_DEFS)?.defs ?? [];
      const runs = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.RUNS)?.cmds ?? [];
      const menuOpts = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.MENU_OPTS)?.options ?? [];
      const name = ident?.name ?? trigger ?? id;

      if (type === 'template') {
        const found = _extractPlaceholders(body);
        const defined = new Set(defs.map((d) => d.name));
        const missing = found.filter((p) => !defined.has(p));
        if (missing.length > 0) {
          alerts.push({
            level: 'warning',
            code: 'SNIPPET_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING',
            snippet: name,
            trigger,
            missing,
            message: `placeholders sem def: ${missing.join(', ')}`,
          });
        }
      } else if (type === 'command') {
        if (!Array.isArray(runs) || runs.length === 0) {
          alerts.push({
            level: 'warning',
            code: 'SNIPPET_CMD_EMPTY',
            snippet: name,
            trigger,
            message: 'snippet do tipo command sem runs',
          });
        }
      } else if (type === 'menu') {
        if (!Array.isArray(menuOpts) || menuOpts.length === 0) {
          alerts.push({
            level: 'warning',
            code: 'SNIPPET_MENU_EMPTY',
            snippet: name,
            trigger,
            message: 'snippet do tipo menu sem options',
          });
        }
      } else if (type === 'text') {
        if (!body || body.trim() === '') {
          alerts.push({
            level: 'info',
            code: 'SNIPPET_TEXT_EMPTY',
            snippet: name,
            trigger,
            message: 'snippet de texto vazio',
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'alerts',
        title: `Snippets (${alerts.length})`,
        data: { alerts },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Extrai nomes únicos de placeholders `{x}` de um body.
 * @param {string} body
 * @returns {string[]}
 * @private
 */
function _extractPlaceholders(body) {
  const out = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const re = /\{([^}]+)\}/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(String(body || ''))) !== null) {
    const name = m[1].trim();
    if (name && !seen.has(name)) {
      seen.add(name);
      out.push(name);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file command-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Valida o AST e marca o comando como pronto para despacho.
 * @imports ecs/system
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Limpeza (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   Removida a flag `commandReady: true` (M-10). Nenhum sistema a lia.
 *   Sua intenção era sinalizar "AST é válido, prossiga", mas cada
 *   sistema já valida o que precisa por conta própria. Flag removida
 *   sem impacto funcional.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';

export class CommandSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('CommandSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast) return prev;

    // Prosa e slash-command não passam por aqui
    if (ast.verb === 'prose' || ast.verb === 'slash') return prev;

    // Valida campo mínimo
    if (!ast.verb) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'AST sem verbo' };
    }

    return prev;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file diagnostics-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Dispatcher fino para comandos `diag.*`.
 * @imports ecs/system, diagnostics/commands-diag
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Refatoração estrutural (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   `init()` agora assina `diag:handler:register` para permitir que
 *   sistemas externos registrem handlers de subcomandos `diag.*` sem
 *   que `commands-diag.js` precise importá-los. O caso de uso é o
 *   `NarrativeSystem`, que expõe `diag.narrative.*` sem acoplar a
 *   `systems/` a `narrative-language/`.
 *
 *   Fluxo:
 *     1. Machine.registerSystem(DiagnosticsSystem) → init() assina o bus.
 *     2. Machine.registerSystem(NarrativeSystem)  → init() emite o
 *        `diag:handler:register` com `verb: 'narrative'`.
 *     3. `commands-diag.js` guarda o handler num Map.
 *     4. Em `diag.narrative.recent`, o dispatcher encontra o handler
 *        registrado e delega.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { DiagnosticsCommands } from '../diagnostics/commands-diag.js';

export class DiagnosticsSystem extends System {
  constructor() {
    super('DiagnosticsSystem');

    /** @type {DiagnosticsCommands} */
    this.commands = new DiagnosticsCommands(this);
  }

  /**
   * Fase 13.7 — registra handlers externos via bus.
   */
  init() {
    if (!this.bus) return;

    this.bus.on('diag:handler:register', (payload) => {
      const { verb, handler } = payload || {};
      if (typeof verb !== 'string' || !verb) return;
      if (typeof handler !== 'function') return;
      this.commands.registerHandler(verb, handler);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Processa uma linha `diag.*`.
   *
   * Como o DiagnosticsSystem está registrado duas vezes no pipeline
   * `command`, o guard `_diagHandled` impede execução dupla.
   *
   * @param {string} _line
   * @param {Object} _ctx
   * @param {Object} prev
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'diag') return prev;
    if (prev._diagHandled === true) return prev;

    try {
      const result = this.commands.dispatch(prev, ast);
      return { ...result, _diagHandled: true };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        ...prev,
        ok: false,
        halt: true,
        error: err?.message ?? String(err),
        _diagHandled: true,
      };
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file diff-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles dif.* — vs, at, entity, range, export.
 * @imports ecs/system, ecs/snapshot
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Stubs → Funcionalidades (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   - `_at`, `_entity`, `_range` existiam no autocomplete mas nunca eram
 *     tratados. O parser não os produzia (o `_parseDif` só entende
 *     `dif.<a> vs <b>` e `dif.export`), então a única forma de suportá-los
 *     sem tocar o parser é extrair a sintaxe de `ast.raw` via regex.
 *   - `_export` retornava payload sem blob. Agora emite `export:ready`
 *     com `Blob` real (mesmo padrão de `ExportSystem`), gerando download.
 *
 * Sintaxes suportadas:
 *   dif.<a> vs <b>                          → diff entre timelines
 *   dif.<a> vs <b> at <tick>                → diff num tick específico
 *   dif.<a> vs <b> entity <entityId>        → diff filtrado por entidade
 *   dif.<a> vs <b> range <t1>..<t2>         → diff entre dois ticks
 *   dif.at <a> <b> <tick>                   → forma alternativa de at
 *   dif.entity <a> <b> <entityId>           → forma alternativa de entity
 *   dif.range <a> <b> <t1>..<t2>            → forma alternativa de range
 *   dif.export <a> vs <b> [format]          → exporta para arquivo
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { Snapshot } from '../ecs/snapshot.js';

export class DiffSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('DiffSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'dif') return prev;

    const timeline = this.machine?.systems?.get('TimelineSystem');
    if (!timeline) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'TimelineSystem não registrado' };
    }

    try {
      const sub = this._resolveSubcommand(ast);
      switch (sub) {
        case 'vs':     return this._vs(prev, ast, timeline);
        case 'at':     return this._at(prev, ast, timeline);
        case 'entity': return this._entity(prev, ast, timeline);
        case 'range':  return this._range(prev, ast, timeline);
        case 'export': return this._export(prev, ast, timeline);
        default:
          return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `subcomando não reconhecido: ${ast.raw}` };
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Resolução de subcomando (via raw)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * @param {Object} ast
   * @returns {'vs'|'at'|'entity'|'range'|'export'}
   * @private
   */
  _resolveSubcommand(ast) {
    const raw = String(ast.raw || '').trim();
    if (/^dif\.export\b/.test(raw)) return 'export';
    if (/^dif\.at\b/.test(raw)) return 'at';
    if (/^dif\.entity\b/.test(raw)) return 'entity';
    if (/^dif\.range\b/.test(raw)) return 'range';
    if (/^dif\.\S+\s+vs\s+\S+/.test(raw)) {
      if (/\sat\s+\S+/.test(raw)) return 'at';
      if (/\sentity\s+\S+/.test(raw)) return 'entity';
      if (/\srange\s+\S+/.test(raw)) return 'range';
      return 'vs';
    }
    return 'vs';
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // dif.<a> vs <b>
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _vs(prev, ast, timeline) {
    const a = ast.a;
    const b = ast.b;

    if (!a || !b) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'uso: dif.<a> vs <b>' };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(a)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${a}` };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(b)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${b}` };
    }

    const snapA = timeline.getSnapshot(timeline.getLastTick(a), a);
    const snapB = timeline.getSnapshot(timeline.getLastTick(b), b);
    const diff = Snapshot.diff(snapA, snapB);

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'diff',
        title: `${a} vs ${b}`,
        data: diff,
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // dif.* at <tick>
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _at(prev, ast, timeline) {
    const parsed = this._parseRaw(ast.raw);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: parsed.error };
    }

    const { a, b, tick } = parsed;
    if (!a || !b || !tick) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: 'uso: dif.<a> vs <b> at <tick>',
      };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(a)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${a}` };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(b)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${b}` };
    }

    const snapA = timeline.getSnapshot(tick, a);
    const snapB = timeline.getSnapshot(tick, b);
    if (!snapA && !snapB) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `tick ${tick} não existe em nenhuma das timelines` };
    }

    const diff = Snapshot.diff(snapA, snapB);

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'diff',
        title: `${a} vs ${b} @ ${tick}`,
        data: diff,
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // dif.* entity <id>
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _entity(prev, ast, timeline) {
    const parsed = this._parseRaw(ast.raw);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: parsed.error };
    }

    const { a, b, entityId } = parsed;
    if (!a || !b || !entityId) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: 'uso: dif.<a> vs <b> entity <entityId>',
      };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(a)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${a}` };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(b)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${b}` };
    }

    const snapA = timeline.getSnapshot(timeline.getLastTick(a), a);
    const snapB = timeline.getSnapshot(timeline.getLastTick(b), b);

    const entityDiff = Snapshot.diffEntity(snapA, snapB, entityId);
    if (!entityDiff) {
      return {
        ...prev,
        ok: true,
        right: {
          kind: 'card',
          title: `${a} vs ${b} · ${entityId}`,
          data: { info: 'Nenhuma diferença para esta entidade' },
        },
      };
    }

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'diff',
        title: `${a} vs ${b} · ${entityId}`,
        data: {
          added: [],
          removed: [],
          changed: [{ id: entityId, patch: entityDiff.patch }],
          stats: {
            added: 0,
            removed: 0,
            changed: 1,
            total: 1,
          },
        },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // dif.* range <t1>..<t2>
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _range(prev, ast, timeline) {
    const parsed = this._parseRaw(ast.raw);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: parsed.error };
    }

    const { a, b, from, to } = parsed;
    if (!a || !b || !from || !to) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: 'uso: dif.<a> vs <b> range <t1>..<t2>',
      };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(a)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${a}` };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(b)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${b}` };
    }

    const snapAfrom = timeline.getSnapshot(from, a);
    const snapAto   = timeline.getSnapshot(to, a);
    const snapBfrom = timeline.getSnapshot(from, b);
    const snapBto   = timeline.getSnapshot(to, b);

    if (!snapAfrom || !snapAto || !snapBfrom || !snapBto) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: `range ${from}..${to} incompleto em alguma timeline`,
      };
    }

    const diffA = Snapshot.diff(snapAfrom, snapAto);
    const diffB = Snapshot.diff(snapBfrom, snapBto);

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'diff',
        title: `${a} vs ${b} · ${from}..${to}`,
        data: {
          from: { tick: from, timeline: a },
          to:   { tick: to,   timeline: b },
          a: diffA,
          b: diffB,
          stats: {
            a: diffA.stats,
            b: diffB.stats,
          },
          added: [],
          removed: [],
          changed: [],
        },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // dif.export
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Exporta o diff como arquivo. Emite `export:ready` com Blob real.
   *
   * Fase 13.7: antes só retornava payload sem blob — nenhum arquivo
   * era gerado. Agora segue o padrão de `ExportSystem`.
   *
   * @private
   */
  _export(prev, ast, timeline) {
    const parsed = this._parseRaw(ast.raw);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: parsed.error };
    }

    const { a, b, format = 'json' } = parsed;
    if (!a || !b) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: 'uso: dif.export <a> vs <b> [json|csv|md]',
      };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(a)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${a}` };
    }
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(b)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${b}` };
    }

    const snapA = timeline.getSnapshot(timeline.getLastTick(a), a);
    const snapB = timeline.getSnapshot(timeline.getLastTick(b), b);
    const diff = Snapshot.diff(snapA, snapB);

    const normalizedFormat = this._normalizeFormat(format);
    const content = this._serializeDiff(diff, normalizedFormat, a, b);
    const mime = this._mimeFor(normalizedFormat);
    const ext = normalizedFormat === 'markdown' ? 'md' : normalizedFormat;
    const filename = `diff-${a}-vs-${b}-${Date.now().toString(36)}.${ext}`;

    try {
      const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime });
      this.bus.emit('export:ready', {
        blob,
        filename,
        mime,
        format: normalizedFormat,
        size: content.length,
        tick: this.getTick(),
      });

      return {
        ...prev,
        ok: true,
        mutated: false,
        export: {
          format: normalizedFormat,
          filename,
          mime,
          size: content.length,
          at: this.getTick(),
          ready: true,
        },
        right: {
          kind: 'card',
          title: `📦 Diff exportado — ${a} vs ${b}`,
          data: {
            arquivo: filename,
            formato: mime,
            tamanho: this._formatBytes(content.length),
            'estatísticas': JSON.stringify(diff.stats, null, 2),
          },
          sticky: true,
        },
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: `falha ao gerar blob: ${err.message}`,
      };
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Parser de raw
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Extrai os argumentos de uma linha `dif.*` diretamente do raw.
   * Suporta múltiplas sintaxes.
   *
   * @param {string} raw
   * @returns {{ ok:true, a:string, b:string, tick?:string, entityId?:string, from?:string, to?:string, format?:string } | { ok:false, error:string }}
   * @private
   */
  _parseRaw(raw) {
    const s = String(raw || '').trim();

    // 1. dif.export <a> vs <b> [format]
    let m = /^dif\.export\s+(\S+)\s+vs\s+(\S+)(?:\s+(\S+))?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) {
      return { ok: true, a: m[1], b: m[2], format: m[3] || 'json' };
    }

    // 2. dif.<a> vs <b> [modifier arg]
    m = /^dif\.([a-zA-Z_][\w-]*)\s+vs\s+([a-zA-Z_][\w-]*)(?:\s+(at|entity|range)\s+(.+?))?\s*$/i.exec(s);
    if (m) {
      const a = m[1];
      const b = m[2];
      const modifier = m[3];
      const arg = m[4];

      if (modifier === 'at') {
        return { ok: true, a, b, tick: arg?.trim() };
      }
      if (modifier === 'entity') {
        return { ok: true, a, b, entityId: arg?.trim() };
      }
      if (modifier === 'range') {
        const rangeMatch = /^(\S+)\.\.(\S+)$/.exec((arg || '').trim());
        if (rangeMatch) {
          return { ok: true, a, b, from: rangeMatch[1], to: rangeMatch[2] };
        }
        return { ok: false, error: `range inválido: ${arg}` };
      }
      return { ok: true, a, b };
    }

    // 3. dif.at <a> <b> <tick>
    m = /^dif\.at\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return { ok: true, a: m[1], b: m[2], tick: m[3] };

    // 4. dif.entity <a> <b> <id>
    m = /^dif\.entity\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return { ok: true, a: m[1], b: m[2], entityId: m[3] };

    // 5. dif.range <a> <b> <from>..<to>
    m = /^dif\.range\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\.\.(\S+)/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return { ok: true, a: m[1], b: m[2], from: m[3], to: m[4] };

    return { ok: false, error: `sintaxe não reconhecida: ${s}` };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Serialização de diff
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _normalizeFormat(format) {
    const f = String(format || 'json').toLowerCase();
    if (f === 'md') return 'markdown';
    if (['json', 'csv', 'markdown'].includes(f)) return f;
    return 'json';
  }

  _mimeFor(format) {
    switch (format) {
      case 'csv':      return 'text/csv;charset=utf-8';
      case 'markdown': return 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8';
      default:         return 'application/json';
    }
  }

  _serializeDiff(diff, format, a, b) {
    if (format === 'csv') {
      const lines = [];
      lines.push('kind,id,detail');
      for (const id of diff.added) {
        lines.push(`added,"${this._csv(id)}",""`);
      }
      for (const id of diff.removed) {
        lines.push(`removed,"${this._csv(id)}",""`);
      }
      for (const c of diff.changed) {
        lines.push(`changed,"${this._csv(c.id)}","${this._csv(JSON.stringify(c.patch))}"`);
      }
      return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
    }

    if (format === 'markdown') {
      const lines = [];
      lines.push(`# Diff — ${a} vs ${b}`);
      lines.push('');
      lines.push(`- **Adicionadas:** ${diff.stats.added}`);
      lines.push(`- **Removidas:** ${diff.stats.removed}`);
      lines.push(`- **Alteradas:** ${diff.stats.changed}`);
      lines.push('');
      if (diff.added.length > 0) {
        lines.push('## Adicionadas');
        for (const id of diff.added) lines.push(`- \`${id}\``);
        lines.push('');
      }
      if (diff.removed.length > 0) {
        lines.push('## Removidas');
        for (const id of diff.removed) lines.push(`- \`${id}\``);
        lines.push('');
      }
      if (diff.changed.length > 0) {
        lines.push('## Alteradas');
        for (const c of diff.changed) {
          lines.push(`### \`${c.id}\``);
          for (const [comp, data] of Object.entries(c.patch)) {
            lines.push(`- **${comp}** (\`${data.op}\`)`);
          }
          lines.push('');
        }
      }
      return lines.join('\n');
    }

    // json (default)
    return JSON.stringify({
      from: diff.from,
      to: diff.to,
      stats: diff.stats,
      added: diff.added,
      removed: diff.removed,
      changed: diff.changed,
    }, null, 2);
  }

  _csv(v) {
    const s = String(v ?? '');
    if (!/[",\n\r]/.test(s)) return s;
    return s.replace(/"/g, '""');
  }

  _formatBytes(n) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return '—';
    if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`;
    if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${(n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`;
  }
}
```

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 12.0 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file entity-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles ent.create / ent.show / ent.list / ent.delete.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants, core/utils/hierarchy
 *              components/identity, components/meta
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13 — Hierarquia narrativa:
 *   - Tipos hierárquicos (package/category/set/phrase/placeholder-term)
 *     permitem nomes duplicados quando o `parent=` é diferente.
 *     O id interno ganha sufixo `__2`, `__3`, etc.
 *   - `_show`, `_delete` usam `resolvePath` para aceitar
 *     caminho hierárquico (`Base.Apresentação.Inimigo.Frase 1`).
 *   - `_create` valida que duplicatas no MESMO pai são rejeitadas.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import {
  ENTITY_TYPE_LABEL,
  COMPONENT_NAMES,
  HIERARCHICAL_TYPES,
} from '../core/constants.js';
import { makeIdentity } from '../components/identity.js';
import { makeMeta } from '../components/meta.js';
import {
  resolvePath,
  listCandidates,
  buildPath,
} from '../core/utils/hierarchy.js';

/**
 * Tipos que exigem o componente Body (frases).
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<string>}
 */
const _TYPES_WITH_BODY = Object.freeze(['phrase']);

export class EntitySystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('EntitySystem'); }

  run(_line, ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'ent') return prev;

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'create': return this._create(prev, ast, ctx);
        case 'show':   return this._show(prev, ast);
        case 'list':   return this._list(prev, ast);
        case 'delete': return this._delete(prev, ast);
        default:       return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `ent.${ast.action} não tratado` };
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // CREATE
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _create(prev, ast, ctx) {
    const isHierarchical = HIERARCHICAL_TYPES.includes(ast.subtype);

    // ── Resolve o parent (se passado) ──────────────────────
    const parentRef = ast.opts?.parent ?? null;
    let parentId = null;
    if (parentRef) {
      parentId = resolvePath(this.world, parentRef);
      if (!parentId) {
        return {
          ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
          error: `parent não encontrado: ${parentRef}`,
        };
      }
    }

    // ── Validação de colisão ───────────────────────────────
    let id = ast.name;

    if (this.world.hasEntity(id)) {
      if (!isHierarchical) {
        return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade já existe: ${ast.name}` };
      }
      // Hierárquico: se o pai é o mesmo, é duplicata real
      const existingLinks = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      const existingParent = existingLinks?.parent ?? null;
      if (existingParent === parentId) {
        return {
          ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
          error: `já existe "${ast.name}" em ${parentId ? buildPath(this.world, parentId) : '(raiz)'}`,
        };
      }
      // Pai diferente → permite, com id sufixado
      let n = 2;
      while (this.world.hasEntity(`${ast.name}__${n}`)) {
        // Também checa se o pai desse sufixo é o mesmo
        const links = this.world.get(`${ast.name}__${n}`, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
        const p = links?.parent ?? null;
        if (p === parentId) {
          return {
            ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
            error: `já existe "${ast.name}" em ${parentId ? buildPath(this.world, parentId) : '(raiz)'}`,
          };
        }
        n++;
        if (n > 1000) {
          return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'colisão excessiva de id interno' };
        }
      }
      id = `${ast.name}__${n}`;
    }

    // ── Gera shortcode ─────────────────────────────────────
    const shortId = this.ids.generate(ast.subtype, ast.name);

    // ── Componentes base ───────────────────────────────────
    const components = {
      [COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY]: makeIdentity({
        id: shortId,
        name: ast.name,
        description: ast.opts.description ?? '',
        type: ast.subtype,
      }),
      [COMPONENT_NAMES.META]: makeMeta({ builtin: false, tick: ctx.tick }),
    };

    // ── Coleta componentes dos opts ────────────────────────
    const stats = {};
    const flags = [];
    const tags = [];
    const enums = {};
    const texts = {};
    const links = {};
    let bodyText = null;
    let placeholderName = null;

    if (parentId) links.parent = parentId;

    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ast.opts)) {
      if (k === 'description') continue;
      if (k === 'parent') continue;    // já processado

      if (k === 'flags') {
        v.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(f => flags.push(f));
      } else if (k === 'tags') {
        v.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(t => tags.push(t));
      } else if (['location', 'owner'].includes(k)) {
        links[k] = resolvePath(this.world, v) ?? v;
      } else if (['inventory', 'members', 'contains'].includes(k)) {
        links[k] = v.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
          .map(ref => resolvePath(this.world, ref) ?? ref);
      } else if (['faction', 'role', 'region', 'type', 'ideology'].includes(k)) {
        enums[k] = v;
      } else if (k === 'body') {
        bodyText = String(v);
      } else if (k === 'placeholderName') {
        placeholderName = String(v);
      } else {
        const trimmed = String(v).trim();
        const num = Number(trimmed);
        if (trimmed !== '' && Number.isFinite(num)) stats[k] = num;
        else texts[k] = v;
      }
    }

    // ── Auto-preenchimento por tipo ────────────────────────
    if (_TYPES_WITH_BODY.includes(ast.subtype) && bodyText === null) {
      bodyText = ast.name;
    }
    if (ast.subtype === 'placeholder-term' && placeholderName === null) {
      placeholderName = 'termo';
    }

    // ── Monta componentes ──────────────────────────────────
    if (Object.keys(stats).length) components[COMPONENT_NAMES.STATS] = stats;
    if (flags.length) components[COMPONENT_NAMES.FLAGS] = { values: flags };
    if (tags.length) components[COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS] = { values: tags };
    if (Object.keys(enums).length) components[COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS] = enums;
    if (Object.keys(texts).length) components[COMPONENT_NAMES.TEXTS] = texts;
    if (Object.keys(links).length) components[COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS] = links;

    if (bodyText !== null) {
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY] = { text: bodyText };
    }
    if (placeholderName !== null) {
      if (!components[COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS]) components[COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS] = {};
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS].placeholderName = placeholderName;
    }

    // ── Cria ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    this.world.createEntity(components, { id });

    const canonicalPath = buildPath(this.world, id);

    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, created: {
      id,
      shortId,
      name: ast.name,
      type: ast.subtype,
      components: Object.keys(components),
      parent: parentId,
      path: canonicalPath,
      wasSuffixed: id !== ast.name,
    }};
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // SHOW
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _show(prev, ast) {
    const target = this._resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) {
      return this._notFound(prev, ast.target);
    }

    const data = this.world.componentsOf(target);
    const canonicalPath = buildPath(this.world, target);

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'card',
      title: `${data.Identity?.name} (${data.Identity?.id})`,
      data: {
        '— caminho —': canonicalPath,
        ...data,
      },
    }};
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // LIST
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _list(prev, ast) {
    const type = ast.subtype;
    const all = this.world.allEntities();
    const filtered = type
      ? all.filter(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.type === type)
      : all;

    const rows = filtered.map(id => {
      const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const links = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      return {
        id: ident?.id ?? '?',
        name: ident?.name ?? '?',
        type: ident?.type ?? '?',
        path: buildPath(this.world, id),
        parent: links?.parent
          ? this.world.get(links.parent, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name ?? links.parent
          : '',
        blueprint: this.world.has(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IS_BLUEPRINT) ? 'sim' : '',
        instanceOf: this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)?.id ?? '',
      };
    });

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'table',
      title: `Entidades (${filtered.length})`,
      data: rows,
    }};
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // DELETE
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _delete(prev, ast) {
    const target = this._resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) {
      return this._notFound(prev, ast.target);
    }

    // Bloqueia remoção de seeds (`__`-prefixados)
    if (String(target).startsWith('__')) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: `não é possível apagar entidades builtin: ${target}`,
      };
    }

    this.world.destroyEntity(target);
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, destroyed: target };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // HELPERS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Resolve uma referência (caminho, shortcode, nome, id interno).
   * @private
   */
  _resolve(ref) {
    return resolvePath(this.world, ref);
  }

  /**
   * Erro enriquecido quando não encontra — inclui candidatos ambíguos.
   * @private
   */
  _notFound(prev, ref) {
    const candidates = listCandidates(this.world, ref);

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ref}` };
    }

    // Encontrou mas ambíguo
    const list = candidates
      .map(c => `  • ${c.name} (${c.shortId}) — ${c.path}`)
      .join('\n');

    return {
      ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
      error: `referência "${ref}" é ambígua entre ${candidates.length} entidades:\n${list}\n\nUse o caminho completo ou o shortcode.`,
    };
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file export-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles exp.pdf/json/csv/snippets/all/md/html — gera arquivos reais.
 * @imports ecs/system, systems/helpers/export-builder
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Documentação (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   O código já suportava `exp.md`, `exp.markdown` e `exp.html` como
 *   aliases de `exp.pdf`, mas eles não apareciam em
 *   `schemas/builtin-commands.js`. Este arquivo foi inspecionado e
 *   confirmado correto — nenhuma mudança de lógica foi feita. Os
 *   aliases agora estão documentados no catálogo (ver Fase 4.6).
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { ExportBuilder } from './helpers/export-builder.js';

export class ExportSystem extends System {
  constructor() {
    super('ExportSystem');
    /** @type {ExportBuilder|null} */
    this.builder = null;
  }

  init() {
    this.builder = new ExportBuilder(this.machine);
  }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'exp') return prev;
    if (!this.builder) return prev;

    try {
      const result = this._build(ast.action);
      if (!result) {
        return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `exp.${ast.action} não suportado` };
      }

      const { content, filename, mime } = result;
      const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime });
      const size = content.length;

      this.bus.emit('export:ready', {
        blob,
        filename,
        mime,
        format: ast.action,
        size,
        tick: this.getTick(),
      });

      return {
        ...prev,
        ok: true,
        mutated: false,
        export: {
          format: ast.action,
          filename,
          mime,
          size,
          at: this.getTick(),
          ready: true,
        },
        right: {
          kind: 'card',
          title: `📦 Export — ${ast.action}`,
          data: {
            arquivo: filename,
            formato: mime,
            tamanho: formatBytes(size),
            tick: this.getTick(),
          },
          sticky: true,
        },
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ── Despacho por ação ─────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _build(action) {
    switch (action) {
      case 'json':     return this.builder.toJSON();
      case 'csv':      return this.builder.toCSV();
      case 'snippets': return this.builder.toSnippets();
      case 'all':      return this.builder.toAll();
      case 'md':
      case 'markdown': return this.builder.toMarkdown();
      case 'pdf':
      case 'html':     return this.builder.toHTML();
      default:         return null;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Formata bytes para exibição.
 * @param {number} n
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function formatBytes(n) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return '—';
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`;
  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`;
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file fork-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles frk.create/switch/list/delete/merge.
 * @imports ecs/system, ecs/snapshot, core/constants
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { Snapshot } from '../ecs/snapshot.js';

export class ForkSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('ForkSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'frk') return prev;
    const timeline = this.machine?.systems?.get('TimelineSystem');
    if (!timeline) return prev;

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'create': return this._create(prev, ast, timeline);
        case 'switch': return this._switch(prev, ast, timeline);
        case 'list':   return this._list(prev, timeline);
        case 'delete': return this._delete(prev, ast, timeline);
        case 'merge':  return this._merge(prev, ast, timeline);
        default:       return prev;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  _create(prev, ast, timeline) {
    if (timeline.timelines.has(ast.name)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline já existe: ${ast.name}` };
    }
    const base = timeline.activeTimeline;
    const atTick = ast.opts?.at ?? timeline.getLastTick(base);
    const baseEntries = timeline.getTimeline(base);
    const newSnapshots = new Map();
    for (const e of baseEntries) {
      if (parseInt(e.tick.slice(1), 10) > parseInt(atTick.slice(1), 10)) break;
      newSnapshots.set(e.tick, Snapshot.clone(e.snapshot));
    }
    const baseSnap = newSnapshots.get(atTick);
    if (!baseSnap) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `tick não existe em ${base}: ${atTick}` };

    timeline.createTimeline(ast.name, { snapshots: newSnapshots, base, point: atTick, createdAt: this.getTick() });
    Snapshot.restore(this.world, baseSnap, { clear: true });
    timeline.switchTo(ast.name);
    this.machine.state.timeline = ast.name;
    this.machine.state.tick = atTick;
    this.machine.state.tickNumber = parseInt(atTick.slice(1), 10);

    // Reindexa links e ids após restaurar o mundo
    this._rebuildIndexes();

    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, fork: { name: ast.name, base, at: atTick }};
  }

  _switch(prev, ast, timeline) {
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(ast.name)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${ast.name}` };
    }
    const lastTick = timeline.getLastTick(ast.name);
    const snap = timeline.getSnapshot(lastTick, ast.name);
    Snapshot.restore(this.world, snap, { clear: true });
    timeline.switchTo(ast.name);
    this.machine.state.timeline = ast.name;
    this.machine.state.tick = lastTick;
    this.machine.state.tickNumber = parseInt(lastTick.slice(1), 10);

    // Reindexa links e ids após restaurar o mundo
    this._rebuildIndexes();

    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, switched: { to: ast.name, tick: lastTick }};
  }

  _list(prev, timeline) {
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: 'Timelines', data: timeline.listTimelines() }};
  }

  _delete(prev, ast, timeline) {
    if (ast.name === 'main') return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'não pode apagar main' };
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(ast.name)) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${ast.name}` };
    const wasActive = timeline.activeTimeline === ast.name;
    timeline.deleteTimeline(ast.name);
    if (wasActive) {
      const lastTick = timeline.getLastTick('main');
      Snapshot.restore(this.world, timeline.getSnapshot(lastTick, 'main'), { clear: true });
      timeline.switchTo('main');
      this.machine.state.timeline = 'main';
      this.machine.state.tick = lastTick;

      // Reindexa links e ids após restaurar o mundo
      this._rebuildIndexes();
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, deleted: ast.name };
  }

  _merge(prev, ast, timeline) {
    if (!timeline.timelines.has(ast.name)) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `timeline não existe: ${ast.name}` };
    if (ast.name === timeline.activeTimeline) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'não pode merge de si mesma' };

    const srcTick = timeline.getLastTick(ast.name);
    const dstTick = timeline.getLastTick(timeline.activeTimeline);
    const snapSrc = timeline.getSnapshot(srcTick, ast.name);
    const snapDst = timeline.getSnapshot(dstTick, timeline.activeTimeline);
    const diff = Snapshot.diff(snapDst, snapSrc);

    for (const id of diff.added) {
      this.world.createEntity(snapSrc.entities[id], { id });
    }
    for (const id of diff.removed) {
      this.world.destroyEntity(id);
    }
    for (const { id, patch } of diff.changed) {
      for (const [comp, data] of Object.entries(patch)) {
        if (data.op === 'added') this.world.addComponent(id, comp, data.after);
        else if (data.op === 'removed') this.world.removeComponent(id, comp);
        else this.world.set(id, comp, data.after);
      }
    }

    // Reindexa links e ids após mutação direta
    this._rebuildIndexes();

    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, merged: { source: ast.name, target: timeline.activeTimeline, stats: diff.stats }};
  }

  // ── Internos ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Reconstrói LinkIndex e IdRegistry a partir do World atual.
   * Chamado após qualquer restore/merge que troque o estado do mundo.
   * @private
   */
  _rebuildIndexes() {
    if (this.links) this.links.rebuild(this.world);
    if (this.ids) this.ids.rebuildFromWorld(this.world);
    if (this.machine?.links && this.machine.links !== this.links) {
      this.machine.links.rebuild(this.world);
    }
    if (this.machine?.ids && this.machine.ids !== this.ids) {
      this.machine.ids.rebuildFromWorld(this.world);
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file help-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles help.commands/snippets/components/cheatsheet/tutorial.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export class HelpSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('HelpSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'help') return prev;

    const reg = this.machine?.registry;
    switch (ast.action) {
      case 'commands':
        return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: '📖 Comandos', data: reg?.getCommands() ?? [], sticky: true }};
      case 'snippets':
        return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'tree', title: '🧩 Snippets', data: this._snippetsTree(), sticky: true }};
      case 'components':
        return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: '⚙️ Componentes', data: reg?.getComponents() ?? [], sticky: true }};
      case 'cheatsheet':
        return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'card', title: '⚡ Cheatsheet', data: this._cheatsheet(), sticky: true }};
      case 'tutorial':
        return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'tutorial-card', title: '🎓 Tutorial', data: { step: 1, total: 7 }}};
      default: return prev;
    }
  }

  // ── Snippets tree ──────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Monta árvore aninhada a partir dos triggers registrados.
   *
   * Fontes:
   *   - Registry (builtin): { trigger, kind, description, subs }
   *   - World (user):       entidades com Trigger
   *
   * Cada nó:
   *   { label, kind, description, source, children: { ... } }
   *
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _snippetsTree() {
    const root = { children: {} };
    const registry = this.machine?.registry;

    // 1. Registry (builtin)
    for (const def of registry?.getSnippets() ?? []) {
      this._insertTrigger(root, def.trigger, {
        kind: def.kind ?? 'menu',
        description: def.description ?? '',
        source: 'builtin',
      });
    }

    // 2. World (user) — sobrepõe builtin quando colidir
    for (const id of this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER)) {
      const trigger = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER)?.value;
      if (!trigger) continue;
      const kind = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE)?.value ?? 'text';
      const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      this._insertTrigger(root, trigger, {
        kind,
        description: ident?.description ?? '',
        source: 'user',
      });
    }

    return this._treeToPlain(root);
  }

  /**
   * Insere um trigger na árvore, criando nós intermediários.
   * @param {Object} root
   * @param {string} trigger
   * @param {Object} meta
   * @private
   */
  _insertTrigger(root, trigger, meta) {
    const parts = String(trigger).split('.').filter(Boolean);
    let cur = root;

    // Se termina com '.', o último segmento é vazio e representa o próprio nó
    const endsWithDot = trigger.endsWith('.');

    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      const part = parts[i];
      if (!cur.children[part]) {
        cur.children[part] = {
          label: part,
          kind: null,
          description: '',
          source: null,
          children: {},
        };
      }
      cur = cur.children[part];
    }

    cur.kind = meta.kind;
    cur.description = meta.description;
    cur.source = meta.source;
    cur.isLeaf = true;
    if (endsWithDot) cur.endsWithDot = true;
  }

  /**
   * Converte árvore interna em estrutura plana serializável.
   * @param {Object} node
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _treeToPlain(node) {
    const out = {};
    for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(node.children ?? {})) {
      const entry = {
        kind: child.kind ?? null,
        description: child.description ?? '',
        source: child.source ?? null,
      };
      if (child.children && Object.keys(child.children).length > 0) {
        entry.children = this._treeToPlain(child);
      }
      out[key] = entry;
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ── Cheatsheet ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  _cheatsheet() {
    return {
      quickCommands: [
        { c: 'ent.create.character X', d: 'cria personagem' },
        { c: 'mut.add.stats X.y 1', d: 'soma stat' },
        { c: 'link.add.rel X Y', d: 'conecta entidades' },
        { c: 'que.at T1 X', d: 'estado em T1' },
        { c: 'sea.find "x"', d: 'busca textual' },
        { c: 'aud.continuity', d: 'checa coerência' },
        { c: 'frk.create alt at T', d: 'ramifica timeline' },
        { c: 'exp.json', d: 'exporta mundo' },
      ],
      operators: [
        { o: '=', d: 'busca global' },
        { o: 'ap.=x', d: 'busca em categoria' },
        { o: 'a,b', d: 'AND' },
        { o: 'a/b', d: 'OR' },
        { o: '!a', d: 'NOT' },
      ],
    };
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file command-runner.js
 * @module systems/helpers
 * @description Executa uma linha de comando via Machine, retornando o resultado.
 * @imports — (nenhum)
 * @importedBy systems/helpers/rule-executor, systems/template-system, systems/snippet-system
 * @level 8
 *
 * Este é o ÚNICO ponto onde um sistema pode invocar o pipeline completo
 * indiretamente. Não importa nenhum sistema específico.
 */

export class CommandRunner {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine  — instância do Context Machine
   */
  constructor(machine) {
    this.machine = machine;
  }

  /**
   * Executa uma linha no pipeline, capturando o resultado.
   * Nunca lança — retorna `{ ok:false, error }` em falha.
   *
   * @param {string} line
   * @param {Object} [ctx={}]  — contexto adicional (opcional)
   * @returns {Object} SystemResult
   */
  run(line, ctx = {}) {
    if (!line || typeof line !== 'string') {
      return { ok: false, error: 'linha vazia' };
    }
    try {
      const result = this.machine.handleLine(line);
      return result ?? { ok: false, error: 'sem resultado' };
    } catch (err) {
      return { ok: false, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Executa várias linhas em sequência.
   * @param {string[]} lines
   * @returns {{ ok:boolean, results:Object[], errors:string[] }}
   */
  runMany(lines = []) {
    const results = [];
    const errors = [];
    for (const line of lines) {
      const res = this.run(line);
      results.push(res);
      if (!res.ok) errors.push(res.error || 'unknown');
    }
    return {
      ok: errors.length === 0,
      results,
      errors,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Executa um comando interno (prefixo `__`) diretamente.
   * @param {string} raw  — ex: '__download:pdf'
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  runInternal(raw, opts = {}) {
    if (!raw || !raw.startsWith('__')) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'não é comando interno' };
    }
    const [verb, arg] = raw.slice(2).split(':');
    switch (verb) {
      case 'download':
        return this.machine.bus?.emit ? { ok: true, action: 'download', format: arg } : { ok: false };
      case 'copy':
        return { ok: true, action: 'copy', format: arg };
      case 'preview':
        return { ok: true, action: 'preview', format: arg };
      case 'close':
        return { ok: true, action: 'close' };
      case 'jump':
        return { ok: true, action: 'jump', tick: arg };
      case 'save':
        this.machine.bus.emit('persist:flush', { reason: 'manual' });
        return { ok: true, action: 'save' };
      default:
        return { ok: false, error: `ação interna desconhecida: ${verb}` };
    }
  }
}
```
