```javascript
/**
 * @file export-builder.js
 * @module systems/helpers
 * @description Constrói representações exportáveis do World em vários formatos.
 * @imports core/constants, core/utils/dom, components/identity
 * @importedBy systems/export-system
 * @level 8
 *
 * Métodos públicos:
 *   toJSON(machine)      → string JSON pretty
 *   toCSV(machine)       → string CSV
 *   toMarkdown(machine)  → string Markdown
 *   toSnippets(machine)  → string JSON só de snippets
 *   toHTML(machine)      → string HTML pronto para imprimir (→ PDF)
 *
 * Cada método retorna { content, filename, mime }.
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES, ENTITY_TYPE_LABEL } from '../../core/constants.js';

export class ExportBuilder {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine — instância do Context Machine
   */
  constructor(machine) {
    this.machine = machine;
  }

  // ── World ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Snapshot completo do World em JSON.
   * @returns {{ content:string, filename:string, mime:string }}
   */
  toJSON() {
    const world = this.machine.world;
    const entities = {};

    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      entities[id] = world.componentsOf(id);
    }

    const payload = {
      version: 1,
      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      tick: this.machine.getTick(),
      timeline: this.machine.getTimeline(),
      app: 'narrative-ecs',
      entities,
    };

    return {
      content: JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2),
      filename: this._filename('json'),
      mime: 'application/json',
    };
  }

  // ── CSV ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Tabela de entidades em CSV.
   * Colunas: id, name, type, description, stats, flags, tags, enums, lists, parent, instanceOf.
   * Objetos aninhados são serializados como JSON inline.
   * @returns {{ content:string, filename:string, mime:string }}
   */
  toCSV() {
    const world = this.machine.world;
    const cols = [
      'id', 'name', 'type', 'description',
      'stats', 'flags', 'tags', 'enums', 'lists',
      'parent', 'instanceOf',
    ];

    const rows = [];
    rows.push(cols.join(','));

    for (const entityId of world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const stats = world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.STATS);
      const flags = world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.FLAGS);
      const tags  = world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS);
      const enums = world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS);
      const lists = world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.LISTS);
      const links = world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      const instOf = world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF);

      const row = [
        this._csv(ident?.id ?? entityId),
        this._csv(ident?.name ?? ''),
        this._csv(ident?.type ?? ''),
        this._csv(ident?.description ?? ''),
        this._csvJson(stats),
        this._csvJson(flags?.values),
        this._csvJson(tags?.values),
        this._csvJson(enums),
        this._csvJson(lists),
        this._csv(links?.parent ?? ''),
        this._csv(instOf?.id ?? ''),
      ];
      rows.push(row.join(','));
    }

    return {
      content: rows.join('\n') + '\n',
      filename: this._filename('csv'),
      mime: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8',
    };
  }

  // ── Markdown ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Documento Markdown legível.
   * Agrupa entidades por tipo e lista componentes relevantes.
   * @returns {{ content:string, filename:string, mime:string }}
   */
  toMarkdown() {
    const world = this.machine.world;
    const tick = this.machine.getTick();
    const timeline = this.machine.getTimeline();

    const lines = [];
    lines.push(`# Mundo — ${tick}`);
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(`- **Timeline:** \`${timeline}\``);
    lines.push(`- **Exportado em:** ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
    lines.push(`- **Total de entidades:** ${world.allEntities().length}`);
    lines.push('');

    // Agrupa por tipo
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const type = ident?.type ?? 'custom';
      if (!groups.has(type)) groups.set(type, []);
      groups.get(type).push(id);
    }

    // Ordena tipos alfabeticamente
    const sortedTypes = Array.from(groups.keys()).sort();

    for (const type of sortedTypes) {
      const ids = groups.get(type);
      const label = ENTITY_TYPE_LABEL[type] ?? type;
      lines.push(`## ${label} (${ids.length})`);
      lines.push('');

      for (const id of ids) {
        lines.push(this._markdownEntity(id));
        lines.push('');
      }
    }

    return {
      content: lines.join('\n'),
      filename: this._filename('md'),
      mime: 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8',
    };
  }

  // ── Snippets ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Exporta apenas entidades que têm `Trigger` (snippets).
   * @returns {{ content:string, filename:string, mime:string }}
   */
  toSnippets() {
    const world = this.machine.world;
    const out = [];

    for (const id of world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER)) {
      const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const trigger = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER)?.value;
      const type = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE)?.value ?? 'text';
      const body = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text ?? '';
      const defs = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.PLACEHOLDER_DEFS)?.defs ?? null;
      const runs = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.RUNS)?.cmds ?? null;
      const menu = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.MENU_OPTS)?.options ?? null;

      out.push({
        id: ident?.id ?? id,
        name: ident?.name ?? trigger,
        trigger,
        type,
        body,
        defs,
        runs,
        menu,
      });
    }

    out.sort((a, b) => a.trigger.localeCompare(b.trigger));

    return {
      content: JSON.stringify({
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        tick: this.machine.getTick(),
        count: out.length,
        snippets: out,
      }, null, 2),
      filename: this._filename('snippets.json'),
      mime: 'application/json',
    };
  }

  // ── HTML (→ PDF via print) ────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Documento HTML com CSS de impressão.
   * O usuário abre no navegador e usa Ctrl+P → Salvar como PDF.
   * @returns {{ content:string, filename:string, mime:string }}
   */
  toHTML() {
    const world = this.machine.world;
    const tick = this.machine.getTick();
    const timeline = this.machine.getTimeline();

    const groups = new Map();
    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const type = ident?.type ?? 'custom';
      if (!groups.has(type)) groups.set(type, []);
      groups.get(type).push(id);
    }

    const sortedTypes = Array.from(groups.keys()).sort();

    let body = '';
    for (const type of sortedTypes) {
      const ids = groups.get(type);
      const label = ENTITY_TYPE_LABEL[type] ?? type;
      body += `<h2>${escapeHtml(label)} (${ids.length})</h2>\n`;
      for (const id of ids) {
        body += this._htmlEntity(id);
      }
    }

    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Narrativa — ${escapeHtml(tick)}</title>
<style>
  :root { color-scheme: light; }
  body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
         max-width: 800px; margin: 40px auto; padding: 0 20px; color: #1a202c; line-height: 1.6; }
  h1 { border-bottom: 2px solid #4a90e2; padding-bottom: 8px; }
  h2 { margin-top: 32px; color: #2b6cb0; font-size: 18px; }
  h3 { margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 15px; }
  .meta { color: #718096; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .entity { border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .entity .shortcode { font-family: 'Consolas', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #718096; font-weight: normal; }
  .entity .desc { color: #4a5568; font-size: 13px; margin: 6px 0; }
  .entity dl { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 13px; }
  .entity dt { font-weight: 600; color: #4a5568; display: inline; }
  .entity dd { display: inline; margin: 0 0 0 4px; font-family: 'Consolas', monospace; }
  .entity dd::after { content: ' · '; color: #cbd5e0; }
  .entity dd:last-child::after { content: ''; }
  @media print { body { margin: 0; } h2 { break-after: avoid; } .entity { break-inside: avoid; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>Mundo — ${escapeHtml(tick)}</h1>
<div class="meta">Timeline: <code>${escapeHtml(timeline)}</code> · ${world.allEntities().length} entidades · exportado em ${new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</div>
${body}
</body>
</html>`;

    return {
      content: html,
      filename: this._filename('html'),
      mime: 'text/html;charset=utf-8',
    };
  }

  // ── All ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Manifesto com todas as representações.
   * @returns {{ content:string, filename:string, mime:string }}
   */
  toAll() {
    const payload = {
      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      tick: this.machine.getTick(),
      timeline: this.machine.getTimeline(),
      json: JSON.parse(this.toJSON().content),
      csv: this.toCSV().content,
      markdown: this.toMarkdown().content,
      snippets: JSON.parse(this.toSnippets().content),
    };

    return {
      content: JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2),
      filename: this._filename('all.json'),
      mime: 'application/json',
    };
  }

  // ── Internos ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Nome de arquivo padrão: `narrativa-<tick>-<timestamp>.<ext>`.
   * @param {string} ext
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _filename(ext) {
    const tick = this.machine.getTick().replace(/[^T0-9]/g, '');
    const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-').slice(0, 19);
    return `narrativa-${tick}-${ts}.${ext}`;
  }

  /**
   * Escapa um campo CSV (aspas, vírgula, quebra de linha).
   * @param {any} v
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _csv(v) {
    const s = String(v ?? '');
    if (!/[",\n\r]/.test(s)) return s;
    return `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }

  /**
   * Serializa um objeto em CSV (JSON inline escapado).
   * @param {any} v
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _csvJson(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return '';
    if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length === 0) return '';
    if (typeof v === 'object' && Object.keys(v).length === 0) return '';
    return this._csv(JSON.stringify(v));
  }

  /**
   * Bloco Markdown de uma entidade.
   * @param {string} id
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _markdownEntity(id) {
    const world = this.machine.world;
    const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);

    const lines = [];
    lines.push(`### ${ident?.name ?? id} (\`${ident?.id ?? id}\`)`);
    if (ident?.description) lines.push('');
    if (ident?.description) lines.push(`> ${ident.description}`);

    const stats = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.STATS);
    if (stats && Object.keys(stats).length > 0) {
      lines.push('');
      lines.push('**Stats:**');
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(stats)) lines.push(`- \`${k}\`: ${v}`);
    }

    const enums = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS);
    if (enums && Object.keys(enums).length > 0) {
      lines.push('');
      lines.push('**Enums:**');
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(enums)) lines.push(`- \`${k}\`: ${v}`);
    }

    const flags = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.FLAGS)?.values;
    if (flags && flags.length > 0) {
      lines.push('');
      lines.push(`**Flags:** ${flags.map(f => `\`${f}\``).join(', ')}`);
    }

    const tags = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS)?.values;
    if (tags && tags.length > 0) {
      lines.push('');
      lines.push(`**Tags:** ${tags.map(t => `#${t}`).join(' ')}`);
    }

    const lists = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LISTS);
    if (lists && Object.keys(lists).length > 0) {
      lines.push('');
      lines.push('**Lists:**');
      for (const [k, arr] of Object.entries(lists)) {
        lines.push(`- \`${k}\`: ${(arr || []).join(', ')}`);
      }
    }

    const body = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text;
    if (body) {
      lines.push('');
      lines.push(`**Body:** ${body}`);
    }

    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  /**
   * Bloco HTML de uma entidade.
   * @param {string} id
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _htmlEntity(id) {
    const world = this.machine.world;
    const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);

    let html = `<div class="entity">`;
    html += `<h3>${escapeHtml(ident?.name ?? id)} <span class="shortcode">${escapeHtml(ident?.id ?? id)}</span></h3>`;

    if (ident?.description) {
      html += `<div class="desc">${escapeHtml(ident.description)}</div>`;
    }

    const pairs = [];

    const stats = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.STATS);
    if (stats) for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(stats)) pairs.push([k, String(v)]);

    const enums = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS);
    if (enums) for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(enums)) pairs.push([k, String(v)]);

    const flags = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.FLAGS)?.values;
    if (flags?.length) pairs.push(['flags', flags.join(', ')]);

    const tags = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS)?.values;
    if (tags?.length) pairs.push(['tags', tags.join(', ')]);

    const lists = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LISTS);
    if (lists) for (const [k, arr] of Object.entries(lists)) {
      pairs.push([k, (arr || []).join(', ')]);
    }

    if (pairs.length > 0) {
      html += `<dl>`;
      for (const [k, v] of pairs) {
        html += `<dt>${escapeHtml(k)}:</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(v)}</dd>`;
      }
      html += `</dl>`;
    }

    html += `</div>\n`;
    return html;
  }
}

/**
 * Escapa string para HTML.
 * @param {string} s
 * @returns {string}
 * @private
 */
function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file expression-evaluator.js
 * @module systems/helpers
 * @description Avalia expressões booleanas simples usadas em regras (IF).
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy systems/helpers/guard-evaluator
 * @level 8
 *
 * Sintaxe suportada:
 *   A = B                     igualdade
 *   A != B                    diferença
 *   A > N  /  A < N           comparação numérica
 *   A >= N / A <= N           comparação numérica
 *   A ~ /regex/               match regex
 *   A                         campo existe (truthy)
 *   !A                        negação
 *   A AND B / A OR B          combinadores
 *   A in B                    A presente em B (array)
 *   A contains B              A contém B (string)
 *   true / false              literais
 *
 * Resolução de paths:
 *   this.stats.fear           → lê Stats.fear da entidade em ctx.entity/this/target
 *   newEntity.name            → lê Identity.name da entidade em ctx.newEntity
 *   Cinza.weather             → lê o primeiro campo "weather" que existir em
 *                                qualquer componente de "Cinza"
 *   type                      → se ctx.entity existe, lê Identity.type
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../../core/constants.js';

export class ExpressionEvaluator {
  /**
   * @param {Object} world
   */
  constructor(world) {
    this.world = world;

    /**
     * Aliases de componente de primeiro nível.
     * Se o path começa com um destes, o acesso é direto.
     * @type {Object<string,string>}
     */
    this.aliases = {
      stats: 'Stats',
      flags: 'Flags',
      enums: 'Enums',
      texts: 'Texts',
      lists: 'Lists',
      links: 'Links',
      tags:  'Tags',
      knows: 'Knows',
      meta:  'Meta',
      identity: 'Identity',
    };
  }

  // ── API principal ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Avalia uma expressão completa contra um contexto.
   *
   * @param {string} expr
   * @param {Object} ctx — { entity, this, target, new, newEntity, evt, payload, ... }
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  evaluate(expr, ctx = {}) {
    const text = String(expr ?? 'true').trim();
    if (!text || text === 'true') return true;
    if (text === 'false') return false;

    // OR (menor precedência)
    const orParts = this._splitTop(text, ' OR ');
    if (orParts.length > 1) {
      return orParts.some(p => this.evaluate(p, ctx));
    }

    // AND
    const andParts = this._splitTop(text, ' AND ');
    if (andParts.length > 1) {
      return andParts.every(p => this.evaluate(p, ctx));
    }

    // NOT (prefixo)
    if (text.startsWith('NOT ')) {
      return !this.evaluate(text.slice(4), ctx);
    }
    if (text.startsWith('!')) {
      return !this.evaluate(text.slice(1), ctx);
    }

    return this._evaluateLeaf(text, ctx);
  }

  // ── Folha: comparações ──────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _evaluateLeaf(text, ctx) {
    // contains
    let m = text.match(/^(.+?)\s+contains\s+(.+)$/);
    if (m) {
      const a = this._resolveValue(m[1], ctx);
      const b = this._resolveValue(m[2], ctx);
      return String(a ?? '').includes(String(b ?? ''));
    }

    // in
    m = text.match(/^(.+?)\s+in\s+(.+)$/);
    if (m) {
      const a = this._resolveValue(m[1], ctx);
      const b = this._resolveValue(m[2], ctx);
      if (Array.isArray(b)) return b.includes(a);
      if (typeof b === 'string') return b.includes(String(a ?? ''));
      return false;
    }

    // regex match:  A ~ /re/flags
    m = text.match(/^(.+?)\s*~\s*\/(.+)\/(\w*)$/);
    if (m) {
      const value = String(this._resolveValue(m[1], ctx) ?? '');
      try {
        const re = new RegExp(m[2], m[3] || '');
        return re.test(value);
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    }

    // comparação:  A op B
    m = text.match(/^(.+?)\s*(>=|<=|!=|>|<|=)\s*(.+)$/);
    if (m) {
      const left = this._resolveValue(m[1], ctx);
      const op = m[2];
      const right = this._resolveValue(m[3], ctx);
      return this._compare(left, op, right);
    }

    // termo simples (truthy)
    const value = this._resolveValue(text, ctx);
    return this._isTruthy(value);
  }

  // ── Resolução de valores ────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _resolveValue(raw, ctx) {
    const token = String(raw).trim();

    // literais
    if (token === 'true') return true;
    if (token === 'false') return false;
    if (token === 'null') return null;

    // número
    if (/^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(token)) return Number(token);

    // string entre aspas
    if ((token.startsWith('"') && token.endsWith('"')) ||
        (token.startsWith("'") && token.endsWith("'"))) {
      return token.slice(1, -1);
    }

    // variável de contexto (this, target, entity, new, newEntity, evt, payload)
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx, token)) {
      return ctx[token];
    }

    // path: Entity.field[.sub]
    const dot = token.indexOf('.');
    if (dot > 0) {
      const entityRef = token.slice(0, dot);
      const path = token.slice(dot + 1);
      const entityId = this._resolveEntity(entityRef, ctx);
      if (!entityId) return null;
      return this._readPath(entityId, path);
    }

    // palavra simples (sem ponto) — tenta ler do Identity da entidade atual
    if (/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/.test(token)) {
      const currentId = ctx.entity ?? ctx.this ?? ctx.target;
      if (currentId && this.world.hasEntity(currentId)) {
        const ident = this.world.get(currentId, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
        if (ident && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ident, token)) {
          return ident[token];
        }
      }
    }

    // referência a entidade (nome curto ou shortcode)
    const id = this._resolveEntity(token, ctx);
    if (id) return id;

    // fallback: devolve o token como string literal
    return token;
  }

  /**
   * Resolve uma referência (variável de contexto, id interno ou shortcode)
   * para o id interno da entidade.
   * @private
   */
  _resolveEntity(ref, ctx) {
    if (!ref) return null;

    // variável de contexto
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx, ref)) {
      const v = ctx[ref];
      if (typeof v === 'string' && this.world.hasEntity(v)) return v;
      if (v?.id && this.world.hasEntity(v.id)) return v.id;
    }

    // id interno
    if (this.world.hasEntity(ref)) return ref;

    // shortcode (Identity.id)
    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (ident?.id === ref) return id;
    }

    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Lê um path dentro de uma entidade.
   *
   * Se o primeiro segmento é um alias conhecido (`stats`, `flags`, …), o acesso
   * é direto ao componente correspondente.
   *
   * Caso contrário, varre TODOS os componentes da entidade procurando
   * um campo com aquele nome — cobre `newEntity.name` (Identity.name),
   * `Cinza.weather` (enums/texts/stats), etc.
   *
   * @param {string} entityId
   * @param {string} path
   * @returns {any}
   * @private
   */
  _readPath(entityId, path) {
    if (!path) return null;
    const parts = String(path).split('.');
    const head = parts[0];
    const compName = this.aliases[head];

    // Caso A: alias conhecido → acesso direto
    if (compName) {
      const comp = this.world.get(entityId, compName);
      if (comp == null) return null;

      if (parts.length === 1) return comp;

      let cur = comp;
      for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
        if (cur == null) return null;
        cur = cur[parts[i]];
      }
      return cur;
    }

    // Caso B: sem alias → varre todos os componentes procurando o campo
    const comps = this.world.componentsOf(entityId);
    if (!comps) return null;

    for (const data of Object.values(comps)) {
      if (data == null || typeof data !== 'object') continue;
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, head)) continue;

      let cur = data[head];
      for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
        if (cur == null) return null;
        cur = cur[parts[i]];
      }
      return cur;
    }

    return null;
  }

  // ── Comparadores ────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _compare(a, op, b) {
    const na = Number(a);
    const nb = Number(b);
    const numeric = Number.isFinite(na) && Number.isFinite(nb);

    switch (op) {
      case '=':  return numeric ? na === nb : a === b;
      case '!=': return numeric ? na !== nb : a !== b;
      case '>':  return numeric && na > nb;
      case '<':  return numeric && na < nb;
      case '>=': return numeric && na >= nb;
      case '<=': return numeric && na <= nb;
      default:   return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _isTruthy(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || v === false) return false;
    if (v === true) return true;
    if (typeof v === 'number') return v !== 0;
    if (typeof v === 'string') return v.length > 0;
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length > 0;
    return true;
  }

  // ── Split de operador no nível de topo ──────────────────────

  /**
   * Divide `text` por `sep` respeitando parênteses e aspas.
   * @private
   */
  _splitTop(text, sep) {
    const out = [];
    let depth = 0;
    let inQuotes = false;
    let buf = '';
    let i = 0;

    while (i < text.length) {
      const ch = text[i];

      if (ch === "'" || ch === '"') {
        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
        buf += ch;
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (!inQuotes) {
        if (ch === '(') depth++;
        if (ch === ')') depth--;
        if (depth === 0 && text.startsWith(sep, i)) {
          out.push(buf);
          buf = '';
          i += sep.length;
          continue;
        }
      }
      buf += ch;
      i++;
    }
    out.push(buf);
    return out.map(s => s.trim());
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file guard-evaluator.js
 * @module systems/helpers
 * @description Avalia o IF de uma regra contra um evento. Retorna os alvos que casam.
 * @imports core/constants, systems/helpers/expression-evaluator
 * @importedBy systems/rule-system
 * @level 8
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../../core/constants.js';
import { ExpressionEvaluator } from './expression-evaluator.js';

export class GuardEvaluator {
  /**
   * @param {Object} world
   * @param {Object} links — LinkIndex
   */
  constructor(world, links) {
    this.world = world;
    this.links = links;
    this.expr = new ExpressionEvaluator(world);
  }

  /**
   * Avalia a condição e retorna a lista de entidades alvo.
   *
   * Regras de coleta:
   *   - Se `item.payload.id` existe, esse é o ÚNICO candidato.
   *   - Caso contrário, todas as entidades do mundo são candidatas.
   *
   * O contexto passado ao avaliador inclui, por candidato:
   *   { evt, payload, new, newEntity, entity, this, target }
   *
   * @param {string} ifExpr
   * @param {Object} item — { evt, payload, depth }
   * @param {Object} [ruleMeta={}]
   * @returns {string[]} entityIds que satisfazem o IF
   */
  evaluate(ifExpr, item, ruleMeta = {}) {
    const candidates = this._collectCandidates(item);
    if (candidates.length === 0) return [];

    const ctxBase = this._buildContext(item);
    const matches = [];

    for (const id of candidates) {
      const ctx = {
        ...ctxBase,
        entity: id,
        this: id,
        target: id,
      };
      try {
        if (this.expr.evaluate(ifExpr || 'true', ctx)) {
          matches.push(id);
        }
      } catch {
        // expressão malformada — ignora este candidato
      }
    }
    return matches;
  }

  // ── Coleta de candidatos ────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _collectCandidates(item) {
    // Evento atômico (component:*, entity:*, link:*) → só o id do payload
    if (item.payload?.id && this.world.hasEntity(item.payload.id)) {
      return [item.payload.id];
    }

    // Sem payload.id → todas as entidades
    return this.world.allEntities();
  }

  // ── Contexto base ───────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _buildContext(item) {
    const ctx = {
      evt: item.evt,
      payload: item.payload ?? null,
    };

    // Aliases comuns para a entidade recém-criada
    if (item.evt === 'entity:created') {
      const newId = item.payload?.id ?? null;
      ctx.new = newId;
      ctx.newEntity = newId;
    }

    return ctx;
  }

  // ── Diagnóstico ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Verifica se um IF é sintaticamente válido.
   * @param {string} ifExpr
   * @returns {{ ok:boolean, error?:string }}
   */
  validate(ifExpr) {
    try {
      this.expr.evaluate(ifExpr || 'true', {});
      return { ok: true };
    } catch (err) {
      return { ok: false, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Coleta referências a entidades citadas numa expressão.
   * @param {string} ifExpr
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  extractRefs(ifExpr) {
    const text = String(ifExpr || '');
    const tokens = text.split(/[\s=!<>~()]+/).filter(Boolean);
    const refs = new Set();
    for (const t of tokens) {
      if (/^\d+$/.test(t)) continue;
      if (['true', 'false', 'null', 'AND', 'OR', 'NOT'].includes(t)) continue;
      if (['contains', 'in'].includes(t)) continue;
      const dot = t.indexOf('.');
      const candidate = dot > 0 ? t.slice(0, dot) : t;
      if (/^[A-Za-z_][\w-]*$/.test(candidate)) {
        refs.add(candidate);
      }
    }
    return Array.from(refs);
  }

  /**
   * Retorna o tipo declarado de uma entidade (helper para debug).
   * @param {string} id
   * @returns {string|null}
   */
  entityType(id) {
    if (!id) return null;
    return this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.type ?? null;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file merge-resolver.js
 * @module systems/helpers
 * @description Resolve herança cumulativa (cadeia de blueprints).
 * @imports core/constants, core/utils/object
 * @importedBy systems/inheritance-system
 * @level 8
 *
 * Algoritmo:
 *   1. Constrói a cadeia folha → raiz.
 *   2. Coleta política de merge de cada nível.
 *   3. Itera da raiz → folha, aplicando merge por componente.
 *   4. Aplica tombstones da folha.
 *   5. Rastreia a origem de cada campo.
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES, NEVER_HERITABLE, MERGE_DEFAULT } from '../../core/constants.js';
import { deepMerge, deepClone } from '../../core/utils/object.js';

export class MergeResolver {
  /**
   * @param {Object} world
   */
  constructor(world) {
    this.world = world;
  }

  /**
   * Resolve o estado efetivo de uma entidade.
   *
   * @param {string} entityId
   * @returns {{
   *   resolved: Object,
   *   origins: Object,
   *   chain: string[],
   *   chainNames: string[],
   *   policy: Object
   * }}
   */
  resolve(entityId) {
    const chain = this.buildChain(entityId);
    const policy = this.collectPolicy(chain);
    const resolved = {};
    const origins = {};

    // raiz → folha
    for (let i = chain.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const levelId = chain[i];
      const comps = this.world.componentsOf(levelId) || {};

      for (const [compName, data] of Object.entries(comps)) {
        if (NEVER_HERITABLE.has(compName)) continue;

        const strategy = this.strategyFor(policy, compName);
        if (!resolved[compName]) {
          resolved[compName] = deepClone(data);
        } else {
          resolved[compName] = deepMerge(resolved[compName], data, { strategy });
        }
      }
    }

    // tombstones
    const tombstones = this.world.get(entityId, COMPONENT_NAMES.TOMBSTONES) || {};
    for (const [compName, fields] of Object.entries(tombstones)) {
      if (!resolved[compName]) continue;
      for (const field of fields) {
        delete resolved[compName][field];
      }
    }

    // origem por campo
    for (const [compName, compData] of Object.entries(resolved)) {
      origins[compName] = {};
      for (const field of Object.keys(compData)) {
        for (const levelId of chain) {
          const levelData = this.world.get(levelId, compName);
          if (levelData && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(levelData, field)) {
            const ident = this.world.get(levelId, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
            origins[compName][field] = ident?.name ?? levelId;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const chainNames = chain.map(id =>
      this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name ?? id
    );

    return { resolved, origins, chain, chainNames, policy };
  }

  // ── Cadeia ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Constrói a cadeia folha → raiz.
   * @param {string} id
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  buildChain(id) {
    const chain = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    let cur = id;
    while (cur && !seen.has(cur)) {
      seen.add(cur);
      chain.push(cur);
      const derives = this.world.get(cur, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM)?.ids ?? [];
      const instanceOf = this.world.get(cur, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)?.id;
      cur = derives[0] ?? instanceOf ?? null;
    }
    return chain;
  }

  /**
   * Coleta política de merge cumulativa ao longo da cadeia.
   * @param {string[]} chain
   * @returns {Object}
   */
  collectPolicy(chain) {
    const merged = { ...MERGE_DEFAULT };
    for (const id of chain) {
      const policy = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.MERGE_POLICY);
      if (policy) Object.assign(merged, policy);
    }
    return merged;
  }

  /**
   * Retorna a estratégia de merge para um componente.
   * @param {Object} policy
   * @param {string} compName
   * @returns {string}
   */
  strategyFor(policy, compName) {
    return policy[compName] ?? 'override';
  }

  // ── Descendentes ────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Encontra todos os descendentes (diretos e indiretos).
   * @param {string} rootId
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  findDescendants(rootId) {
    const out = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const queue = [rootId];

    while (queue.length) {
      const cur = queue.shift();
      for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
        if (seen.has(id) || id === rootId) continue;
        const instOf = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)?.id;
        const derives = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM)?.ids ?? [];
        if (instOf === cur || derives.includes(cur)) {
          seen.add(id);
          out.push(id);
          queue.push(id);
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Verifica se reparent criaria ciclo.
   * @param {string} target
   * @param {string} newParent
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  wouldCycle(target, newParent) {
    if (target === newParent) return true;
    const parentChain = this.buildChain(newParent);
    return parentChain.includes(target);
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file roll-picker.js
 * @module systems/helpers
 * @description Fonte de strings aleatórias para o RollOverlay.
 * @imports core/constants
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 8
 *
 * Uma "categoria" é uma entidade do tipo `set`. As frases elegíveis são as
 * entidades do tipo `phrase` cujo Links.parent aponta para essa set.
 *
 * Se a set não tiver frases diretas, procura em sets-filhas (recursivo).
 */

import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../../core/constants.js';

export class RollPicker {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine
   */
  constructor(machine) {
    this.machine = machine;
  }

  // ── Sequência padrão ───────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Retorna a lista padrão de categorias para o roll.
   * Usa as `set` entities que tenham ao menos uma `phrase` descendente.
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  defaultSequence() {
    const sets = this._allSets();
    const usable = sets.filter(id => this._phrasesUnder(id).length > 0);
    const chosen = usable.length > 0 ? usable : sets;
    return chosen.map(id => this._shortLabel(id));
  }

  /**
   * Retorna os IDs internos das categorias padrão.
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  defaultSequenceIds() {
    const sets = this._allSets();
    const usable = sets.filter(id => this._phrasesUnder(id).length > 0);
    return usable.length > 0 ? usable : sets;
  }

  // ── Pick ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Retorna uma string aleatória para uma categoria.
   * A categoria pode vir como:
   *   - ID interno ('__set_ap_inim')
   *   - shortcode ('SET-API')
   *   - nome humano ('Inimigo')
   *
   * @param {string} category
   * @returns {string}
   */
  pickNext(category) {
    const setId = this._resolveSet(category);
    if (!setId) return `(categoria: ${category})`;

    const phrases = this._phrasesUnder(setId);
    if (phrases.length === 0) return '(sem itens)';

    const pick = phrases[Math.floor(Math.random() * phrases.length)];
    const body = this.machine.world.get(pick, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text;
    if (body) return body;

    const ident = this.machine.world.get(pick, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    return ident?.name ?? pick;
  }

  // ── Listagem ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Lista as frases sob uma categoria, como strings interpoláveis.
   * @param {string} category
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  listPhrases(category) {
    const setId = this._resolveSet(category);
    if (!setId) return [];
    return this._phrasesUnder(setId).map(id => {
      const body = this.machine.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text;
      if (body) return body;
      return this.machine.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name ?? id;
    });
  }

  // ── Internos ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Todas as entidades do tipo `set`.
   * @returns {string[]}
   * @private
   */
  _allSets() {
    const out = [];
    for (const id of this.machine.world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = this.machine.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (ident?.type === 'set') out.push(id);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Todas as entidades do tipo `phrase`.
   * @returns {string[]}
   * @private
   */
  _allPhrases() {
    const out = [];
    for (const id of this.machine.world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = this.machine.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (ident?.type === 'phrase') out.push(id);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Frases que apontam para uma set, diretas ou via sets-filhas (BFS).
   * @param {string} setId
   * @returns {string[]}
   * @private
   */
  _phrasesUnder(setId) {
    const allPhrases = this._allPhrases();
    const direct = allPhrases.filter(p => {
      const links = this.machine.world.get(p, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      const parent = links?.parent;
      if (Array.isArray(parent)) return parent.includes(setId);
      return parent === setId;
    });

    if (direct.length > 0) return direct;

    // Tenta sets-filhas
    const childSets = this._childSets(setId);
    const out = [];
    for (const child of childSets) {
      out.push(...this._phrasesUnder(child));
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Sets-filhas diretas via Links.parent.
   * @param {string} parentId
   * @returns {string[]}
   * @private
   */
  _childSets(parentId) {
    const out = [];
    for (const id of this._allSets()) {
      const links = this.machine.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      const parent = links?.parent;
      if (Array.isArray(parent)) {
        if (parent.includes(parentId)) out.push(id);
      } else if (parent === parentId) {
        out.push(id);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Resolve uma referência de categoria para o ID interno.
   * @param {string} ref
   * @returns {string|null}
   * @private
   */
  _resolveSet(ref) {
    if (!ref) return null;
    const world = this.machine.world;

    // id interno
    if (world.hasEntity(ref)) {
      const ident = world.get(ref, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (ident?.type === 'set') return ref;
    }

    // shortcode
    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (!ident) continue;
      if (ident.type !== 'set') continue;
      if (ident.id === ref) return id;
    }

    // nome humano
    for (const id of world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (!ident) continue;
      if (ident.type !== 'set') continue;
      if (ident.name === ref) return id;
    }

    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Rótulo curto para exibição na linha do overlay.
   * @param {string} setId
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _shortLabel(setId) {
    const ident = this.machine.world.get(setId, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    return ident?.name ?? ident?.id ?? setId;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file rule-executor.js
 * @module systems/helpers
 * @description Aplica o DO de uma regra para um alvo, usando CommandRunner.
 * @imports systems/helpers/command-runner
 * @importedBy systems/rule-system
 * @level 8
 */

import { CommandRunner } from './command-runner.js';

export class RuleExecutor {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} world
   * @param {Object} bus
   */
  constructor(machine, world, bus) {
    this.machine = machine;
    this.world = world;
    this.bus = bus;
    this.runner = new CommandRunner(machine);
  }

  /**
   * Aplica o bloco DO para um alvo específico.
   *
   * @param {string} doExpr  — pode ter várias linhas
   * @param {string} target  — id interno da entidade alvo
   * @param {Object} [vars={}]  — variáveis extras de substituição
   * @param {number} [depth=0]
   * @returns {{ ok:boolean, applied:number, errors:string[] }}
   */
  apply(doExpr, target, vars = {}, depth = 0) {
    if (!doExpr) return { ok: true, applied: 0, errors: [] };

    const lines = String(doExpr)
      .split('\n')
      .map(s => s.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    const results = [];
    const errors = [];

    for (const raw of lines) {
      const line = this._interpolate(raw, target, vars);
      const res = this.runner.run(line);
      results.push(res);
      if (!res?.ok) errors.push(res?.error || 'erro desconhecido');
    }

    return {
      ok: errors.length === 0,
      applied: results.filter(r => r?.mutated).length,
      errors,
      results,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verifica se um DO é executável (sintaxe válida).
   * @param {string} doExpr
   * @returns {{ ok:boolean, error?:string }}
   */
  validate(doExpr) {
    if (!doExpr) return { ok: false, error: 'DO vazio' };
    const lines = String(doExpr).split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'DO vazio' };

    const parse = this.machine.systems?.get('ParseSystem');
    if (!parse) return { ok: true }; // não dá para validar sem parser

    for (const line of lines) {
      const probe = line.replace(/\{[^}]+\}/g, 'X');
      const res = parse.parse(probe);
      if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: res.error };
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // ── Interpolação ────────────────────────────────────────────

  _interpolate(line, target, vars) {
    const table = {
      this: target,
      target,
      new: target,
      ...vars,
    };
    return String(line).replace(/\{([^}]+)\}/g, (m, name) => {
      const key = name.trim();
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(table, key)) {
        return table[key];
      }
      return m;
    });
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file identity-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles id.show / id.rename / id.describe / id.retype.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES, ENTITY_TYPES } from '../core/constants.js';

export class IdentitySystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('IdentitySystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'id') return prev;

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'show':     return this._show(prev, ast);
        case 'rename':   return this._update(prev, ast, 'name');
        case 'describe': return this._update(prev, ast, 'description');
        case 'retype':   return this._retype(prev, ast);
        default:         return prev;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  _show(prev, ast) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'card',
      title: 'Identidade',
      data: this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY),
    }};
  }

  _update(prev, ast, field) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };

    const before = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY, { [field]: ast.value });
    const after = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);

    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, identity: {
      op: ast.action, target, field,
      before: before?.[field], after: after?.[field],
    }};
  }

  _retype(prev, ast) {
    if (!ENTITY_TYPES.includes(ast.value)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `tipo inválido: ${ast.value}` };
    }
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };

    const before = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY, { type: ast.value });
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, identity: {
      op: 'retype', target, field: 'type',
      before: before?.type, after: ast.value,
    }};
  }
}
```

### projeto_narrative-write/systems/inheritance-system.js

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 8.7 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file inheritance-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles inst.chain/resolve/reparent/unset/policy.
 * @imports ecs/system, components/instantiation, core/constants, core/utils/object
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES, NEVER_HERITABLE, MERGE_MODES, MERGE_DEFAULT } from '../core/constants.js';
import { deepMerge, deepClone } from '../core/utils/object.js';

export class InheritanceSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('InheritanceSystem'); }

  run(_line, ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'inst') return prev;
    if (!['chain', 'resolve', 'reparent', 'unset', 'policy'].includes(ast.action)) return prev;

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'chain':    return this._chain(prev, ast);
        case 'resolve':  return this._resolve(prev, ast);
        case 'reparent': return this._reparent(prev, ast, ctx);
        case 'unset':    return this._unset(prev, ast, ctx);
        case 'policy':   return this._policy(prev, ast, ctx);
        default:         return prev;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  _buildChain(id) {
    const chain = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    let cur = id;
    while (cur && !seen.has(cur)) {
      seen.add(cur);
      chain.push(cur);
      const derives = this.world.get(cur, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM)?.ids ?? [];
      const instanceOf = this.world.get(cur, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)?.id;
      cur = derives[0] ?? instanceOf ?? null;
    }
    return chain;
  }

  _chain(prev, ast) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };
    const chain = this._buildChain(target);
    const tree = this._chainToTree(chain);
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'tree', title: `Cadeia de ${ast.target}`, data: tree }};
  }

  _chainToTree(chain) {
    let node = null;
    for (let i = chain.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const ident = this.world.get(chain[i], COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      node = { node: ident?.name ?? chain[i], id: chain[i], children: node ? [node] : [] };
    }
    return node;
  }

  _resolve(prev, ast) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };

    const chain = this._buildChain(target);
    const policy = this._mergePolicyChain(chain);
    const result = {};
    const origins = {};

    // Resolve raiz → folha
    for (let i = chain.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const levelId = chain[i];
      for (const compName of this.world.entities.get(levelId)) {
        if (NEVER_HERITABLE.has(compName)) continue;
        const data = this.world.get(levelId, compName);
        const strat = this._strategyFor(policy, compName);
        result[compName] = result[compName]
          ? deepMerge(result[compName], data, { strategy: strat })
          : deepClone(data);
      }
    }

    // Aplica tombstones
    const tombstones = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TOMBSTONES) || {};
    for (const [comp, fields] of Object.entries(tombstones)) {
      if (!result[comp]) continue;
      for (const field of fields) delete result[comp][field];
    }

    // Calcula origem por campo
    for (const [compName, compData] of Object.entries(result)) {
      origins[compName] = {};
      for (const field of Object.keys(compData)) {
        for (const levelId of chain) {
          const levelData = this.world.get(levelId, compName);
          if (levelData && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(levelData, field)) {
            origins[compName][field] = this.world.get(levelId, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name ?? levelId;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'resolve',
      title: `Estado resolvido de ${ast.target}`,
      data: { resolved: result, origins, chain: chain.map(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name ?? id) },
    }};
  }

  _mergePolicyChain(chain) {
    const merged = { ...MERGE_DEFAULT };
    for (const id of chain) {
      const policy = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.MERGE_POLICY);
      if (policy) Object.assign(merged, policy);
    }
    return merged;
  }

  _strategyFor(policy, compName) {
    return policy[compName] ?? 'override';
  }

  _reparent(prev, ast, ctx) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };

    const derivesRaw = ast.opts.derives;
    if (!derivesRaw) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'opts.derives obrigatório' };

    const newDerives = derivesRaw.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      .map(ref => this.resolve(ref))
      .filter(Boolean);

    const before = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM)?.ids ?? [];
    this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM, { ids: newDerives });

    // Marca descendentes
    const descendants = this._findDescendants(target);
    for (const desc of descendants) {
      if (!this.world.has(desc, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE)) {
        this.world.addComponent(desc, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE, {
          value: true, at: ctx.tick, cause: 'reparent',
        });
      }
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, reparented: {
      target, before, after: newDerives, staleMarked: descendants.length,
    }};
  }

  _unset(prev, ast, ctx) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };

    const dot = ast.path.indexOf('.');
    if (dot <= 0) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'path inválido' };
    const comp = ast.path.slice(0, dot);
    const field = ast.path.slice(dot + 1);
    const compName = this._compName(comp);
    if (!compName) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `componente inválido: ${comp}` };

    const before = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TOMBSTONES) || {};
    const fields = new Set(before[compName] || []);
    fields.add(field);

    const next = { ...before, [compName]: Array.from(fields) };
    if (this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TOMBSTONES)) this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TOMBSTONES, next);
    else this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TOMBSTONES, next);

    // Eager resolve — remove campo
    const cur = this.world.get(target, compName);
    if (cur && field in cur) {
      const clone = { ...cur };
      delete clone[field];
      this.world.set(target, compName, clone);
    }

    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, tombstoned: { target, component: compName, field }};
  }

  _policy(prev, ast, ctx) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };

    const updates = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ast.opts)) {
      const compName = this._compName(k);
      if (!compName) continue;
      if (!MERGE_MODES[compName]?.includes(v)) {
        return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `modo inválido: ${k}=${v}` };
      }
      updates[compName] = v;
    }

    const before = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.MERGE_POLICY) || {};
    const after = { ...before, ...updates };

    if (this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.MERGE_POLICY)) this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.MERGE_POLICY, after);
    else this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.MERGE_POLICY, after);

    const descendants = this._findDescendants(target);
    for (const desc of descendants) {
      if (!this.world.has(desc, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE)) {
        this.world.addComponent(desc, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE, { value: true, at: ctx.tick, cause: 'policy' });
      }
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, policyChanged: { target, before, after }};
  }

  _findDescendants(id) {
    const out = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const queue = [id];
    while (queue.length) {
      const cur = queue.shift();
      for (const other of this.world.allEntities()) {
        if (seen.has(other) || other === id) continue;
        const instOf = this.world.get(other, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)?.id;
        const derives = this.world.get(other, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM)?.ids ?? [];
        if (instOf === cur || derives.includes(cur)) {
          seen.add(other);
          out.push(other);
          queue.push(other);
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  _compName(short) {
    const map = { stats: 'Stats', flags: 'Flags', enums: 'Enums', texts: 'Texts', lists: 'Lists', tags: 'Tags' };
    return map[short] ?? null;
  }
}
```

### projeto_narrative-write/systems/instantiation-system.js

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 12.5 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file instantiation-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles inst.mark/unmark/create/destroy/list/sync.
 * @imports ecs/system, components/*, core/constants
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Bugfix P0-1 (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   `_create` criava a entidade com `createEntity({})` e adicionava o
 *   componente Identity DEPOIS. Como `World.createEntity` emite
 *   `entity:created` no FINAL do método, o `Machine._wireLifecycle`
 *   verificava se a entidade tinha Identity e não encontrava —
 *   portanto o shortcode NUNCA era registrado no `IdRegistry`.
 *
 *   Consequências:
 *     - `IdRegistry.byShortcode` não continha instâncias.
 *     - `ShortcodeId.generate()` podia colidir (`CHR-GOB-1` duas vezes).
 *     - `aud.identities` operava sobre um índice dessincronizado.
 *
 *   Correção: montar o mapa completo de componentes ANTES de chamar
 *   `world.createEntity(components)`. Assim, quando `entity:created`
 *   dispara, a Identity já está presente e o Machine registra o
 *   shortcode normalmente.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES, NEVER_COPY } from '../core/constants.js';
import {
  makeIsBlueprint, makeInstanceOf, makeInstanceCounter,
  makeInstanceConfig, defaultInstanceConfig, formatInstanceName,
} from '../components/instantiation.js';
import { makeIdentity } from '../components/identity.js';
import { makeMeta } from '../components/meta.js';

export class InstantiationSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('InstantiationSystem'); }

  run(_line, ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'inst') return prev;
    // Só trata mark/unmark/create/destroy/list/sync; chain/resolve/etc vão para InheritanceSystem
    if (!['mark', 'unmark', 'create', 'destroy', 'list', 'sync'].includes(ast.action)) return prev;

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'mark':    return this._mark(prev, ast);
        case 'unmark':  return this._unmark(prev, ast);
        case 'create':  return this._create(prev, ast, ctx);
        case 'destroy': return this._destroy(prev, ast);
        case 'list':    return this._list(prev, ast);
        case 'sync':    return this._sync(prev, ast, ctx);
        default:        return prev;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // MARK / UNMARK
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _mark(prev, ast) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };
    }

    if (!this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IS_BLUEPRINT)) {
      this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IS_BLUEPRINT, makeIsBlueprint(true));
    }
    if (!this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_COUNTER)) {
      this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_COUNTER, makeInstanceCounter(0));
    }
    if (!this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_CONFIG)) {
      this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_CONFIG, defaultInstanceConfig());
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, blueprintMarked: target };
  }

  _unmark(prev, ast) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };
    }
    this.world.removeComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IS_BLUEPRINT);
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, blueprintUnmarked: target };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // CREATE — Fase 13.7 (P0-1)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Cria uma instância a partir de um blueprint.
   *
   * Fase 13.7 — monta todos os componentes ANTES de chamar
   * `world.createEntity`, garantindo que `entity:created` dispare
   * com Identity presente (registro correto no IdRegistry).
   *
   * @private
   */
  _create(prev, ast, ctx) {
    const bp = this.resolve(ast.blueprint);
    if (!bp) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `blueprint não encontrado: ${ast.blueprint}` };
    }
    if (!this.world.has(bp, COMPONENT_NAMES.IS_BLUEPRINT)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `não é blueprint: ${ast.blueprint}` };
    }

    const bpIdentity = this.world.get(bp, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    if (!bpIdentity) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `blueprint sem Identity: ${ast.blueprint}` };
    }

    const cfg = this.world.get(bp, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_CONFIG) || defaultInstanceConfig();
    const counter = this.world.get(bp, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_COUNTER) || { value: cfg.startAt - 1 };
    const nextNumber = counter.value + 1;

    const instanceName = ast.name || formatInstanceName(
      cfg.namePattern, bpIdentity.name, nextNumber, cfg.pad
    );
    const instanceId = formatInstanceName(
      cfg.idPattern, bpIdentity.id, nextNumber, cfg.pad
    );

    // Avança o contador ANTES de criar a entidade. Se algo lançar no
    // meio, o contador não fica dessincronizado do número de instâncias
    // já criadas (não há instância sem contador, nem contador sem instância
    // — o `createEntity` é atômico para os nossos propósitos).
    if (this.world.has(bp, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_COUNTER)) {
      this.world.set(bp, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_COUNTER, { value: nextNumber });
    } else {
      this.world.addComponent(bp, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_COUNTER, { value: nextNumber });
    }

    // ── Monta mapa completo de componentes ─────────────────
    const components = this._buildInstanceComponents(
      bp,
      instanceId,
      instanceName,
      bpIdentity,
      ctx
    );

    // Aplica overrides dos opts (podem sobrescrever componentes copiados)
    this._applyOverridesToComponents(components, ast.opts);

    // ── Cria com tudo pronto ───────────────────────────────
    // O `entity:created` que dispara no final de createEntity
    // já verá a Identity, e o Machine registrará o shortcode.
    const newId = this.world.createEntity(components);

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      mutated: true,
      instance: {
        id: newId,
        shortId: instanceId,
        name: instanceName,
        number: nextNumber,
        blueprint: bp,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Monta o mapa de componentes para a nova instância.
   *
   * Cópia tudo do blueprint exceto NEVER_COPY. Adiciona Identity,
   * Meta e InstanceOf próprios. Não toca o World.
   *
   * @param {string} bp                 — id interno do blueprint
   * @param {string} instanceId         — shortcode da instância
   * @param {string} instanceName       — nome humano da instância
   * @param {Object} bpIdentity         — Identity do blueprint (para herdar description/type)
   * @param {Object} ctx                — contexto (com tick)
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _buildInstanceComponents(bp, instanceId, instanceName, bpIdentity, ctx) {
    const components = {
      [COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY]: makeIdentity({
        id: instanceId,
        name: instanceName,
        description: bpIdentity.description,
        type: bpIdentity.type,
      }),
      [COMPONENT_NAMES.META]: makeMeta({ builtin: false, tick: ctx.tick }),
      [COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF]: makeInstanceOf(bp),
    };

    for (const compName of this.world.entities.get(bp)) {
      if (NEVER_COPY.has(compName)) continue;
      if (compName === COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY) continue;
      if (compName === COMPONENT_NAMES.META) continue;
      const data = this.world.get(bp, compName);
      components[compName] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
    }

    return components;
  }

  /**
   * Aplica overrides dos opts DIRETO no mapa de componentes,
   * antes de a entidade ser criada.
   *
   * Formato aceito: `compShort.field=valor` onde `compShort` é
   * um dos aliases (`stats`, `flags`, `enums`, `texts`, `lists`, `tags`).
   *
   * @param {Object} components — mapa mutado in-place
   * @param {Object|null|undefined} opts
   * @private
   */
  _applyOverridesToComponents(components, opts) {
    if (!opts) return;
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(opts)) {
      const dot = key.indexOf('.');
      if (dot <= 0) continue;
      const compShort = key.slice(0, dot);
      const field = key.slice(dot + 1);
      const compName = this._compName(compShort);
      if (!compName) continue;

      const current = components[compName];
      components[compName] = current
        ? { ...current, [field]: value }
        : { [field]: value };
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // DESTROY / LIST / SYNC
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _destroy(prev, ast) {
    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `instância não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };
    }
    if (!this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `não é instância: ${ast.target}` };
    }
    this.world.destroyEntity(target);
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, destroyed: target };
  }

  _list(prev, ast) {
    const target = ast.target ? this.resolve(ast.target) : null;
    if (target) {
      const instances = this.world.allEntities()
        .filter(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)?.id === target);
      return {
        ...prev,
        ok: true,
        right: {
          kind: 'table',
          title: `Instâncias de ${this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name || target}`,
          data: instances.map(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)),
        },
      };
    }
    const blueprints = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.IS_BLUEPRINT)
      .map(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY));
    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: { kind: 'table', title: 'Blueprints', data: blueprints },
    };
  }

  _sync(prev, ast, ctx) {
    const bp = this.resolve(ast.blueprint);
    if (!bp) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `blueprint não encontrado: ${ast.blueprint}` };
    }

    const instances = this.world.allEntities()
      .filter(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)?.id === bp);

    let updated = 0;
    for (const instId of instances) {
      for (const compName of this.world.entities.get(bp)) {
        if (NEVER_COPY.has(compName)) continue;
        if (compName === COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY) continue;
        if (compName === COMPONENT_NAMES.META) continue;
        const data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.world.get(bp, compName)));
        if (this.world.has(instId, compName)) this.world.set(instId, compName, data);
        else this.world.addComponent(instId, compName, data);
      }
      this.world.removeComponent(instId, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE);
      updated++;
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: updated > 0, synced: { blueprint: bp, count: updated } };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // HELPERS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Mapeia aliases de opts para nome canônico de componente.
   * @param {string} short
   * @returns {string|null}
   * @private
   */
  _compName(short) {
    const map = {
      stats: 'Stats',
      flags: 'Flags',
      enums: 'Enums',
      texts: 'Texts',
      lists: 'Lists',
      tags: 'Tags',
    };
    return map[short] ?? null;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file knowledge-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles kno.learn/forget/show/at.
 * @imports ecs/system, components/knowledge, core/constants, core/utils/time
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';
import * as Know from '../components/knowledge.js';
import { tickToNumber } from '../core/utils/time.js';

export class KnowledgeSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('KnowledgeSystem'); }

  run(_line, ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'kno') return prev;

    const target = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'learn':  return this._learn(prev, ast, target, ctx);
        case 'forget': return this._forget(prev, ast, target);
        case 'show':   return this._show(prev, ast, target);
        case 'at':     return this._at(prev, ast, target);
        default:       return prev;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  _learn(prev, ast, target, ctx) {
    let knows = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS);
    if (!knows) {
      this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS, Know.makeKnows());
      knows = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS);
    }
    if (Know.knowsFact(knows, ast.fact)) return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, noop: true };
    const next = Know.learn(knows, ast.fact, ctx.tick);
    this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS, next);
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, knowledge: {
      op: 'learn', target, fact: ast.fact, learnedAt: ctx.tick,
    }};
  }

  _forget(prev, ast, target) {
    const knows = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS);
    if (!knows || !Know.knowsFact(knows, ast.fact)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, noop: true };
    }
    this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS, Know.forget(knows, ast.fact));
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, knowledge: { op: 'forget', target, fact: ast.fact }};
  }

  _show(prev, ast, target) {
    const knows = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS);
    const rows = knows ? Know.facts(knows) : [];
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: `O que ${ast.target} sabe`, data: rows }};
  }

  _at(prev, ast, target) {
    const knows = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.KNOWS);
    if (!knows) return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: 'Nada', data: [] }};
    const cutoff = ast.opts?.at ? tickToNumber(ast.opts.at) : Infinity;
    const rows = Know.facts(knows).filter(f => tickToNumber(f.learnedAt) <= cutoff);
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: `O que ${ast.target} sabia em ${ast.opts.at}`, data: rows }};
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file link-query-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles link.where/to/from/tree.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Bugfix P0-3 (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   `_where`, `_to` e `_from` liam `this.world.get(to, 'Type')`,
 *   mas o componente `Type` NÃO EXISTE. A coluna "type" sempre
 *   mostrava `'?'`.
 *
 *   Correção: ler `Identity.type` do componente canônico.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export class LinkQuerySystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('LinkQuerySystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'link') return prev;
    if (!['where', 'to', 'from', 'tree'].includes(ast.action)) return prev;

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'where': return this._where(prev, ast);
        case 'to':    return this._to(prev, ast);
        case 'from':  return this._from(prev, ast);
        case 'tree':  return this._tree(prev, ast);
        default:      return prev;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // AÇÕES
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _where(prev, ast) {
    const from = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!from) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };
    }
    const out = this.links.from(from);
    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'table',
        title: `Links de ${ast.target}`,
        data: out.map(({ rel, to }) => ({
          rel,
          to,
          type: this._typeOf(to),
        })),
      },
    };
  }

  _to(prev, ast) {
    const from = this.resolve(ast.from);
    if (!from) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `origem não existe: ${ast.from}` };
    }
    const targets = this.links.from(from, ast.rel);
    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'table',
        title: `${ast.from}.${ast.rel} → ${targets.length} alvo(s)`,
        data: targets.map(to => ({
          to,
          type: this._typeOf(to),
        })),
      },
    };
  }

  _from(prev, ast) {
    const to = this.resolve(ast.target);
    if (!to) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.target}` };
    }
    const incoming = this.links.to(to);
    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'table',
        title: `Quem aponta para ${ast.target}`,
        data: incoming.map(({ from, rel }) => ({
          from,
          rel,
          type: this._typeOf(from),
        })),
      },
    };
  }

  _tree(prev, ast) {
    const from = this.resolve(ast.from);
    if (!from) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${ast.from}` };
    }
    const depth = Math.max(1, parseInt(ast.opts?.depth ?? '3', 10) || 3);
    const seen = new Set();
    const tree = this._walk(from, depth, seen);
    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'tree',
        title: `Árvore a partir de ${ast.from}`,
        data: tree,
      },
    };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // HELPERS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Devolve o tipo da entidade a partir de `Identity.type`.
   * Retorna `'?'` se a entidade não tem Identity.
   *
   * @param {string} id
   * @returns {string}
   * @private
   */
  _typeOf(id) {
    if (!id) return '?';
    const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    return ident?.type ?? '?';
  }

  _walk(id, depth, seen) {
    if (depth <= 0) {
      return { id, children: [] };
    }
    if (seen.has(id)) {
      return { id, cycle: true, children: [] };
    }
    seen.add(id);

    const node = { id, children: [] };
    for (const { rel, to } of this.links.from(id)) {
      node.children.push({ rel, ...this._walk(to, depth - 1, seen) });
    }
    return node;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file link-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles link.set/add/pull/clear.
 * @imports ecs/system, components/links, core/constants
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';
import * as Links from '../components/links.js';

export class LinkSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('LinkSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'link') return prev;
    if (!['set', 'add', 'pull', 'clear'].includes(ast.action)) return prev;

    const from = this.resolve(ast.from);
    if (!from) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `origem não existe: ${ast.from}` };

    const to = ast.to ? this.resolve(ast.to) : null;
    if (ast.action !== 'clear' && !to) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `destino não existe: ${ast.to}` };
    }

    const links = this.world.get(from, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS) || {};
    const before = Links.getTargets(links, ast.rel);
    let next;

    if (ast.action === 'set') next = Links.setLink(links, ast.rel, to);
    else if (ast.action === 'add') next = Links.addLink(links, ast.rel, to);
    else if (ast.action === 'pull') next = Links.pullLink(links, ast.rel, to);
    else if (ast.action === 'clear') next = Links.clearLink(links, ast.rel);

    if (this.world.has(from, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS)) this.world.set(from, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS, next);
    else this.world.addComponent(from, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS, next);

    if (this.links) this.links.reindex(from, this.world.get(from, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS));

    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, link: {
      action: ast.action, rel: ast.rel, from, to,
      before, after: Links.getTargets(next, ast.rel),
    }};
  }
}
```
