```javascript
/**
 * @file parse-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Linha crua → AST. Tokeniza, extrai verbo/ação/subtipo/opts.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 4 — Diagnostics: adicionado `case 'diag'` e `_parseDiag()`.
 * Fase 5/6 — Diagnostics: `_parseDiag()` recebe `subtype` e o propaga.
 * Onda 5 — Superfície: `test` e `baseline` adicionados ao switch de `_parseDiag`.
 * Fase 5 — LUME: adicionado `case 'narr'` e `_parseNarr()`.
 * Fase 8 — LUME: adicionado `'narrative'` ao grupo de subcomandos que
 *              prepend o subtype em `positional` (para `diag.narrative.*`).
 * Fase 13 — Hierarquia: adicionado `case 'phr'` e `_parsePhr()`.
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Bugfix P0-5 (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   `_parseNarr` não aceitava `narr.catalog` (documentado em
 *   `builtin-commands.js` e `command-catalog.js`). O handler existe em
 *   `NarrativeSystem._runNarrCommand`, mas nunca era alcançado porque
 *   o parser rejeitava antes. Adicionado `'catalog'` à lista VALID.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { ENTITY_TYPES, RULE_MODES } from '../core/constants.js';

export class ParseSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('ParseSystem'); }

  run(line, _ctx, prev) {
    if (prev.kind === 'slash-command') {
      return { ...prev, ast: this._parseSlash(line) };
    }
    if (prev.kind === 'empty') return prev;
    if (prev.kind === 'prose') {
      return { ...prev, ast: { verb: 'prose', raw: line } };
    }
    if (prev.kind !== 'command') return prev;

    const ast = this.parse(line);
    if (!ast.ok) return { ...prev, ok: false, error: ast.error, halt: true };
    return { ...prev, ast: ast.ast };
  }

  // ── Tokenizer ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  tokenize(line) {
    const tokens = [];
    let i = 0;
    const n = line.length;
    while (i < n) {
      while (i < n && /\s/.test(line[i])) i++;
      if (i >= n) break;
      let token = '';
      let quote = null;
      while (i < n) {
        const ch = line[i];
        if (quote) {
          if (ch === quote) { quote = null; i++; continue; }
          if (ch === '\\' && i + 1 < n) { token += line[i + 1]; i += 2; continue; }
          token += ch; i++;
        } else {
          if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") { quote = ch; i++; continue; }
          if (/\s/.test(ch)) break;
          token += ch; i++;
        }
      }
      tokens.push(token);
    }
    return tokens;
  }

  parseOptions(tokens) {
    const opts = {};
    for (const tok of tokens) {
      const eq = tok.indexOf('=');
      if (eq <= 0) continue;
      opts[tok.slice(0, eq)] = tok.slice(eq + 1);
    }
    return opts;
  }

  // ── Parse principal ────────────────────────────────────────

  parse(line) {
    const tokens = this.tokenize(line);
    if (tokens.length === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'linha vazia' };

    const head = tokens[0];
    const parts = head.split('.');
    if (parts.length < 2) {
      return { ok: false, error: `cabeçalho inválido: ${head}` };
    }

    const [verb, action, subtype] = parts;
    const rest = tokens.slice(1);
    const raw = line;

    switch (verb) {
      case 'ent':  return this._parseEnt(action, subtype, rest, raw);
      case 'id':   return this._parseId(action, subtype, rest, raw);
      case 'inst': return this._parseInst(action, subtype, rest, raw);
      case 'mut':  return this._parseMut(action, subtype, rest, raw);
      case 'link': return this._parseLink(action, subtype, rest, raw);
      case 'que':  return this._parseQue(action, rest, raw);
      case 'sea':  return this._parseSea(action, rest, raw);
      case 'at':   return this._parseAt(action, rest, raw);
      case 'whe':  return this._parseWhe(action, rest, raw);
      case 'tim':  return this._parseTim(action, rest, raw);
      case 'aud':  return this._parseAud(action, rest, raw);
      case 'kno':  return this._parseKno(action, rest, raw);
      case 'frk':  return this._parseFrk(action, rest, raw);
      case 'dif':  return this._parseDif(action, rest, raw);
      case 'rul':  return this._parseRul(action, rest, raw);
      case 'snip': return this._parseSnip(action, subtype, rest, raw);
      case 'exp':  return this._parseExp(action, rest, raw);
      case 'help': return this._parseHelp(action, rest, raw);
      case 'diag': return this._parseDiag(action, subtype, rest, raw);
      case 'narr': return this._parseNarr(action, subtype, rest, raw);
      case 'phr':  return this._parsePhr(action, rest, raw);
      default:     return { ok: false, error: `verbo não suportado: ${verb}` };
    }
  }

  // ── ent.* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseEnt(action, subtype, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'create') {
      if (!ENTITY_TYPES.includes(subtype)) {
        return { ok: false, error: `tipo inválido: ${subtype}` };
      }
      const name = rest[0];
      if (!name) return { ok: false, error: 'nome obrigatório' };
      return { ok: true, ast: {
        verb: 'ent', action, subtype, name,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw,
      }};
    }
    if (action === 'show' || action === 'delete') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: `alvo obrigatório: ent.${action}` };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'ent', action, target, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'list') {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'ent', action, subtype: rest[0] || null, raw } };
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `ent.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  // ── id.* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseId(action, _subtype, rest, raw) {
    if (!['show', 'rename', 'describe', 'retype'].includes(action)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `id.${action} não suportado` };
    }
    const target = rest[0];
    if (!target) return { ok: false, error: `alvo obrigatório em id.${action}` };
    const value = rest.slice(1).join(' ');
    if (action === 'show') {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'id', action, target, raw } };
    }
    if (!value) return { ok: false, error: `valor obrigatório em id.${action}` };
    return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'id', action, target, value, raw } };
  }

  // ── inst.* ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseInst(action, _subtype, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'mark') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: 'alvo obrigatório em inst.mark' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, target,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    if (action === 'unmark') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: 'alvo obrigatório em inst.unmark' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, target, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'create') {
      const blueprint = rest[0];
      if (!blueprint) return { ok: false, error: 'blueprint obrigatório em inst.create' };
      const maybeName = rest[1] && !rest[1].includes('=') ? rest[1] : null;
      const optsStart = maybeName ? 2 : 1;
      return { ok: true, ast: {
        verb: 'inst', action, blueprint, name: maybeName,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(optsStart)), raw,
      }};
    }
    if (action === 'destroy') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: 'alvo obrigatório em inst.destroy' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, target, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'list') {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, target: rest[0] || null, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'sync') {
      const bp = rest[0];
      if (!bp) return { ok: false, error: 'blueprint obrigatório em inst.sync' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, blueprint: bp, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'chain' || action === 'resolve') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: `alvo obrigatório em inst.${action}` };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, target, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'reparent') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: 'alvo obrigatório em inst.reparent' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, target,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    if (action === 'unset') {
      const target = rest[0];
      const path = rest[1];
      if (!target || !path) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: inst.unset <target> <comp>.<field>' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, target, path, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'policy') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: 'alvo obrigatório em inst.policy' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'inst', action, target,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `inst.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  // ── mut.* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseMut(action, subtype, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'flag') {
      if (!['on', 'off'].includes(subtype)) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'uso: mut.flag.<on|off> <target> <flag>' };
      }
      const target = rest[0], flag = rest[1];
      if (!target || !flag) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: mut.flag.<on|off> <target> <flag>' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'mut', action, subtype, target, flag, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'enum' || action === 'text') {
      const tpath = rest[0];
      const value = rest.slice(1).join(' ');
      if (!tpath || !value) return { ok: false, error: `uso: mut.${action} <target>.<field> <valor>` };
      const dot = tpath.indexOf('.');
      if (dot <= 0) return { ok: false, error: `path inválido: ${tpath}` };
      return { ok: true, ast: {
        verb: 'mut', action, target: tpath.slice(0, dot),
        path: tpath.slice(dot + 1), value, raw,
      }};
    }
    if (!['add', 'set', 'sub', 'push', 'pull'].includes(action)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `mut.${action} não suportado` };
    }
    if (['add', 'set', 'sub'].includes(action) && subtype !== 'stats') {
      return { ok: false, error: `mut.${action} requer .stats` };
    }
    if (['push', 'pull'].includes(action) && subtype !== 'list') {
      return { ok: false, error: `mut.${action} requer .list` };
    }
    const tpath = rest[0];
    if (!tpath) return { ok: false, error: 'path alvo obrigatório' };
    const dot = tpath.indexOf('.');
    if (dot <= 0) return { ok: false, error: `path inválido: ${tpath}` };
    const value = rest.slice(1).join(' ');
    if (value === '') return { ok: false, error: 'valor obrigatório' };
    return { ok: true, ast: {
      verb: 'mut', action, subtype, target: tpath.slice(0, dot),
      path: tpath.slice(dot + 1), value, raw,
    }};
  }

  // ── link.* ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseLink(action, subtype, rest, raw) {
    const MUT = ['set', 'add', 'pull', 'clear'];
    const QUERY = ['where', 'to', 'from', 'tree'];

    if (MUT.includes(action)) {
      const rel = subtype;
      if (!rel) return { ok: false, error: `relação obrigatória: link.${action}.<rel>` };
      const from = rest[0];
      if (!from) return { ok: false, error: 'origem obrigatória' };
      if (action === 'clear') {
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'link', action, rel, from, raw } };
      }
      const to = rest[1];
      if (!to) return { ok: false, error: 'destino obrigatório' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'link', action, rel, from, to, raw } };
    }
    if (QUERY.includes(action)) {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: `uso: link.${action} <target>` };
      if (action === 'to') {
        const dot = target.indexOf('.');
        if (dot <= 0) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: link.to <from>.<rel>' };
        return { ok: true, ast: {
          verb: 'link', action, from: target.slice(0, dot),
          rel: target.slice(dot + 1), raw,
        }};
      }
      if (action === 'tree') {
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'link', action, from: target,
          opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
      }
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'link', action, target, raw } };
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `link.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  // ── que.* / sea.* / at.* / whe.* / tim.* ──────────────────

  _parseQue(action, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'at') {
      const tick = rest[0], target = rest[1];
      if (!tick || !target) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: que.at <tick> <target>' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'que', action, tick, target, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'when') {
      const cond = rest[0];
      if (!cond) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: que.when <condição>' };
      const eq = cond.indexOf('=');
      if (eq <= 0) return { ok: false, error: `condição inválida: ${cond}` };
      return { ok: true, ast: {
        verb: 'que', action, path: cond.slice(0, eq),
        value: cond.slice(eq + 1), raw,
      }};
    }
    if (action === 'timeline') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: que.timeline <ent>.<campo>' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'que', action, target, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'knowledge') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: que.knowledge <ent> [at T]' };
      return { ok: true, ast: {
        verb: 'que', action, target,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw,
      }};
    }
    if (action === 'where') {
      const subtype = rest[0] || null;
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'que', action, subtype, raw } };
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `que.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  _parseSea(action, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'find') {
      const query = rest.join(' ').trim();
      if (!query) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: sea.find "expressão"' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'sea', action, query, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'in') {
      const category = rest[0];
      const query = rest.slice(1).join(' ').trim();
      if (!category) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: sea.in <categoria> "expressão"' };
      return { ok: true, ast: {
        verb: 'sea', action, subtype: category, query, raw,
      }};
    }
    if (action === 'tag') {
      const tag = rest[0];
      if (!tag) return { ok: false, error: 'uso: sea.tag <tag>' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'sea', action, tag, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'help') {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'sea', action, raw } };
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `sea.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  _parseAt(action, rest, raw) {
    const target = rest[0];
    const opts = this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1));
    return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'at', action, target, opts, raw } };
  }

  _parseWhe(action, rest, raw) {
    const cond = rest[0];
    return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'whe', action, condition: cond, raw } };
  }

  _parseTim(action, rest, raw) {
    return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'tim', action, target: rest[0], raw } };
  }

  // ── aud.* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseAud(action, rest, raw) {
    return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'aud', action, opts: this.parseOptions(rest), raw } };
  }

  // ── kno.* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseKno(action, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'learn' || action === 'forget') {
      const target = rest[0];
      const fact = rest.slice(1).join(' ');
      if (!target || !fact) return { ok: false, error: `uso: kno.${action} <ent> "fato"` };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'kno', action, target, fact, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'show' || action === 'at') {
      const target = rest[0];
      if (!target) return { ok: false, error: `alvo obrigatório em kno.${action}` };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'kno', action, target,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `kno.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  // ── frk.* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseFrk(action, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'create') {
      const name = rest[0];
      if (!name) return { ok: false, error: 'nome obrigatório em frk.create' };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'frk', action, name,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    if (action === 'switch' || action === 'delete' || action === 'merge') {
      const name = rest[0];
      if (!name) return { ok: false, error: `nome obrigatório em frk.${action}` };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'frk', action, name, raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'list') {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'frk', action, raw } };
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `frk.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  // ── dif.* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseDif(action, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'export') {
      const a = rest[0];
      const vs = rest[1];
      const b = rest[2];
      const format = rest[3] || 'json';
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'dif', action, a, b, format, raw } };
    }
    const a = action;
    const vs = rest[0];
    const b = rest[1];
    const opts = this.parseOptions(rest.slice(2));
    return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'dif', action: 'vs', a, b, opts, raw } };
  }

  // ── rul.* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseRul(action, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'add') {
      const name = rest[0];
      if (!name) return { ok: false, error: 'nome obrigatório em rul.add' };
      const onIdx = rest.indexOf('ON:');
      const ifIdx = rest.indexOf('IF:');
      const doIdx = rest.indexOf('DO:');
      if (onIdx < 0 || doIdx < 0) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'rul.add precisa de ON: e DO:' };
      }
      const on = rest[onIdx + 1] || '';
      const ifExpr = ifIdx >= 0 ? rest.slice(ifIdx + 1, doIdx).join(' ') : 'true';
      const doExpr = rest.slice(doIdx + 1).join(' ');
      const opts = {};
      for (let i = 1; i < (onIdx >= 0 ? onIdx : 1); i++) {
        const tok = rest[i];
        const eq = tok.indexOf('=');
        if (eq > 0) opts[tok.slice(0, eq)] = tok.slice(eq + 1);
      }
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'rul', action, name, on, ifExpr, doExpr, opts, raw } };
    }
    if (['list', 'find'].includes(action)) {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'rul', action, query: rest[0] || null,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    if (['show', 'run', 'sim', 'off', 'on', 'del'].includes(action)) {
      const name = rest[0];
      if (!name) return { ok: false, error: `nome obrigatório em rul.${action}` };
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'rul', action, name,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `rul.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  // ── snip.* ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseSnip(action, subtype, rest, raw) {
    if (action === 'create') {
      const trigger = rest[0];
      if (!trigger) return { ok: false, error: 'trigger obrigatório' };
      if (subtype) {
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'snip', action: 'create.' + subtype,
          trigger, opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
      }
      const body = rest.slice(1).join(' ');
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'snip', action, trigger, body, raw } };
    }
    if (['list', 'tree'].includes(action)) {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'snip', action, raw } };
    }
    if (['find'].includes(action)) {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'snip', action, query: rest[0] || '',
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    if (['rename', 'delete', 'from'].includes(action)) {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'snip', action, trigger: rest[0], raw } };
    }
    if (action === 'create.template') {
      return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'snip', action,
        trigger: rest[0], opts: this.parseOptions(rest.slice(1)), raw }};
    }
    return { ok: false, error: `snip.${action} não suportado` };
  }

  // ── exp.* / help.* ────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseExp(action, rest, raw) {
    return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'exp', action,
      opts: this.parseOptions(rest), raw }};
  }

  _parseHelp(action, rest, raw) {
    return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'help', action,
      opts: this.parseOptions(rest), raw }};
  }

  // ── diag.* (Fase 4 + Fase 5/6 + Onda 5 + Fase 8) ──────────

  _parseDiag(action, subtype, rest, raw) {
    const opts = this.parseOptions(rest);
    const positional = rest.filter(t => !t.includes('='));
    const st = subtype ?? null;

    switch (action) {
      case 'status':
      case 'on':
      case 'off':
      case 'counts':
      case 'clear':
      case 'snapshot':
      case 'smoke':
      case 'health':
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'diag', action, subtype: st, opts, raw } };

      case 'mode': {
        const value = st || positional[0];
        if (!value) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'uso: diag.mode <off|light|full|dev>' };
        }
        return {
          ok: true,
          ast: { verb: 'diag', action, value, subtype: st, opts, raw },
        };
      }

      case 'flight':
      case 'traces':
      case 'invariants':
      case 'contracts':
      case 'rules': {
        const n = positional[0];
        const next = { ...opts };
        if (n && /^\d+$/.test(n)) next.n = n;
        return {
          ok: true,
          ast: { verb: 'diag', action, subtype: st, opts: next, raw },
        };
      }

      case 'logs': {
        const n = positional[0];
        const level = positional[1];
        const next = { ...opts };
        if (n && /^\d+$/.test(n)) next.n = n;
        if (level && ['debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'].includes(level)) {
          next.level = level;
        }
        return {
          ok: true,
          ast: { verb: 'diag', action, subtype: st, opts: next, raw },
        };
      }

      case 'rca':
      case 'inject':
      case 'fuzz':
      case 'replay':
      case 'bundle':
      case 'test':
      case 'baseline':
      case 'narrative': {
        const fullPositional = st ? [st, ...positional] : positional;
        return {
          ok: true,
          ast: {
            verb: 'diag',
            action,
            subtype: st,
            opts,
            positional: fullPositional,
            raw,
          },
        };
      }

      default:
        return { ok: false, error: `diag.${action} não suportado` };
    }
  }

  // ── narr.* (Fase 5 — LUME) ────────────────────────────────
  //
  // Fase 13.7 — `'catalog'` adicionado ao VALID (bugfix P0-5).

  _parseNarr(action, subtype, rest, raw) {
    const VALID = [
      'off', 'preview', 'suggest', 'auto',
      'status', 'stats', 'overrides', 'lexicon',
      'catalog',
    ];
    if (!VALID.includes(action)) {
      return { ok: false, error: `narr.${action} não suportado` };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      ast: {
        verb: 'narr',
        action,
        subtype: subtype ?? null,
        opts: this.parseOptions(rest),
        raw,
      },
    };
  }

  // ── phr.* (Fase 13 — Hierarquia narrativa) ────────────────

  _parsePhr(action, rest, raw) {
    const opts = this.parseOptions(rest);
    const positional = rest.filter(t => !t.includes('='));

    switch (action) {
      case 'show':
      case 'placeholders': {
        const target = positional[0];
        if (!target) {
          return { ok: false, error: `uso: phr.${action} <target>` };
        }
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'phr', action, target, opts, raw } };
      }

      case 'list': {
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'phr', action, opts, raw } };
      }

      case 'render': {
        const target = positional[0];
        if (!target) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'uso: phr.render <target> [chave=valor ...]' };
        }
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'phr', action, target, opts, raw } };
      }

      case 'find': {
        const query = positional.join(' ').replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        if (!query) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'uso: phr.find "termo"' };
        }
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'phr', action, query, opts, raw } };
      }

      case 'tree': {
        const target = positional[0];
        if (!target) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'uso: phr.tree <target> [depth=N]' };
        }
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'phr', action, target, opts, raw } };
      }

      case 'set': {
        const target = positional[0];
        if (!target) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'uso: phr.set <target> [body=...] [tags=...] [parent=...]' };
        }
        return { ok: true, ast: { verb: 'phr', action, target, opts, raw } };
      }

      default:
        return { ok: false, error: `phr.${action} não suportado` };
    }
  }

  // ── Slash ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parseSlash(line) {
    const t = line.trim();
    const withoutSlash = t.slice(1);
    const parts = withoutSlash.split(/\s+/);
    const cmd = parts[0] || '';
    const args = parts.slice(1);
    return { verb: 'slash', command: cmd, args, raw: line };
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file persistence-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Flush debounced do estado para storage, com compressão opcional.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants, data/compression
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { DEBOUNCE_MS, STORAGE_KEYS } from '../core/constants.js';
import { Compression } from '../data/compression.js';

export class PersistenceSystem extends System {
  constructor() {
    super('PersistenceSystem');
    this.adapter = null;
    this._timer = null;
    this.lastFlushAt = null;
  }

  init() {
    this.on('persist:flush', () => this.schedule());
    this.on('tick:advanced', () => this.schedule());
  }

  setAdapter(adapter) {
    this.adapter = adapter;
  }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    return prev;
  }

  // ── API de carregamento ────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Lê e descomprime `world:main`.
   * Retorna o objeto de estado já parseado, ou `null` se ausente.
   *
   * @returns {Promise<Object|null>}
   */
  async loadWorld() {
    if (!this.adapter) return null;
    const raw = await this.adapter.get(STORAGE_KEYS.WORLD_MAIN);
    if (!raw) return null;

    const json = await Compression.decompress(raw);
    if (!json) return null;

    try {
      return JSON.parse(json);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(`[persist] payload corrompido: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  // ── Flush ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Agenda um flush com debounce.
   */
  schedule() {
    if (this._timer) clearTimeout(this._timer);
    this._timer = setTimeout(() => this.flush(), DEBOUNCE_MS);
  }

  /**
   * Serializa e persiste o estado atual.
   * Aplica compressão se disponível e registra em `meta:compression`.
   *
   * @param {string} [reason='debounced']
   * @returns {Promise<{ ok:boolean, error?:string, size?:number, compressed?:boolean }>}
   */
  async flush(reason = 'debounced') {
    if (!this.adapter) return { ok: false, error: 'sem adapter' };

    try {
      const state = this._serializeState();
      const json = JSON.stringify(state);
      const payload = await Compression.compress(json);
      const compressed = Compression.isCompressed(payload);

      await this.adapter.set(STORAGE_KEYS.WORLD_MAIN, payload);
      await this.adapter.set(STORAGE_KEYS.META_LAST_TICK, this.getTick());
      await this.adapter.set(
        STORAGE_KEYS.META_COMPRESSION,
        compressed ? 'gzip' : 'none'
      );

      this.lastFlushAt = Date.now();
      this.bus.emit('persist:saved', {
        tick: this.getTick(),
        reason,
        size: payload.length,
        compressed,
      });

      return { ok: true, size: payload.length, compressed };
    } catch (err) {
      this.bus.emit('persist:failed', { error: err.message });
      return { ok: false, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ── Serialização ──────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Monta o objeto de estado a partir do World e das timelines.
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _serializeState() {
    const timeline = this.machine?.systems?.get('TimelineSystem');

    const state = {
      version: 1,
      savedAt: Date.now(),
      tick: this.getTick(),
      timeline: this.getTimeline(),
      world: {},
      timelines: {},
    };

    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      state.world[id] = this.world.componentsOf(id);
    }

    if (timeline) {
      for (const [name, tl] of timeline.timelines) {
        state.timelines[name] = {
          entries: tl.entries.map(e => ({
            tick: e.tick,
            kind: e.kind,
            mutation: e.mutation ?? null,
            link: e.link ?? null,
            created: e.created ?? null,
          })),
          snapshots: Object.fromEntries(tl.snapshots),
        };
      }
    }

    return state;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file phrase-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles phr.* — gerenciamento e exibição de frases da
 *              hierarquia narrativa (package → category → set → phrase).
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants, core/utils/hierarchy
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13 — Comandos:
 *   phr.show <target>                  → card formatado com placeholders destacados
 *   phr.list [parent=<set>]            → tabela de frases (com preview do body)
 *   phr.render <target> [k=v ...]      → interpola placeholders e mostra resultado
 *   phr.find "<termo>"                 → busca em names e bodies
 *   phr.tree <target> [depth=N]        → árvore com preview de body
 *   phr.placeholders <target>          → lista placeholders únicos da frase
 *   phr.set <target> [body=...] [tags=...] [parent=...]
 *                                      → edita campos (body/tags/parent)
 *
 * Aceita referências por:
 *   - Shortcode:        PHR-A1B
 *   - Caminho:          Base.Apresentação.Inimigo.Frase_1
 *   - Nome simples:     "Frase 1"     (só se único)
 *
 * Determinismo: sem Math.random, sem wall-clock.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';
import {
  resolvePath,
  listCandidates,
  buildPath,
} from '../core/utils/hierarchy.js';

export class PhraseSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('PhraseSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'phr') return prev;

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'show':         return this._show(prev, ast);
        case 'list':         return this._list(prev, ast);
        case 'render':       return this._render(prev, ast);
        case 'find':         return this._find(prev, ast);
        case 'tree':         return this._tree(prev, ast);
        case 'placeholders': return this._placeholders(prev, ast);
        case 'set':          return this._set(prev, ast);
        default:
          return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `phr.${ast.action} não suportado` };
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // phr.show <target>
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _show(prev, ast) {
    const target = this._resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return this._notFound(prev, ast.target);

    const ident = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    const body = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text ?? '';
    const links = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
    const tags = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS)?.values ?? [];

    const parentName = links?.parent
      ? this.world.get(links.parent, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name ?? links.parent
      : '—';

    const placeholders = this._extractPlaceholders(body);
    const canonicalPath = buildPath(this.world, target);

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'card',
        title: `📝 ${ident?.name ?? target}`,
        data: {
          'caminho':      canonicalPath,
          'shortcode':    ident?.id ?? '—',
          'tipo':         ident?.type ?? '—',
          'parent (set)': parentName,
          'placeholders': placeholders.length > 0 ? placeholders.join(', ') : '(nenhum)',
          'tags':         tags.length > 0 ? tags.join(', ') : '(nenhuma)',
          '— body —':     '',
          'texto':        body || '(vazio)',
        },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // phr.list [parent=<set>]
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _list(prev, ast) {
    const parentFilter = ast.opts?.parent ?? null;

    let ids = this._allPhrases();

    if (parentFilter) {
      const parentId = this._resolve(parentFilter);
      if (!parentId) return this._notFound(prev, parentFilter);
      ids = ids.filter(id => {
        const links = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
        return links?.parent === parentId;
      });
    }

    const rows = ids.map(id => {
      const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const body = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text ?? '';
      return {
        id: ident?.id ?? '?',
        name: ident?.name ?? '?',
        path: buildPath(this.world, id),
        preview: this._truncate(body, 40),
      };
    });

    const title = parentFilter
      ? `📝 Frases em "${parentFilter}" (${rows.length})`
      : `📝 Frases (${rows.length})`;

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title, data: rows, sticky: true } };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // phr.render <target> [key=value ...]
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _render(prev, ast) {
    const target = this._resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return this._notFound(prev, ast.target);

    const ident = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    const body = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text ?? '';

    const values = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ast.opts ?? {})) {
      if (k === 'target') continue;
      values[k] = String(v);
    }

    const missing = [];
    const rendered = body.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_m, key) => {
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values, key)) return values[key];
      missing.push(key);
      return `«${key}»`;
    });

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'card',
        title: `📝 ${ident?.name ?? target} — renderizada`,
        data: {
          'caminho':     buildPath(this.world, target),
          'original':    body,
          'renderizada': rendered,
          'faltando':    missing.length > 0 ? missing.join(', ') : '(nenhum)',
        },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // phr.find "<termo>"
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _find(prev, ast) {
    const query = String(ast.query ?? '').toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'uso: phr.find "termo"' };

    const matches = [];
    for (const id of this._allPhrases()) {
      const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      const body = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text ?? '';

      const nameHit = (ident?.name ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
      const bodyHit = body.toLowerCase().includes(query);

      if (nameHit || bodyHit) {
        matches.push({
          id: ident?.id ?? '?',
          name: ident?.name ?? '?',
          path: buildPath(this.world, id),
          preview: this._truncate(body, 50),
          onde: nameHit && bodyHit ? 'nome+body' : nameHit ? 'nome' : 'body',
        });
      }
    }

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'table',
        title: `🔍 Frases com "${ast.query}" (${matches.length})`,
        data: matches,
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // phr.tree <target> [depth=N]
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _tree(prev, ast) {
    const target = this._resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return this._notFound(prev, ast.target);

    const depth = Math.max(1, parseInt(ast.opts?.depth ?? '4', 10) || 4);
    const tree = this._walk(target, depth, new Set());

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'tree',
      title: `🌳 ${this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name ?? target}`,
      data: tree,
      sticky: true,
    }};
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // phr.placeholders <target>
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _placeholders(prev, ast) {
    const target = this._resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return this._notFound(prev, ast.target);

    const body = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text ?? '';
    const placeholders = this._extractPlaceholders(body);

    const rows = placeholders.map(p => {
      const suggestions = this._suggestFor(p);
      return {
        placeholder: `{${p}}`,
        sugestoes: suggestions.length > 0 ? suggestions.slice(0, 5).join(', ') : '(nenhuma)',
      };
    });

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'table',
      title: `🏷️ Placeholders de "${ast.target}" (${placeholders.length})`,
      data: rows,
      sticky: true,
    }};
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // phr.set <target> [body=...] [tags=...] [parent=...]
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _set(prev, ast) {
    const target = this._resolve(ast.target);
    if (!target) return this._notFound(prev, ast.target);

    const opts = ast.opts ?? {};
    const changes = {};

    if (typeof opts.body === 'string') changes.body = opts.body;

    if (typeof opts.tags === 'string') {
      changes.tags = opts.tags.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    }

    if (typeof opts.parent === 'string') {
      const parentId = this._resolve(opts.parent);
      if (!parentId) return this._notFound(prev, opts.parent);
      changes.parent = parentId;
    }

    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'nada a alterar (use body=, tags=, parent=)' };
    }

    if (changes.body !== undefined) {
      if (this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)) {
        this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY, { text: changes.body });
      } else {
        this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY, { text: changes.body });
      }
    }

    if (changes.tags !== undefined) {
      if (this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS)) {
        this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS, { values: changes.tags });
      } else {
        this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS, { values: changes.tags });
      }
    }

    if (changes.parent !== undefined) {
      if (this.world.has(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS)) {
        this.world.set(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS, { parent: changes.parent });
      } else {
        this.world.addComponent(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS, { parent: changes.parent });
      }
    }

    return {
      ...prev,
      ok: true,
      mutated: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'card',
        title: `✏️ ${this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name ?? target} — atualizada`,
        data: {
          'caminho':   buildPath(this.world, target),
          'alterados': Object.keys(changes).join(', '),
          'body':      changes.body ?? '(inalterado)',
          'tags':      changes.tags ? changes.tags.join(', ') : '(inalterado)',
          'parent':    changes.parent ?? '(inalterado)',
        },
        sticky: true,
      },
    };
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // HELPERS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _allPhrases() {
    return this.world.allEntities().filter(id =>
      this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.type === 'phrase'
    );
  }

  _resolve(ref) {
    return resolvePath(this.world, ref);
  }

  _notFound(prev, ref) {
    const candidates = listCandidates(this.world, ref);

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `frase não encontrada: ${ref}` };
    }

    const list = candidates
      .map(c => `  • ${c.name} (${c.shortId}) — ${c.path}`)
      .join('\n');

    return {
      ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
      error: `referência "${ref}" é ambígua entre ${candidates.length} entidades:\n${list}\n\nUse o caminho completo ou o shortcode.`,
    };
  }

  _extractPlaceholders(body) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const out = [];
    const re = /\{(\w+)\}/g;
    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(body)) !== null) {
      if (!seen.has(m[1])) { seen.add(m[1]); out.push(m[1]); }
    }
    return out;
  }

  _suggestFor(name) {
    const out = [];
    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
      if (ident?.type !== 'placeholder-term') continue;
      const enums = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS);
      if (enums?.placeholderName === name) out.push(ident.name);
    }
    return out;
  }

  _walk(id, depth, seen) {
    const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    const body = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text;
    const type = ident?.type ?? '?';

    if (seen.has(id)) {
      return { node: `${ident?.name ?? id} (ciclo)`, children: [] };
    }
    if (depth <= 0) {
      return { node: ident?.name ?? id, children: [] };
    }

    seen.add(id);

    const label = body
      ? `${ident?.name ?? id}  →  "${this._truncate(body, 40)}"`
      : (ident?.name ?? id);

    const children = [];
    for (const other of this.world.allEntities()) {
      if (other === id) continue;
      const links = this.world.get(other, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
      if (links?.parent === id) {
        children.push(this._walk(other, depth - 1, seen));
      }
    }

    return { node: label, type, children };
  }

  _truncate(s, n) {
    const str = String(s ?? '');
    if (str.length <= n) return str;
    return str.slice(0, n - 1) + '…';
  }
}
```

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 10.1 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file query-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles que.*, at.*, whe.*, tim.*.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants, core/utils/time
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Stubs → Funcionalidades (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   - `_wheShow` era stub que retornava `{ data: [] }`. Agora delega
 *     para `_when()`, extraindo `path=valor` da condição. Uso:
 *       whe.show <ent>.<campo>=<valor>
 *   - `_where` agora suporta `que.where.<rel> <ent>`. Antes o rel era
 *     silenciosamente descartado pelo parser e só funcionava
 *     `que.where <ent>` (todos os links). A extração do rel é feita
 *     por regex sobre `ast.raw` porque `_parseQue` não recebe subtype.
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';
import { tickToNumber } from '../core/utils/time.js';

export class QuerySystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('QuerySystem'); }

  run(_line, ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast) return prev;

    try {
      if (ast.verb === 'que') {
        if (ast.action === 'at') return this._at(prev, ast);
        if (ast.action === 'when') return this._when(prev, ast);
        if (ast.action === 'timeline') return this._timeline(prev, ast);
        if (ast.action === 'where') return this._where(prev, ast);
      }
      if (ast.verb === 'at') return this._atShow(prev, ast);
      if (ast.verb === 'whe') return this._wheShow(prev, ast);
      if (ast.verb === 'tim') return this._timShow(prev, ast);
      return prev;
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // que.at / at.show
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _at(prev, ast) {
    const timeline = this.machine?.systems?.get('TimelineSystem');
    const snap = timeline?.getSnapshot(ast.tick);
    if (!snap) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `tick não encontrado: ${ast.tick}` };

    const target = this.resolve(ast.target.split('.')[0]);
    const field = ast.target.split('.')[1] || 'identity';
    const data = snap.entities[target];
    if (!data) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `entidade não encontrada em ${ast.tick}` };

    const compName = this._fieldToComponent(field);
    const value = compName ? data[compName] : data;

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'card', title: `${ast.target} em ${ast.tick}`,
      data: { tick: ast.tick, entity: target, field, value },
    }};
  }

  _atShow(prev, ast) {
    const timeline = this.machine?.systems?.get('TimelineSystem');
    const tick = ast.opts?.at ?? ast.target;
    const snap = timeline?.getSnapshot(tick);
    if (!snap) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `tick não encontrado: ${tick}` };
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'card', title: `Snapshot ${tick}`, data: snap }};
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // que.when
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _when(prev, ast) {
    const timeline = this.machine?.systems?.get('TimelineSystem');
    const entries = timeline?.getTimeline() ?? [];
    const [entRef, field] = String(ast.path || '').split('.');
    const target = this.resolve(entRef);
    const matches = [];

    for (const e of entries) {
      if (!e.mutation) continue;
      if (e.mutation.target !== target) continue;
      if (e.mutation.path !== field && !e.mutation.path?.endsWith(`.${field}`)) continue;
      if (e.mutation.after !== ast.value) continue;
      matches.push({
        tick: e.tick, op: e.mutation.op, path: e.mutation.path,
        before: e.mutation.before, after: e.mutation.after,
      });
    }

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: `Quando ${ast.path} = ${ast.value}`, data: matches }};
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // whe.show — Fase 13.7
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * `whe.show <ent>.<campo>=<valor>`
   * Delega para `_when` com path e value extraídos da condição.
   *
   * @param {Object} prev
   * @param {Object} ast
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _wheShow(prev, ast) {
    const condition = String(ast.condition || '').trim();
    if (!condition) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: 'uso: whe.show <entidade>.<campo>=<valor>',
      };
    }

    const eq = condition.indexOf('=');
    if (eq <= 0) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: `condição inválida: "${condition}" (esperado <path>=<valor>)`,
      };
    }

    const path = condition.slice(0, eq).trim();
    const value = condition.slice(eq + 1).trim();
    if (!path || !value) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: `condição inválida: "${condition}"`,
      };
    }

    return this._when(prev, { path, value });
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // que.timeline / tim.show
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _timeline(prev, ast) {
    const timeline = this.machine?.systems?.get('TimelineSystem');
    const entries = timeline?.getTimeline() ?? [];
    const [entRef, field] = String(ast.target || '').split('.');
    const target = this.resolve(entRef);

    const series = [];
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (!e.mutation) continue;
      if (e.mutation.target !== target) continue;
      if (e.mutation.path !== field && !e.mutation.path?.endsWith(`.${field}`)) continue;
      const delta = e.mutation.op === 'add' ? e.mutation.value
        : e.mutation.op === 'set' ? null : null;
      series.push({ tick: e.tick, value: e.mutation.after, delta });
    }

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'graph', title: ast.target, data: { series } }};
  }

  _timShow(prev, ast) {
    return this._timeline(prev, { target: ast.target });
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // que.where — Fase 13.7 (suporte a .<rel>)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * `que.where <ent>` → todos os links
   * `que.where.<rel> <ent>` → apenas links com esse rel
   *
   * O rel é extraído de `ast.raw` porque `_parseQue` não recebe o
   * subtype do cabeçalho. O parser atual define `ast.subtype = rest[0]`
   * (o alvo), perdendo o rel.
   *
   * @param {Object} prev
   * @param {Object} ast
   * @returns {Object}
   * @private
   */
  _where(prev, ast) {
    const raw = String(ast.raw || '');
    const m = /^que\.where\.([a-zA-Z_][\w-]*)\s+(.+)$/.exec(raw);
    const rel = m ? m[1] : null;
    const targetRef = m ? m[2].trim() : ast.subtype;

    if (!targetRef) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: 'uso: que.where [<rel>] <entidade>',
      };
    }

    const target = this.resolve(targetRef);
    if (!target) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: false, halt: true,
        error: `entidade não encontrada: ${targetRef}`,
      };
    }

    const links = this.world.get(target, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
    if (!links) {
      return {
        ...prev, ok: true,
        right: {
          kind: 'table',
          title: `Links de ${targetRef}${rel ? `.${rel}` : ''}`,
          data: [],
        },
      };
    }

    const rows = [];

    if (rel) {
      const value = links[rel];
      if (value === undefined) {
        return {
          ...prev, ok: true,
          right: {
            kind: 'table',
            title: `Links de ${targetRef}.${rel}`,
            data: [],
          },
        };
      }
      const targets = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
      for (const to of targets) {
        rows.push({ rel, to, type: this._typeOf(to) });
      }
    } else {
      for (const [r, value] of Object.entries(links)) {
        if (r === 'parent') continue;
        const targets = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
        for (const to of targets) {
          rows.push({ rel: r, to, type: this._typeOf(to) });
        }
      }
      if (links.parent) {
        rows.push({ rel: 'parent', to: links.parent, type: this._typeOf(links.parent) });
      }
    }

    return {
      ...prev, ok: true,
      right: {
        kind: 'table',
        title: `Links de ${targetRef}${rel ? `.${rel}` : ''} (${rows.length})`,
        data: rows,
      },
    };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // HELPERS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _fieldToComponent(field) {
    const map = { stats: 'Stats', flags: 'Flags', enums: 'Enums', texts: 'Texts', lists: 'Lists', links: 'Links' };
    return map[field] ?? null;
  }

  _typeOf(id) {
    if (!id) return '?';
    const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    return ident?.type ?? '?';
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file render-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Empurra resultados para os três painéis.
 * @imports ecs/system
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';

export class RenderSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('RenderSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    if (prev.left) this.bus.emit('render:left', prev.left);
    if (prev.right) this.bus.emit('render:right', prev.right);
    if (prev.annotation) this.bus.emit('render:annotation', prev.annotation);

    if (prev.mutated) {
      const highlight = [];
      if (prev.created?.id) highlight.push(prev.created.id);
      if (prev.mutation?.target) highlight.push(prev.mutation.target);
      if (prev.link?.from) highlight.push(prev.link.from);
      if (prev.instance?.id) highlight.push(prev.instance.id);
      if (prev.destroyed) highlight.push(prev.destroyed);
      if (highlight.length) {
        this.bus.emit('render:left', { kind: 'highlight', ids: highlight });
      }
    }
    return prev;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file rule-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Regras automáticas — ON/IF/DO com matching por evento.
 * @imports ecs/system, components/rule, core/constants, systems/helpers/guard-evaluator
 * @level 7
 *
 * Fase 3 — Diagnostics: emite `rule:evaluated` sempre, com motivo, para
 * diagnóstico de regras que não disparam. Motivos possíveis:
 *   - meta-missing
 *   - mode-not-auto
 *   - suspended
 *   - rule-component-missing
 *   - on-not-match
 *   - guard-empty
 *   - fired
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES, MAX_DEPTH } from '../core/constants.js';
import { makeIdentity } from '../components/identity.js';
import { makeRule, makeRuleMeta, markFired } from '../components/rule.js';
import { makeMeta } from '../components/meta.js';
import { GuardEvaluator } from './helpers/guard-evaluator.js';

const MAX_ITERATIONS = 1000;

export class RuleSystem extends System {
  constructor() {
    super('RuleSystem');
    this._queue = [];
    this._processing = false;
    /** @type {GuardEvaluator|null} */
    this.guard = null;
  }

  init() {
    this.guard = new GuardEvaluator(this.world, this.links);

    const events = [
      'component:added', 'component:updated', 'component:removed',
      'links:pruned',
      'entity:created', 'entity:destroyed',
    ];
    for (const evt of events) {
      this.on(evt, (payload) => this._onEvent(evt, payload));
    }
  }

  // ── Declaração (rul.add) ────────────────────────────────────

  run(_line, ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'rul' || ast.action !== 'add') return prev;

    try {
      const shortId = this.ids.generate('rule', ast.name);
      const components = {
        [COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY]: makeIdentity({ id: shortId, name: ast.name, type: 'rule' }),
        [COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE]: makeRule({ on: ast.on, if: ast.ifExpr, do: ast.doExpr }),
        [COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE_META]: makeRuleMeta({
          declaredAt: ctx.tick,
          mode: ast.opts?.mode || 'auto',
          tag: ast.opts?.tag,
        }),
        [COMPONENT_NAMES.META]: makeMeta({ builtin: false, tick: ctx.tick }),
      };
      this.world.createEntity(components, { id: shortId });
      return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, rule: { id: shortId, name: ast.name, declaredAt: ctx.tick } };
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ── Firing ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _onEvent(evt, payload) {
    if (this._processing) {
      this._queue.push({ evt, payload, depth: 0 });
      return;
    }
    this._queue.push({ evt, payload, depth: 0 });
    this._drain();
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _drain() {
    this._processing = true;
    let safety = 0;

    while (this._queue.length && safety < MAX_ITERATIONS) {
      safety++;
      const item = this._queue.shift();
      if (item.depth > MAX_DEPTH) {
        this.bus.emit('rule:cycle', { depth: item.depth });
        continue;
      }
      try {
        this._processItem(item);
      } catch (err) {
        this.bus.emit('rule:error', { evt: item.evt, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (safety >= MAX_ITERATIONS) {
      this.bus.emit('rule:overflow', { iterations: safety, remaining: this._queue.length });
      this._queue.length = 0;
    }

    this._processing = false;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _processItem(item) {
    const rules = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE);

    for (const ruleId of rules) {
      const meta = this.world.get(ruleId, COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE_META);
      const rule = this.world.get(ruleId, COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE);

      // ── Captura do invisível ─────────────────────────────
      if (!meta) {
        this.bus.emit('rule:evaluated', {
          rule: ruleId, reason: 'meta-missing', fired: false,
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (meta.mode !== 'auto') {
        this.bus.emit('rule:evaluated', {
          rule: ruleId, reason: 'mode-not-auto', mode: meta.mode, fired: false,
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (meta.suspended === true) {
        this.bus.emit('rule:evaluated', {
          rule: ruleId, reason: 'suspended', fired: false,
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (!rule) {
        this.bus.emit('rule:evaluated', {
          rule: ruleId, reason: 'rule-component-missing', fired: false,
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (!this._onMatches(rule.on, item)) {
        this.bus.emit('rule:evaluated', {
          rule: ruleId, reason: 'on-not-match',
          on: rule.on, evt: item.evt, fired: false,
        });
        continue;
      }

      const matches = this.guard
        ? this.guard.evaluate(rule.if, item, meta)
        : [];

      if (matches.length === 0) {
        this.bus.emit('rule:evaluated', {
          rule: ruleId, reason: 'guard-empty',
          if: rule.if, fired: false,
        });
        this.bus.emit('rule:skipped', { rule: ruleId, reason: 'guard-false' });
        continue;
      }

      for (const target of matches) {
        this._applyDo(rule.do, target, item);
      }

      this.world.set(
        ruleId,
        COMPONENT_NAMES.RULE_META,
        markFired(meta, this.getTick(), 'auto')
      );

      this.bus.emit('rule:evaluated', {
        rule: ruleId, reason: 'fired', fired: true, affected: matches,
      });
      this.bus.emit('rule:fired', { rule: ruleId, affected: matches });
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _onMatches(onExpr, item) {
    if (!onExpr) return false;
    if (onExpr === item.evt) return true;

    const id = item.payload?.id;
    if (!id) return false;

    if (id === onExpr) return true;

    const type = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.type;
    if (type && type === onExpr) return true;

    return false;
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _applyDo(doExpr, target, item) {
    if (!doExpr) return;

    const lines = String(doExpr)
      .split('\n')
      .map(s => s.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    const vars = {
      new: target,
      newEntity: target,
      this: target,
      target,
      entity: target,
    };

    for (const raw of lines) {
      const cmd = this._interpolate(raw, vars);
      if (!cmd) continue;

      let parsed;
      try {
        const parse = this.machine.systems.get('ParseSystem');
        if (!parse) continue;
        const res = parse.parse(cmd);
        if (!res?.ok) continue;
        parsed = res.ast;
      } catch {
        continue;
      }

      try {
        switch (parsed.verb) {
          case 'mut': {
            const mutSys = this.machine.systems.get('MutationSystem');
            if (mutSys) mutSys.run(cmd, {}, { ast: parsed, ok: true });
            break;
          }
          case 'link': {
            const linkSys = this.machine.systems.get('LinkSystem');
            if (linkSys) linkSys.run(cmd, {}, { ast: parsed, ok: true });
            break;
          }
          case 'kno': {
            const knoSys = this.machine.systems.get('KnowledgeSystem');
            if (knoSys) knoSys.run(cmd, { tick: this.getTick() }, { ast: parsed, ok: true });
            break;
          }
          default:
            break;
        }
      } catch {
        // isola erro por linha
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * @private
   */
  _interpolate(line, vars) {
    return String(line).replace(/\{([^}]+)\}/g, (m, name) => {
      const key = name.trim();
      return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(vars, key)
        ? vars[key]
        : m;
    });
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file search-query-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Executa o verbo `sea` — busca textual com operadores.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants
 * @level 7
 *
 * Sintaxe:
 *   sea.find   "<expr>"                      busca global
 *   sea.in     <categoria> "<expr>"          busca sob uma categoria (via Links.parent)
 *   sea.tag    <tag>                         lista entidades com uma tag
 *   sea.help                                 cheatsheet dos operadores
 *
 * Operadores (delegados ao SearchSystem):
 *   termo         TERM     busca por palavra
 *   a,b           AND
 *   a/b           OR
 *   a|b           XOR
 *   !a            NOT
 *   'frase'       PHRASE
 *   a<b / a>b     BEFORE / AFTER
 *   a-3/b         NEAR (distância 3)
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export class SearchQuerySystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('SearchQuerySystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'sea') return prev;

    try {
      switch (ast.action) {
        case 'find': return this._find(prev, ast);
        case 'in':   return this._in(prev, ast);
        case 'tag':  return this._tag(prev, ast);
        case 'help': return this._help(prev);
        default:     return prev;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // ── Ações ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Busca global em todas as entidades.
   * @private
   */
  _find(prev, ast) {
    const expr = ast.query || '';
    const predicate = this._compile(expr);

    const matches = [];
    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      const projection = this._project(id);
      if (!projection) continue;
      if (predicate(projection)) {
        matches.push(this._row(id));
      }
    }

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'table',
      title: `🔍 "${expr}" (${matches.length})`,
      data: matches,
      sticky: true,
    }};
  }

  /**
   * Busca restrita aos descendentes de uma categoria.
   * @private
   */
  _in(prev, ast) {
    const categoryName = ast.subtype;
    const expr = ast.query || '';

    if (!categoryName) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'uso: sea.in <categoria> "expressão"' };
    }

    const categoryId = this.resolve(categoryName);
    if (!categoryId) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `categoria não encontrada: ${categoryName}` };
    }

    const scope = this._collectDescendants(categoryId);
    const predicate = this._compile(expr);

    const matches = [];
    for (const id of scope) {
      const projection = this._project(id);
      if (!projection) continue;
      if (predicate(projection)) {
        matches.push(this._row(id));
      }
    }

    const ident = this.world.get(categoryId, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'table',
      title: `🔍 ${ident?.name ?? categoryName} → "${expr}" (${matches.length})`,
      data: matches,
      sticky: true,
    }};
  }

  /**
   * Lista entidades que possuem uma tag específica.
   * @private
   */
  _tag(prev, ast) {
    const tag = ast.tag;
    if (!tag) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'uso: sea.tag <tag>' };

    const matches = [];
    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      const tags = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS);
      if (tags?.values && tags.values.includes(tag)) {
        matches.push(this._row(id));
      }
    }

    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'table',
      title: `🏷️ "${tag}" (${matches.length})`,
      data: matches,
      sticky: true,
    }};
  }

  /**
   * Cheatsheet dos operadores.
   * @private
   */
  _help(prev) {
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: {
      kind: 'card',
      title: '🔍 Busca — operadores',
      data: {
        'termo':          'busca por palavra',
        'a,b':            'AND (a e b)',
        'a/b':            'OR (a ou b)',
        'a|b':            'XOR (a ou b, não ambos)',
        '!a':             'NOT (sem a)',
        "'frase exata'":  'match de frase',
        'a<b':            'a antes de b',
        'a>b':            'a depois de b',
        'a-3/b':          'a em até 3 palavras de b',
        '—':              '—',
        'sea.find "x"':   'busca global',
        'sea.in cat "x"': 'busca sob categoria',
        'sea.tag t':      'lista entidades com tag',
      },
    }};
  }

  // ── Helpers internos ───────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Compila uma expressão usando o SearchSystem.
   * Retorna um predicado `(text) => boolean`.
   * @private
   */
  _compile(expr) {
    const search = this.machine?.systems?.get('SearchSystem');
    if (!search) {
      // Fallback: substring simples, case-insensitive
      const needle = String(expr || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!needle) return () => true;
      return (text) => String(text || '').toLowerCase().includes(needle);
    }
    const predicate = search.compile(expr || '');
    return (text) => predicate(String(text || '').toLowerCase());
  }

  /**
   * Projeta uma entidade num único texto pesquisável.
   * Inclui Identity, Texts, Tags, Flags, Enums, Lists, Body.
   * @private
   */
  _project(id) {
    const world = this.world;
    const parts = [];

    const ident = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    if (ident) {
      if (ident.name)        parts.push(ident.name);
      if (ident.id)          parts.push(ident.id);
      if (ident.description) parts.push(ident.description);
      if (ident.type)        parts.push(ident.type);
    }

    const texts = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TEXTS);
    if (texts) {
      for (const v of Object.values(texts)) {
        if (v != null) parts.push(String(v));
      }
    }

    const tags = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TAGS);
    if (tags?.values) {
      for (const t of tags.values) parts.push(String(t));
    }

    const flags = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.FLAGS);
    if (flags?.values) {
      for (const f of flags.values) parts.push(String(f));
    }

    const enums = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.ENUMS);
    if (enums) {
      for (const v of Object.values(enums)) {
        if (v != null) parts.push(String(v));
      }
    }

    const lists = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LISTS);
    if (lists) {
      for (const arr of Object.values(lists)) {
        if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
          for (const item of arr) parts.push(String(item));
        }
      }
    }

    const body = world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY);
    if (body?.text) parts.push(String(body.text));

    return parts.join(' ');
  }

  /**
   * Linha tabular de uma entidade.
   * @private
   */
  _row(id) {
    const ident = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY);
    return {
      id:   ident?.id   ?? id,
      name: ident?.name ?? id,
      type: ident?.type ?? '?',
    };
  }

  /**
   * Coleta descendentes de uma entidade via `Links.parent` (BFS).
   * Inclui a própria raiz na lista.
   * @private
   */
  _collectDescendants(rootId) {
    const out = [rootId];
    const seen = new Set([rootId]);
    const queue = [rootId];

    while (queue.length) {
      const cur = queue.shift();

      for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
        if (seen.has(id)) continue;

        const links = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.LINKS);
        if (!links) continue;

        const parent = links.parent;
        const parents = Array.isArray(parent) ? parent : (parent ? [parent] : []);

        if (parents.includes(cur)) {
          seen.add(id);
          out.push(id);
          queue.push(id);
        }
      }
    }

    return out;
  }
}
```

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 4.1 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file search-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Motor de busca com operadores , / | ! " " ~ < > ; %.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/utils/string
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { escapeRegExp } from '../core/utils/string.js';

export class SearchSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('SearchSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    // Sistema passivo — expõe métodos para outros sistemas usarem.
    // Não roda no pipeline principal.
    return prev;
  }

  compile(expr) {
    const text = String(expr || '').trim();
    if (!text) return () => true;
    const ast = this._parse(text);
    return (searchable) => this._evaluate(ast, String(searchable || '').toLowerCase());
  }

  evaluate(expr, searchable) {
    return this.compile(expr)(searchable);
  }

  // ── Parser ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  _parse(expr) {
    if (expr.includes(',')) {
      const parts = this._splitBy(expr, ',');
      return { op: 'AND', children: parts.map(p => this._parse(p.trim())) };
    }
    if (expr.includes('|')) {
      const parts = this._splitBy(expr, '|');
      return { op: 'XOR', children: parts.map(p => this._parse(p.trim())) };
    }
    if (expr.includes('/')) {
      const parts = this._splitBy(expr, '/');
      return { op: 'OR', children: parts.map(p => this._parse(p.trim())) };
    }
    if (expr.startsWith('!')) {
      return { op: 'NOT', child: this._parse(expr.slice(1).trim()) };
    }
    const nearMatch = expr.match(/^(.+?)-(\d+)\/(.+)$/);
    if (nearMatch) {
      return { op: 'NEAR', a: nearMatch[1].trim(), dist: parseInt(nearMatch[2], 10), b: nearMatch[3].trim() };
    }
    const beforeMatch = expr.match(/^(.+?)<(.+)$/);
    if (beforeMatch) return { op: 'BEFORE', a: beforeMatch[1].trim(), b: beforeMatch[2].trim() };
    const afterMatch = expr.match(/^(.+?)>(.+)$/);
    if (afterMatch) return { op: 'AFTER', a: afterMatch[1].trim(), b: afterMatch[2].trim() };
    if (expr.startsWith("'") && expr.endsWith("'") && expr.length > 2) {
      return { op: 'PHRASE', phrase: expr.slice(1, -1).trim().toLowerCase() };
    }
    return { op: 'TERM', term: expr.toLowerCase() };
  }

  _evaluate(ast, text) {
    switch (ast.op) {
      case 'AND': return ast.children.every(c => this._evaluate(c, text));
      case 'OR':  return ast.children.some(c => this._evaluate(c, text));
      case 'XOR': return ast.children.filter(c => this._evaluate(c, text)).length === 1;
      case 'NOT': return !this._evaluate(ast.child, text);
      case 'NEAR': return this._near(text, ast.a.toLowerCase(), ast.b.toLowerCase(), ast.dist);
      case 'BEFORE': return this._before(text, ast.a.toLowerCase(), ast.b.toLowerCase());
      case 'AFTER': return this._after(text, ast.a.toLowerCase(), ast.b.toLowerCase());
      case 'PHRASE': {
        const norm = text.replace(/[\n\r]+/g, ' ').replace(/[^\w]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        return norm.includes(ast.phrase);
      }
      case 'TERM': {
        const re = new RegExp(`(^|\\s)${escapeRegExp(ast.term)}`);
        return re.test(text);
      }
      default: return false;
    }
  }

  _near(text, a, b, dist) {
    const words = text.split(/\s+/);
    for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
      if (!words[i].includes(a)) continue;
      for (let j = i + 1; j <= Math.min(words.length - 1, i + dist); j++) {
        if (words[j].includes(b)) return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  _before(text, a, b) {
    const ia = text.indexOf(a), ib = text.indexOf(b);
    return ia >= 0 && ib >= 0 && ia < ib;
  }

  _after(text, a, b) {
    const ia = text.indexOf(a), ib = text.indexOf(b);
    return ia >= 0 && ib >= 0 && ia > ib;
  }

  _splitBy(text, char) {
    const parts = [];
    let current = '';
    let inQuotes = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      const ch = text[i];
      if (ch === "'" && text[i - 1] !== '\\') inQuotes = !inQuotes;
      if (ch === char && !inQuotes) {
        parts.push(current);
        current = '';
      } else {
        current += ch;
      }
    }
    parts.push(current);
    return parts;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file seed-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Popula dados iniciais na primeira execução.
 * @imports ecs/system, schemas/builtin-seeds
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { getBuiltinSeeds } from '../schemas/builtin-seeds.js';

export class SeedSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('SeedSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) { return prev; }

  seed() {
    const seeds = getBuiltinSeeds();
    for (const { id, components } of seeds) {
      if (this.world.hasEntity(id)) continue;
      this.world.createEntity(components, { id });
    }
    return { seeded: seeds.length };
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file slash-command-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles /play, /editor, /help, /roll, /reset, /save.
 * @imports ecs/system
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';

export class SlashCommandSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('SlashCommandSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'slash') return prev;

    const cmd = ast.command;
    const allowed = ['play', 'editor', 'help', 'roll', 'reset', 'save'];
    if (!allowed.includes(cmd)) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `comando desconhecido: /${cmd}` };
    }

    switch (cmd) {
      case 'play':
        this.machine.state.play = true;
        break;

      case 'editor':
        this.machine.state.play = false;
        break;

      case 'save':
        this.bus.emit('persist:flush', { reason: 'manual' });
        break;

      case 'reset':
        this.bus.emit('machine:reset-requested', {});
        break;

      case 'help':
        this.machine.handleLine('help.cheatsheet');
        break;

      case 'roll':
        this.machine.state.roll = this.machine.state.roll ?? 'n';
        this.bus.emit('ui:roll:start', {
          system: this.machine.state.roll,
          tick: this.getTick(),
        });
        break;

      default:
        break;
    }

    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: false, mode: cmd };
  }
}
```
