### projeto_narrative-write/systems/snippet-system.js

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 6.2 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file snippet-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Handles snip.create/* + resolve do trigger.
 * @imports ecs/system, components/*, core/constants
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';
import { makeIdentity } from '../components/identity.js';
import { makeMeta } from '../components/meta.js';
import { makeTrigger, makeBody, makeSnippetType, makeMenuOpts, makeRuns } from '../components/snippet.js';

export class SnippetSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('SnippetSystem'); }

  run(_line, ctx, prev) {
    const ast = prev.ast;
    if (!ast || ast.verb !== 'snip') return prev;

    try {
      if (ast.action?.startsWith('create')) return this._create(prev, ast, ctx);
      if (ast.action === 'list') return this._list(prev, ast);
      if (ast.action === 'tree') return this._tree(prev, ast);
      if (ast.action === 'find') return this._find(prev, ast);
      if (ast.action === 'delete') return this._delete(prev, ast);
      return prev;
    } catch (err) {
      return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  resolve(prefix) {
    const all = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER);
    const matches = [];
    for (const id of all) {
      const trigger = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER).value;
      if (trigger.startsWith(prefix)) {
        const type = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE)?.value ?? 'text';
        matches.push({ id, trigger, type, source: 'user' });
      }
    }
    matches.sort((a, b) => b.trigger.length - a.trigger.length);
    return matches;
  }

  _create(prev, ast, ctx) {
    const trigger = ast.trigger;
    if (!trigger) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: 'trigger obrigatório' };

    const existing = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER)
      .find(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER).value === trigger);
    if (existing) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `trigger já existe: ${trigger}` };

    const action = ast.action;
    const shortId = this.ids.generate('snippet', trigger);

    const components = {
      [COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY]: makeIdentity({ id: shortId, name: trigger, type: 'snippet' }),
      [COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER]: makeTrigger(trigger),
      [COMPONENT_NAMES.META]: makeMeta({ builtin: false, tick: ctx.tick }),
    };

    if (action === 'create') {
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE] = makeSnippetType('text');
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY] = makeBody(ast.body || '');
    } else if (action === 'create.template') {
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE] = makeSnippetType('template');
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY] = makeBody(ast.opts?.body || '');
    } else if (action === 'create.menu') {
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE] = makeSnippetType('menu');
      const optsStr = String(ast.opts?.opts || '').trim();
      let options = [];

      if (optsStr.startsWith('[')) {
        // Nova sintaxe: JSON completo (permite body e run)
        try {
          options = JSON.parse(optsStr);
        } catch (err) {
          return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `opts JSON inválido: ${err.message}` };
        }
      } else {
        // Sintaxe antiga: "key1:Label1 key2:Label2"
        options = optsStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(pair => {
          const [key, label] = pair.split(':');
          return { key, label: label || key, type: 'text' };
        });
      }

      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.MENU_OPTS] = makeMenuOpts(options);
    } else if (action === 'create.command') {
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE] = makeSnippetType('command');
      const runsStr = ast.opts?.runs || '';
      components[COMPONENT_NAMES.RUNS] = makeRuns(runsStr.split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean));
    }

    this.world.createEntity(components, { id: shortId });
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, snippet: { trigger, type: action, shortId }};
  }

  _list(prev, ast) {
    const ids = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER);
    const rows = ids.map(id => ({
      trigger: this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER).value,
      type: this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE)?.value ?? '?',
      shortId: this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.id,
    }));
    rows.sort((a, b) => a.trigger.localeCompare(b.trigger));
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: `Snippets (${rows.length})`, data: rows }};
  }

  _tree(prev, ast) {
    const ids = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER);
    const tree = {};
    for (const id of ids) {
      const trigger = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER).value;
      const parts = trigger.split('.');
      let cur = tree;
      for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        const p = parts[i] || '__root';
        if (!cur[p]) cur[p] = { children: {}, meta: null };
        if (i === parts.length - 1) cur[p].meta = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.id;
        cur = cur[p].children;
      }
    }
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'tree', title: 'Árvore de Snippets', data: tree }};
  }

  _find(prev, ast) {
    const query = ast.query || '';
    const ids = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER);
    const rows = ids
      .filter(id => {
        const trigger = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER).value;
        const body = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.BODY)?.text ?? '';
        return trigger.includes(query) || body.includes(query);
      })
      .map(id => ({
        trigger: this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER).value,
        type: this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.SNIPPET_TYPE)?.value ?? '?',
        shortId: this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.id,
      }));
    return { ...prev, ok: true, right: { kind: 'table', title: `Snippets com "${query}"`, data: rows }};
  }

  _delete(prev, ast) {
    const found = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER)
      .find(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.TRIGGER).value === ast.trigger);
    if (!found) return { ...prev, ok: false, halt: true, error: `snippet não existe: ${ast.trigger}` };
    this.world.destroyEntity(found);
    return { ...prev, ok: true, mutated: true, deleted: ast.trigger };
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file stale-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Propaga marcação Stale quando blueprint muda.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export class StaleSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('StaleSystem'); }

  init() {
    this.on('component:updated', (e) => this._maybeMark(e));
    this.on('component:added',   (e) => this._maybeMark(e));
  }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) { return prev; }

  _maybeMark({ id, name }) {
    if (!id) return;
    if (!this.world.has(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IS_BLUEPRINT)) return;

    const tick = this.getTick();
    const descendants = this._walkDescendants(id);
    for (const d of descendants) {
      if (this.world.has(d, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE)) continue;
      this.world.addComponent(d, COMPONENT_NAMES.STALE, {
        value: true, at: tick, cause: `${id}.${name}`,
      });
    }
    if (descendants.length > 0) {
      this.bus.emit('stale:propagated', { source: id, field: name, marked: descendants });
    }
  }

  _walkDescendants(rootId) {
    const out = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const queue = [rootId];
    while (queue.length) {
      const cur = queue.shift();
      for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
        if (seen.has(id) || id === rootId) continue;
        const instOf = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.INSTANCE_OF)?.id;
        const derives = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.DERIVES_FROM)?.ids ?? [];
        if (instOf === cur || derives.includes(cur)) {
          seen.add(id);
          out.push(id);
          queue.push(id);
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file template-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Gerencia placeholders tipados em templates.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants, components/snippet
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';
import { extractPlaceholderNames, interpolateBody } from '../components/snippet.js';

export class TemplateSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('TemplateSystem'); }

  /**
   * Sistema passivo — não roda no pipeline principal.
   * Expõe métodos que o Editor e o SnippetSystem usam.
   */
  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    return prev;
  }

  // ── Inferência de tipo ─────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Infere o tipo de um placeholder a partir do seu nome.
   * @param {string} name
   * @returns {string}
   */
  inferType(name) {
    const n = String(name || '').toLowerCase();
    if (/personagem|nome|heroi|heroina|npc|aliado|atacante|alvo/.test(n)) return 'entity.character';
    if (/local|lugar|cidade|regiao|pais|sala|cenario/.test(n)) return 'entity.location';
    if (/item|arma|objeto|escudo/.test(n)) return 'entity.item';
    if (/faccao|grupo|ordem/.test(n)) return 'entity.faction';
    if (/emocao|sentimento|tom/.test(n)) return 'enum';
    if (/numero|valor|dano|hp|custo/.test(n)) return 'number';
    return 'text';
  }

  /**
   * Constrói defs a partir do corpo de um template.
   * @param {string} body
   * @returns {Array<{name:string,type:string,opts:any}>}
   */
  buildDefsFromBody(body) {
    const names = extractPlaceholderNames(body);
    return names.map(name => ({
      name,
      type: this.inferType(name),
      opts: null,
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Interpola placeholders num body.
   * @param {string} body
   * @param {Object<string,string>} values
   * @returns {string}
   */
  interpolate(body, values) {
    return interpolateBody(body, values);
  }

  // ── Sugestões para placeholders ────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Retorna sugestões para um placeholder conforme o tipo.
   * @param {Object} def
   * @returns {string[]}
   */
  suggestionsFor(def) {
    if (!def) return [];

    if (def.type === 'entity.character') {
      return this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)
        .filter(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.type === 'character')
        .map(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name)
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    if (def.type === 'entity.location') {
      return this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)
        .filter(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.type === 'location')
        .map(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name)
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    if (def.type === 'entity.item') {
      return this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)
        .filter(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.type === 'item')
        .map(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name)
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    if (def.type === 'entity.faction') {
      return this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)
        .filter(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.type === 'faction')
        .map(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name)
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    if (def.type === 'enum') {
      return Array.isArray(def.opts) ? [...def.opts] : [];
    }

    return [];
  }

  // ── Validação cruzada (opcional) ───────────────────────────

  /**
   * Valida um valor contra as regras do def.
   * @param {Object} def
   * @param {string} value
   * @returns {{ ok:boolean, error?:string }}
   */
  validate(def, value) {
    if (!def) return { ok: true };
    const v = String(value ?? '').trim();

    if (def.type === 'entity.character' || def.type === 'entity.location' ||
        def.type === 'entity.item' || def.type === 'entity.faction') {
      if (!v) return { ok: true };
      const found = this.world.query(COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)
        .find(id => this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.name === v);
      if (!found) return { ok: false, error: `entidade não encontrada: ${v}` };
    }

    if (def.type === 'enum' && Array.isArray(def.opts) && def.opts.length) {
      if (!v || def.opts.includes(v)) return { ok: true };
      return { ok: false, error: `valor inválido: ${v}` };
    }

    return { ok: true };
  }
}
```

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 3.4 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file timeline-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Snapshots + entries. Coração da memória do mundo.
 * @imports ecs/system, ecs/snapshot, core/constants
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { Snapshot } from '../ecs/snapshot.js';

export class TimelineSystem extends System {
  constructor() {
    super('TimelineSystem');
    this.entries = [];
    this.snapshots = new Map();
    /** @type {Map<string, Array>} */
    this.timelines = new Map([['main', { entries: this.entries, snapshots: this.snapshots }]]);
    this.activeTimeline = 'main';
  }

  init() {
    const snap = Snapshot.take(this.world, { tick: this.getTick(), timeline: this.activeTimeline });
    this.entries.push({ tick: this.getTick(), kind: 'init', snapshot: snap, diff: null, mutation: null });
    this.snapshots.set(this.getTick(), snap);
  }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    if (!prev.mutated) return prev;

    const tick = this.getTick();
    const snap = Snapshot.take(this.world, { tick, timeline: this.activeTimeline });
    const previous = this.snapshots.size > 0
      ? Array.from(this.snapshots.values())[this.snapshots.size - 1]
      : null;
    const diff = previous ? Snapshot.diff(previous, snap) : null;

    const entry = {
      tick,
      timeline: this.activeTimeline,
      kind: prev.created ? 'entity-created' : 'mutation',
      created: prev.created ?? null,
      mutation: prev.mutation ?? null,
      link: prev.link ?? null,
      snapshot: snap,
      diff,
      recordedAt: Date.now(),
    };

    this.entries.push(entry);
    this.snapshots.set(tick, snap);
    this.bus.emit('timeline:recorded', entry);

    return { ...prev, timelineEntry: entry, diff };
  }

  getTimeline(name = null) {
    const tl = name ? this.timelines.get(name) : this.timelines.get(this.activeTimeline);
    return tl?.entries ?? [];
  }

  getSnapshot(tick, name = null) {
    const tl = name ? this.timelines.get(name) : this.timelines.get(this.activeTimeline);
    return tl?.snapshots.get(tick) ?? null;
  }

  getLastTick(name = null) {
    const entries = this.getTimeline(name);
    return entries.length ? entries[entries.length - 1].tick : 'T0';
  }

  createTimeline(name, { snapshots, base, point, createdAt }) {
    const entries = [];
    for (const [tick, snap] of snapshots) {
      entries.push({ tick, kind: 'checkpoint', snapshot: snap, diff: null, mutation: null });
    }
    this.timelines.set(name, { entries, snapshots: new Map(snapshots), base, point, createdAt });
    return { name, base, point, entries: entries.length };
  }

  switchTo(name) {
    if (!this.timelines.has(name)) throw new Error(`timeline não existe: ${name}`);
    this.activeTimeline = name;
    const tl = this.timelines.get(name);
    this.entries = tl.entries;
    this.snapshots = tl.snapshots;
    return { name, lastTick: this.getLastTick(name) };
  }

  deleteTimeline(name) {
    if (name === 'main') throw new Error('não pode apagar main');
    if (!this.timelines.has(name)) throw new Error(`timeline não existe: ${name}`);
    this.timelines.delete(name);
  }

  listTimelines() {
    const out = [];
    for (const [name, tl] of this.timelines) {
      out.push({
        name, base: tl.base ?? null, point: tl.point ?? null,
        ticks: tl.entries.length, active: name === this.activeTimeline,
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  size() { return this.entries.length; }
  clear() { this.entries.length = 0; this.snapshots.clear(); }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file validation-system.js
 * @module systems
 * @description Valida unicidade, refs e ciclos pós-mutação.
 * @imports ecs/system, core/constants
 * @level 7
 */

import { System } from '../ecs/system.js';
import { COMPONENT_NAMES } from '../core/constants.js';

export class ValidationSystem extends System {
  constructor() { super('ValidationSystem'); }

  run(_line, _ctx, prev) {
    if (!prev.mutated) return prev;
    const warnings = [];

    // Unicidade de shortcode
    const byId = new Map();
    for (const id of this.world.allEntities()) {
      const shortId = this.world.get(id, COMPONENT_NAMES.IDENTITY)?.id;
      if (!shortId) continue;
      if (byId.has(shortId) && byId.get(shortId) !== id) {
        warnings.push(`shortcode duplicado: ${shortId}`);
      }
      byId.set(shortId, id);
    }

    if (warnings.length > 0) {
      this.bus.emit('validation:warnings', { warnings });
    }
    return prev;
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file command-guide.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Painel de comandos organizados por categoria.
 * @imports core/utils/dom
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 12
 *
 * Fase D:
 *   - Aceita `{ container }` opcional. Sem container, usa
 *     `document.body` (histórico). Com container, anexa nele.
 */

import { el, clear } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

export class CommandGuide {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {HTMLElement} [opts.container=null]
   */
  constructor(machine, { container = null } = {}) {
    this.machine = machine;
    this.visible = false;

    this.node = el('div', { class: 'command-guide' });
    const parent = container || document.body;
    parent.appendChild(this.node);

    this._render();
  }

  open() {
    this.visible = true;
    this._render();
    this.node.classList.add('visible');
  }

  close() {
    this.visible = false;
    this.node.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  toggle() {
    if (this.visible) this.close();
    else this.open();
  }

  destroy() {
    if (this.node?.parentNode) this.node.parentNode.removeChild(this.node);
  }

  // ── Internos ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  _render() {
    clear(this.node);

    const header = el('div', { class: 'command-guide-header' });
    header.appendChild(el('span', {}, '📖 Comandos'));
    const closeBtn = el('button', { class: 'header-btn' }, '✕');
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.close());
    header.appendChild(closeBtn);
    this.node.appendChild(header);

    const content = el('div', { class: 'command-guide-content' });

    const commands = this.machine.registry?.getCommands() ?? [];
    for (const cmd of commands) {
      const section = el('div', { class: 'guide-section' });
      section.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'guide-section-title' }, `${cmd.verb}.`));
      if (cmd.description) {
        section.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'guide-line' }, cmd.description));
      }
      for (const ex of cmd.examples ?? []) {
        section.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'guide-line' }, ex));
      }
      content.appendChild(section);
    }

    this.node.appendChild(content);
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file floating-menu.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Menu flutuante acionado por `.` no editor.
 *              Suporta dois modos:
 *                - 'snippet'  → triggers de snippets (comportamento histórico)
 *                - 'hierarchy'→ autocomplete de caminho hierárquico (Fase 13)
 * @imports core/utils/dom
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 12
 *
 * Fase 13 — Autocomplete hierárquico:
 *   `open({ ..., mode:'hierarchy', insertRange })` e itens com `body`
 *   disparam `ui:snippet:insert` com `replaceRange` para que o editor
 *   substitua o `partial` digitado pelo nome completo.
 */

import { el, clear } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

export class FloatingMenu {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {HTMLElement} [opts.container=null]
   */
  constructor(machine, { container = null } = {}) {
    this.machine = machine;
    this.items = [];
    this.selected = 0;
    this.cursor = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    this.visible = false;
    this.trigger = '';
    this.mode = 'snippet';
    /** @type {{from:number,to:number}|null} */
    this.insertRange = null;

    this.node = el('div', { class: 'narrative-floating-menu' });
    const parent = container || document.body;
    parent.appendChild(this.node);

    this._wireEvents();
  }

  /**
   * Abre o menu.
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {string} opts.trigger
   * @param {Array} opts.items
   * @param {{x:number,y:number}} opts.cursor
   * @param {'snippet'|'hierarchy'} [opts.mode='snippet']
   * @param {{from:number,to:number}|null} [opts.insertRange=null]
   */
  open({ trigger, items, cursor, mode = 'snippet', insertRange = null }) {
    if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
      this.close();
      return;
    }
    this.trigger = trigger;
    this.items = items;
    this.selected = 0;
    this.cursor = cursor ?? { x: 0, y: 0 };
    this.mode = mode;
    this.insertRange = insertRange;
    this.visible = true;

    this._render();
    this._position();
    this.node.classList.add('visible');
    this.node.classList.toggle('mode-hierarchy', mode === 'hierarchy');
    this.node.classList.toggle('mode-snippet', mode !== 'hierarchy');
  }

  /**
   * Atualiza a lista de itens.
   * @param {Array} items
   */
  update(items) {
    this.items = items ?? [];
    this.selected = 0;
    this._render();
    if (this.items.length === 0) this.close();
  }

  /**
   * Fecha o menu.
   */
  close() {
    this.visible = false;
    this.items = [];
    this.selected = 0;
    this.mode = 'snippet';
    this.insertRange = null;
    this.node.classList.remove('visible');
    this.node.classList.remove('mode-hierarchy');
    this.node.classList.remove('mode-snippet');
  }

  /**
   * Move a seleção.
   * @param {number} dir
   */
  moveSelection(dir) {
    const len = this.items.length;
    if (len === 0) return;
    this.selected = (this.selected + dir + len) % len;
    this._render();
    this._scrollToSelected();
  }

  /**
   * Retorna o item selecionado.
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  getSelected() {
    return this.items[this.selected] ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Confirma o item selecionado.
   *
   * Ordem de execução:
   *   1. Menu com options → expande em sub-itens (não fecha).
   *   2. Fecha o menu.
   *   3. Se `run` → executa via machine.handleLine.
   *   4. Se `body` → emite `ui:snippet:insert` com `replaceRange`.
   *
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  confirm() {
    const item = this.getSelected();
    if (!item) return false;

    // ── Caso 1: snippet de menu → expande ──────────────────
    const opts = item.def?.menu;
    if (Array.isArray(opts) && opts.length > 0 && !item._isSubItem) {
      this.items = opts.map(o => ({
        trigger: o.label ?? o.key,
        type: 'text',
        source: 'option',
        body: o.body ?? o.label ?? o.key,
        run: o.run ?? null,
        _isSubItem: true,
      }));
      this.selected = 0;
      this._render();
      this._position();
      return true;
    }

    // ── Caso 2/3: fecha PRIMEIRO e depois executa ──────────
    const body = item.body;
    const run = item.run;
    const replaceRange = this.insertRange;   // captura antes de close()

    this.close();

    if (run) {
      try {
        this.machine.handleLine(run);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[FloatingMenu] erro ao executar run:', run, err);
      }
    }

    if (body) {
      this.machine.bus.emit('ui:snippet:insert', {
        text: body,
        replaceRange,
      });
    }

    return true;
  }

  // ── Internos ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  _render() {
    clear(this.node);

    const headerText = this.mode === 'hierarchy'
      ? `Caminho: ${this.trigger || '(raiz)'}`
      : (this.trigger ? `Snippets com "${this.trigger}"` : 'Snippets');
    this.node.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'menu-header' }, headerText));

    if (this.items.length === 0) {
      this.node.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'menu-empty' }, 'Nenhum resultado'));
      return;
    }

    this.items.forEach((item, i) => {
      const cls = ['menu-item'];
      if (i === this.selected) cls.push('selected');

      const node = el('div', { class: cls.join(' '), 'data-index': String(i) });
      node.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'menu-item-label' }, item.trigger));

      // Badge de tipo (hierarquia)
      if (this.mode === 'hierarchy' && item.type) {
        node.appendChild(el('span', {
          class: `menu-item-badge badge-${item.type}`,
        }, item.type));
      }

      // Shortcode (hierarquia) ou source (snippet)
      if (this.mode === 'hierarchy' && item.shortId) {
        node.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'menu-item-meta' }, item.shortId));
      } else if (this.mode !== 'hierarchy' && !item._isSubItem) {
        const source = item.source === 'user' ? 'user' : 'builtin';
        node.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'menu-item-meta' }, source));
      }

      // Ícone de navegação: se tem filhos, mostra seta
      if (this.mode === 'hierarchy' && item.hasChildren) {
        node.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'menu-item-arrow' }, '›'));
      }

      // Snippet sub-item com run mostra raio
      if (item._isSubItem && item.run) {
        node.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'menu-item-meta' }, '⚡'));
      }

      this.node.appendChild(node);
    });
  }

  _position() {
    const w = this.node.offsetWidth || 260;
    const h = this.node.offsetHeight || 200;
    let { x, y } = this.cursor;

    if (x + w > window.innerWidth - 10) x = window.innerWidth - w - 10;
    if (y + h > window.innerHeight - 10) y = y - h - 20;
    if (x < 10) x = 10;
    if (y < 10) y = 10;

    this.node.style.left = `${x}px`;
    this.node.style.top = `${y}px`;
  }

  _scrollToSelected() {
    const node = this.node.querySelector(`.menu-item[data-index="${this.selected}"]`);
    if (node) node.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }

  _wireEvents() {
    this.node.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const item = e.target.closest('.menu-item');
      if (!item) return;
      this.selected = parseInt(item.dataset.index, 10);
      this.confirm();
    });
  }

  destroy() {
    if (this.node?.parentNode) this.node.parentNode.removeChild(this.node);
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file focus-manager.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Gerencia ciclo de foco entre painéis (Tab/Shift+Tab).
 * @imports core/utils/dom
 * @importedBy ui/keyboard-router
 * @level 12
 */

import { focusSilently } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

export class FocusManager {
  /**
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {HTMLElement} opts.panelLeft
   * @param {HTMLElement} opts.panelRight
   * @param {HTMLElement} opts.editor
   */
  constructor({ panelLeft, panelRight, editor }) {
    this.order = [
      { name: 'editor', el: editor },
      { name: 'panel-left', el: panelLeft },
      { name: 'panel-right', el: panelRight },
    ];
    this.current = 0;
  }

  cycle(direction = 1) {
    const len = this.order.length;
    this.current = (this.current + direction + len) % len;
    this._applyFocus();
    return this.order[this.current].name;
  }

  focus(name) {
    const idx = this.order.findIndex(o => o.name === name);
    if (idx < 0) return null;
    this.current = idx;
    this._applyFocus();
    return name;
  }

  focusEditor() {
    this.focus('editor');
  }

  currentPanel() {
    return this.order[this.current]?.name ?? 'editor';
  }

  /**
   * Libera recursos.
   * Fase C — remove a classe `panel-focus` de todos os elementos
   * e esvazia a ordem. Usado pelo UI test harness.
   */
  destroy() {
    for (const item of this.order) {
      if (!item.el) continue;
      try { item.el.classList.remove('panel-focus'); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }
    this.order = [];
    this.current = 0;
  }

  // ── Internos ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  _applyFocus() {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.order.length; i++) {
      const item = this.order[i];
      if (!item.el) continue;
      if (i === this.current) {
        item.el.classList.add('panel-focus');
        focusSilently(item.el);
      } else {
        item.el.classList.remove('panel-focus');
      }
    }
  }
}
```

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 6.3 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file graph-renderer.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Renderiza séries temporais em SVG inline.
 * @imports core/utils/dom
 * @importedBy ui/panel-right
 * @level 12
 *
 * Uso:
 *   GraphRenderer.render({ series, title }, container);
 *
 * Series esperado:
 *   [{ tick: 'T3', value: 10, delta: +3 }, ...]
 */

import { el, clear } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

const PADDING_LEFT   = 46;
const PADDING_RIGHT  = 16;
const PADDING_TOP    = 16;
const PADDING_BOTTOM = 28;
const DOT_RADIUS     = 3.5;
const LINE_WIDTH     = 2;

export class GraphRenderer {
  /**
   * Renderiza o gráfico no container.
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {Array<{tick:string,value:any,delta:any}>} opts.series
   * @param {string} [opts.title]
   * @param {number} [opts.width=320]
   * @param {number} [opts.height=180]
   * @param {HTMLElement} container
   */
  static render({ series = [], title = '', width = 320, height = 180 } = {}, container) {
    if (!container) return;
    clear(container);

    const usable = (series || []).filter(p =>
      p && typeof p.value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(p.value)
    );

    const wrap = el('div', { class: 'graph-renderer' });
    if (title) {
      wrap.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'graph-title' }, title));
    }

    if (usable.length === 0) {
      wrap.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'graph-empty' }, 'Sem dados para exibir'));
      container.appendChild(wrap);
      return;
    }

    // Escalas
    const values = usable.map(p => p.value);
    let minY = Math.min(...values);
    let maxY = Math.max(...values);
    if (minY === maxY) {
      minY -= 1;
      maxY += 1;
    }
    // Margem estética
    const rangeY = maxY - minY;
    minY -= rangeY * 0.1;
    maxY += rangeY * 0.1;

    const innerW = width - PADDING_LEFT - PADDING_RIGHT;
    const innerH = height - PADDING_TOP - PADDING_BOTTOM;

    const n = usable.length;
    const stepX = n > 1 ? innerW / (n - 1) : 0;

    const projectX = (i) => PADDING_LEFT + i * stepX;
    const projectY = (v) =>
      PADDING_TOP + innerH - ((v - minY) / (maxY - minY)) * innerH;

    // SVG
    const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
    svg.setAttribute('class', 'graph-svg');
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
    svg.setAttribute('width', String(width));
    svg.setAttribute('height', String(height));
    svg.setAttribute('role', 'img');
    if (title) svg.appendChild(_titleNode(title));

    // Grid horizontal (3 linhas)
    const gridYs = [0, 0.5, 1];
    for (const g of gridYs) {
      const y = PADDING_TOP + innerH * g;
      const line = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, 'line');
      line.setAttribute('class', 'graph-grid');
      line.setAttribute('x1', String(PADDING_LEFT));
      line.setAttribute('x2', String(PADDING_LEFT + innerW));
      line.setAttribute('y1', String(y));
      line.setAttribute('y2', String(y));
      svg.appendChild(line);
    }

    // Eixos
    const axisY = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, 'line');
    axisY.setAttribute('class', 'graph-axis');
    axisY.setAttribute('x1', String(PADDING_LEFT));
    axisY.setAttribute('x2', String(PADDING_LEFT));
    axisY.setAttribute('y1', String(PADDING_TOP));
    axisY.setAttribute('y2', String(PADDING_TOP + innerH));
    svg.appendChild(axisY);

    const axisX = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, 'line');
    axisX.setAttribute('class', 'graph-axis');
    axisX.setAttribute('x1', String(PADDING_LEFT));
    axisX.setAttribute('x2', String(PADDING_LEFT + innerW));
    axisX.setAttribute('y1', String(PADDING_TOP + innerH));
    axisX.setAttribute('y2', String(PADDING_TOP + innerH));
    svg.appendChild(axisX);

    // Y labels
    const yLabels = [maxY, (maxY + minY) / 2, minY];
    for (let i = 0; i < yLabels.length; i++) {
      const val = yLabels[i];
      const y = PADDING_TOP + innerH * (i / (yLabels.length - 1));
      const t = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, 'text');
      t.setAttribute('class', 'graph-label');
      t.setAttribute('x', String(PADDING_LEFT - 6));
      t.setAttribute('y', String(y + 3));
      t.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'end');
      t.textContent = _formatNumber(val);
      svg.appendChild(t);
    }

    // X labels (máximo 5)
    const maxLabels = 5;
    const labelEvery = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(n / maxLabels));
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i += labelEvery) {
      const p = usable[i];
      const x = projectX(i);
      const t = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, 'text');
      t.setAttribute('class', 'graph-label');
      t.setAttribute('x', String(x));
      t.setAttribute('y', String(PADDING_TOP + innerH + 16));
      t.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
      t.textContent = String(p.tick ?? '');
      svg.appendChild(t);
    }

    // Linha
    if (n > 1) {
      const points = usable.map((p, i) => `${projectX(i)},${projectY(p.value)}`).join(' ');
      const poly = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, 'polyline');
      poly.setAttribute('class', 'graph-line');
      poly.setAttribute('points', points);
      poly.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
      poly.setAttribute('stroke-width', String(LINE_WIDTH));
      svg.appendChild(poly);
    }

    // Pontos com tooltip nativo
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const p = usable[i];
      const cx = projectX(i);
      const cy = projectY(p.value);
      const c = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, 'circle');
      c.setAttribute('class', 'graph-dot');
      c.setAttribute('cx', String(cx));
      c.setAttribute('cy', String(cy));
      c.setAttribute('r', String(DOT_RADIUS));

      const tt = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, 'title');
      const delta = (p.delta === null || p.delta === undefined)
        ? ''
        : ` (Δ ${p.delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${p.delta})`;
      tt.textContent = `${p.tick}: ${p.value}${delta}`;
      c.appendChild(tt);

      svg.appendChild(c);
    }

    wrap.appendChild(svg);
    container.appendChild(wrap);
  }
}

// ── Internos ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _titleNode(text) {
  const t = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'title');
  t.textContent = text;
  return t;
}

function _formatNumber(n) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
  if (Number.isInteger(n)) return String(n);
  return n.toFixed(1);
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file history-panel.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Painel de histórico navegável (Ctrl+H).
 * @imports core/utils/dom
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 12
 *
 * Fase D:
 *   - Aceita `{ container, target }` opcional.
 *   - `destroy()` remove o nó do DOM.
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Fiação órfã (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   - Implementado filtro do input de busca (S-7). Antes o input era
 *     renderizado mas nunca escutava `input` — digitar não filtrava.
 *   - Removido listener `keydown` local (S-8). Era redundante com o
 *     `KeyboardRouter`, que escuta em capture phase e faz
 *     `e.stopPropagation()` quando o painel está visível — o listener
 *     local (capture=false) nunca era alcançado.
 *   - `moveSelection()` agora opera sobre `visibleEntries` (filtrado).
 */

import { el, clear } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

export class HistoryPanel {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {HTMLElement} [opts.container=null]
   * @param {EventTarget} [opts.target=document]
   */
  constructor(machine, { container = null, target = document } = {}) {
    this.machine = machine;
    this.target = target;
    this.visible = false;
    this.selected = 0;

    /** @type {Array<Object>} entradas completas (não filtradas) */
    this.entries = [];

    /** @type {Array<Object>} entradas visíveis (após filtro) */
    this.visibleEntries = [];

    /** @type {string} query atual do filtro */
    this.filterQuery = '';

    this.node = el('div', { class: 'history-panel' });
    const parent = container || document.body;
    parent.appendChild(this.node);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // API pública
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  open() {
    const timeline = this.machine.systems.get('TimelineSystem');
    const entries = timeline?.getTimeline() ?? [];
    this.entries = entries.slice().reverse();
    this.visibleEntries = [...this.entries];
    this.filterQuery = '';
    this.selected = 0;
    this.visible = true;
    this._render();
    this.node.classList.add('visible');
  }

  close() {
    this.visible = false;
    this.node.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  toggle() {
    if (this.visible) this.close();
    else this.open();
  }

  /**
   * Aplica filtro textual. Atualiza `visibleEntries` e re-renderiza.
   * @param {string} query
   */
  filter(query) {
    const q = String(query ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
    this.filterQuery = q;
    if (!q) {
      this.visibleEntries = [...this.entries];
    } else {
      this.visibleEntries = this.entries.filter((entry) => {
        const haystack = this._summarize(entry).toLowerCase();
        return haystack.includes(q);
      });
    }
    // Reset da seleção para o topo da lista filtrada
    this.selected = 0;
    this._render();
  }

  moveSelection(dir) {
    const len = this.visibleEntries.length;
    if (len === 0) return;
    this.selected = Math.max(0, Math.min(len - 1, this.selected + dir));
    this._render();
    this._scrollToSelected();
  }

  jumpToSelected() {
    const entry = this.visibleEntries[this.selected];
    if (!entry) return;
    try {
      this.machine.restoreFrom(entry.tick);
      this.machine.bus.emit('ui:history:jump', { tick: entry.tick });
    } catch (err) {
      this.machine.bus.emit('ui:flash-error', { message: err.message });
    }
  }

  destroy() {
    if (this.node?.parentNode) this.node.parentNode.removeChild(this.node);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _render() {
    clear(this.node);

    const totalCount = this.entries.length;
    const shown = this.visibleEntries.length;
    const headerText = shown === totalCount
      ? `Histórico (${totalCount})`
      : `Histórico (${shown}/${totalCount})`;

    const header = el('div', { class: 'history-header' }, headerText);
    const closeBtn = el('button', { class: 'header-btn' }, '✕');
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.close());
    header.appendChild(closeBtn);
    this.node.appendChild(header);

    // Search input
    const search = el('div', { class: 'history-search' });
    const input = el('input', {
      type: 'text',
      placeholder: 'Buscar...',
      value: this.filterQuery,
    });

    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
      this.filter(input.value);
      // Re-foca o input após re-render (o filtro reconstrói o DOM)
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newInput = this.node.querySelector('.history-search input');
        if (newInput) {
          newInput.focus();
          // Coloca o cursor no fim do valor
          const len = newInput.value.length;
          try { newInput.setSelectionRange(len, len); } catch { /* isola */ }
        }
      }, 0);
    });

    search.appendChild(input);
    this.node.appendChild(search);

    // Lista
    const list = el('div', { class: 'history-list' });

    if (this.visibleEntries.length === 0) {
      list.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'history-empty' },
        this.filterQuery ? 'Nada corresponde à busca' : 'Sem histórico'));
    } else {
      this.visibleEntries.forEach((entry, i) => {
        const cls = ['history-entry'];
        if (i === this.selected) cls.push('selected');
        if (entry.metadata?.undone) cls.push('undone');
        if (entry.tick === this.machine.getTick()) cls.push('current');

        const row = el('div', { class: cls.join(' '), 'data-index': String(i) });
        row.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'history-entry-tick' }, entry.tick));
        row.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'history-entry-summary' }, this._summarize(entry)));
        list.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    this.node.appendChild(list);

    // Footer
    const footer = el('div', { class: 'history-footer' },
      `↑↓ navegar · Enter ir · Esc fechar · ${shown} entradas`);
    this.node.appendChild(footer);

    this._bindListEvents();
  }

  _summarize(entry) {
    if (entry.kind === 'init') return 'snapshot inicial';
    if (entry.mutation) {
      return `${entry.mutation.op} ${entry.mutation.target}.${entry.mutation.path}`;
    }
    if (entry.created) return `create ${entry.created.id}`;
    if (entry.link) return `link.${entry.link.action} ${entry.link.from}`;
    return entry.kind;
  }

  _scrollToSelected() {
    const row = this.node.querySelector(`.history-entry[data-index="${this.selected}"]`);
    if (row && typeof row.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
      try { row.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); } catch { /* isola */ }
    }
  }

  _bindListEvents() {
    this.node.querySelectorAll('.history-entry').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.selected = parseInt(node.dataset.index, 10);
        this.jumpToSelected();
      });
    });
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file keyboard-router.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Roteia eventos de teclado por contexto.
 * @imports ui/shortcut-registry
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 12
 *
 * Fase C:
 *   - Aceita `{ target = document }` opcional no construtor.
 *   - `destroy()` remove o listener de `this.target`.
 *
 * Fase 13.7 — Fiação órfã (auditoria 25/09/2026):
 *   Removidos os `case 'undo'` e `case 'redo'` de `_execute()`.
 *   Eles só emitiam `ui:shortcut` para um toast "em breve". Undo/redo
 *   serão readicionados quando `Machine.undo()` existir.
 */

import { ShortcutRegistry } from './shortcut-registry.js';

export class KeyboardRouter {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} ui — { floatingMenu, historyPanel, rollOverlay, playOverlay, commandGuide }
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {EventTarget} [opts.target=document]
   */
  constructor(machine, ui, { target = document } = {}) {
    this.machine = machine;
    this.ui = ui || {};
    this.target = target;
    this.shortcuts = new ShortcutRegistry();
    this._handler = null;
    this._bind();
  }

  // ── Ciclo de vida ──────────────────────────────────────────

  destroy() {
    if (this._handler && this.target) {
      try {
        this.target.removeEventListener('keydown', this._handler, true);
      } catch { /* isola */ }
      this._handler = null;
    }
    this.shortcuts?.destroy?.();
  }

  // ── Internos ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  _bind() {
    this._handler = (e) => {
      if (this._overlayActive()) return;

      if (this._contextual(e)) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        return;
      }

      const shortcut = this.shortcuts.match(e);
      if (shortcut) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        this._execute(shortcut, e);
      }
    };
    this.target.addEventListener('keydown', this._handler, true);
  }

  _overlayActive() {
    const { rollOverlay, playOverlay } = this.ui;
    if (rollOverlay?.visible) return true;
    if (playOverlay?.visible) return true;
    return false;
  }

  _contextual(e) {
    const { floatingMenu, historyPanel, commandGuide } = this.ui;

    if (floatingMenu?.visible) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); floatingMenu.moveSelection(1); return true; }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp')   { e.preventDefault(); floatingMenu.moveSelection(-1); return true; }
      if (e.key === 'Enter')     { e.preventDefault(); floatingMenu.confirm(); return true; }
      if (e.key === 'Escape')    { e.preventDefault(); floatingMenu.close(); return true; }
      return false;
    }

    if (historyPanel?.visible) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); historyPanel.moveSelection(1); return true; }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp')   { e.preventDefault(); historyPanel.moveSelection(-1); return true; }
      if (e.key === 'Enter')     { e.preventDefault(); historyPanel.jumpToSelected(); return true; }
      if (e.key === 'Escape')    { e.preventDefault(); historyPanel.close(); return true; }
      return false;
    }

    if (commandGuide?.visible && e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      commandGuide.close();
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  _execute(name) {
    const bus = this.machine.bus;

    switch (name) {
      case 'history':
        this.ui.historyPanel?.toggle();
        break;

      case 'save':
        bus.emit('persist:flush', { reason: 'manual' });
        break;

      case 'toggle-panel':
        bus.emit('ui:panel:toggle');
        break;

      case 'toggle-left':
        bus.emit('ui:panel:left:toggle');
        break;

      case 'toggle-right':
        bus.emit('ui:panel:right:toggle');
        break;

      case 'help':
        this.machine.handleLine('help.cheatsheet');
        break;

      case 'play':
        this.ui.playOverlay?.toggle();
        break;

      default:
        break;
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file modal.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Modal genérico — open/close/confirm/alert/prompt.
 * @imports core/utils/dom
 * @importedBy boot.js, ui/*
 * @level 12
 *
 * Uso:
 *   const modal = new ModalManager();
 *
 *   // Genérico
 *   const value = await modal.open({
 *     title: 'Confirmar',
 *     body: 'Deseja apagar?',
 *     actions: [
 *       { label: 'Cancelar', type: 'ghost',   value: false },
 *       { label: 'Apagar',   type: 'danger',  value: true  },
 *     ],
 *   });
 *
 *   // Atalhos
 *   await modal.confirm('Apagar', 'Tem certeza?', { danger: true });
 *   await modal.alert('Aviso', 'Algo aconteceu.');
 *   const nome = await modal.prompt('Renomear', 'Kaelin');
 *
 * Refatoração Fase B:
 *   O construtor aceita `{ container }` opcional. Sem container, o
 *   overlay é anexado a `document.body` (comportamento histórico).
 *   Com container, é anexado nele — usado pelo UI test harness para
 *   isolar cenários em iframe.
 */

import { el, clear } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

export class ModalManager {
  /**
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {HTMLElement} [opts.container=null]
   */
  constructor({ container = null } = {}) {
    this.node = el('div', { class: 'modal-overlay' });
    const parent = container || document.body;
    parent.appendChild(this.node);

    this.visible = false;
    /** @type {Function|null} */
    this._resolve = null;
    /** @type {Function|null} */
    this._onKeydown = null;

    // Fechar ao clicar fora da caixa
    this.node.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === this.node && this._dismissible) {
        this.close(null);
      }
    });
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // API principal
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Abre um modal genérico.
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {string} [opts.title='']
   * @param {string|Node} [opts.body='']
   * @param {Array<{
   *   label:string,
   *   type?:'primary'|'danger'|'ghost',
   *   value?:any,
   *   readInput?:()=>any
   * }>} [opts.actions=[]]
   * @param {boolean} [opts.dismissible=true] — permite fechar com Esc/clique fora
   * @returns {Promise<any>}
   */
  open({ title = '', body = '', actions = [], dismissible = true } = {}) {
    // Se já existe um aberto, resolve com null antes
    if (this._resolve) this.close(null);

    this._dismissible = dismissible;

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this._resolve = resolve;
      this._render({ title, body, actions });

      this.visible = true;
      this.node.classList.add('visible');

      this._onKeydown = (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && this._dismissible) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          this.close(null);
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown, true);

      const firstBtn = this.node.querySelector('.modal-btn');
      if (firstBtn) setTimeout(() => firstBtn.focus(), 30);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Modal de confirmação.
   * @param {string} title
   * @param {string} message
   * @param {Object} [opts]
   * @param {string} [opts.confirmLabel='Confirmar']
   * @param {string} [opts.cancelLabel='Cancelar']
   * @param {boolean} [opts.danger=false]
   * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
   */
  confirm(title, message, {
    confirmLabel = 'Confirmar',
    cancelLabel = 'Cancelar',
    danger = false,
  } = {}) {
    return this.open({
      title,
      body: message,
      actions: [
        { label: cancelLabel, type: 'ghost', value: false },
        { label: confirmLabel, type: danger ? 'danger' : 'primary', value: true },
      ],
    });
  }

  /**
   * Modal de alerta (um botão).
   * @param {string} title
   * @param {string} message
   * @param {Object} [opts]
   * @param {string} [opts.okLabel='OK']
   * @returns {Promise<true>}
   */
  alert(title, message, { okLabel = 'OK' } = {}) {
    return this.open({
      title,
      body: message,
      actions: [{ label: okLabel, type: 'primary', value: true }],
    });
  }

  /**
   * Modal de input de texto.
   * @param {string} title
   * @param {string} [defaultValue='']
   * @param {Object} [opts]
   * @param {string} [opts.placeholder='']
   * @param {string} [opts.okLabel='OK']
   * @param {string} [opts.cancelLabel='Cancelar']
   * @returns {Promise<string|null>} — null se cancelado
   */
  prompt(title, defaultValue = '', {
    placeholder = '',
    okLabel = 'OK',
    cancelLabel = 'Cancelar',
  } = {}) {
    const input = el('input', {
      type: 'text',
      value: String(defaultValue ?? ''),
      placeholder,
      style: {
        width: '100%',
        padding: '8px 10px',
        border: '1px solid var(--border-mid)',
        borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
        fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
        fontSize: '13px',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      },
    });

    input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        this.close(input.value);
      }
    });

    setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 40);

    return this.open({
      title,
      body: input,
      actions: [
        { label: cancelLabel, type: 'ghost', value: null },
        { label: okLabel, type: 'primary', readInput: () => input.value },
      ],
    });
  }

  /**
   * Fecha o modal com um valor.
   * @param {any} [value=null]
   */
  close(value = null) {
    if (!this.visible) return;

    this.visible = false;
    this.node.classList.remove('visible');

    if (this._onKeydown) {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown, true);
      this._onKeydown = null;
    }

    const resolve = this._resolve;
    this._resolve = null;

    if (typeof resolve === 'function') {
      resolve(value);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Destrói o modal — remove o nó do DOM.
   */
  destroy() {
    this.close(null);
    if (this.node?.parentNode) {
      this.node.parentNode.removeChild(this.node);
    }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Internos
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _render({ title, body, actions }) {
    clear(this.node);

    const box = el('div', { class: 'modal-box' });

    if (title) {
      box.appendChild(el('div', { class: 'modal-title' }, String(title)));
    }

    const bodyNode = el('div', { class: 'modal-body' });
    if (body instanceof Node) {
      bodyNode.appendChild(body);
    } else {
      bodyNode.textContent = String(body ?? '');
    }
    box.appendChild(bodyNode);

    if (Array.isArray(actions) && actions.length > 0) {
      const actionsNode = el('div', { class: 'modal-actions' });
      for (const act of actions) {
        const cls = `modal-btn ${act.type ?? 'ghost'}`;
        const btn = el('button', { class: cls }, String(act.label ?? 'OK'));

        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const value = typeof act.readInput === 'function'
            ? act.readInput()
            : (act.value !== undefined ? act.value : null);
          this.close(value);
        });

        actionsNode.appendChild(btn);
      }
      box.appendChild(actionsNode);
    }

    this.node.appendChild(box);
  }
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file narrative-overlay.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Overlay flutuante para correção de referências ambíguas
 *              e (Camada 5) para correção de operação/subtipo.
 * @imports core/utils/dom, ui/operation-picker
 * @importedBy boot.js
 * @level 12
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * CAMADA 5 — INTEGRAÇÃO COM O OPERATION PICKER
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Adicionado um botão "Corrigir classificação" que abre o
 * `OperationPicker` no modo adequado:
 *
 *   - Se o act tem `proposition.predicateLemma` → modo verb-subtype
 *     para corrigir o D-number do verbo.
 *   - Se o act tem `construction.id` → modo construction-op para
 *     corrigir a operação da construction.
 *
 * O picker emite `narr:learn:verb-subtype:request` ou
 * `narr:learn:construction-op:request` no bus. O NarrativeSystem
 * escuta e persiste no user-lexicon.
 *
 * Modos de operação do overlay:
 *   - `openReference()` — comportamento original (correção de referência)
 *   - `openAct()`       — NOVO: correção de classificação de um act
 *   - `close(chose)`    — fecha; emite `narr:override:set` se chose
 *
 * Para retrocompatibilidade, `open()` é alias de `openReference()`.
 */

import { el, clear } from '../core/utils/dom.js';
import { OperationPicker } from './operation-picker.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONSTANTES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const _RECOMMENDED_THRESHOLD = 0.75;

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CLASSE
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export class NarrativeOverlay {
  /**
   * @param {Object} machine
   * @param {Object} [opts={}]
   * @param {HTMLElement} [opts.container=null]
   * @param {EventTarget} [opts.target=document]
   */
  constructor(machine, { container = null, target = document } = {}) {
    this.machine = machine;
    this.target = target;
    this.visible = false;

    /** @type {Object|null} */
    this.payload = null;

    /** @type {Function|null} */
    this._onKeydown = null;

    this.node = el('div', { class: 'narrative-overlay' });
    const parent = container || document.body;
    parent.appendChild(this.node);

    this.win = parent.ownerDocument?.defaultView
      ?? this.target?.defaultView
      ?? window;

    this.node.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === this.node) this.close(null);
    });

    // ── Operation picker (Camada 5) ────────────────────────
    this.operationPicker = new OperationPicker(machine, {
      container: parent,
      target,
    });
  }

  // ── API pública — referência ───────────────────────────

  /**
   * Abre o overlay para correção de referência ambígua.
   * Aceita tanto `open()` (retrocompatível) quanto `openReference()`.
   */
  open({ spanKey, candidates, current = null, sourceSpan = null, sentenceId = null } = {}) {
    return this.openReference({ spanKey, candidates, current, sourceSpan, sentenceId });
  }

  /**
   * Abre o overlay para correção de referência ambígua.
   *
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {string} opts.spanKey
   * @param {Array} opts.candidates
   * @param {string|null} [opts.current]
   * @param {Object} [opts.sourceSpan]
   * @param {string} [opts.sentenceId]
   */
  openReference({ spanKey, candidates, current = null, sourceSpan = null, sentenceId = null } = {}) {
    if (!spanKey) return;
    if (!Array.isArray(candidates) || candidates.length === 0) return;

    this.payload = {
      mode: 'reference',
      spanKey,
      candidates: [...candidates],
      current,
      sourceSpan,
      sentenceId,
      learn: false,
    };

    const anchor = this._resolveAnchor(sourceSpan);
    this._render();
    this._position(anchor);
    this.visible = true;
    this.node.classList.add('visible');

    this._bindEsc();
    this._focusFirst();
  }

  /**
   * Abre o overlay para correção de classificação de um act.
   * Modo novo da Camada 5.
   *
   * @param {Object} opts
   * @param {Object} opts.act
   * @param {Object} [opts.sourceSpan]
   */
  openAct({ act, sourceSpan = null } = {}) {
    if (!act || typeof act !== 'object') return;

    const lemma = act?.proposition?.predicateLemma ?? null;
    const constructionId = act?.constructionId ?? act?.provenance?.constructionId ?? null;
    const currentOp = Array.isArray(act.operations) && act.operations.length > 0
      ? act.operations[0]
      : null;
    const currentSubtype = this._primarySubtype(act);

    if (!lemma && !constructionId) {
      // Sem verbos nem construction → nada a corrigir
      return;
    }

    this.payload = {
      mode: 'act',
      act,
      lemma,
      constructionId,
      currentOp,
      currentSubtype,
      sourceSpan: sourceSpan ?? act.source ?? null,
    };

    const anchor = this._resolveAnchor(this.payload.sourceSpan);
    this._render();
    this._position(anchor);
    this.visible = true;
    this.node.classList.add('visible');

    this._bindEsc();
    this._focusFirst();
  }

  /**
   * Fecha o overlay.
   * @param {string|null} chose — só relevante no modo 'reference'
   */
  close(chose = null) {
    if (!this.visible) return;

    this.visible = false;
    this.node.classList.remove('visible');

    if (this._onKeydown) {
      try { this.target.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown, true); }
      catch { /* isola */ }
      this._onKeydown = null;
    }

    const payload = this.payload;
    this.payload = null;

    // Só emite override se for modo 'reference'
    if (chose && payload && payload.mode === 'reference') {
      const rejected = payload.candidates
        .map((c) => c.entityId)
        .filter((id) => id !== chose);

      try {
        this.machine.bus.emit('narr:override:set', {
          spanKey: payload.spanKey,
          chose,
          rejected,
          learn: payload.learn === true,
        });
      } catch { /* isola */ }
    }
  }

  /**
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  isVisible() {
    return this.visible;
  }

  /**
   * Remove do DOM.
   */
  destroy() {
    this.close(null);
    try { this.operationPicker?.destroy?.(); } catch { /* isola */ }
    if (this.node?.parentNode) {
      this.node.parentNode.removeChild(this.node);
    }
  }

  // ── Internos — bind ────────────────────────────────────

  _bindEsc() {
    this._onKeydown = (e) => {
      if (!this.visible) return;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        this.close(null);
      }
    };
    try { this.target.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown, true); }
    catch { /* isola */ }
  }

  _focusFirst() {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const first = this.node.querySelector('.narrative-candidate, .act-picker-btn');
      if (first && typeof first.focus === 'function') first.focus();
    }, 30);
  }

  // ── Internos — helpers ─────────────────────────────────

  _primarySubtype(act) {
    const subs = act?.subtypes;
    if (!subs || typeof subs !== 'object') return null;
    for (const [dOp, sub] of Object.entries(subs)) {
      const id = typeof sub === 'string' ? sub : sub?.id;
      if (id) return id;
    }
    return null;
  }

  // ── Internos — posicionamento ──────────────────────────

  _resolveAnchor(sourceSpan) {
    if (!sourceSpan) return null;

    try {
      const doc = this.node.ownerDocument;
      const ta = doc.querySelector('.editor-input');
      if (!ta) return null;

      const rect = ta.getBoundingClientRect();
      const style = doc.defaultView?.getComputedStyle(ta);
      const lineHeight = parseInt(style?.lineHeight ?? '20', 10) || 20;
      const paddingTop = parseInt(style?.paddingTop ?? '14', 10) || 14;

      const text = ta.value ?? '';
      const before = text.slice(0, sourceSpan.start);
      const lineIdx = (before.match(/\n/g) || []).length;

      const x = rect.left + 40;
      const y = rect.top + paddingTop + (lineIdx * lineHeight);

      return { x, y };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  _position(anchor) {
    const w = this.node.offsetWidth || 320;
    const h = this.node.offsetHeight || 200;
    const vw = this.win.innerWidth;
    const vh = this.win.innerHeight;

    if (!anchor) {
      this.node.style.left = `${Math.max(10, (vw - w) / 2)}px`;
      this.node.style.top = `${Math.max(10, (vh - h) / 2)}px`;
      return;
    }

    let { x, y } = anchor;
    if (x + w > vw - 10) x = vw - w - 10;
    if (y + h > vh - 10) y = y - h - 20;
    if (x < 10) x = 10;
    if (y < 10) y = 10;

    this.node.style.left = `${x}px`;
    this.node.style.top = `${y}px`;
  }

  // ── Internos — render ─────────────────────────────────

  _render() {
    clear(this.node);
    const p = this.payload;
    if (!p) return;

    if (p.mode === 'reference') {
      this._renderReference();
    } else if (p.mode === 'act') {
      this._renderAct();
    }
  }

  // ── Render — modo referência ───────────────────────────

  _renderReference() {
    const p = this.payload;

    const header = el('div', { class: 'narrative-overlay-header' });
    header.appendChild(el('span', {}, '⚠ Referência ambígua'));
    const closeBtn = el('button', {
      class: 'narrative-overlay-close',
      title: 'Fechar (Esc)',
    }, '✕');
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.close(null));
    header.appendChild(closeBtn);
    this.node.appendChild(header);

    if (p.sourceSpan?.raw) {
      const ctx = el('div', { class: 'narrative-overlay-context' });
      ctx.textContent = `"${p.sourceSpan.raw}"`;
      this.node.appendChild(ctx);
    }

    const question = el('div', { class: 'narrative-overlay-question' }, 'A que se refere?');
    this.node.appendChild(question);

    const list = el('div', { class: 'narrative-candidate-list' });

    const sorted = [...p.candidates].sort((a, b) => {
      const sa = typeof a.score === 'number' ? a.score : 0;
      const sb = typeof b.score === 'number' ? b.score : 0;
      if (sb !== sa) return sb - sa;
      return String(a.name ?? '').localeCompare(String(b.name ?? ''));
    });

    const top = sorted[0];
    const topIsDominant = top && typeof top.score === 'number' &&
      top.score >= _RECOMMENDED_THRESHOLD;

    for (const c of sorted) {
      const row = el('button', {
        class: 'narrative-candidate',
        'data-entity-id': c.entityId,
        type: 'button',
      });

      if (c.entityId === p.current) row.classList.add('current');
      if (topIsDominant && c.entityId === top.entityId) row.classList.add('recommended');

      row.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'narrative-candidate-label' },
        String(c.name ?? c.entityId ?? '?')));
      row.appendChild(el('span', { class: 'narrative-candidate-score' },
        typeof c.score === 'number' ? c.score.toFixed(2) : '—'));

      row.addEventListener('click', () => this.close(c.entityId));
      list.appendChild(row);
    }

    this.node.appendChild(list);

    const learnRow = el('label', { class: 'narrative-overlay-learn' });
    const chk = el('input', { type: 'checkbox' });
    chk.checked = p.learn === true;
    chk.addEventListener('change', () => {
      if (this.payload) this.payload.learn = chk.checked;
    });
    learnRow.appendChild(chk);
    learnRow.appendChild(el('span', {}, 'Lembrar esta correção'));
    this.node.appendChild(learnRow);

    const footer = el('div', { class: 'narrative-overlay-footer' });

    const clearAllBtn = el('button', {
      class: 'narrative-overlay-btn ghost',
      type: 'button',
      title: 'Remover todos os overrides persistidos',
    }, '🗑 Esquecer tudo');

    clearAllBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      try { this.machine.bus.emit('narr:override:clearAll', {}); } catch { /* isola */ }
      this.close(null);
    });
    footer.appendChild(clearAllBtn);

    const cancelBtn = el('button', {
      class: 'narrative-overlay-btn ghost',
      type: 'button',
    }, 'Cancelar');
    cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.close(null));
    footer.appendChild(cancelBtn);

    this.node.appendChild(footer);
  }

  // ── Render — modo act (Camada 5) ──────────────────────

  _renderAct() {
    const p = this.payload;
    const act = p.act;

    const header = el('div', { class: 'narrative-overlay-header' });
    header.appendChild(el('span', {}, '🎯 Corrigir classificação'));
    const closeBtn = el('button', {
      class: 'narrative-overlay-close',
      title: 'Fechar (Esc)',
    }, '✕');
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.close(null));
    header.appendChild(closeBtn);
    this.node.appendChild(header);

    // Texto da frase
    const raw = act?.source?.raw ?? '';
    if (raw) {
      const ctx = el('div', { class: 'narrative-overlay-context' });
      ctx.textContent = raw.length > 80 ? raw.slice(0, 77) + '…' : raw;
      this.node.appendChild(ctx);
    }

    // Estado atual
    const info = el('div', { class: 'act-picker-current' });
    if (p.currentOp) {
      info.appendChild(el('div', {},
        `Operação atual: ${p.currentOp}`));
    }
    if (p.currentSubtype) {
      info.appendChild(el('div', {},
        `Subtipo atual: ${p.currentSubtype}`));
    }
    if (lemmaLine(p)) info.appendChild(lemmaLine(p));
    this.node.appendChild(info);

    // Botão único que abre o picker
    const actions = el('div', { class: 'narrative-overlay-footer' });

    const openPickerBtn = el('button', {
      class: 'act-picker-btn primary',
      type: 'button',
    }, p.lemma ? 'Corrigir verbo' : 'Corrigir operação');

    openPickerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      // Fecha o overlay atual (sem emitir override)
      const saved = { lemma: p.lemma, constructionId: p.constructionId,
                      currentOp: p.currentOp, currentSubtype: p.currentSubtype };
      this.close(null);
      // Abre o picker
      this.operationPicker.open({
        lemma: saved.lemma,
        constructionId: saved.constructionId,
        currentOp: saved.currentOp,
        currentSubtype: saved.currentSubtype,
      });
    });
    actions.appendChild(openPickerBtn);

    const cancelBtn = el('button', {
      class: 'narrative-overlay-btn ghost',
      type: 'button',
    }, 'Cancelar');
    cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.close(null));
    actions.appendChild(cancelBtn);

    this.node.appendChild(actions);
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS DE RENDER
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function lemmaLine(p) {
  if (!p.lemma) return null;
  const d = document.createElement('div');
  d.textContent = `Verbo: ${p.lemma}`;
  return d;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORTS AGREGADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export const NarrativeOverlayCatalog = Object.freeze({
  OperationPicker,
});
```

```javascript
/**
 * @file operation-picker.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Overlay flutuante para correção de operação/subtipo
 *              de uma frase. Parte da Camada 5.
 * @imports core/utils/dom
 * @importedBy ui/narrative-overlay
 * @level 12
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * CONTRATO
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   const picker = new OperationPicker(machine, { container });
 *
 *   picker.open({
 *     lemma: 'esgueirar',              // para verb-subtype
 *     currentSubtype: 'D1.2',          // opcional
 *     currentOp: 'represent',          // opcional
 *     constructionId: null,            // se for construction-op
 *     onConfirm: (choice) => { ... },  // callback
 *   });
 *
 *   picker.close();
 *   picker.isVisible();
 *   picker.destroy();
 *
 * O picker emite no bus:
 *   `narr:learn:verb-subtype:request` — quando o usuário confirma
 *                                        uma correção de verbo
 *   `narr:learn:construction-op:request` — idem para construction
 *
 * Ao confirmar, chama `onConfirm({ kind, prefer })` se fornecido.
 */

import { el, clear } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CATÁLOGO DE OPERAÇÕES E SUBTIPOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Operações v1 com rótulos PT-BR.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<{ id:string, label:string, color:string }>}
 */
const _OPERATIONS = Object.freeze([
  { id: 'represent',   label: 'Representar', color: '#4a90e2' },
  { id: 'describe',    label: 'Descrever',   color: '#38a169' },
  { id: 'expose',      label: 'Expor',       color: '#d69e2e' },
  { id: 'interiorize', label: 'Interiorizar',color: '#6b46c1' },
  { id: 'enunciate',   label: 'Enunciar',    color: '#805ad5' },
  { id: 'evaluate',    label: 'Avaliar',     color: '#d53f8c' },
  { id: 'focalize',    label: 'Focalizar',   color: '#2c5282' },
  { id: 'structure',   label: 'Estruturar',  color: '#718096' },
]);

/**
 * Subtipos canônicos com rótulos.
 * @type {ReadonlyArray<{ id:string, op:string, label:string }>}
 */
const _SUBTYPES = Object.freeze([
  // D1
  { id: 'D1.1', op: 'represent', label: 'Acontecimento' },
  { id: 'D1.2', op: 'represent', label: 'Ação' },
  { id: 'D1.3', op: 'represent', label: 'Estado-em-cena' },
  { id: 'D1.4', op: 'represent', label: 'Mudança-em-cena' },
  { id: 'D1.5', op: 'represent', label: 'Processo' },
  { id: 'D1.6', op: 'represent', label: 'Conduta Fisiológica' },
  { id: 'D1.7', op: 'represent', label: 'Fenômeno Atmosférico' },

  // D2
  { id: 'D2.1', op: 'describe', label: 'Entidade/Corpo' },

  { id: 'D3.5', op: 'expose', label: 'Especificar' },
```
