```css
}

/* ── Alert rows ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

.panel-right .alert-row {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--fg-muted);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.panel-right .alert-row.error   { border-color: var(--danger); }
.panel-right .alert-row.warning { border-color: var(--warn); }
.panel-right .alert-row.info    { border-color: var(--accent); }

.panel-right .alert-code {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.panel-right .alert-message {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

/* ── Tree view ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

.panel-right .tree-view {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.panel-right .tree-view-node {
  padding: 2px 0 2px 12px;
  border-left: 1px dotted var(--border-mid);
  margin-left: 4px;
}

.panel-right .tree-view-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
  margin-right: 6px;
}

.panel-right .tree-view-badge {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  color: var(--accent-strong);
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-right: 4px;
}

.panel-right .tree-view-source {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  margin-right: 6px;
}

.panel-right .tree-view-desc {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-secondary);
  font-style: italic;
}

.panel-right .tree-empty,
.panel-right .result-empty {
  padding: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   NARRATIVE PANEL — Estágio 8
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.panel-right .narrative-card .narrative-acts {
  max-height: 420px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding-right: 2px;
}

.panel-right .narrative-metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.panel-right .narrative-metric {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 5px 7px;
  text-align: center;
}

.panel-right .narrative-metric-label {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.panel-right .narrative-metric-value {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

.panel-right .narrative-metric-value.variant-error   { color: var(--danger); }
.panel-right .narrative-metric-value.variant-warning { color: var(--warn); }

/* ── Linha de ato ────────────────────────────────────────── */

.panel-right .narrative-act-row {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 7px 9px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  transition: background 0.12s, border-left-color 0.12s;
}

.panel-right .narrative-act-row:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-left-color: var(--accent-strong);
}

.panel-right .narrative-act-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.panel-right .narrative-op-badge {
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: lowercase;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}

.panel-right .narrative-op-represent   { background: var(--narr-D1); }
.panel-right .narrative-op-describe    { background: var(--narr-D2); }
.panel-right .narrative-op-expose      { background: var(--narr-D3); }
.panel-right .narrative-op-interiorize { background: var(--narr-D4); }
.panel-right .narrative-op-enunciate   { background: var(--narr-D5); }
.panel-right .narrative-op-evaluate    { background: var(--narr-D6); }
.panel-right .narrative-op-focalize    { background: var(--narr-D7); }
.panel-right .narrative-op-structure   { background: var(--narr-D8); }

.panel-right .narrative-act-confidence {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.panel-right .narrative-act-confidence.conf-high { color: var(--success); }
.panel-right .narrative-act-confidence.conf-mid  { color: var(--fg-secondary); }
.panel-right .narrative-act-confidence.conf-low  { color: var(--warn); }

.panel-right .narrative-act-text {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
  line-height: 1.35;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.panel-right .narrative-act-dims {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  margin-top: 3px;
}

/* ── Subtipos (Estágio 8) ───────────────────────────────── */

.panel-right .narrative-subtypes {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 5px;
}

.panel-right .subtype-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3;
  cursor: help;
}

.panel-right .subtype-badge .subtype-id {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  opacity: 0.85;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}

.panel-right .subtype-badge .subtype-label {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── Eixos (Estágio 8) ──────────────────────────────────── */

.panel-right .narrative-axes {
  margin-top: 5px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.panel-right .axis-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  padding: 1px 4px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
}

.panel-right .axis-label {
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}

.panel-right .axis-sep {
  color: var(--fg-muted);
}

.panel-right .axis-value {
  color: var(--fg-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ── Traits (Estágio 8) ─────────────────────────────────── */

.panel-right .narrative-traits {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 3px;
  margin-top: 5px;
}

.panel-right .trait-pill {
  font-size: 9px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.panel-right .trait-pill.trait-positive {
  background: rgba(56, 161, 105, 0.10);
  color: #2f855a;
  border-color: rgba(56, 161, 105, 0.25);
}

.panel-right .trait-pill.trait-negative {
  background: rgba(214, 158, 46, 0.10);
  color: #975a16;
  border-color: rgba(214, 158, 46, 0.25);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .panel-right .trait-pill.trait-positive {
    background: rgba(56, 161, 105, 0.15);
    color: #9ae6b4;
  }
  .panel-right .trait-pill.trait-negative {
    background: rgba(214, 158, 46, 0.15);
    color: #fbd38d;
  }
}

/* ── Propostas (Estágio 8) ──────────────────────────────── */

.panel-right .narrative-proposals {
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.panel-right .narrative-proposal-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  font-size: 11px;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.panel-right .proposal-kind {
  font-size: 9px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  color: var(--accent-strong);
}

.panel-right .proposal-kind-create { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.panel-right .proposal-kind-rule   { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
.panel-right .proposal-kind-link   { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
.panel-right .proposal-kind-mutate { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-strong); }

.panel-right .proposal-source {
  font-size: 9px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.panel-right .proposal-source-subtype { background: rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.10); color: #1e40af; }
.panel-right .proposal-source-axis    { background: rgba(113, 128, 150, 0.10); color: #2d3748; }
.panel-right .proposal-source-user    { background: rgba(56, 161, 105, 0.10); color: #166534; }
.panel-right .proposal-source-rule    { background: rgba(214, 158, 46, 0.10); color: #92400e; }

.panel-right .proposal-command {
  flex: 1;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
  word-break: break-all;
  min-width: 0;
}

.panel-right .narrative-diagnostics {
  margin-top: 10px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GRAPH RENDERER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.panel-right .graph-container {
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.graph-renderer {
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.graph-title {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

.graph-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  overflow: visible;
}

.graph-svg .graph-axis {
  stroke: var(--border-mid);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.graph-svg .graph-grid {
  stroke: var(--border-light);
  stroke-width: 1;
  stroke-dasharray: 2 3;
}

.graph-svg .graph-line {
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.graph-svg .graph-dot {
  fill: var(--accent);
  stroke: var(--bg-primary);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  transition: r 0.1s ease, fill 0.1s ease;
}

.graph-svg .graph-dot:hover {
  r: 5;
  fill: var(--accent-strong);
}

.graph-svg .graph-label {
  fill: var(--fg-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
}

.graph-empty {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 24px 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FLOATING MENU (autocomplete)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.narrative-floating-menu {
  position: fixed;
  min-width: 240px;
  max-width: 420px;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  z-index: 10000000;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 13px;
  display: none;
}

.narrative-floating-menu.visible {
  display: block;
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-header {
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item {
  padding: 7px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item:hover,
.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item.selected {
  background: var(--bg-active);
  color: var(--accent-strong);
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-label {
  flex: 1;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-meta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  color: var(--accent-strong);
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-empty {
  padding: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.narrative-floating-menu.mode-hierarchy .menu-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-arrow {
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-left: 4px;
}

.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-package          { background: #e0e7ff; color: #3730a3; }
.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-category         { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-set              { background: #cffafe; color: #155e75; }
.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-phrase           { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-placeholder-term { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-package          { background: #312e81; color: #c7d2fe; }
  .narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-category         { background: #1e3a8a; color: #bfdbfe; }
  .narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-set              { background: #164e63; color: #a5f3fc; }
  .narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-phrase           { background: #14532d; color: #bbf7d0; }
  .narrative-floating-menu .menu-item-badge.badge-placeholder-term { background: #78350f; color: #fde68a; }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HISTORY PANEL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.history-panel {
  position: fixed;
  top: 90px;
  right: 30px;
  width: 360px;
  max-height: 640px;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  z-index: 10000002;
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.history-panel.visible {
  display: flex;
}

.history-header {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
  color: var(--fg-inverse);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.history-search {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
}

.history-search input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
}

.history-list {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  min-height: 0;
}

.history-entry {
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.history-entry:hover,
.history-entry.selected {
  background: var(--bg-active);
}

.history-entry.current {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
}

.history-entry.undone {
  opacity: 0.5;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}

.history-entry-tick {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--accent-strong);
  font-weight: 600;
  min-width: 36px;
}

.history-entry-summary {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

.history-footer {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ROLL OVERLAY
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.roll-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  z-index: 99999998;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--fg-inverse);
}

.roll-overlay.visible { display: flex; }

.roll-header {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #a78bfa;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.roll-lines {
  width: 720px;
  max-width: 90vw;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.roll-line {
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #1e1e2e;
  border: 2px solid #3b3b5c;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.roll-line.roll-active  { border-color: #7c3aed; background: #2a1a4e; }
.roll-line.roll-fixed   { border-color: #16a34a; background: #14271e; opacity: 0.9; }
.roll-line.roll-pending { opacity: 0.45; }

.roll-cat-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #4b5563;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  min-width: 36px;
  text-align: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.roll-line.roll-active .roll-cat-badge { background: #7c3aed; }
.roll-line.roll-fixed .roll-cat-badge  { background: #16a34a; }

.roll-text {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

.roll-line.roll-pending .roll-text {
  color: #6b7280;
  font-style: italic;
}

.roll-footer {
  margin-top: 22px;
  color: #9ca3af;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.roll-footer kbd {
  background: #374151;
  color: #e5e7eb;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PLAY OVERLAY
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.play-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: #0d0d1a;
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  z-index: 99999997;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: #e5e7eb;
  padding: 40px;
}

.play-overlay.visible { display: flex; }

.play-header {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #a78bfa;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.play-text {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  padding: 12px 0;
}

.play-input-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  border-top: 1px solid #374151;
  padding-top: 12px;
}

.play-input-row .prompt { color: #7c3aed; font-weight: 700; }

.play-input-row input {
  flex: 1;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #e5e7eb;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   COMMAND GUIDE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.command-guide {
  position: fixed;
  top: 90px;
  left: 30px;
  width: 460px;
  max-height: 640px;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  z-index: 10000001;
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
}

.command-guide.visible { display: flex; }

.command-guide-header {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
  color: var(--fg-inverse);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.command-guide-content {
  padding: 12px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.command-guide-content .guide-section { margin-bottom: 14px; }

.command-guide-content .guide-section-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.command-guide-content .guide-line {
  padding: 5px 8px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TOAST
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  z-index: 10000003;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.toast {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  color: var(--fg-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  pointer-events: auto;
  max-width: 340px;
  animation: toast-in 0.2s ease;
}

.toast.error   { border-color: var(--danger); }
.toast.success { border-color: var(--success); }
.toast.warning { border-color: var(--warn); }

.toast.fadeout { animation: toast-out 0.2s ease forwards; }

@keyframes toast-in {
  from { transform: translateX(40px); opacity: 0; }
  to   { transform: translateX(0);    opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes toast-out {
  from { transform: translateX(0);    opacity: 1; }
  to   { transform: translateX(40px); opacity: 0; }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MODAL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 10000004;
}

.modal-overlay.visible { display: flex; }

.modal-box {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 20px;
  min-width: 380px;
  max-width: 560px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
}

.modal-box .modal-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

.modal-box .modal-body {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--fg-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.modal-box .modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.modal-box .modal-btn {
  padding: 7px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: none;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.modal-box .modal-btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
.modal-box .modal-btn.primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--fg-inverse); }
.modal-box .modal-btn.danger  { background: var(--danger); color: var(--fg-inverse); }
.modal-box .modal-btn.ghost   { background: var(--bg-secondary); color: var(--fg-primary); }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FOCUS / ERROR
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.panel-focus {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent);
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

.error-flash { animation: flash-error 0.4s ease; }

@keyframes flash-error {
  0%, 100% { background: transparent; }
  50%      { background: var(--bg-error); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DIAGNOSTICS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.panel-right .diag-summary {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  padding: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.panel-right .diag-metric {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 70px;
}

.panel-right .diag-metric-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.panel-right .diag-metric-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

.panel-right .diag-metric-value.warn  { color: var(--warn); }
.panel-right .diag-metric-value.error { color: var(--danger); }

.panel-right .diag-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  margin-left: 4px;
}

.panel-right .diag-badge.info  { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-strong); }
.panel-right .diag-badge.warn  { background: #fff3bf; color: #975a16; }
.panel-right .diag-badge.error { background: #fed7d7; color: #822727; }

.panel-right .diag-event-line {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--border-mid);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.panel-right .diag-event-line.info  { border-color: var(--accent); }
.panel-right .diag-event-line.warn  { border-color: var(--warn); }
.panel-right .diag-event-line.error { border-color: var(--danger); }

.panel-right .diag-events-list {
  max-height: 400px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.panel-right .diag-markdown {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

.panel-right .diag-markdown h1,
.panel-right .diag-markdown h2,
.panel-right .diag-markdown h3 { color: var(--fg-primary); }

.panel-right .diag-markdown code {
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0 3px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.9em;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   NARRATIVE OVERLAY
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.narrative-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 10000005;
  min-width: 280px;
  max-width: 360px;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
  display: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.narrative-overlay.visible {
  display: block;
  animation: narrative-overlay-in 0.12s ease;
}

@keyframes narrative-overlay-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.narrative-overlay-header {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d69e2e, #b7791f);
  color: var(--fg-inverse);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 12px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.narrative-overlay-close {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--fg-inverse);
  font-size: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0 4px;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.narrative-overlay-close:hover { opacity: 1; }

.narrative-overlay-context {
  padding: 8px 12px 4px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-secondary);
  font-style: italic;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}

.narrative-overlay-question {
  padding: 10px 12px 6px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.narrative-candidate-list {
  padding: 0 8px 8px;
  max-height: 220px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.narrative-candidate {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg-primary);
  text-align: left;
}

.narrative-candidate:hover,
.narrative-candidate:focus {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  outline: none;
}

.narrative-candidate.current {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
}

.narrative-candidate.recommended {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--success);
}

.narrative-candidate.recommended::before {
  content: '✓ ';
  color: var(--success);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-right: 4px;
}

.narrative-candidate-label { flex: 1; font-weight: 500; }

.narrative-candidate-score {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--fg-muted);
  padding-left: 8px;
}

.narrative-overlay-learn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--fg-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
}

.narrative-overlay-footer {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 6px;
}

.narrative-overlay-btn {
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: none;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.narrative-overlay-btn.ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fg-secondary);
}

.narrative-overlay-btn.ghost:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--fg-primary);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   UTILITÁRIOS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.hidden { display: none !important; }
.invisible { visibility: hidden; }
.no-select { user-select: none; }
```

### projeto_narrative-write/ui/toast.js

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 5.2 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file toast.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Notificações temporárias no canto inferior direito.
 * @imports core/utils/dom
 * @importedBy boot.js, ui/*
 * @level 12
 *
 * Fase 13.6 — Dedup por chave:
 *   `show(msg, { key })` — se já existe um toast com a mesma chave,
 *   atualiza o conteúdo em lugar (não cria novo) e reinicia o timer.
 *   `dismiss(key)` — remove programaticamente por chave.
 *
 *   Isso evita empilhamento quando o mesmo diagnóstico é emitido
 *   repetidamente durante a digitação.
 */

import { el, clear } from '../core/utils/dom.js';

export class ToastManager {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} [container]
   */
  constructor(container = null) {
    this.container = container || this._createContainer();
    /** @type {HTMLElement[]} */
    this.active = [];
    /** @type {Map<string, HTMLElement>} key → node */
    this._keyed = new Map();
    /** @type {WeakMap<HTMLElement, number>} node → timer id */
    this._timers = new WeakMap();
    /** @type {WeakMap<HTMLElement, number>} node → duration */
    this._durations = new WeakMap();

    this.max = 4;
    this.defaultDuration = 3000;
  }

  /**
   * Mostra um toast. Se `key` for passado e já existir um toast com a
   * mesma chave, atualiza o existente em vez de criar novo.
   *
   * @param {string} message
   * @param {Object} [opts]
   * @param {'info'|'success'|'warning'|'error'} [opts.type='info']
   * @param {number} [opts.duration=3000]
   * @param {string|null} [opts.key=null]
   * @returns {HTMLElement}
   */
  show(message, opts = {}) {
    const {
      type = 'info',
      duration = this.defaultDuration,
      key = null,
    } = opts;

    // ── Dedup: se key existe, atualiza ─────────────────────
    if (key && this._keyed.has(key)) {
      const node = this._keyed.get(key);
      if (node && node.parentNode) {
        node.textContent = String(message);
        node.className = `toast ${type}`;

        // Reinicia timer
        const oldTimer = this._timers.get(node);
        if (oldTimer) clearTimeout(oldTimer);

        const newTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          this._remove(node);
        }, duration);
        this._timers.set(node, newTimer);
        this._durations.set(node, duration);

        return node;
      }
      // Node foi removido; limpa a entrada
      this._keyed.delete(key);
    }

    // ── Cria novo ──────────────────────────────────────────
    const node = el('div', { class: `toast ${type}` }, String(message));
    node.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';

    if (key) {
      node.dataset.toastKey = key;
      this._keyed.set(key, node);
    }

    this.container.appendChild(node);
    this.active.push(node);

    // Descarta o mais antigo se ultrapassar max
    while (this.active.length > this.max) {
      const oldest = this.active.shift();
      this._remove(oldest);
    }

    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      this._remove(node);
    }, duration);
    this._timers.set(node, timeout);
    this._durations.set(node, duration);

    node.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const t = this._timers.get(node);
      if (t) clearTimeout(t);
      this._remove(node);
    });

    return node;
  }

  /**
   * Atalhos por tipo.
   */
  info(msg, d, key)    { return this.show(msg, { type: 'info',    duration: d, key }); }
  success(msg, d, key) { return this.show(msg, { type: 'success', duration: d, key }); }
  warning(msg, d, key) { return this.show(msg, { type: 'warning', duration: d, key }); }
  error(msg, d, key)   { return this.show(msg, { type: 'error',   duration: d ?? 5000, key }); }

  /**
   * Remove um toast por chave.
   * @param {string} key
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  dismiss(key) {
    if (!key) return false;
    const node = this._keyed.get(key);
    if (!node) return false;

    this._keyed.delete(key);
    this._remove(node);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Verifica se um toast existe por chave.
   * @param {string} key
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  has(key) {
    const node = this._keyed.get(key);
    return !!node && !!node.parentNode;
  }

  /**
   * Limpa todos os toasts.
   */
  clear() {
    for (const node of [...this.active]) this._remove(node);
    this.active = [];
    this._keyed.clear();
  }

  // ── Internos ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  _createContainer() {
    const c = el('div', { class: 'toast-container' });
    document.body.appendChild(c);
    return c;
  }

  _remove(node) {
    if (!node || !node.parentNode) return;

    const idx = this.active.indexOf(node);
    if (idx >= 0) this.active.splice(idx, 1);

    // Limpa timer
    const t = this._timers.get(node);
    if (t) clearTimeout(t);

    // Limpa keyed
    const key = node.dataset.toastKey;
    if (key && this._keyed.get(key) === node) {
      this._keyed.delete(key);
    }

    node.classList.add('fadeout');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (node.parentNode) node.parentNode.removeChild(node);
    }, 200);
  }

  destroy() {
    this.clear();
    if (this.container?.parentNode) {
      this.container.parentNode.removeChild(this.container);
    }
  }
}
```

### projeto_narrative-write/ui/ui-wires.js

*Extensão:* `js` · *Tamanho:* 19.8 KB · *Tipo:* texto/código

```javascript
/**
 * @file ui-wires.js
 * @module ui
 * @description Wiring central de eventos do bus para a UI.
 * @imports core/utils/dom, systems/helpers/roll-picker
 * @importedBy boot.js, diagnostics/ui-harness
 * @level 12
 *
 * Fase 6 — Wiring narrativo.
 * Fase 13 — Autocomplete universal (`replaceRange`).
 * Fase 13.4 — Preview visual robusto.
 * Fase 13.6 — Diagnósticos narrativos com dedup:
 *   - Cada código de diagnóstico → UM toast (chave `narr-diag:<code>`).
 *   - Análise seguinte reconcilia: códigos que sumiram → toast removido.
 *   - Só `warning` e `error` são mostrados (`info` é silencioso).
 *   - Máximo de 5 toasts narrativos simultâneos.
 */

import { triggerDownload } from '../core/utils/dom.js';
import { RollPicker } from '../systems/helpers/roll-picker.js';

/**
 * Quantos toasts narrativos podem coexistir.
 * @type {number}
 */
const _MAX_NARRATIVE_TOASTS = 5;

/**
 * Duração de toasts narrativos (longa — não piscam).
 * @type {number}
 */
const _NARRATIVE_TOAST_MS = 6000;

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// createPlatformDOM
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export function createPlatformDOM(doc = document) {
  const platform = doc.createElement('div');
  platform.id = 'narrative-platform';
  platform.className = 'visible';

  const header = doc.createElement('div');
  header.className = 'narrative-header';

  const title = doc.createElement('div');
  title.textContent = 'Editor Narrativo ECS';
  header.appendChild(title);

  const actions = doc.createElement('div');
  actions.className = 'narrative-header-actions';

  const mkSpan = (attr, text = '') => {
    const s = doc.createElement('span');
    s.setAttribute(attr, '');
    s.textContent = text;
    return s;
  };
  actions.appendChild(mkSpan('data-tick', 'T0'));
  actions.appendChild(mkSpan('data-boot-mode', '—'));
  actions.appendChild(mkSpan('data-save-indicator', '●'));

  const mkBtn = (action, text, title) => {
    const b = doc.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'header-btn';
    b.setAttribute('data-action', action);
    if (title) b.title = title;
    b.textContent = text;
    return b;
  };

  actions.appendChild(mkBtn(
    'narrative-mode',
    '📖 OFF',
    'Modo narrativo — clique para ciclar (OFF → PRV → SUG → AUTO)'
  ));

  actions.appendChild(mkBtn('test', '🧪', 'Rodar bateria de testes automáticos (diag.test)'));
  actions.appendChild(mkBtn('guide', 'Comandos'));
  actions.appendChild(mkBtn('config', 'Config'));
  actions.appendChild(mkBtn('mode', '🌐'));

  header.appendChild(actions);
  platform.appendChild(header);

  const body = doc.createElement('div');
  body.className = 'narrative-body';

  const leftEl = doc.createElement('aside');
  leftEl.className = 'panel-left';
  body.appendChild(leftEl);

  const editorEl = doc.createElement('main');
  editorEl.className = 'editor-container';
  body.appendChild(editorEl);

  const rightEl = doc.createElement('aside');
  rightEl.className = 'panel-right';
  body.appendChild(rightEl);

  platform.appendChild(body);

  return { platform, header, leftEl, editorEl, rightEl };
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// wireUI
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export function wireUI(machine, app) {
  if (!machine || !machine.bus) {
    throw new Error('[wireUI] machine inválido');
  }

  const bus = machine.bus;
  const unsubs = [];
  const on = (event, handler) => {
    try {
      const unsub = bus.on(event, handler);
      unsubs.push(unsub);
    } catch { /* isola */ }
  };

  const {
    panelLeft, panelRight, floatingMenu, toast, editor, rollOverlay,
  } = app || {};

  // ── Estado interno: códigos de diagnóstico atualmente visíveis ──
  /** @type {Set<string>} */
  const narrativeDiagCodes = new Set();

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER BASE
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  on('render:left', (payload) => {
    if (!payload || !panelLeft) return;
    if (payload.kind === 'highlight' && Array.isArray(payload.ids)) {
      panelLeft.render?.();
      for (const id of payload.ids) panelLeft.pulse(id);
    } else if (payload.kind === 'tree') {
      panelLeft.render?.();
    }
  });

  on('render:right', (payload) => {
    panelRight?.update?.(payload);
  });

  on('render:annotation', (ann) => {
    if (ann && editor) editor.annotate(ann);
  });

  on('tick:advanced', ({ tick }) => {
    if (!app?.platform) return;
    const badge = app.platform.querySelector('[data-tick]');
    if (badge) badge.textContent = tick;
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // MENU FLUTUANTE
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  on('ui:menu:open', ({ trigger, items, cursor, mode, insertRange }) => {
    floatingMenu?.open?.({
      trigger,
      items,
      cursor,
      mode: mode ?? 'snippet',
      insertRange: insertRange ?? null,
    });
  });

  on('ui:menu:close', () => floatingMenu?.close?.());

  on('ui:snippet:insert', ({ text, replaceRange }) => {
    if (typeof text !== 'string' || text.length === 0 || !editor) return;

    if (replaceRange && typeof replaceRange.from === 'number') {
      try {
        editor.replaceRange(replaceRange.from, replaceRange.to, text);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[wireUI] replaceRange falhou:', err);
        editor.insert(text);
      }
    } else {
      editor.insert(text);
    }
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // PAINÉIS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  on('ui:panel:toggle', () => {
    if (typeof app?.togglePlatform === 'function') app.togglePlatform();
  });
  on('ui:panel:left:toggle', () => {
    const panel = app?.platform?.querySelector('.panel-left');
    if (panel) panel.style.display = panel.style.display === 'none' ? '' : 'none';
  });
  on('ui:panel:right:toggle', () => {
    const panel = app?.platform?.querySelector('.panel-right');
    if (panel) panel.style.display = panel.style.display === 'none' ? '' : 'none';
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ATALHOS / ROLL / ERROS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  on('ui:shortcut', ({ name }) => {
    if (toast && (name === 'undo' || name === 'redo')) {
      toast.info(`${name === 'undo' ? '↩ Desfeito' : '↪ Refeito'} (em breve)`, 1500);
    }
  });

  on('ui:roll:committed', ({ lines }) => {
    if (Array.isArray(lines) && lines.length > 0 && editor) {
      editor.insert(lines.join('\n') + '\n');
      toast?.success?.('Roll aplicado ao editor.');
    }
  });

  on('ui:roll:start', () => {
    if (!rollOverlay) return;
    const picker = new RollPicker(machine);
    const sequence = picker.defaultSequence();
    if (sequence.length === 0) {
      toast?.warning?.('Nada para rolar — crie sets e phrases primeiro.');
      return;
    }
    rollOverlay.setPicker((cat) => picker.pickNext(cat));
    rollOverlay.start({ sequence, interval: 800 });
  });

  on('ui:flash-error', ({ message }) => {
    toast?.error?.(message ?? 'Erro');
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // PERSISTÊNCIA
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  on('persist:saved', () => {
    const dot = app?.platform?.querySelector('[data-save-indicator]');
    if (dot) {
      dot.classList.add('pulse');
      setTimeout(() => dot.classList.remove('pulse'), 400);
    }
  });
  on('persist:failed', ({ error }) => {
    toast?.warning?.(`Falha ao salvar: ${error}`);
  });

  on('boot:complete', (info) => {
    const badge = app?.platform?.querySelector('[data-boot-mode]');
    if (badge) badge.textContent = info.mode === 'warm' ? '🌡 warm' : '❄ cold';
  });

  on('rule:fired', ({ affected }) => {
    toast?.info?.(`🔔 Regra disparou: ${affected?.length ?? 0} alvo(s)`, 2500);
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // EXPORT
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  on('export:ready', ({ blob, filename, format }) => {
    try {
      triggerDownload(blob, filename);
      if (format === 'pdf' || format === 'html') {
        toast?.info?.(
          `📄 ${filename} baixado. Abra e use Ctrl+P para salvar como PDF.`,
          6000
        );
      } else {
        toast?.success?.(`📦 Exportado: ${filename}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast?.error?.(`Falha ao exportar: ${err.message}`);
    }
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // BATERIA
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  on('test:battery:complete', (report) => {
    if (report?.summary?.ok) {
      toast?.success?.(
        `🧪 Bateria aprovada — ${report.summary.totalPassed}/${report.summary.totalPhases} fases`,
        4000
      );
    } else {
      toast?.warning?.(
        `🧪 Bateria reprovada — ${report?.summary?.totalFailed ?? '?'} falha(s)`,
        5000
      );
    }
  });

  on('test:battery:error', ({ error }) => {
    toast?.error?.(`🧪 Bateria falhou: ${error}`);
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // NARRATIVA — PREVIEW VISUAL (Fase 6 + 13.4 + 13.6)
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Helper: reconcilia os toasts narrativos com a lista atual de
   * códigos de diagnóstico. Remove os que sumiram.
   * @private
   */
  const reconcileNarrativeToasts = (currentCodes) => {
    for (const code of Array.from(narrativeDiagCodes)) {
      if (!currentCodes.has(code)) {
        try { toast?.dismiss?.(`narr-diag:${code}`); } catch { /* isola */ }
        narrativeDiagCodes.delete(code);
      }
    }
  };

  /**
   * Preview visual: aplica highlights + reconcilia toasts.
   */
  on('narrative:preview', (payload) => {
    if (!payload) return;

    // ── Reconciliação de toasts (removendo os que sumiram) ──
    const codes = new Set();
    const diags = Array.isArray(payload.ir?.diagnostics)
      ? payload.ir.diagnostics
      : [];
    for (const d of diags) {
      if (!d || typeof d.code !== 'string') continue;
      codes.add(d.code);
    }
    reconcileNarrativeToasts(codes);

    // ── Se IR vazio, limpa tudo ────────────────────────────
    if (!payload.acts?.length && !payload.spans?.length) {
      if (editor?.highlighter?.setNarrativeSpans) {
        try { editor.highlighter.setNarrativeSpans([]); } catch { /* isola */ }
      }
      return;
    }

    if (window.__NARRATIVE_DEBUG) {
      try {
        console.log('[wireUI] narrative:preview', {
          spans: payload.spans?.length ?? 0,
          acts: payload.acts?.length ?? 0,
          diagCodes: Array.from(codes),
        });
      } catch { /* isola */ }
    }

    if (!editor || !editor.highlighter) return;
    if (typeof editor.highlighter.setNarrativeSpans !== 'function') return;

    try {
      const acts = Array.isArray(payload.acts) ? payload.acts : [];
      const rawSpans = Array.isArray(payload.spans) ? payload.spans : [];

      const spans = rawSpans
        .map((sp) => {
          const sid = String(sp.id ?? '').split('.')[0];
          let act = acts.find((a) => a?.provenance?.sentenceId === sid);
          if (!act && acts.length === 1) act = acts[0];

          const operations =
            Array.isArray(act?.operations) && act.operations.length > 0
              ? act.operations
              : ['represent'];

          return {
            id: sp.id,
            start: sp.source?.start ?? sp.start,
            end: sp.source?.end ?? sp.end,
            raw: sp.raw,
            operations,
            primaryOperation: operations[0],
            confidence: typeof act?.confidence === 'number' ? act.confidence : 0.9,
            ambiguous: false,
          };
        })
        .filter((s) =>
          typeof s.start === 'number' &&
          typeof s.end === 'number' &&
          s.end > s.start
        );

      editor.highlighter.setNarrativeSpans(spans);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[wireUI] narrative:preview → highlighter falhou:', err);
    }
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // NARRATIVA — DIAGNÓSTICOS (Fase 13.6: dedup por código)
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /**
   * Diagnóstico narrativo: um toast por código, atualizado em lugar.
   *
   * Regras:
   *   - `info` → ignorado (silencioso)
   *   - `warning` / `error` → toast com chave `narr-diag:<code>`
   *   - Se já existe toast para o código → atualiza mensagem
   *   - Se o conjunto de códigos exceder `_MAX_NARRATIVE_TOASTS`,
   *     descarta silenciosamente os excedentes
   */
  on('narrative:diagnostic', (diag) => {
    if (!diag) return;

    const severity = diag.severity;
    if (severity !== 'warning' && severity !== 'error') {
      // `info` não polui
      return;
    }

    const code = String(diag.code ?? 'unknown');
    const key = `narr-diag:${code}`;
    const msg = diag.message ? `${code}: ${diag.message}` : code;
    const type = severity === 'error' ? 'error' : 'warning';

    // Limite de toasts simultâneos
    if (!narrativeDiagCodes.has(code) && narrativeDiagCodes.size >= _MAX_NARRATIVE_TOASTS) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      toast?.show?.(msg, {
        type,
        duration: _NARRATIVE_TOAST_MS,
        key,
      });
      narrativeDiagCodes.add(code);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[wireUI] falha ao mostrar diagnóstico:', err);
    }
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // NARRATIVA — SUGGEST / MODE
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  on('narrative:suggest', (payload) => {
    if (!panelRight) return;
    panelRight.update({
      kind: 'narrative',
      title: '📖 Propostas narrativas',
      data: {
        ir: payload.ir,
        proposals: payload.proposals,
      },
    });
  });

  on('narrative:degraded', ({ reason }) => {
    toast?.warning?.(`📖 Narrativa: ${reason}`, 4000, 'narr-degraded');
  });

  on('narrative:act:applied', ({ command }) => {
    if (window.__NARRATIVE_DEBUG) {
      console.log('[wireUI] ✅ act aplicado:', command);
    }
  });

  on('narr:override:set', ({ chose }) => {
    toast?.success?.(`Referência resolvida → ${chose}`, 2000, 'narr-override');
  });

  on('narr:mode:changed', ({ mode }) => {
    updateNarrativeButton(app?.platform, mode);
    // Ao trocar de modo, limpa todos os toasts narrativos
    for (const code of Array.from(narrativeDiagCodes)) {
      try { toast?.dismiss?.(`narr-diag:${code}`); } catch { /* isola */ }
      narrativeDiagCodes.delete(code);
    }
  });

  on('narr:act:focus', ({ act }) => {
    if (!act?.source || !editor) return;
    try {
      const ta = editor.textarea;
      if (!ta) return;
      const offset = act.source.start;
      ta.focus();
      ta.setSelectionRange(offset, offset);
      const before = ta.value.slice(0, offset);
      const lineIdx = (before.match(/\n/g) || []).length;
      const lineHeight = 20;
      ta.scrollTop = Math.max(0, (lineIdx - 3) * lineHeight);
    } catch { /* isola */ }
  });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RETORNO
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  return unsubs;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPERS EXPORTADOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Atualiza o rótulo do botão narrativo conforme o modo.
 * @param {HTMLElement} platform
 * @param {string} mode
 */
export function updateNarrativeButton(platform, mode) {
  if (!platform) return;
  const btn = platform.querySelector('[data-action="narrative-mode"]');
  if (!btn) return;

  const label = (() => {
    switch (mode) {
      case 'off':     return '📖 OFF';
      case 'preview': return '📖 PRV';
      case 'suggest': return '📖 SUG';
      case 'auto':    return '📖 AUTO';
      default:        return '📖 —';
    }
  })();

  btn.textContent = label;
  btn.title = `Modo narrativo: ${mode} (clique para ciclar)`;
  btn.classList.toggle('active', mode !== 'off');
}

/**
 * Cicla para o próximo modo narrativo.
 * @param {Object} machine
 * @returns {string} novo modo
 */
export function cycleNarrativeMode(machine) {
  try {
    const sys = machine?.systems?.get?.('NarrativeSystem');
    if (!sys) return 'off';

    const current = sys.getMode();
    const order = ['off', 'preview', 'suggest', 'auto'];
    const idx = order.indexOf(current);
    const next = order[(idx + 1) % order.length];

    machine.handleLine(`narr.${next}`);
    return next;
  } catch {
    return 'off';
  }
}
```
